name: B2Run Hannover
description: The B2Run Hannover on May 27, 2026, is a corporate run over a roughly 6.5 km long, mostly flat course along Lake Maschsee with a spectacular finish in the Heinz von Heiden Arena. The race is aimed at companies, organizations, and individual runners from Hannover and the surrounding area and promotes team spirit, motivation, and community feeling. The event offers a professional supporting program with moderation and music and is ideal for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners. The focus is on fun, camaraderie, and team building, not on personal best times.
course_highlights: Approximately 6.5 km long, varied loop course along Lake Maschsee
Mostly flat route suitable for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners
Spectacular finish in the Heinz von Heiden Arena
additional: The event is part of the nationwide B2Run corporate run series in Germany and offers a professional supporting program with moderation and music. Teams can run together to the finish to enjoy the event atmosphere. The event is ideal for team building, corporate health promotion, and active breaks outside of everyday work. 6.5 km course, team event, corporate run, finish in the Heinz-von-Heiden-Arena, personalized team running shirts, focus on team building and corporate fitness.

name: Seligenstädter Marathonstaffel
description: The 44th Seligenstadt Asklepios Marathon Relay is a unique relay race for teams of six from clubs, leisure groups, and companies, taking place on May 27, 2026, along the riverbank in Seligenstadt. The fast turnaround course along the Main promenade offers an attractive running route with start and finish at the newly redesigned festival square. The event is organized by LG Seligenstadt and the Friends of LG Seligenstadt e.V. and provides not only a sporting experience but also culinary catering with pasta dishes from MAIN'E KÜCHE. The bib number distribution and award ceremony will also take place at the festival square.
course_highlights: Fast turnaround course along the Main promenade
Start and finish at the newly redesigned festival square at Seligenstadt's Mainufer
Culinary catering with pasta dishes from MAIN'E KÜCHE
additional: Bib number distribution and award ceremony at the festival square; access via parking deck Grabenstraße 48 or parking lot Steinheimer Str. 47; catering with pasta dishes from MAIN'E KÜCHE Participants can compete in teams from clubs, leisure groups, and companies. The event takes place on May 27, 2026, and is part of LG Seligenstadt events. Start and award ceremony are at the Mainufer festival square.

name: Steglitzer Volkslauf
price_range: 5,00 € Nachmeldegebühr, sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt
description: The Steglitz Volkslauf is a traditional running event taking place on May 27, 2026, at the Lichterfelde Stadium in Berlin-Lichterfelde. Organized by TuS Lichterfelde von 1887 e.V., the Volkslauf offers a sporting opportunity for runners of all ages. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized execution. The races start and end at the Lichterfelde Stadium, providing an attractive setting for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lichterfelde Stadium
Running routes through the surroundings of Berlin-Lichterfelde
Traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Late registrations are possible online from May 25th (00:01) until 30 minutes before the respective start for a fee of €5.00. Certificates for places 1-3 will be handed out during the award ceremony; all finishers can request a certificate with their place and time after the last runner has finished. Multiple race distances, online registration, start times from 6:00 PM, certificates and age group classifications, event held as part of the Steglitz Festival Weeks.

name: Abendlauf Wilstedt bei Nacht
description: The Wilstedt Evening Run at Night takes place on May 29, 2026, and transforms the village of Wilstedt into an atmospheric running course. The event is family-friendly and open to everyone, from beginners to experienced runners. The new running route offers beautiful views of the village at night. The atmosphere is enhanced by cheering spectators and a fireworks display in the evening.
course_highlights: New running route through Wilstedt with scenic village views
Atmospheric setting with cheering spectators along the course
Floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt after the run until 10:30 PM
additional: Start and finish are at the Wilstedt sports grounds. The event begins with the mini-run at 8:15 PM, followed by jogging and walking starts. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM, then participation costs 9 euros. Only pre-registrants receive a T-shirt or functional shirt, which will be handed out on the event day. After the run, free floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt is available until 10:30 PM. A fireworks display will conclude the event around 10:45 PM. Nordic walking poles are not allowed on the course. Children and strollers are only permitted during walking/hiking. Shower and changing facilities are limited. New family-friendly evening run through Wilstedt, including mini-run, fireworks, and musical entertainment, registration until May 17.

name: Lauf Rund um Burg
description: The 37th Run Around Burg is part of the Cross and Forest Run Series and takes place around Burg in Dithmarschen. The event offers runners the opportunity to run on scenic routes of 4.8 km and 10 km. The race is characterized by its natural surroundings and varied course. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Running routes of 4.8 km and 10 km
Part of the Cross and Forest Run Series
Natural course around Burg
additional: Typical May weather conditions: approximately 20 °C, mostly cloudy, an average of 55 mm of precipitation. The run is part of a diverse sports program by MTV Burg, with registration via Yolawo. In good weather, children's and youth sports activities are also planned.

name: Michelstädter Stadtlauf
description: The Michelstadt City Run, organized by TSV Weiten-Gesäß, will take place on May 29, 2026, for the 41st time. The event offers, in addition to the traditional individual races over 5 km and 10 km, a new team race where four team members each run a relaxed 2.5 km lap. The city run is open to all age groups, including student and youth races, and promotes community spirit as well as the visibility of local businesses. The event is ideal for companies as a group activity and for runners seeking personal bests or sporting challenges.
course_highlights: New team race with 4 x 2.5 km laps
Classic individual races over 5 km and 10 km
Student and youth races for families
additional: The new team race is a special highlight and suitable for all fitness levels. The times of the team members are added together for the total time. The event promotes team spirit and offers a healthy change from the work routine. Runners can choose between 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, and team races; online registration is possible. The race is approved by the DLV and is part of the Michelstadt Bee Market.

name: Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf
description: The Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf is a charity run with the unique concept "Sport meets Music" in support of the Children's Hospice Middle Germany. The event offers various running competitions for children, teenagers, companies, and individual participants as well as walkers. In addition to the sporting event, there is musical accompaniment and a children's garden concert, making the run a special experience for participants and spectators. Race bibs can be picked up the day before, and after the run, there is an AfterRöblinglaufParty.
course_highlights: Variety of runs for children, teenagers, companies, and individual participants
Charity run in support of the Children's Hospice Middle Germany
Musical accompaniment and children's garden concert
additional: Race bib pickup on 28.05.2026 from 15:30 to 18:00 at Schwanenteich in Mühlhausen. Runs with team scoring for children and companies. AfterRöblinglaufParty and children's garden concert as part of the program. Multiple children's, youth, and corporate runs, online registration from 11.01.2026, donations for the Children's Hospice Middle Germany, including music events and after-run party.

name: Nacht von Hasbergen
description: The Night of Hasbergen is a traditional road race taking place on Friday, May 29, 2026, in Hasbergen. The event offers exciting running competitions for all age groups, from the baby run to relay races and the main 10 km race. The races will be held on a new course layout, which has been adjusted due to construction work. The event begins with an opening ceremony and a show act for the children and concludes with award ceremonies for the various competitions.
course_highlights: New course layout due to construction on Tecklenburger Straße
Competitions from 0.5 km baby run to 10 km main race
Street closures and parking bans on the race route from 4:00 PM
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 3:30 PM for a late registration fee of 2 euros. The bib number distribution begins on the day of the event from 3:30 PM at the Citizens' Hall at the Town Hall, Hüggelplatz 1, 49205 Hasbergen. The event includes five competitions: 0.5 km baby run, relay race 5 x 0.5 km, half-distance 5 km (ranking eligible), elite race 5 km, and main race 10 km (ranking eligible). All proceeds from the baby run are donated 100% to youth work in Hasbergen. Various race distances, relay start numbers, late registrations on the day of the event, information on exchange points, online registration, course layout with construction detours.

name: Raesfelder Mai-Lauf
description: The Raesfeld May Run takes place annually on the last Friday in May and offers a diverse range of races for all age groups. From the 400 m Bambini races for preschool children to the 5 km and 10 km runs for adults, there is something for everyone. Additionally, there is a team race over 5 km that promotes the fun of running together. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and are therefore eligible for official rankings.
course_highlights: 400 m child-friendly course for Bambinis
1000 m and 2.3 km courses for children and adolescents
5 km and 10 km DLV-measured courses for adults
additional: Start times: 4:00 PM Bambini races (400 m), 5:00 PM 1000 m school race, 5:30 PM 2.3 km school race, 6:00 PM 10 km Volksbank Run, 6:05 PM 5 km walking run, 7:30 PM 5 km corporate, family, and team run. The 10 km course is run as a 5 km lap twice. Part of the Lippe-Issel Cup, registration required, family-friendly, various categories.

name: VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf
description: The VfL Ahaus City Festival Run takes place on May 29, 2026, and offers runners a well-tested and attractive course in the city of Ahaus. The race is organized by VfL Ahaus 1892 e.V., one of the leading amateur sports clubs in the Münsterland region. The event is open to runners of all ages and features a friendly atmosphere with a focus on health and community. The course has been carefully explored and approved by the VfL Ahaus Running Group, ensuring participants can look forward to a great running experience.
course_highlights: Course tested and approved by the VfL Ahaus Running Group
Attractive city course in Ahaus
Event focused on health and community
additional: Registration opens on March 15, 2026. There are still starting places available. The run takes place as part of the city festival. VfL Ahaus, in cooperation with AOK, also offers functional training courses. The routes are not officially measured; registration begins on March 15, 2026; spots are still available; the event is part of the city festival with a diverse supporting program.

description: The Volksbank Run "Around the Offlumer See" is a traditional running event in Neuenkirchen, Lower Saxony, taking place on May 29, 2026. The course runs around the Offlumer See with start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg. Various races are offered for all age groups, from the toddler run to school runs and the main 10 km race. The event is organized by the SuS 09 Neuenkirchen running club and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with registration on the day of the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg
Course around the Offlumer See, measured by DLV for the 10 km main race
Various distances from 300 m toddler run to 10 km main race
additional: Registration on the day of the event is possible until 30 minutes before each start. Race documents can be picked up from 3:00 PM at the registration tent. Timing is provided by Teamsoft-Sportzeit. Races start in staggered times from 4:00 PM (toddler run) to 7:00 PM (main race). The course runs around the Offlumer See. Registration on the day of the event is possible. Parking is available at the Naturfreibad and Offlumer See.

name: 08. Dünenfeld Marathon
description: The Dünenfeld Marathon in Augustdorf is a special race organized according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.1 km each, totaling 42.7 km, and features some trail sections. The start is located at the viewpoint, from where runners can enjoy a beautiful view of the large dune fields. The event is a private race with self-supply and manual timing, requiring a photo of the clock as proof to be submitted via email.
course_highlights: 7 loops of 6.1 km with trail sections
Start at the viewpoint with a view of the dune fields
Course runs parallel to the dune field and Ölbach
additional: The race takes place with a minimum of 3 participants. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested. Timing is done with a manual stopwatch, and a photo of the clock must be sent on the same day via email. No showers or changing rooms are available. Participants must be at least 18 years old. The course is marked with ribbon. Self-supply is required, as the start area is passed after each lap. Trail character, self-supply, no showers/changing rooms, participation at own risk, limited number of participants, registration until the day before at 6 pm.

name: 19. Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Run Between the Seas is a unique relay race that takes participants as a team on a 92.2-kilometer route from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The course crosses Schleswig-Holstein and connects the coasts of both seas, with up to ten athletes per team running together. The race promotes both individual performance and community and attracts up to 800 teams from amateur and elite sports. The fastest relay teams take about 5 hours and 10 minutes to reach the finish line around 2:15 PM.
course_highlights: 92.2-kilometer route from Husum to Damp
10 varied stages with distances between 6.9 and 11.5 kilometers
Course passes through flat North Frisia, historic towns, along the Schlei fjord, and through the end-moraine landscape of Schwansen
additional: The entry fee is per team (5-10 runners). Teams registering for the corporate classification pay an additional 19% VAT. Race materials can be sent by mail (shipping option available until March 31, 2026) or collected at two pick-up dates (May 22, 10 AM - 6 PM, May 29, 1 PM - 8 PM). The race starts in Husum at the harbor pier, organized by LAV Husum. The course includes 10 exchange points and is partially temporarily closed for railway crossings. Relay marathon, registration opens June 13, 2025, various stages, team and individual participation, catering and accommodation on site.

name: 3. Abend-Kanallauf Rethmar
location: Sportgelände des MTV Rethmar, Sehnde, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: MTV Rethmar von 1900 e.V. - Sparte Laufen
description: The 3rd Evening Canal Run Rethmar 2026 is a versatile running event at the sports grounds of MTV Rethmar in Sehnde. Offered are distances from 400 meters for children up to the Kalimandscharo half marathon over 21.1 km. The 5 km and 10 km routes are measured and record-eligible, with a slight cross-country character. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is open to runners of all ages, regardless of club affiliation.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km routes with a slight cross-country character
Half marathon route Kalimandscharo over 21.1 km
Diverse routes from 400 m for children to half marathon
additional: Late registration fee of 3.00 EUR is waived for 400m and 1,500m for all age groups U18. The 5 km and 10 km routes are measured and record-eligible. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Age group classification according to DLO. Routes measured, cross-country character, online registration, results published after the race, participation in all weather, various age classes.

name: 34. Emder Matjeslauf
description: The 34th Emder Matjeslauf will take place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, in the city center of Emden. The event is a traditional city run organized by the Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. since 1991 and is well known beyond the region. In addition to the main race over 10 km, there are also school class competitions and team rankings, making the run a versatile event for all age groups. The course has been adjusted due to construction work on Neutorstraße but still offers an attractive loop through the city. The Emder Laufgemeinschaft looks forward to many participants and wishes everyone good luck.
course_highlights: Loop through the city center of Emden
New course layout due to construction on Neutorstraße
Traditional city run since 1991
additional: The Wattje Loop over 600 meters is limited to 400 participants. There are school class competitions over 1,300 m and 2,500 m as well as a team competition over 5 km. Starting documents and functional shirts will be distributed; cotton or functional shirts can be ordered for Wattje runners while supplies last. Multiple race distances, participant limit of 400 for Wattje Loop, various race times, fixed date on 30.05.2026.

name: 55. Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest fun run in North Hesse and will take place on May 30, 2026, at the Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children's and school runs over 400 m and 1000 m, as well as races over 5 km, 10 km, and 19 km, which lead on firm paths through the Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race of the North Hesse Cup, the run offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies, and a buffet. The start and finish areas are centrally located in the Waldstadion, which also offers changing facilities.
course_highlights: Runs on firm paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen on the edge of the city forest
Course lengths: 5 km, 10 km, and 19 km as well as children's runs on the track
additional: Race number pickup from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse in the Waldstadion. Late registrations on the day of the event are not possible. Changing rooms are available in the MT clubhouse. Refreshments with water on the long distances, warm tea at the finish, and from 15:30 onwards, a buffet with coffee, cake, and bratwurst. Medical services provided by the German Red Cross. Certificates and medals for Bambini and 1000 m runs, certificate printing available on-site or online. The event is subject to the applicable regulations for road and stadium-remote running events. Registration online via RaceResult. Event at Waldstadion Melsungen, including award ceremonies, refreshments, and medical support.

name: 6. Wehrheimer Backyard Ultra
description: The Wehrheimer Backyard Ultra (WEHBU) takes place on May 30, 2026, for the sixth time. This private event in a family setting is only accessible by personal invitation, as start and finish areas are located on private property. The course runs over gravel and asphalt paths with some challenging elevation changes and offers a fantastic view of Wehrheim and the Taunus mountains, including the Feldberg. A special challenge is the "Meadow of Horror," which can be muddy depending on the weather. The winner receives an original Bembel as a trophy, fitting with Wehrheim's secondary name as the "Apple Village."
course_highlights: Course on gravel and asphalt paths
Challenging elevation changes with views of Wehrheim and the Taunus mountains including Feldberg
Famous "Meadow of Horror" at the end of each lap, muddy depending on weather
additional: Participation only possible by personal invitation from the organizer; start and finish areas on private property; the event is a family-oriented, private race with high demand and a long waiting list; the winner receives an original Bembel as a trophy. Private event, invitation required, challenging course with elevation changes, muddy meadow, view of the Taunus mountains, trophy for the winner.

name: HafenCity Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld von 34€ trägt jeder selbst.

description: The HafenCity Run 2026 is a community run at a relaxed pace over a 4 km course through HafenCity Hamburg. There are no prerequisites or timing, with fun and shared experience taking center stage. The run combines recreational sports, team spirit, and charity, with part of the registration fee donated. Participants receive a DAV shirt and can run from age 6 onwards.
course_highlights: 4 km course through HafenCity Hamburg
Running without performance pressure or timing
Charity event with donation share per bib and team
additional: The start window is from 1 PM to 2 PM. There is no time limit or performance pressure. 6 euros from each registration fee and an additional 10 euros per team are donated to the charity fund. Participants receive a DAV shirt, with shirt size to be specified at registration. The run is open to everyone from age 6, with an entry fee of 34 euros, including a DAV shirt. There are no pre-meetings, and the run takes place on May 30, 2026, between 1 PM and 2 PM. The course is approximately 4 km long and runs through HafenCity, focusing on fun and community.

name: Aegidius-Lauf
location: Aegidiushaus, Auf der Bul, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Aegidius Run is a charity race established for over 20 years in Hanover, taking place on May 30, 2026. The event offers several race distances, including children's runs, a wheelchair race, as well as 5 km and 10 km runs and walking variants. Start and finish are at the Aegidiushaus ON THE BULT, and the participation fees go entirely to a good cause. The race course is attractive and is conducted without chip timing, using a stopwatch. All participants receive a certificate, and the top male and female runners are awarded prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aegidiushaus ON THE BULT in Hanover
Attractive race course with multiple distances (1 km children's run, 5 km, 10 km)
Stopwatch timing without chip timing, certificates for all participants
additional: There is no chip timing, but a stopwatch. All participants receive a certificate, the top three women and men receive prizes. Race shirts will be handed out at the info booths starting at 14:00. The participation fee of 15 euros per adult race goes entirely to a good cause. Children's runs and wheelchair race are free. The event begins with children's runs from 14:00, followed by the 5 km runs and walking at 15:15, and the 10 km run at 16:15. Multiple race distances, online registration, certificates for all, prizes for the top three men and women, no chip timing, race on the backside of the Aegidius-Haus in Hanover.

name: Allbaulauf 2026
description: The AllbauLauf 2026 will take place on May 30th around Niederfeldsee and Krupp-Park in Altendorf, Essen. The event offers a colorful mix of races for students, youth, corporate runners, recreational runners, and competitive athletes. Especially popular are the short distances for toddlers and students, which run directly along the waterfront promenade and over a bridge. The event is a sporting highlight with a variety of running options for all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Around Niederfeldsee and Krupp-Park in Altendorf
Course for toddlers over 300 meters along the waterfront promenade and bridge
Diverse running options from students to competitive athletes
additional: The toddlers start at 12:00 PM on a 300-meter course. The University Championships of the University of Duisburg-Essen are held as part of the AllbauLauf, with registration through the university's sports department. The event includes distances of 300 meters for toddlers, 1 km for students, as well as 5 km and 10 km for adults. Registration is possible via the sports department of the University of Duisburg-Essen. There are also special offers for corporate runs and community events.

name: Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
location: Waldstadion Melsungen, Melsungen, Schwalm-Eder-Kreis, Hessen, Germany
price_range: Erwachsene 8,00 €, Jugendliche und Kinder 4,00 €, Bambini kostenlos
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest fun run in North Hesse and takes place on May 30, 2026, at the Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children's and school runs over 400 m and 1000 m, as well as main runs over 5 km, 10 km, and 19 km, which lead on firm paths through the Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race of the North Hesse Cup, the run offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies, and a buffet. The start and finish areas are idyllically located on the edge of the city forest, making the run particularly attractive.
course_highlights: Runs on firm paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen on the edge of the city forest
Various distances from 400 m to 19 km
additional: Race bibs are issued from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse in the Waldstadion. Changing rooms are available in the MT clubhouse. Refreshments with water are provided on the long distances, warm tea at the finish, and from 15:30 onwards, a buffet with coffee, cake, and bratwurst. Medical services are provided by the German Red Cross. Late registrations on the day of the event are not possible. Certificates can be printed on-site or downloaded online via RaceResult. The courses run through the Melsungen city forest. Registration is only online, race bibs are collected at the clubhouse, no on-site late registration, refreshments at the finish area, medical services by the German Red Cross.

name: Charity Trail Mannebach 111
description: The Charity Trail Mannebach 111 is a challenging trail run taking place on May 30, 2026, in Mannebach. The event offers four distances ranging from 12 km to 48 km with varying elevation gains, passing through the scenic Traum Schleife. The course is diverse and includes refreshment points as well as a finisher medal for all participants. The entry fee is entirely donated to charitable organizations, making the race a special event with a social commitment.
course_highlights: Four distances: 12 km (343 meters elevation), 24 km (686 meters), 36 km (1029 meters), 48 km (1372 meters)
Refreshments after 4 km at the Aussichtspunkt Kolmet, after 8 km at the Lebensfluss, and at the start/finish area
Start and finish at the sports and recreation facility in 54441 Mannebach
additional: Race bib pickup from 07:30; briefing at 09:45; showers and changing rooms available at the sports and recreation facility; participation from 18 years old (younger only with guardians); maximum 99 participants per distance; manual timing, overall ranking by gross time; no late registrations on race day; entry fee fully donated; transfer to another distance possible up to three weeks before the race; on-course refreshments; a backpack or hydration vest with at least 1 liter of liquid and a personal cup recommended; disqualification for violations such as littering or route shortening. Trail running, support for charitable causes, multiple distances, online registration only, outdoor terrain.

name: Greifenstein Berglauf
organizer: Fussfit Petry GmbH, webconcept GbR, weitere lokale Sponsoren
description: The Greifenstein Mountain Run is a challenging road race over 5.3 km from Ehringshausen-Katzenfurt to Greifenstein Castle, taking place for the 27th time on May 30, 2026. The course runs along country roads and farm tracks with a total of 260 meters of elevation gain to the finish at the castle, which offers a breathtaking view of the region. The race is open to youth, men, women, and seniors, with a combined classification for all categories. Nordic walking is offered without age classifications, and a free Bambini race for the youngest children takes place separately in the afternoon. The event concludes with an award ceremony and refreshments in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle.
course_highlights: 5.3 km road race with 260 meters of elevation
Start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle with panoramic view
Challenging section above Edingen
additional: The registration fee includes bus transfer to the start, clothing transport to the finish, and drinks at both start and finish. Bib numbers and finisher shirts will be distributed on the event day from 14:00 in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle. Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start on the event day. Parking is available at the village exit of Greifenstein towards Beilstein. A free Bambini race for children will be offered around 16:50, accompanied by members of LG Dill. The award ceremony and refreshments with coffee, cake, cold drinks, and bratwurst will take place in the castle courtyard. On clear days, the courtyard offers an impressive view over the Dill valley to the Feldberg in the Taunus. Registration is open until May 28, 2026, online. Start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle. The race is without relay and walking categories. Results are available since 2008.

name: HIT-felder Volkslauf
description: The HIT-felder Volkslauf is a traditional race in Seevetal organized by TSV Eintracht Hittfeld. It offers courses for the whole family, from short runs on the Peperdieksberg sports facility to longer routes on field and forest paths. The event takes place on May 30, 2026, starting at 1:30 PM and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere with a comprehensive supporting program. All participants receive a finisher medal, and there are team rankings as well as cash prizes for the strongest pre-registered groups.
course_highlights: Courses on field and forest paths as well as partially asphalted side streets
Runs over 600 m, 1000 m, 2.5 km, 4.5 km, 10.6 km with small and large laps
Electronic timing, spikes not allowed
additional: Start and finish at the Hittfeld School Center, Sportanlage Peperdieksberg. Changing rooms and showers available at the school center. Late registrations on the day of the event are possible up to 30 minutes before the start for cash payment (except Roland-Witt-Familienlauf). Supporting program with coffee, cake, grilled sausages, and drinks. Certificates available online at www.stgk.de. Team rankings in certain runs. The most registered group receives a challenge cup and cash prizes. The event takes place in May, with typical weather around 20°C low and 10°C high, and offers not only running routes but also children's runs, walking, and Nordic walking.

name: Illinger City-Lauf
description: The Illingen City Run is a traditional running event in Illingen organized by the Wustweiler Cross-Country Community e.V. The course runs through the town of Illingen with start and finish at the Illingen Indoor Pool. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with an award ceremony and a cozy get-together on the hall's forecourt. Showers, parking facilities, and medical services are available on site, and the runs are insured by the Saarland State Sports Association.
course_highlights: Course route through the city center of Illingen
Start and finish at the Illingen Indoor Pool
Turn points at Illipse, Wemmetsweiler, and Burgenweg
additional: Non-binding online pre-registration is possible until the day of the event, late registrations until approximately 30 minutes before the start without an additional fee. Bib number distribution begins at 14:30 at the indoor pool. Certificates can be printed online or on-site. Showers available at the indoor pool. Medical services and parking are available on site. Photo and video recordings for public relations purposes. Bib number distribution from 14:30, award ceremony and communal gathering with food and drinks on the hall's forecourt, on-site parking, showers at the indoor pool, medical services, photo and video recordings for publicity.

name: Internationaler Biesfelder Dorflauf
location: Kürten, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 3,00 € Nachmeldegebühr ab 23.05.2026, sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Online-Anmeldung ist bis zum 28.05.2026 möglich!

description: The International Biesfelder Village Run is a traditional running event in the municipality of Kürten, taking place on May 30, 2026. The race is characterized by its hilly course, which challenges runners and carries the slogan "Flat is elsewhere." Various distances, including children's and school runs, offer suitable competitions for all age groups. The event is organized by Biesfeld Triathlon e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with start and finish at the community elementary school in Biesfeld.
course_highlights: Hilly run in the municipality of Kürten with challenging inclines
Course lengths from 0.6 km (children) to 9.2 km (main race)
Start and finish on the schoolyard of the community elementary school in Biesfeld
additional: Race documents will be issued on race day on the schoolyard of the community elementary school in Biesfeld. No separate chip is needed for timing, as the chip is integrated into the bib (RaceResult). From May 23, 2026, a late registration fee of €3.00 will be charged; late registrations are possible on-site on race day. Distances: 0.6 km, 2.1 km, 9.2 km; online registration until May 28, 2026; bib with chip; event in Kürten-Biesfeld.

name: Johannes-Lauf Lette
location: Ernsting's family Sportpark, Lette, Coesfeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Johanneslauf in Lette is a traditional running event that has been held annually since 1998 at the Ernsting's family Sportpark. The race attracts participants from the entire region and is a fixed part of the regional sports calendar. Organized by DJK Vorwärts Lette e.V., a club with a long tradition and strong commitment to amateur sports, the event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ernsting's family Sportpark
Race over 5 kilometers
Tradition since 1998 with regional significance
additional: The race is part of the Streiflicher race series, with around 400 participants in previous events, including a 5 km walking route.

name: Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Run Between the Seas is a unique relay race that takes participants as teams from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The 92.2-kilometer route is divided into ten stages that pass through the diverse landscape of Schleswig-Holstein. Besides individual performance, the focus is on the team effort. The race not only connects the coasts but also the people of the region and offers a special running experience for both recreational and elite athletes.
course_highlights: 92.2 kilometer route in 10 stages from Husum to Damp
Crossing through flat North Frisia, Viking cultural monument Waldemar's Wall, and Schloss Gottorf
Final section through rolling end-moraine landscape of Schwansen with finish on the Baltic Sea beach
additional: Start is at the harbor in Husum (Ship Bridge). The fastest teams require approximately 5 hours and 10 minutes to reach the finish around 2:15 PM. The race materials can be sent by mail or picked up on specific days on site. There is a clothing transport and bus shuttle service. The event includes a pasta and runners' party. The route passes through ten exchange points with distances between 6.9 and 11.5 kilometers. Distance: 92.2 km, team relay race, registration opens June 13, 2025, various stages and exchange points, catering and accommodation available.

name: Leegebrucher Straßenlauf am 30.05.2026
price_range: Kinder frei; Jugendliche 3 Euro; Erwachsene 4 Euro
description: The Leegebruch Street Run takes place on May 30, 2026, and is a traditional running event in Leegebruch that appeals to runners of almost all ages. Participants run laps on the sports field and the streets of Leegebruch. The event promises a lively atmosphere and is open to athletes of all performance levels. Registration is done online via an external platform.
course_highlights: Laps on the sports field and the streets of Leegebruch
Traditional running event with a family-friendly character
Suitable for runners of almost any age
additional: Registration is exclusively online; on-site late registration is not possible. There are no age categories and no award ceremony. Changing rooms and showers are not available. Refreshments include cold and warm drinks as well as snacks at the kiosk. Parking is available at the festival meadow on Lindenstraße. Running on streets and in the stadium, online registration, no changing rooms or showers, parking at Lindenstraße.

name: Limbacher Marktlauf
description: The Limbacher Marktlauf takes place on May 30, 2026, for the 30th time at the Waldstadion Limbach-Oberfrohna. The event offers a great running atmosphere with new courses, new competitions, and a finisher medal. In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a comprehensive supporting program. The race is organized by LV Limbach 2000 e.V. and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Start at Waldstadion Limbach-Oberfrohna
New courses and competitions in the anniversary year
Finisher medal for all participants
additional: The race offers a finisher medal and a comprehensive supporting program. Registration is via Triathlonservice.de. Organizer is LV Limbach 2000 e.V. The event features various race distances, registration until 27.05.2026, start at Waldstadion, finisher medals, and a supporting program.

name: Nienburger Spargellauf
description: The Nienburg Asparagus Run is a traditional race held on May 30, 2026, in Nienburg, offering various distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The courses are officially measured and lead over flat, partly shaded loops with start and finish at the Wesavi parking lot. In addition to individual and children's runs, there is also a 10 km relay race as well as corporate and club competitions. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prizes for the top runners.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured loops of 2.5 km each
Start and finish at the Wesavi parking lot in Nienburg
Partly shaded course
additional: Start and finish are at the Wesavi parking lot in Nienburg. The children's runs start at 1:00 PM, the 10 km relay race at 3:00 PM, the 5 km Asparagus Run at 4:45 PM, and the 10 km Asparagus Run at 6:00 PM. Timing is electronic with gross and net times. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with tiered late registration fees. The course is flat and partly shaded. Prizes are awarded for top placements. The race also includes children's and relay runs, with prizes for placements. Registration is available online, and the event is very popular among participants.

name: SV Greven Deichlauf
description: The SV Greven Deichlauf on May 30, 2026, offers an unforgettable running experience along the idyllic Ems dike and through the city forest. The nature-oriented course is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes and is accompanied by numerous spectators. A total of approximately 1,000 runners participate, seeking both a sporting challenge and a nature experience.
course_highlights: Round course from Emsaue Stadium along the Ems dike
Course passes through the city forest
Nature-oriented running route with many spectators
additional: Running event, round course, nature experience, approx. 1000 participants, official timing, medals for children and age groups

name: Turm zu Turm Lauf
price_range: Nachmeldegebühr 2,00 € (bei Nachmeldung vor Ort), sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt
description: The 21st Tower to Tower Run on May 30, 2026, in Georgsmarienhütte offers runners a varied and scenic experience. The main route of 24 kilometers connects the prominent viewpoints Hermannsturm and Varusturm and passes through forest sections with around 520 meters of elevation gain. Additionally, there are races for children, a fun run, a 10-kilometer landscape run, and a walking course. The event is a sporting highlight of the Osnabrück and Westphalia region and offers suitable routes for all age and performance levels.
course_highlights: 24 km route with approximately 520 meters of elevation between Hermannsturm and Varusturm
10 km landscape run with approximately 252 meters of elevation through forest and park
3.4 km fun run with approximately 66 meters of elevation through Kasinopark
additional: Baby race (400 m) starts at 14:30, children's race (1000 m) at 14:45, fun run (3.4 km) at 15:10, landscape run (10 km) at 15:00, walking course (6.4 km) starts around 15:12. Certificates for baby and school runs available on-site, longer distances also available online. The races are part of the ACTIVE Triple Pack series and the Sparkasse Cup. Routes: 400 m baby, 1000 m children, 3.3 km fun run, 10 km landscape, 24 km Tower to Tower, 6.4 km walk; registration until 28.05.2026; sustainable event with foldable cups; refreshments with water, tea, cola, bananas, coffee, cake, sausages; no dogs or baby joggers allowed.

name: Wälster Lauf
description: The Walstedde Run is a traditional folk and road race in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde, organized annually by Fortuna Walstedde. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and offers an attractive opportunity for runners and walkers of all ages to engage in sports. The event traditionally opens the sports week in Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract a steadily growing number of participants. Besides the sporting competition, fun in movement and community are also central themes.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde
Folk and road race with various distances
Traditional opening of the sports week in Lambertusdorf Walstedde
additional: The Walstedde Run offers races and walking events on a DLV-measured course. The event includes various age groups and distances, such as a children's run, school runs, fun run, 5 km and 10 km road races, as well as walking. Start times are staggered from 15:30 to 17:15. The event opens the sports week in Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to enjoy increasing participant numbers. It is a well-established running tradition in the region, known for its accurate and fair courses. Suitable for both hobby runners and ambitious competitors.

name: 10K Hamburg - Elbe
description: The 10K Hamburg - Elbe is an exciting 10-kilometer race taking place at attractive spots in the Elbe metropolis Hamburg. The course runs on continuously closed and secured turnaround routes, leading on paved and asphalted paths. The race is open to runners of all performance levels and offers an official measurement according to international competition standards. The event is part of a cup ranking over several 10K Hamburg races with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Continuously closed and secured turnaround routes
Paved and asphalted paths
Attractive running spots along the Elbe
additional: Clothing deposit for personal belongings available on event day. Due to limited parking options, public transportation is strongly recommended. Official result lists and personalized certificates are available for download online immediately after the event. Multiple starting points (Elbe, Volkspark, Rotherbaum), online registration only, start at 9:00 AM, medals for finishers.

name: 16. Campuslauf Technische Universität Braunschweig
location: Campus of Technische Universität Braunschweig, Braunschweig, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 16th Campus Run of the Technical University of Braunschweig will take place on May 31, 2026, on the university campus. The run offers students and staff the opportunity to engage in sports and spend an active time together on the university grounds. The event is part of the university's sports program and promotes community spirit as well as the health of the participants.
course_highlights: Run across the grounds of TU Braunschweig campus
Event as part of TU Braunschweig's university sports program
Opportunity for students and staff to engage in sports
additional: The event is part of the university sports program of TU Braunschweig. Some sports facilities are closed during the Pentecost holidays. There will be a tax change starting from the summer semester 2026, which will impose VAT on certain offers. Race on May 31, 2026, registration online and on-site, live results during the run.

name: 32. Tangerlauf
description: The 32nd Tangerlauf in Tangerhütte is a traditional race through the Tanger valley, organized by SV Germania Tangerhütte. The course runs along the Tanger River through the picturesque Altmark landscape, which is especially beautiful in spring. The race has a long history dating back to the GDR era and was revived after reunification. The organizers wish all participants good weather and much enjoyment during the race.
course_highlights: Course along the Tanger River
Run through the Altmark nature
Traditional race with history since GDR times
additional: The race takes place in spring, the course runs through the Altmark natural landscape, and the event has a long history dating back to the GDR era.

name: 4. Eilenriedelauf
location: VfR 06 Döhren, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 4th Eilenriedelauf will take place on May 31, 2026, in Hanover and is organized by the Hannover Runners e.V. It is a popular race through the southern Eilenriede, appealing to runners of all performance levels. The event is part of the Laufpass series and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments at the finish area. Volunteer helpers are warmly welcomed and are invited to a convivial gathering after the race.
course_highlights: Popular race through the southern Eilenriede
Run in Hanover's green lung
Family-friendly atmosphere with finish area refreshments
additional: After the race, all helpers are invited to a convivial gathering at the rugby club's beer garden. Donations of cakes for the finish area are requested, to be delivered by 10 a.m. on the event day. Registration is open until May 28. The race starts at the entrance of VfR 06 Döhren and includes a 5 km run, 5 km walk, and 10 km run, with chip timing.

name: 40. Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
location: Jahnstadion Göttingen, Göttingen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 40th Göttingen Sparkasse Volkslauf will take place on May 31, 2026, at the Jahnstadion Göttingen and offers a diverse running program for participants of all performance levels. The event combines tradition and community and invites both experienced runners and hobby joggers to an active day filled with fun and movement. The courses include 2 km, 5.4 km, and 10.8 km distances, with the half marathon unfortunately canceled this year. The event emphasizes health, well-being, and togetherness in the region.
course_highlights: Course lengths: 2 km, 5.4 km, and 10.8 km
Start and finish at Göttingen Jahnstadion
Running routes are not measured; details can be viewed on the website
additional: No registration is required for the Bambini run; race numbers can be collected free of charge on the day of the event. Late registrations on the event day are not possible. The entry fee includes the organizational fee and a mineral drink. There are individual classifications and a special classification for the most active school, as well as rankings in the S-Running-Cup, SüdNiedersachsen-Cup, and Gö-Challenge. Race distances: 2 km, 5.4 km, 10.8 km; event held at Jahnstadion; online registration; half marathon canceled due to road closures; medical support and parking available.

name: 5. Urwaldsteig-Ultratrail
location: Parkplatz Schloss Waldeck, Waldeck, Hessen, Germany
description: The Urwaldsteig Ultratrail is a challenging ultramarathon of approximately 66 km with around 2000 meters of elevation gain around Lake Edersee. The course runs counterclockwise from Waldeck through diverse natural landscapes, including dense forests, narrow paths, the Kahle Haardt nature reserve, and the Kellerwald-Edersee National Park. Participants can expect impressive views of the lake, historic sites such as Hünselburg, and varied trail sections with high natural and experiential value. The start and finish are at the Schloss Waldeck parking lot, with the race beginning at 8 a.m.
course_highlights: Approximately 66 km loop with around 2000 meters of elevation gain
Trail character with narrow paths through Kellerwald-Edersee National Park
Impressive views of Lake Edersee and historic sites like Hünselburg
additional: Refreshment station around km 32.2 after the bridge near Herzhausen. Day parking fee at the start location Schloss Waldeck is at least €5, please have the correct change or digital payment options available. The race follows the original Urwaldsteig marked course; GPX track is only for rough orientation. Approximately 66 km, around 2000 meters of elevation, trail character, refreshment at km 32.2, no showers or toilets, GPS recommended, limited participants (30), start at 8 a.m. at Schloss Waldeck parking lot.

name: 9. Hellmich Parkhauslauf
location: Parkhaus Lehrte, Lehrte, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The HELLMICH Parking Garage Run in Lehrte is a unique running event held in the Lehrte parking garage. Participants run on a circuit approximately 1 km long through the parking garage, offering a special running experience with inclines and views of the city. There are three different races with varying numbers of laps, suitable for both children and adults. The event is limited to 50 participants per race to ensure safety, and each finisher receives a medal as a memento.
course_highlights: Circuit run in the parking garage with approximately 1 km per lap
Start on the lowest level of the parking garage, finish opposite the start
Inclines and view from the top parking deck
additional: Maximum 50 participants per race for safety reasons. Race packets can be picked up on race day from 09:15 to 12:00 at the stand near the start. The award ceremony takes place at 12:30 on the stage in front of the parking garage. Winners receive Lehrter Taler as a prize. Maximum 50 participants per race, start and finish in Lehrte parking garage, race begins at 10:15 AM, award ceremony at 12:30 PM.

name: Frankfurter Runden
description: The Frankfurt Runden are a unique mass participation event in the heart of Frankfurt am Main, taking place for the sixth time on May 31, 2026. Participants can freely choose between 10, 20, 30, or 40 km during the run by completing one to four laps on a flat, scenic course along the Main with a view of the skyline. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and offers professional timing, medical support, and on-course catering. A high-quality organic cotton shirt and digital live tracking features complete the offering.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km lap along the Main with skyline view
Freely selectable distance from 10 to 40 km during the run
Two refreshment stations with water, isotonic drinks, bananas, and snacks
additional: Start and finish are located below the Holbeinsteg at the Main riverbank. Bib numbers and time slots are assigned according to the chosen distance, with start blocks at 10-minute intervals. There is a clothing bag storage, medical support, and electronic timing by Datasport. The course is very flat, but there are stairs to climb at km 8. The cut-off time is 12:00 PM. Participants receive a high-quality organic cotton shirt and can use the Your Run App for live tracking and community features. Run on probably Germany's most beautiful running course, flexible lap choice, including shirt, live tracking, and medical support.

name: Alemannia Stadtparklauf
location: Aachener Stadtpark, Aachen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Aachen City Park Run by CAROLUS THERMEN takes place in the picturesque Aachen City Park and offers a pleasant running atmosphere away from roads. The course runs along winding walking paths and showcases the park's special beauties. Races are offered over 2 km, 4 km, 8 km, as well as a 600 m school run and a toddler run for the little ones. Start and finish are at the large fountain on Monheimsallee, where catering and a supporting program are also provided. Since 2024, the City Park Run has been part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup.
course_highlights: Winding walking paths in Aachen City Park
Start and finish at the large fountain on Monheimsallee
Course lengths: 2 km, 4 km, 8 km, 600 m school run, and toddler run
additional: Start and finish at the large fountain with registration office, bib number distribution, refreshment station, and supporting program. Easily accessible by several bus lines and a large public parking garage. Results and certificates are usually available online shortly after the event. Event in Aachen City Park with various race distances, children's runs, supporting program, online registration, results available shortly after the race.

name: Brunnenfestlauf 2026
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinde 1861 e. V. Oberursel (TSGO)
description: The Brunnenfestlauf Oberursel is a traditional race that starts and ends at the historic marketplace in the heart of Oberursel. The course takes runners through beautiful residential areas, forests, and meadows, offering a varied running experience for participants of all ages. In addition to the main races over 10 km, half marathon, and 5 km, there is also a 3 km student and sports badge run as well as a toddler run for the youngest participants. The event is embedded in the Brunnenfest and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with competitions for different age groups and youth categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic marketplace Oberursel
Course through residential, forest, and meadow areas
Varied running routes from 0.8 km to half marathon
additional: Registrations on the day of the event are possible until 09:30 AM. The races start in waves: 10:00 AM for 10 km & half marathon, 10:10 AM for 5 km, 12:35 PM for the 3 km student and sports badge run, and 1:05 PM for the toddler run. There is a 5 € late registration fee for all races except the 3 km run. The event supports the German Sports Badge and offers a 3 km Sports Badge run. Supported by local sports clubs, with a focus on youth races and the Sports Badge, historic venues.

name: Eilenriedelauf Hannover
description: The Eilenriedelauf is a popular race through the southern Eilenriede in Hanover, organized by the Hannover Runners. The event takes place on May 31, 2026, and offers runners of all performance levels the opportunity to run in the beautiful nature of Hanover. The event is part of the Laufpass series and emphasizes community and sporting fun. After the race, there is a convivial atmosphere with refreshments and cake at the finish area.
course_highlights: Popular race through the southern Eilenriede
Run in Hanover's green lung
Part of the Laufpass series
additional: After the race, volunteers gather at the rugby club's beer garden for a social conclusion with food and drinks. Participants are asked to donate cakes for the finish area, which should be delivered by 10 a.m. on the event day. Volunteers can register via a form or contact by email. Participation is included in the Laufpass program of the Hanover region, which includes stamp collection and rewards. Registration is possible online, with refreshments at km 3, 5, 7, 10, and at the finish line.

name: Elsterlauf
organizer: SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda e.V. und Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Elsterlauf in Bad Liebenwerda is a traditional running and walking event taking place on May 31, 2026, for the 46th time. The event offers a variety of race distances, including marathon, half marathon, various walking and hiking routes, as well as children's races. The course runs through the spa town of Bad Liebenwerda and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with categories for individual runners, teams, and companies. All participants receive a finisher medal and certificate, and there is an award ceremony by age groups. The organization is carried out by SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda and the Running and Walking Club 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
course_highlights: Variety of distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, 5.7 km, 2 km, walking and hiking
Start and finish at Roßmarkt in Bad Liebenwerda, near the elementary school with changing rooms and showers
Guided 11 km hike and family-friendly races such as Bambini and taster runs
additional: Late registrations are possible on May 30, 2026, from 12:00 to 15:00 and on May 31, 2026, from 07:00 to 09:30. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Bad Liebenwerda elementary school, luggage storage from 07:00 to 14:00. The cut-off time for all routes is 13:15. There is a corporate and club ranking with teams of three runners. Cyclists and hikers start without timing and ranking. All participants receive a finisher medal and certificate. Results are published online. The race event features online registration, various categories for runners, walkers, and families, including award ceremonies and finisher medals.

name: Erfurtshäuser Lauf
price_range: 8,00 € für Hauptlauf, andere Kategorien kostenlos oder vor Ort zu zahlen

price_tiers.distance: alle Läufe außer Bambini und Schüler

description: The Erfurtshäuser Run is a traditional race event in Amöneburg-Erfurtshausen that welcomes runners of all ages. There are various competitions such as the Bambini, Schüler, Jedermann, and main race, as well as walking/nordic walking. The course is marked, with each kilometer indicated, and refreshment stations are set up along the route. At the finish line, the organizer provides food and drinks for the participants. Timing is done electronically with additional backup using stopwatches, and certificates can be issued upon request.
course_highlights: Marked course with kilometer indicators
Refreshment stations along the route
Changing rooms and showers on site as well as in the sports home
additional: The Bambini run starts at 11:30 a.m., the Schüler run at 11:45 a.m. Registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start. Participants are insured through the Hessian State Sports Federation. Photos are taken during the event and published on the homepage, with an option to object. Changing rooms and showers are available on site and in the sports home. The course is marked, with refreshments along the route, and registration closes 30 minutes before the start.

name: Freigerichter Benzinglauf
description: The Freigericht Benzinglauf is a scenic popular race that takes runners along varied paths through the first elevations of the Spessart. The start and finish of all courses are at the DJK-Heim in Freigericht-Neuses. The three different routes mainly run on forest, woodland, and gravel paths with a small portion of asphalt. Adequate refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The race offers various distances for runners, walkers, and children, ensuring suitable options for all age groups and performance levels.
course_highlights: 90% forest, woodland, and gravel paths, 10% asphalt
Courses lead to the first elevations of the Spessart
Start and finish at the DJK-Heim in Freigericht-Neuses
additional: Number bibs and late registration at the DJK-Heim in Neuses. Start for half marathon (21.2 km), 10 km, and 5 km runs as well as 10 km and 5 km walking/nordic walking. Children's and youth races with various age groups. Food and drinks are well provided. Running event with multiple distances, including children and youth races, starting and ending at the DJK-Heim in Neuses. The event offers a challenge classification for participants taking part in multiple races.

name: Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
location: Göttinger Jahnstadion, Göttingen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 40th Göttinger Sparkassen-Volkslauf will take place on May 31, 2026, at the Göttinger Jahnstadion and offers a diverse running program for runners of all performance levels. The event combines tradition and community and invites both experienced runners and hobby joggers to an active day filled with fun and movement. The courses are almost flat, paved, and partially asphalted, running on a loop through the region. In addition to the main races, there are also school and children’s runs as well as walking routes suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: Almost flat, paved, and partially asphalted loop courses
Course lengths: 2 km, 5.4 km, and 10.8 km (2 laps)
Various race categories for all age groups and performance levels
additional: No registration is required for the children’s run; race numbers can be collected free of charge on the day of the event. Late registrations on the event day are not possible. The entry fee includes an organizational fee and a mineral drink. There are individual classifications in the respective races, no age group awards. The event is part of the SüdNiedersachsen-Cup and the Gö-Challenge. Race distances: 2 km, 5.4 km, 10.8 km; event held at Göttinger Jahnstadion; half marathon is canceled in 2026; participation with or without club affiliation; entry fee includes mineral drink; medical support available; in all weather conditions.

name: Obermosel Trail
location: Sportplatz Wasserliesch, Wasserliesch, Trier-Saarburg, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Obermosel Trail celebrates its premiere on May 31, 2026, in Wasserliesch. The event offers varied routes through the impressive landscape of the Obermosel, suitable for ambitious trail runners, hobby runners, walkers, and youth. The distances range from 5 km to 33 km, with the 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km routes also available as walking options. Start and finish are at the Wasserliesch sports field, and the event emphasizes well-marked courses, refreshment points, and medical support.
course_highlights: Technically demanding single trails with roots and small hills
Vineyards with steep ascents and scenic views
Wide gravel paths and forest and meadow trails for varied terrain
additional: Number pickup begins at 9:00 AM at the Wasserliesch sports field and ends 30 minutes before each start. A mandatory briefing takes place 15 minutes prior to each start. The event concludes for all participants by 7:00 PM. Refreshment points with drinks and fruit are available along the course and at the finish area. Carrying a mobile phone is strongly recommended. Dogs are not allowed. Switching to another distance is possible, but no refunds are given for switching to a shorter distance or non-participation. The bib number is personal and must not be transferred. Travel options include train, bicycle, or car; parking is available but the parking lot directly at the sports field is closed on the event day. Multiple routes are offered, including youth races and walking options; start and finish are at the Wasserliesch sports field; registration runs from March to May 2026.

name: Pi Lauf 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bambini und Schülerlauf sind kostenlos, bitte hier die Teilnahme über pilaufanmeldung@web.de zusenden.

description: The Pi Run 2026 in Neunkirchen-Seelscheid offers a diverse running program for all age groups and performance levels. The event includes distances from children's and school runs to a main race over 13.4 kilometers as well as walking. The course is scenic with refreshment points and good infrastructure on site. Every finisher receives a medal, and the top runners are honored. The Lions Club provides food and drinks, including cakes and beverages.
course_highlights: Main race over 13.431 km with two refreshment points at km 6.5 and 11.5
Children's and school runs as short distances (approx. 600 m and 1100 m)
Refreshment point on the general course at approx. 3 km
additional: Race number pickup begins at 08:00 on race day at the start/finish area or in the nearby school building. Late registrations are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective start with a fee of 2 EUR. Changing facilities and toilets are available in school buildings and adjacent halls. Parking is plentiful nearby. Every finisher receives a medal, and children in the children's race get an ice cream cone from the sponsor. Registration is via the Race Result platform; participants receive running shirts and a functional scarf; the event takes place at typical temperatures around 20°C.

name: Ra(h)ser-Run
description: The Ra(h)ser Run is a flat race through the district of Rahser in Viersen, with distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for rankings, mostly running along paved paths beside the Niers river banks. The event offers races for various age groups, including a toddler run for the youngest participants and a city championship for schools. Timing is done electronically with transponders embedded in the bibs. Registration is exclusively online, with late registrations possible up to 60 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Flat, paved loop courses through the district of Rahser and along the Niers river banks
5 km and 10 km courses are DLV-certified and eligible for rankings
Kilometer markers and course marshals for safety
additional: Late registrations are accepted up to 60 minutes before the respective start for a fee of 5 €. The bibs include an integrated transponder for electronic timing, providing gross and net times. During the event, Sittarder Straße between Kränkelsweg and Oberrahserstraße will be closed to through traffic. Participants can purchase a race shirt until May 7th as part of the online registration. School and children’s runs, free training sessions at Stadion Hoher Busch, and race courses for various school levels are also offered.

name: Spatzenberg-Lauf
description: The Spatzenberg Run is a traditional community race in Löhne, taking place on a hilly loop course around and over the Spatzenberg in the nature reserve. The route mainly runs on paved paths and roads and offers an attractive running opportunity for participants of all ages. In addition to the main race over 9 km, there are also shorter runs over 6 km and 3 km for students. The event is organized by the Turn- und Rasensportverein Löhne 1910 e.V., Abteilung Lauftreff, and takes place at the Obernfeld sports field.
course_highlights: Hilly loop course around and over the Spatzenberg (nature reserve)
Route on paved paths and roads
Distances: 9 km, 6 km, and 3 km student race
additional: Timing is done with a disposable chip on the back of the bib number. Race packets can be picked up from 9:00 a.m. on the day of the event at the Obernfeld sports field. Late registrations are possible on the event day until 10:15 a.m., subject to bib number availability. Payment by SEPA direct debit for online registration or cash upon collection of race materials. Hilly course around the Spatzenberg, online or same-day registration, timing with disposable chip, water station at the finish line.

name: Sponsorenlauf Brustkrebshilfe Dorsten
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Khadijeh Mohri, Andreas Schilasky, Ali Abdali
description: The Breast Cancer Support Sponsor Run in Dorsten is a charitable race in Dorsten that focuses on supporting and raising awareness for breast cancer. The event takes place in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof and offers various running and walking routes suitable for all age groups and fitness levels. Besides the sporting aspect, supporting breast cancer aid is the main focus, with a minimum participation fee that can be supplemented with additional donations. Participants can run, walk, or support through a donation without participating in the course.
course_highlights: Event in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof with wide paths and plenty of greenery
Course lengths: 800 m for children, 2.5 km and 5 km for running or walking
Accessible changing and shower facilities on site
additional: Race bibs are issued on-site, parking is available nearby, participation without running or walking is also possible through the "Run with the Heart" donation. The race takes place on May 31, 2026, with a focus on donations for breast cancer centers and community engagement. Over 2,000 participants are expected, with a fundraising goal of over 50,000 euros.

name: Steinberger Wald-Volkslauf
description: The 49th Steinberger Forest Community Run will take place on May 31, 2026, in Dietzenbach-Steinberg. The event is organized by SC Steinberg and offers runners a sporting challenge in a natural forest environment. Participants can look forward to well-marked routes suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational runners. The event is a longstanding tradition and warmly invites all running enthusiasts to join.
course_highlights: Forest routes in a natural environment
Well-marked 5 km and 10 km routes
Varied running paths with moderate terrain
additional: There are two main routes of 5 km and 10 km in length. The courses are designed as forest runs and offer a varied running environment. The event is organized by SC Steinberg, which also offers other sports activities such as cross-country skiing, triathlon, and running clubs. Routes: 5 km and 10 km, online registration, sporting activities, club run

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event set in one of southern Germany's most beautiful landscapes, featuring gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns, and an exhilarating atmosphere along the course. The route offers a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal with varied sections on paved field paths and through historic town centers. The flat finish in Steinheim invites a strong final sprint. The marathon is open to adult runners aged 18 and over and is part of a diverse running program in Bottwartal.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns such as Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Monthly free training runs in various pace groups for preparation, summer break runs during the summer holidays, year-end run with 10 km and afterwards punch & mulled wine. Registration for all runs is via the partner Datasport. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible until shortly before the race. Training runs in Steinheim an der Murr with distances of 14 km, 21 km, and 42.2 km, mostly in sunny weather in June.

name: Urwaldlauf
description: The Jungle Run is a six-hour race in which participants can run as many laps as they like within six hours on a 1.85 km course through the jungle near Saarbrücken. The start time is individually selectable from 10 a.m., and participants can compete as individuals or in teams. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic single trails and offers a challenging experience with 46 meters of elevation gain per lap. The event emphasizes flexibility and fun, with electronic lap tracking and refreshments at the Jungle Barn Neuhaus.
course_highlights: 1.85 km long lap through the jungle near Saarbrücken
46 meters of elevation gain per lap, over 1000 meters on marathon distance
Switch between wide forest paths and idyllic single trails
additional: Number pickup from 9 a.m. on site. Flexible start time from 10 a.m., finish by 4 p.m. Electronic lap tracking and refreshment station at the Jungle Barn Neuhaus. Participant limit of 350. Late registrations are possible online or on-site, with a late registration fee payable on-site. Team scoring available; consistent spelling of team names is important. 6-hour race, 1.85 km lap, approximately 46 meters of elevation gain per lap, forest paths and single trails, flexible start from 10 a.m., finish at 4 p.m., online registration until the Friday before the event.

The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with start and finish at the sports field in Liederbach.

description: The Hiking Marathon TSV Bollensen warmly invites all friends of popular sports to experience an enjoyable hike through the beautiful Solling Vogler forest area. The routes are circular courses starting and ending at the TSV Bollensen sports home and lead exclusively over forest paths. The region was awarded the quality region "Wanderbares Deutschland" in 2022. Refreshments are provided at stations along the route as well as food and drinks at the finish. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and a cozy gathering after the hike.

Circular courses with start and finish at TSV Bollensen sports home
Quality region "Wanderbares Deutschland" since 2022

name: dm Firmenlauf Saarbrücken
description: The dm Corporate Run Saarbrücken is a sporting event for teams and companies taking place on June 2, 2026, in downtown Saarbrücken. The 5 km flat and asphalted course runs from the State Theatre along the Saar River and through the city center, accompanied by great atmosphere and spectator cheers. After the run, participants can enjoy an after-run party with live music, awards ceremony, and refreshments. The run promotes team spirit, movement, and communal celebration in a relaxed setting.
course_highlights: 5 km flat, asphalted course through Saarbrücken city center
Course refreshment at kilometer 2.5 at Staden with water
Atmospheric finish at the Saar riverbank and St. Johanner Market
additional: Race bibs are collected and distributed internally by the team captain. Late registrations are possible online until shortly before the start and at the race bib distribution. Included are goodies, professional timing, personalized certificate, course entertainment with DJ & Samba bands, finish line refreshments with non-alcoholic beer mix, water, and fruit, as well as an after-run party with live band and awards ceremony. The course is barrier-free and suitable for participants with disabilities. description: The Alpen City Run takes place on the Wednesday before Corpus Christi, June 3, 2026, and is a traditional running event in the municipality of Alpen. The course leads on a roughly 2.5-kilometer loop through the heart of Alpen, starting and finishing at the Alpen Sports Center. The program is aimed at all age and performance levels, with races from the Bambini run to the 10-kilometer race. The event thrives on a lively atmosphere and the support of spectators along the route.
course_highlights: Approximately 2.5-kilometer loop through the heart of Alpen
Start and finish at the Alpen Sports Center
Various races for all age and performance levels
additional: Bambini runs (400 m) are free of charge. Certificates and prizes for the top finishers in each age group. Special awards for the largest pre-registered club, fastest boss/bosses and apprentices in the company run, as well as for the schools and daycare centers with the most participants. Bib number distribution at the race office on the sports center grounds. Use of numerous parking spaces in the city center is possible. Music devices are prohibited during the competition. Late registration until 60 minutes before the start is possible for a fee of 3 euros. The event takes place at the Alpen Sports Center; includes various race distances and community activities.

description: The Gäulauf in the Verbandsgemeinde Edenkoben is a traditional community run that has brought runners together in Gommersheim for over two decades. The event on June 3, 2026, offers various race distances for children, teenagers, and adults on a flat course through several municipalities. Registration is possible online until the day of the event, with on-site late registration available for a fee. The central registration in the multi-purpose hall near the finish area ensures smooth organization.
course_highlights: Flat loop course through Gommersheim, Böbingen, Freimersheim, Kleinfischlingen, Großfischlingen, Venningen, and Altdorf
Adjusted safe route for children's races
Various distances from 350 m to half marathon and walking
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start with a late registration fee of 3 euros for adults and 2 euros for children. Registration is centrally located in the multi-purpose hall near the finish area. The races start in staggered groups from 6:30 PM with children's races, followed by 10 km, half marathon, and walking. The Gäulauf offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories, central registration in Gommersheim, and takes place on June 3, 2026.

name: J.P. Morgan Corporate Challenge
location: Opernplatz, Frankfurt am Main, Hessen, Germany
description: The JPMorgan Chase Corporate Challenge Frankfurt is one of the world's largest corporate running series, taking place on June 3, 2026, at Opernplatz. The course covers 5.6 kilometers and is aimed at teams of employees of all fitness levels who want to experience a special moment away from everyday work. In addition to the athletic competition, the event also emphasizes communal celebration, with flexible party packages for teams. The event also supports local charitable organizations, making the run a social occasion.
course_highlights: 5.6-kilometer course
Start and finish at Opernplatz Frankfurt
Corporate run with teams of all fitness levels
additional: After the run, teams can book flexible party packages with food, drinks, and space to relax at Opernplatz. The event supports the Laureus Sport for Good Foundation Germany and the German Disabled Sports Youth (Deutsche Behindertensportjugend - DBSJ). Participation is only open to employees of companies who are at least 18 years old and have been working for the company for at least 30 days prior to the run. Registration is managed by team captains who assemble and oversee teams. 5.6 km run, post-run party with food and drinks, charity support, registration via email or phone.
