description: The 1KOMMA5° Urban Run on June 3, 2026, is a special race through the city center of Münster, taking place for the third time. The approximately 5-kilometer route passes through several notable buildings in the city, including the City Hall, the LWL Museum of Art and Culture, and the Youth Church, and goes past well-known sights such as the Prinzipalmarkt and the Domplatz. The run is not a competitive race with timing but a shared experience at a relaxed jogging pace with race support. The event combines fun, culture, and movement and is aimed at runners aged 16 and older. The participant limit is 1,000 people, and the start fee includes a high-quality running shirt.
course_highlights: Inner city loop of about 5 kilometers with running through several city buildings
Passing historic sights such as Prinzipalmarkt, Lamberti Church, and Domplatz
Run along the promenade, Münster's green belt in the city center
additional: The run is not a timed race and is conducted in several groups with race support. The minimum age is 16 years. There are no changing facilities at the start/finish area. The start fee includes a high-quality running shirt, which will be handed out from 5:30 PM at the start area. The participant limit is 1,000 people; registration was quickly fully booked, and the waiting list is also closed. The route passes through buildings and attractions in Münster, with limited luggage storage, no timing, and no changing facilities. The course includes buildings and attractions in Münster, with no changing facilities and limited luggage storage. The minimum age is 16 years.

name: Sternchenlauf
description: The Star Run in Schloss Holte-Stukenbrock is a traditional community race held annually on the Wednesday before Corpus Christi. The event offers various running competitions for all age groups, from baby and children's runs to 5 km and 10 km races as well as walking. The course takes place on a diverse 2.5 km loop with forest ground, gravel, and asphalt, lined by enthusiastic spectators. In addition to individual categories, there are team and relay competitions, making the race especially attractive for groups.
course_highlights: 2.5 km diverse loop course with forest ground, gravel, and asphalt
Flat course profile with good signage
Turnaround sections for baby, children, and student runs on Falkenstraße
additional: Start times: Baby run at 17:00, children's run at 17:15, 1.0 km student run at 17:30, 2.5 km student run at 17:45, 5 km race at 18:30, 10 km race and 5 km walk at 19:30. Walking starts simultaneously with the 10 km race at the back of the field. Participant limit approximately 2000, relay teams limited to 50. Event shirts can be purchased during registration or on-site. Changing rooms and showers are available. Start and finish at the Waldstadion Schwarz-Weiß Sende e.V. Registration for individual and group runs; the 5 km race is fully booked, remaining spots available on-site from 4 PM on the event day. The event is part of regional running events and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Tag des Laufens
organizer: German Road Races (GRR), Deutscher Leichtathletik-Verband (DLV), laufen.de
description: The Day of Running is a nationwide running event in Germany, taking place for the fifth time on June 3, 2026. Under the motto #gemeinsammehrbewegen, all running enthusiasts are invited to run together and collect donations for the healthy movement of children and adolescents. The event is initiated by German Road Races e.V. and the German Athletics Association and supported by DATEV. There are no fixed routes or start times; participants can join individually or in groups at a location of their choice or organize their own event. The funds raised will go to Plan International Germany to support sports clubs and the training of coaches.
course_highlights: Running at any location in Germany possible
Individual or group runs without fixed routes
Various events in many German cities
additional: Free race numbers can be downloaded online as a PDF and printed. Participants can post photos or videos with the hashtag #tagdeslaufens on Instagram and participate in prize draws. There is a competition with a prize money of 1,000 euros for teams engaged in social activities. Donations of 15 euros or more enable participation in a VIP trip to the German Athletics Championships 2026. Events across Germany, fundraising campaigns, social media activities, running events, charity runs.

name: Berliner Wasserbetriebe 5x5 km TEAM-Staffel
description: The Berlin Waterworks 5 x 5 km TEAM relay is a unique relay race in Berlin's Tiergarten, emphasizing team spirit and shared experience. Five team members each run 5 km on a scenic route between the Victory Column and the Federal Chancellery. The event is ideal for everyone who wants to overcome athletic challenges together and have fun, regardless of performance level. The transition zone in the start-finish area is a lively meeting point full of motivation and emotions. After the race, all participants receive a special medal symbolizing team cohesion.
course_highlights: 5 km long loop through the northern Tiergarten with views of the Reichstag and Federal Chancellery
Transition zone in the start-finish area as a central, lively meeting point
The route offers plenty of shade even on hot days
additional: Start takes place in waves (1, 2, or 3) to avoid congestion. Timing is done via a relay baton with integrated timing, provided by the organizer and must be used. The relay time limit is 3 hours. Snack bags, an environmentally friendly alternative to picnic baskets, are distributed; participants are asked to bring their own reusable water bottles or cups. Relay race in Tiergarten, team event, anniversary edition, medals, team spirit, 3-day event

Traditional district championships with regional significance

Scenic course in Oberweis

The event also includes children's runs, walking, and fitness runs, with registration starting in March 2026. It usually takes place in good weather in June.

description: The Klingenlauf is a traditional running event in Solingen, taking place on June 4, 2026, in the Südpark. name: Volkslauf Wacker Frohnhausen
description: The Volkslauf Wacker Frohnhausen is a traditional running event in Gladenbach-Frohnhausen, organized annually by SV Wacker Frohnhausen. The races take place around Donnerberg and offer courses for various performance levels. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and involvement of the local community. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with diverse routes.
course_highlights: Run around Donnerberg
Course lengths: 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km
Traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The race takes place at the forest sports field in Gladenbach-Frohnhausen; the weather is expected to be sunny at around 23°C; registration and further details should be inquired with the organizer before participation.

name: Volkslauf „Rund um Köchel“
description: The 'Rund um Köchel' Volkslauf is a traditional running competition held as part of the annual sports festival of SG Sportfreunde 69 Marmagen-Nettersheim. It offers runners of all ages and performance levels the opportunity to compete in four disciplines (1,000 m, 2,000 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m). The event is part of a festive week full of action and team spirit at the grass sports facility in Marmagen. Additionally, for the first time, a obstacle race for children is offered, making the event family-friendly and versatile.
course_highlights: Four disciplines: 1,000 m, 2,000 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m
Event at the grass sports facility in Marmagen
Part of a large sports festival with a diverse program
additional: The Volkslauf takes place on June 4, 2026, from 15:45 to 19:30. There are four race distances for different age and performance groups. Additionally, a children's obstacle race with 700 m and 1,400 m is offered. The event is embedded in a multi-day sports festival with further sporting and family-friendly activities. Participation in four running disciplines, including an obstacle race for children.

name: 1. Westerwälder Backyard Ultra
description: The Westerwälder Backyard Ultra 2026 is a unique ultramarathon taking place in Höchstenbach in the Westerwald (Rhineland-Palatinate). Participants run on a marked loop course of 6.706 km with 71 meters of elevation gain per lap, passing through forest, woodland, and meadow paths. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere with electronic lap counting, catering at the start/finish area, and a medal for everyone who completes at least one lap. Additionally, part of the entry fee is donated to local youth work and a tree planting project.
course_highlights: 6.706 km long loop course with 71 meters of elevation gain per lap
Running on forest, woodland, and meadow paths
Electronic lap counting via RaceResult
additional: Number bib distribution begins on June 5, 2026, at 5:00 PM. Mandatory briefing 15 minutes before the start. Catering with runner-friendly drinks and snacks at the start/finish area. Tenting/pavilion setup is limited. Shower tags available on site. No refund of entry fee in case of non-participation; substitute runners allowed. Waiting list available when full. Part of the entry fee is donated to youth work and a tree planting project. Medal for all who complete at least one lap. Award ceremony shortly after the event ends. Participants can camp or set up pavilions in the start/finish area. The registration fee includes a donation to a charitable cause, plus €1.50 per lap (up to a maximum of 10 laps). The event is limited to 200 participants and begins on June 5, 2026, at 7:00 PM.

name: Borkener Citylauf
description: The Borken City Run is a traditional popular race that has been held annually in the city center of Borken since 1987. The event offers runs for young and old on a closed 2.5 km circuit that passes through the city center, the city park, and the marketplace. Starting and finishing at the marketplace, the City Run is a popular running event that appeals to both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The event is organized by the Borken City Sports Association and several local clubs, offering a family-friendly atmosphere with various age groups and awards.
course_highlights: Closed 2.5 km circuit through the city center, city park, and marketplace
Start and finish at the marketplace in Borken
Various distances for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 2:00 PM until 30 minutes before the respective race start for a fee of €2.00 at the Borken Tourist Information. Race bibs will be issued from 2:00 PM. Transponders are collected after crossing the finish line for a refundable €2.00. Races for different age groups, online registration, on-site late registration possible, special support for young runners with guide children.

name: Freundschaftslauf
description: The SaarLANDlauf is a friendship run around Saarland, held in 20 stages along the Saarland circular hiking trail with a total distance of approximately 400 kilometers. The runs are guided friendship runs organized by local sponsors and are aimed at experienced runners who can comfortably complete a half marathon. The goal is to strengthen the community of Saarland runners and running clubs and to explore the most beautiful corners of Saarland together. Participation is free of charge, but a small donation is gladly appreciated.
course_highlights: 20 stages each approximately 20 km long
Routes run along the Saarland circular hiking trail with plenty of inclines and descents
Guided runs without markings, GPS data provided
additional: The runs are not competitions but friendship runs. There are no running guides or markings; instead, GPS data of the routes are provided. The event promotes sociability and community, with a cozy gathering after the runs. Changing rooms, showers, and parking are available at the meeting points. Participants explore the mystical swampy Rötelsteinpfad region, with scenic views of the Nahe. The event is part of a multi-day, regionally focused running event with several stages and route options.

name: Heider Abend-Stadtlauf
description: The Heider Evening City Run is a traditional race in Heide organized by MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide. The event offers runners of various performance levels the opportunity to compete on an attractive course through the city. The race is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and support from the local sports club. The route is well marked and provides a varied running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Heide.
course_highlights: Course runs through the city center of Heide
Well marked race route with diverse cityscape
Organized by the traditional MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide
additional: The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes community through sporting activities in Heide.

name: Rohrener Volkslauf
description: The 48th Rohrener Volkslauf takes place on Friday evening in Monschau, Germany. Various competitions are offered, including a 4.2 km and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a separate 10 km event for walkers and Nordic walkers. The races follow a rolling course and all finish at Im Johannesfeld in Monschau. In addition to adults, younger runners also participate, and registration is done online through the organizer.
course_highlights: Rolling course through Monschau
Finish at Im Johannesfeld
Separate 10 km for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: The shorter races start first, followed by the walkers and Nordic walkers, with the 10 km runners starting last. Typical weather in June is around 23°C with mostly sunny days. Event features a rolling course, online registration, including children and youth races as well as walking events.

name: Saalfelder Bambini-Schloßparklauf
organizer: Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. und Thüringer Leichtathletik Verband e.V.
description: The Saalfeld Children's Castle Park Run is a traditional children's race taking place on June 5, 2026, starting at 5:00 PM in the Saalfeld Castle Park. The event is aimed at children born between 2017 and 2023, who will run one or two laps depending on their age. The race is organized by the Saalfeld Athletics Club e.V. and offers a child-friendly atmosphere for the youngest runners. Registration is available online, at the start, or by phone.
course_highlights: Races for children aged 3 to 9 years
Lap length varies depending on age group (1 or 2 laps)
Event held in the idyllic Saalfeld Castle Park
additional: Registration is possible online, at the start, or by phone with Uta Weber (Tel.: 0176/84770473). There are no entry fees. The races are divided by birth year, with each group running 1 or 2 laps. A liability disclaimer for damages and injuries applies. The event is organized by the Saalfeld Athletics Club e.V. The children's race takes place in the castle park and is part of the Saalfeld Kulmberg Run, with dates and results available.

name: Spargellauf
description: The WERNER Spargellauf in Deinste is a 5.5 km relay race that takes place annually and will celebrate its 20th anniversary in 2026. Teams of five runners run together through the asparagus fields, with an asparagus stalk serving as the baton. The race is suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to professionals, and fun is the main focus, as the winning team is drawn by lot. In addition to the race, there is a culinary mile with regional specialties and a family program with a bouncy castle and other attractions. For the anniversary, a special running shirt is offered, and a large after-show party takes place.
course_highlights: 5.5 km long course through the Deinste asparagus fields
Relay race with an asparagus stalk as the baton
Suitable for all fitness levels, walking, strolling, or running possible
additional: Anniversary 2026 with after-show party, anniversary magazine, lucky wheel, and special anniversary dishes and drinks. The winning team is drawn by lot and receives regional products (asparagus, potatoes, ham, strawberries). Anniversary running shirt with individual team name or logo available for order until May 16. Culinary mile with a variety of foods and drinks. Family program with a bouncy castle. Anniversary event with after-show party, running shirt offer, music, and catering along the course.

name: Stapelmoorer Run-Fun-Loop
description: The Stapelmoorer Run Fun Loop is a 10 km race measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV), starting and ending at the sports field of Teutonia Stapelmoor. The course takes runners through the scenic surroundings of Stapelmoor, with sections along farm roads, school routes, and village streets. The event is part of the Teutonia Stapelmoor running community and offers participants a well-organized and varied running route in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km DLV-measured course
Start and finish at the sports field of Teutonia Stapelmoor
Course passes through farm roads, school routes, and village streets
additional: Registration online until the day of the event, start and finish at the sports field in Stapelmoor, including Nordic walking without timing.

name: Warnemünder Stapellauf
description: The Warnemünde Launch is a small race held in June in Rostock, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany. The event offers short distances of 555 meters and 9.3 kilometers, ideal for runners seeking a straightforward racing experience. The courses bear local nautical names reflecting Warnemünde's coastal identity, including the 5 Nautical Miles Run (9 km) and the 3 Nautical Miles Run (6 km). Results are managed via my.race|result, and the event is listed in the running.de calendar.
course_highlights: Short distances: 555 m and 9.3 km
Local nautical names of the runs (5 Nautical Miles Run, 3 Nautical Miles Run, 3 Cable Lengths Run)
Event location Warnemünde with coastal character
additional: The event takes place on June 5, 2026, in Warnemünde. Typical June weather includes maximum temperatures around 23°C and minimums around 13°C, with mostly sunny days. Detailed course information is not available; results are provided online. The event also includes race courses related to maritime navigation, engineering sciences, and logistics; results are available online.

name: 2. Jenaer Backyard Ultra
description: The 2nd Jena Backyard Ultra is a unique 'Last Human Standing' race in Jena-Cospeda, Thuringia. All participants start simultaneously every hour on a 6.7 km loop, which they must complete within an hour. Those who fail to finish the loop or give up are eliminated. The race ends when only one runner remains, having completed the loop within the time limit. In addition to individual standings, there is a team classification for teams of up to three participants, which accumulate the most laps over the duration.
course_highlights: 6.7 km long loop with some steep climbs
Beautiful nature and rewarding views
Start and finish at the sports field Cospeda in Jena
additional: Arrival from 05.06.2026 16:00 is possible. Tent facilities are available on the event grounds, but there are no parking spaces for caravans, campers, or cars. Parking is only permitted in designated areas on Mühlenweg, a few minutes' walk from the site. Basic supplies of drinks, fruit, vegetables, and snacks are provided during the event. The race starts at 6:00 AM; participants must bring their own food and drinks. Tent and parking facilities are available. The participant limit has already been reached; all spots are booked.

name: 41. Internationaler Sollinglauf
organizer: Laufgruppe des Dasseler Sport-Clubs von 1920 e.V.
price_range: €5.00 bis €35.00 je nach Veranstaltung und Anmeldedatum
description: The 41st International Solling Run will take place on June 6, 2026, in the Solling area near Dassel. The event offers various race distances from 400 meters up to the Leaders Academy Solling Marathon over 42.5 km. The courses lead through the diverse landscape of the Solling and provide suitable options for ambitious runners as well as recreational runners and walkers. The event is organized by the Dasseler Sport-Club von 1920 e.V. and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prize money.
course_highlights: Marathon over 42.5 km through the Solling area
Various distances from 400 m to 42.5 km
Walking and hiking options with a time limit of 6 hours
additional: Walking and hiking are possible on various routes, registration for these is only on-site. Swapping start numbers or running a different route than registered is not allowed. There is a time limit of 6 hours for walking and hiking on the race courses. Multiple running and walking options, registration on-site possible, age-dependent prices.

name: Below- Gedenk- und Heidelauf
price_range: 8,5 km: 12 EUR, Jugend 5 EUR, Schüler frei

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Schüler m/w gebohren 2010 und jünger: FREI

price_tiers.distance: Jugendliche und Erwachsene über 1,5 km & 3 km

description: The Below, Memorial, and Heidelauf is a traditional race through the Wittstocker Heath and forest, organized annually by LC Dosse Wittstock e.V. The 8.5 km course is open to women, men, and youth, offering a varied natural scenery. In addition to the main race, there are classifications for youth and students as well as a school cup ranking. The event is part of the Brandenburg Cup and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere with trophies for overall winners and certificates for all participants.
course_highlights: Course through the Wittstocker Heath and forest
Natural, varied terrain on the race route
Refreshments on the course provided by the organizer
additional: Trophies for the overall winners of the race routes, certificates available upon request, 2nd Sparkasse OPR School Cup with prizes for the three schools with the most participants, late registration deadline ends on 24.05.2025 at 9:30 AM, participation at own risk, liability disclaimer for accidents, theft, and damages, start and finish at the Stadion des Friedens, Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Str.62, 16909 Wittstock. Course through the Wittstocker Heath and forest, online registration, participation at own risk

name: Finkenwerder Insellauf (mit HH-Meisterschaften 5 km)
description: The Finkenwerder Island Run takes place on June 6, 2026, in Finkenwerder, Hamburg, and offers a diverse running program for all age groups. The main races are held on an exactly measured, flat 5 km loop course through green oases and along the Elbe, ideal for fast times and the Hamburg Championships over 5 km. In addition to the main routes, there are age-appropriate runs for children and adolescents as well as relay and walking competitions. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, with start and finish directly at the Finkenwerder Market Square and a sustainable event concept with reusable cups and recycling medals.
course_highlights: 5 km flat, precisely measured loop course with approximately 6 meters of elevation
Course runs through green oases and along the Elbe
Start and finish directly at the Finkenwerder Market Square
additional: Late registrations are possible until about one hour before the start (6:15 PM) at the Market Square with an additional fee. Showers and changing rooms are available at the Gorch-Fock-Halle approximately 250 meters away. The event is part of the BSV Summer Cup and the Hamburgiade. It features a sustainable organization with reusable cups, recycling medals, and waste reduction. The award ceremony begins around 8:15 PM at the Market Square. The course follows the Elbe route, registration is available online and on-site, start at 7:15 PM, award ceremony around 8:15 PM, no escort vehicles allowed, sustainable organization with reusable cups and recycling medals.

name: Hahnenkammlauf
description: The Hahnenkammlauf in Edelsfeld is an idyllic forest run that will already be in its 23rd edition in 2026. The event is open to runners of all ages, from children to experienced athletes, and offers varied routes around the sports grounds at Hahnenkamm. Due to the renovation of the sports field, the course has been adjusted. The run is part of the Amberg-Sulzbach District Cup and annually motivates around 250 participants to achieve sporting success in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Idyllic forest course around Hahnenkamm
Year-round marked routes from 1,000 meters
Adjusted course due to sports field renovation
additional: Number bib collection from 1:30 PM at the sports clubhouse. Children's runs from 3:00 PM (400m and 600m for toddlers, 1,000m and 2,000m for school children) with subsequent award ceremony. Youth, women’s, and men’s runs start from 5:15 PM. The courses are divided according to DLO age classes and are also relevant for the district cup and municipal evaluation. Online payment of the starting fee is possible, as well as payment on the day of the event. Children's run training begins in May as preparation for the race. Routes at Hahnenkamm, online registration available, late registrations accepted until 2:00 PM on race day, bib collection at the sports clubhouse, course secured by fire brigade, free refreshments, medical support by First Responders.

name: Lingelbacher Windmühlenlauf
description: The Lingelbacher Windmill Run is a traditional running event in Lingelbach near Alsfeld, which will take place for the 21st time in 2026. The race is organized by TSV Lingelbach 1925 e.V. and offers various running distances for children, students, and adults. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the scenic route around Lingelbach. The registration fee is paid in cash on site at the race bib distribution.
course_highlights: Various distances (700 m, 5.3 km, 10 km)
Hilly routes for a sporting challenge
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
additional: The registration fee is payable in cash on site at the race bib distribution. The event takes place in June, with typical temperatures around 23°C; various categories including children and walking; cash payment possible on site.

name: Oranienburger Stundenlauf
description: The Oranienburg Hour Run is a varied race event on the track behind Oranienburg Castle. The event offers different competitions with time limits of 15, 30, and 60 minutes, as well as a 400-meter children's run and Nordic walking. The races are divided by age groups and gender, and all fully completed laps within the time limit are counted. Each finisher receives a medal, and there are certificates as well as award ceremonies for the top runners.
course_highlights: Running on the track behind Oranienburg Castle
Scoring based on fully completed laps within the time limit
Various competitions from 15 to 60 minutes, including children's runs and Nordic walking
additional: Maximal 100 participants per start. Registration fees: €2.00 for children, €5.00 for adults. Registration exclusively online via myracepartner.com. Payment methods: direct debit, PayPal (group registrations only direct debit). Each finisher receives a medal, certificates are available online. Award ceremonies for children's and youth races as well as main runs according to age groups and overall ranking. The event is part of the EMB-Energy Cup Oberhavel and offers online registration and parking facilities.

name: Silberberglauf
price_range: regulärer Preis bis 01.06.2026, Last Minute bis 05.06.2026, vor Ort ab 08:30 Uhr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Anmeldung zum regulären Preis ist bis zum 01.06.2026 möglich.

description: The 41st Silberberglauf on June 6, 2026, offers runners and walkers varied routes around the Silberberg near Ilmenau. With distances of 21.1 km, 11 km, 6 km, as well as children's runs over 2.5 km and 0.6 km, there is something for all age groups and performance levels. The event is part of the Sparkassencup Saalfeld-Rudolstadt and the TLV-Cup and promises a sporty atmosphere with catering, medals, and award ceremonies. The children's sports festival in the afternoon rounds off the family-friendly event.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approximately 600 meters of elevation gain
11 km route with approximately 250 meters of elevation gain and Nordic walking classification
Children's runs and children's sports festival in the afternoon
additional: Race bib distribution on race day from 07:30 to 08:45 for main races, children's runs from 14:00. Last-minute registration on-site until 08:30 for main races and until 14:40 for children's runs. Catering at the routes and at the sports field, changing facilities, toilets, finisher medals, and certificates. Using poles is mandatory for the 11 km route; running with poles is prohibited. Baby joggers, dogs, and bicycle accompaniment are not allowed for safety reasons. All routes close at 13:00. Trail terrain, online registration via Race Result, safety rules regarding equipment, participation in multiple cups.

name: Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow LC/NLC
description: The Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow is a traditional race event taking place on June 6, 2026, in Güstrow, Germany. Organized by Tri Fun Güstrow e. V., the event offers various distances for different age groups. The main race includes a 10 km course for runners from U20 and older, complemented by shorter races for youth and children. The 48th edition of this local event is held at the InselseeHeidberg bathing beach and promises a sporting challenge in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Start at the InselseeHeidberg bathing beach in Güstrow
10 km main race for U20 and older
Shorter races for youth and children classes
additional: The event includes a 10 km main race, a 5 km road race for JU14, JU16, and JU18, as well as a 1.2 km race for KU10 and KU12. Typical June weather in Güstrow is around 23°C with mostly sunny days and an average of 65 mm of precipitation. The event is part of the regional race calendar and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. The weather in June in Güstrow is typically pleasantly warm, around 23°C.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
price_range: 42€ für den Marathon, 99€ für die Staffel
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany's first beach marathon and takes place on June 6, 2026, on the island of Usedom. The runs take place exclusively on sand along the Baltic Sea coast, without asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique natural and running experience directly by the sea. Participants can choose from a marathon, half marathon, 10 km short distance, or a relay marathon. The event combines sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program at the finish area in Ahlbeck.
course_highlights: Running exclusively on sand without asphalt or road traffic
Start in Zinnowitz, finish in Ahlbeck (Marathon)
11 aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, bananas, gels, and cola
additional: The marathon has a time limit of 7 hours (cut-off at 16:00). Exceeding the time limit results in no further course security or catering. The relay consists of 5 segments with at least 3 runners per team, with classifications for female, male, and mixed teams. Start areas are Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, with a common finish area in Ahlbeck. There is a professional entertainment and information program from 10:00 to 18:00 at the finish area. Running on sand, no asphalt course, start and finish areas in Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, including catering, medal, certificate, and shuttle transfers.

name: Wremer Deichlauf
location: Wremen, Wurster Nordseeküste, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wremer Deichlauf is the traditional highlight of the sports season of TuS Wremen 09 and warmly invites all running enthusiasts. There are two courses offered: a short loop of 5,300 meters and a long route of 15,900 meters through the green marsh. The courses mainly run on paved bike and farm roads and also go off the dike directly along the water and mudflats. There is also a separate walking competition on the short loop.
course_highlights: Course mainly on paved bike and farm roads
Run directly along the water and mudflats on the Treibselräumweg
Two distances: 5.3 km and 15.9 km through the green marsh
additional: Walking competition on the 5,300-meter loop. The event is the highlight of the sports season of TuS Wremen 09. The courses are mainly paved and also run off the dike along the water. Courses mainly on paved bike or farm roads, run along water and mudflats, walking competition on the short course.

name: 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge von 1862 e.V.
description: The 14th City Run of TSV Neustadt on June 7, 2026, is an accessible community race in Neustadt am Rübenberge that promotes community and inclusion. The race stands for a collective togetherness and brings friends together through shared activity. With every step, social connectedness is strengthened and a sign for an inclusive future is set. The race is open to all age groups and offers a sporting event with social commitment.
course_highlights: Accessible race for inclusive participation
Community togetherness and social connectedness
Community race in Neustadt am Rübenberge
additional: The race is designed to be accessible to promote inclusion. There is a race championship for elementary schools. The event is organized by the gymnastics and sports club TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge from 1862 e.V. It is accessible, inclusive, communal, a community race, with parking available at the South School Center and Gymnasium, changing rooms, showers, and bag storage in the TSV club building.

name: 17. Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon
description: The 17th Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon offers a unique running weekend with an exhilarating atmosphere in the heart of Salzkotten. The courses lead through the town and the district of Verne, are officially measured, and provide a sporting experience at the highest level. In the shadow of the Salzkotten saline, runners will find a first-class refreshment area and a relaxed chillout zone. All proceeds from the event directly support youth work of local clubs, thereby promoting sports in the region.
course_highlights: Attractive loop course approximately 10.55 km through Salzkotten and Verne
Marathon and half marathon courses officially measured and IWR/DLO-compliant
Loop course with about 25 meters of elevation, flat 10 km route ideal for personal bests
additional: Start times vary depending on the distance: Marathon and half marathon start at 08:30, 10 km run at 10:30, 5 km run at 11:30, children's runs from 15:30 with different start times depending on age group. The courses are officially measured and meet international competition rules. On race day, local roads and side streets are closed from approximately 06:30 to 16:00. There is a supervised bicycle parking lot at the Sälzerhalle parking lot available for voluntary donation. The NUNAV app is recommended for stress-free arrival and parking search. The marathon emphasizes community and team spirit, with corporate teams able to participate in the team competition. The event also offers parking options, pacemaker teams, and a supporting program for families.

name: 21. ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf
description: The ProPotsdam Castle Run in Potsdam is a unique running event that combines tradition, culture, and athletic challenge. The course leads through the historic castles, gardens, and sights of the Brandenburg state capital and offers runners an unforgettable experience in UNESCO World Heritage. With over 4,500 participants, the race is a popular event for running enthusiasts of all performance levels. Experience the special atmosphere and the diverse impressions along the route through the city’s history.
course_highlights: Run through historic castles, churches, parks, and gardens
Course along lakes, rivers, bridges, and the Russian Colony
Temporary road closures in Potsdam city center and surroundings
additional: The race takes place on June 7, 2026, from 09:00 to 12:00. The course is temporarily closed to traffic in several sections and will be reopened after the runners have passed. Until April 30, 2026, a start place transfer is possible via the Davengo account, afterwards only until May 20, 2026, through a re-registration form. On the day before, June 6, 2026, there will be an experiential sports day with participatory activities and movement stations for families and children at the Luftschiffhafen Sports Park. The event includes course details, start times, fees, a special edition T-shirt, pasta party, downloadable certificate, age restrictions, bib numbers, timing with EasyChip, online registration, and a run through historic landmarks.

name: 45. Wehlheider Volkslauf
location: Park Schönfeld, Kassel-Wehlheiden, Kassel, Hesse, Germany
description: The Wehlheider Volkslauf is a traditional mass participation event held in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden, which is part of the Nordhessencup. The course mainly runs on paved paths and through forested areas, with various distances suitable for all age groups. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to everyone, regardless of club affiliation. Changing and shower facilities are available, and runners are provided with refreshments along the route.
course_highlights: Course mainly on paved paths and through forested areas
5 km course as a turnaround route
Children's runs at Angerstation with 400 m and 1000 m distances
additional: Spike shoes are prohibited. Bib numbers must be worn visibly; safety pins are not provided. Changing and shower facilities are available but without windows, posing an infection risk. The event is part of the Nordhessencup and the HLV running cup. Pre-registration is mandatory; late registrations are not possible. The event takes place in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Nordhessencup, a series of running events in northern Hesse.

name: Harzgeröder Klippenlauf
description: The Harzgeröder Cliffs Run on June 7, 2026, is a versatile folk and cross-country race in the Lower Harz, suitable for runners of all performance levels. Offered are distances from 1 km for children up to the challenging half marathon with 21.1 km and 450 meters of elevation. The races lead through the Selketal along the Selketalstieg, past the districts of Mägdesprung and Alexisbad, featuring rocky sections, narrow trail paths, and a rock tunnel. In addition to the sporting challenge, the Cliffs Run also offers fun for the whole family with a raffle and other events. The start and finish are located on the grounds of the dog training area in Harzgerode.
course_highlights: Rocky sections and challenging ascents
Narrow trail paths along the Selketalstieg
Rock tunnel on the 15 km and half marathon routes
additional: Start and finish at the dog training area in Harzgerode with an organizational office and race number pickup. Safety pins are not allowed to attach the race number; race number bands are available for 5 EUR. Different starting categories include a taster run (1 km), school run (2.5 km), open run (5 km), main run (15 km), and half marathon (21.1 km). A raffle with great prizes for participants. The event is one of the major running and sports events in the region. Participants can pre-order a race shirt; registration is possible online, and running with dogs is prohibited. description: The 44th Heiligenröder Evening Run is a traditional night street race in Niestetal, Germany, which is part of the Nordhessencup running series. The event offers courses for all age groups and performance levels, from 400 meters for toddlers to 20.35 km for experienced runners. The event combines competitive elements with more relaxed running options, with toddlers, walkers, and Nordic walkers being stopped but not classified. Participation is free for toddlers, while moderate entry fees apply for children, adolescents, and adults.
course_highlights: Night street race in Niestetal-Heiligenrode
Courses ranging from 400 m to 20.35 km
Part of the Nordhessencup running series
additional: Toddlers run for free, entry fees for children, adolescents, and adults are moderate. Toddlers, walkers, and Nordic walkers are stopped but not classified. The event is listed on laufen.de. Typical June weather: around 23°C, mostly sunny. Night race, multiple distances, events for all ages, part of Nordhessencup Laufserie

name: Gänseliesellauf
location: Krischerstraße, Monheim am Rhein, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Stadt Monheim am Rhein, Sportgemeinschaft Monheim 1894/1968 e.V.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inklusive 100 Meter-Lauf für alle keine Anmeldegebühr

description: The 40th Gänseliesellauf will take place on June 12, 2026, in Monheim am Rhein and traditionally opens the city festival. There will be five different races for various age groups, from a 900-meter run for kindergarten children to a 10-kilometer race for adults. The event is organized by the city of Monheim am Rhein in cooperation with the sports club Monheim 1894/1968 e. V. and offers not only athletic competition but also a diverse supporting program with catering and festival activities. The races start and end on Krischerstraße, and all participants receive certificates that can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Krischerstraße at house number 10
Five races for different age groups and distances
Event as part of the Monheim city festival with festival program
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before each race. Certificates can be downloaded after the race via my.raceresult.com. Refreshing drinks and food are available near the races. The event is supported by MEGA Monheimer Elektrizitäts- und Gasversorgung GmbH. Various race distances, registration by email, certificates available online, city festival program

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The Lippe Summer Series 2026 is a three-part running event taking place from June 12 to June 26, 2026, in the Schieder-Schwalenberg region. The first race, the 36th Donoper Volkslauf, is organized by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and features a varied course of 7,777 meters around the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines athletic challenge with nature experience and community and is open to runners, walkers, and hikers.
course_highlights: 7,777 meters of varied course profile
Start and finish at the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop
Part of a three-part running series through the most beautiful landscapes of the region
additional: The Lippe Summer Series includes three races on three consecutive Fridays. In addition to the race, walking and hiking are also possible. The event is supported by the KOLIBRI Förderverein für offene Kinder- und Jugendarbeit Schwalenberg e.V. The event takes place on roads and in the terrain, with temperatures around 23°C in June. It is a social run suitable for the whole family.

name: Aschauer Bankerl-Lauf
location: Aschau im Chiemgau, Rosenheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Aschauer Bankerl Run is a convivial evening run set in the idyllic Chiemgau landscape, open to all running enthusiasts. For the fifth time, the organizer Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. invites participants to a race event without timing, where the focus is on the joy of movement. Various distances are offered, ranging from about 1 km (Bambini run) to 7 km. Part of the proceeds will be donated to a good cause, making the event socially engaged.
course_highlights: Idyllic landscape in Chiemgau
Distances from approx. 1 km to 7 km
Evening run without timing with accompanying runners
additional: Accompanying runners are available for more leisurely participants. In the finish area, there are water, coffee, cake, and other refreshments. Part of the proceeds benefits the Benedetto-Menni-Nest, a shared living community for people with special support needs in Aschau. Race for all age groups, donations for charitable purposes, online registration, accompanying runners, refreshments at the finish area

name: Citylauf Grevenbroich
description: The City Run Grevenbroich is a family-friendly running event with nine different races that appeals to sports enthusiasts of all ages. The event offers ideal courses, top entertainment, and excellent organization supported by the entire city. In addition to the athletic competition, there is an attractive supporting program and coveted prizes for the best participants. The races range from short Bambini and school runs to open to all and city championship races over 5 km and 10 km.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 700 m to 10 km
City championship race in the Sparkassen Run over 10 km
Family event with nine races and great supporting program
additional: Nine races with start times from 5:30 PM to 8:40 PM, including Bambini, school, and relay competitions. Certificates for all participants as well as medals and prizes for the best. Timing is provided by TAF-Timing. The event is a major city event with strong support and a supporting program. Multiple race distances, online registration, chip timing, results since 2015, anniversary event in 2026.

name: Deichlauf Neuwied

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Jugend ab 12 Jahre (Jg. 2014) bis 19 Jahre (Jg. 2007) 8,- EUR

description: The Deichlauf Neuwied is a traditional running event in Rhineland-Palatinate that appeals to runners of all ages. It offers various competitions, including children and youth runs, an Olympic school relay, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as walking/nordic walking. The course runs along the dyke and provides an attractive running backdrop. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and attracts around 2,000 participants annually.
course_highlights: Running course along the dyke
Diverse competitions from 600 m relay to 10 km run
Attractive running backdrop in Neuwied
additional: Showers are not available. Medical services are on site at the finish and along the course. Photos and videos are taken by an authorized service provider and may be published. Late registrations are possible online until June 11, 2026, and on the day of the event until one hour before the respective start. Participants are insured under the sports insurance contract of the Sportbund Rheinland. Various categories for children, youth, and adults; registration until May 31, 2026; results and certificates available online.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derentaler Löwenlauf is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a sporting family event for all age groups. The event offers various distances that lead through the beautiful Derentaler farmland and Steinbachtal valley. A special focus is on celebrating diversity, tolerance, and working together, supported by a donation to the "augen auf!" foundation per participant. The race is organized with great heart by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, teenagers, adults, and seniors.
course_highlights: 3 km Schülerlauf ab 8 Jahren
6 km Runde durch die Derentaler Feldmark
12,7 km Strecke inklusive Steinbachtal
additional: One euro per participant is donated to the "augen auf!" foundation. The race is conceived as a family festival with various distances for all age groups. Multiple distances (300 m, 10 km), no official timing, special route due to construction work, fundraising for the 'Augen auf!' foundation.

name: Holstenköstenlauf
organizer: SVT Neumünster in Kooperation mit BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH
price_range: 10 km Lauf: 23,00 Euro bis 26,00 Euro, 5 km Lauf: 13,00 Euro bis 16,00 Euro, Holstenkösten-Becher: 12,00 Euro
description: The Holstenköstenlauf in Neumünster is a traditional city run that takes place as part of Schleswig-Holstein's largest city festival, the Holstenköste. The event offers races for all age groups, from children to adults, and runs through various districts of Neumünster. The 10 km course is officially measured according to DLV rules and promises an attractive route through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.
course_highlights: Attractive course through city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld
10 km course officially measured according to DLV rules
Start and finish at Kleinflecken, identical start and finish line
additional: Race bib distribution on June 10 and 11, 2026, timing with transponder (timing fee 3.00 euros, waived if using own BMS chip), race bib is non-transferable and must be worn at the front of sportswear, Holstenkösten mug can be pre-ordered (12.00 euros) and will be handed out at race bib pickup. Participation is possible for various age groups, registration online or on-site, race bib pickup in the foyer of the city hall, refreshments on the course and at the finish, award ceremonies in the evening.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is an experiential race without timing, appealing to runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometer routes. Additionally, there are children's races for kindergarten and elementary school children, enthusiastically accompanied by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop runs from the marketplace along the Hauptfehnkanal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and back to the finish via the East Frisia hiking trail. The 5 km route also starts from the marketplace, goes over the East Frisia hiking trail, and returns to the finish. The race offers a beautiful opportunity to experience the region on varied paths.
course_highlights: 10 km loop along Hauptfehnkanal and East Frisia hiking trail
5 km loop with a circuit through Rhaudermoor and East Frisia hiking trail
Children's races for kindergarten and elementary school children
additional: The race is a community run without timing. Training plans for different performance goals are offered. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers. It takes place in June, with typical weather around 23°C. There are bus transportation options from Rhauderfehn to Ihrhove, as well as showers and changing facilities on site. Competitions are also offered for children and adolescents.

name: Krackenlauf 2026
description: Krackenlauf Großlangheim takes place on Friday, June 12, 2026, and offers races for various age groups and performance levels. There is a Bambini race over 800 meters, a school race over 2000 meters, a main race over 7500 meters, and a walker competition over 6000 meters. The event is a popular local running event with unchanged times and distances, open to all running enthusiasts. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.
course_highlights: Bambini race 800 meters
School race 2000 meters
Main race 7500 meters and walker 6000 meters
additional: The races and distances remain unchanged compared to previous years. Registration is done online via RaceResult. There are races for children, students, the main race, and walkers. The event takes place in the evening. The event offers various categories, including children's races, main race, and walker competition. Registration will be later via RaceResult, and the event takes place in Großlangheim.

name: Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben
description: The "Meine Night" charity relay race is a community running event in Meine, organized to benefit charitable causes. The event promotes team spirit and athletic effort in a special atmosphere. Participants experience a varied course that runs through the community and strengthens the sense of community.
course_highlights: Relay race format for teams
Course through the community of Meine
Charity run with social engagement
additional: Charity run, registration available via the website, event promotes community and spirituality

name: Oesterweger Feuerwehrlauf
description: The Oesterweger People's and Fire Brigade Run in Versmold offers a diverse running program for all age groups and skill levels on June 12, 2026. From short Bambini and school runs without an entry fee to an officially measured 10 km road race and a team and fire brigade run over 6 km, there is something for everyone. The flat, asphalted routes lead through the town center and provide plenty of motivation from spectators. Walkers can also enjoy a beautiful 6 km tour through the rural countryside in parallel.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalted routes through the town center of Oesterweg
10 km loop course with four equal laps plus an introductory lap
6 km laps for team and fire brigade run as well as walking
additional: Bambini run (450 m) and school run (1.2 km) are free of charge. The school run is scored for participants up to 11 years old, and the taster run for up to 15 years old. The team and fire brigade run consists of teams of four participants each. Walkers start parallel to the fire brigade run from the back rows to avoid disturbing the runners. Various distances available, online registration, race brochures for download, special categories for fire brigade and teams, results on TimeTeamJung.

name: Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf
description: The Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf takes place on June 12, 2026, at the GWG-Schwerte-Arena and welcomes numerous runners in a proven format. The afternoon is dedicated to younger participants with shorter distances, while the longer races in the evening are the main attraction. Especially popular are the relay races for children and youth, as well as the Nordic walking competition along the scenic Ruhrtalradweg. The course for the 10 km run is measured according to DLV standards and is a loop course over asphalted and paved paths through a forest area, with the finish line in the stadium.
course_highlights: 10 km course measured according to DLV standards
Loop course over the asphalted Ruhrtalradweg and paved forest paths
Finish in the stadium of GWG Schwerte Arena
additional: Race bib distribution and late registration on June 11, 2026, from 6 to 7 PM at the competition office. Late registrations are possible up to 60 minutes before the start of each category for a fee of €3 (children's races are free). Included in the registration fee are timing via disposable transponder, personalized certificate, shower facilities at the VfB Westhofen club house, baggage storage without liability, water service at the 5 km and 10 km runs, and drinks at the finish area. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The event offers a variety of running options for all age groups and supports community sports. Registration is via the official website, and the event takes place on a Friday in June.

name: Sommer-Abend-Lauf
description: The Summer Evening Run in Steinach is a popular running event celebrating its 10th edition on June 12, 2026. It offers a main race of 5 and 10 kilometers on a scenic, flat course as well as various children's runs. The event attracts many running enthusiasts from the region and beyond each year and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with start and finish at the school. The races take place in the evening, offering a special running experience in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat, scenic running course through Steinach
5 km or 10 km main race (1 or 2 laps of 5 km each)
Children's runs on school streets with 375 m, 750 m, and 1100 m
additional: Children's runs start staggered from 6:00 PM (Bambini 375 m), 6:30 PM (school children 750 m), and 7:00 PM (school children 1100 m). The main race starts at 8:00 PM with start and finish at the school. Changing facilities are available in the gymnasium and festival hall. Flat course, online registration possible, family- and company-friendly.

name: Spendenlauf LT Phoenix Dudweiler
description: The LT Phoenix Dudweiler charity run is a running event where all entry fees and donations benefit the Children's Hospice and Palliative Care Team Saar. Participants have the opportunity on-site to learn about the important work of the organization. The run not only promotes the health and well-being of the runners but also supports a significant social cause in the Saarbrücken region.
course_highlights: Charity run in favor of the Children's Hospice and Palliative Care Team Saar
Event in Saarbrücken-Dudweiler
Information about the work of the supported organization on-site
additional: Participation in the run is linked to a club insurance, which requires prior registration with the sports officer Fabiola Marx (Phone: 06897 761487, Email: fabi.marx@web.de). No published start times or prize categories are available on the website. The run is part of the activities of the running group "Rennschnecke" Dudweiler e.V. and offers the opportunity to learn about the work of the Children's Hospice and Palliative Care Team Saar on-site. The event is open to all age groups and performance levels.

name: Volksbank Ettlinger Altstadt-Lauf
location: Volksbank Arena, Stadtgarten Ettlingen, Ettlingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Volksbank Ettlinger Old Town Run will take place on June 12, 2026, at the Volksbank Arena in the Stadtgarten Ettlingen. The course runs through the historic old town with a mix of paved streets and cobblestone alleys, passing landmarks such as the Baroque Ettlingen Palace and the Town Hall Bridge with the St. Nepomuk stone statue. Various races are offered for students, youth, a 10 km main race, and an inclusion run. The event is family-friendly and offers competitions suitable for all ages.
course_highlights: Course through historic old town alleys and paved streets
Passing the Baroque Ettlingen Palace and the Town Hall Bridge with St. Nepomuk statue
Loop course with start and finish in Schöllbronner Straße
additional: There is a timing service with pacemakers for finish times between 40 and 60 minutes, recognizable by large balloons. Original old town run race shirts made of breathable Coolmax material can be pre-ordered for 19 euros, with the deadline for orders on May 6, 2026. Courses: 1 km students' run, 2.95 km students' run, 10 km main run, 3.525 km inclusion run; start times from 6:00 PM; venue: Volksbank Arena, Stadtgarten Ettlingen; approximately 1,500 participants; including tandem runs for the inclusion run; large post-race party.

name: Voxtruper Volkslauf
description: The 13th Voxtruper Volkslauf on June 12, 2026, in Osnabrück offers a diverse running program for all age groups and performance levels. The event includes courses from 0.4 km for children to the main race over 9.8 km with 182 meters of elevation. The runs take place through a very beautiful landscape with several refreshment points to ensure participants' well-being. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event, and the event emphasizes a safe and smooth process without dogs and baby joggers.
course_highlights: Very scenic race with different courses
Main race 9.8 km with 182 meters of elevation
Multiple refreshment points depending on the course (up to four for 9.8 km)
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 45 minutes before the respective race. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. Certificate printing online and result lists at www.laufen-os.de. Refreshment points: 1 at 3.9 km, 2 at 5.5 km, 4 at 9.8 km. Participants can register on-site; no dogs or baby joggers allowed; the courses are designed to be scenic.

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
location: Heilwald, Bad Lippspringe, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon will take place on June 13, 2026, in Bad Lippspringe. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, totaling 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald, which offers a special running experience with its calming upland climate and diverse forest. The event is a private running event with self-supply, where timing is done manually and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and a voluntary donation for tree planting is requested.
course_highlights: Six laps of 7.05 km through the Bad Lippspringe Heilwald
Diverse forest with calming upland climate
Course measured with a survey wheel and GPS watch
additional: Self-supply with provisions, as runners pass by the car after each lap. Timing is done with a manual stopwatch, a photo of the clock on race day must be emailed as proof. No showers or changing facilities are available. Participant limit 18, minimum age 18. Organizer assumes no liability. Participation at your own risk. Consent to the creation and use of photos, result lists, and videos is given upon registration. Course: 6 laps of 7.05 km in the Heilwald; self-supply; no showers; participation at own risk; participant limit 18; registration until the day before at 6 pm.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: The 13th Himmelswegelauf on June 13, 2026, takes participants through a unique cultural landscape around Nebra (Unstrut). The running routes connect significant archaeological sites such as the Pömmelte ring sanctuary, the Goseck solar observatory, and the site of the Nebra sky disk. The start and finish are at the Arche Nebra visitor center, close to the sky disk, which is considered the oldest concrete depiction of the cosmos. In addition to the marathon, half marathon, and the 10 km sky disk run, there are also walking, cycling tours, and hikes to the site. The event is under the patronage of the Prime Minister of Saxony-Anhalt and offers a culturally and sportingly appealing experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Arche Nebra, near the Nebra sky disk
Routes pass by the 4,000-year-old Pömmelte ring sanctuary
Marathon starts at the 7,000-year-old Goseck solar observatory
additional: Race number pickup and late registration are possible on the day of the event, with different times for marathon, half marathon, sky disk run, walking, and cycling tours. The event offers not only running disciplines but also walking, cycling tours, and hikes. The award ceremonies are hosted by Radio SAW presenter Holger Tapper. The event is open to runners, cyclists, walkers, and hikers, with registration required. The date is planned for June 13, 2026.

name: 14. Glück-Lauf
description: The Glück-Lauf in Salzgitter-Gebhardshagen is a versatile running event that appeals to both families and experienced runners. With distances ranging from 1.2 km for children to a challenging trail half marathon over 21.2 km with nearly 400 meters of elevation gain, the event offers something for everyone. Approximately 400 participants, including hobby runners, competitive athletes, and local club runners, share the race day. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized refreshment stations along the course.
course_highlights: Trail half marathon with approximately 21.2 km and nearly 400 m elevation gain
Children's run over 1.2 km with participation from U8 children
Refreshment stations and preparation for sunny weather
additional: The event includes a 10.8 km course with a remarkable story of a 64-year-old runner who overtook younger competitors. Participants are encouraged to prepare for the sun with caps, scarves, and hydration packs. The event attracts both children and experienced runners and is a local highlight in Gebhardshagen. Distances range from 1.2 km to 21.2 km, including a trail half marathon, family and competitive events. Weather in June is usually warm and sunny. Registration is available online and on-site.

name: 15. Fullestrand-Ultramarathon
description: The Fullestrand Ultramarathon will take place on June 13, 2026, in Kassel and offers a challenging 46.5 km course along the Fulda River with approximately 350 meters of elevation gain. The route starts in Kassel and runs upstream along the Fuldahöhenweg and back along the Fuldaradweg, passing through diverse landscapes and natural areas. The event is organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the leadership of Sylke Kuhn and combines athletic challenge with the beauty of North Hesse's nature and culture.
course_highlights: 46.5 km long course along the Fulda with about 350 meters of elevation
Sections on the Fuldahöhenweg (marking X17) with some elevation gain
Return route on the Fuldaradweg R1 through Fulda meadows, Bugaseen, and Kassel districts
additional: Meet at 7:58 AM at the start. Start and finish are at Auedamm 17 in Kassel, opposite the pancake house next to the Auebad. The route partly runs on bike paths and requires use of the harbor bridge traffic lights. The event is organized by Sylke Kuhn, who also manages other marathon and ultramarathon races in the region. The course includes flat paths, single trails with mud, no markings, water stations available, time limit of 8 hours.

name: 18. Edeka Ladage-Lauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 3 € Teilnehmer:innen: Kindergarten­kinder laufen eine etwa 600 m und Grundschüler:innen eine 900 m lange Strecke.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 4 € Teilnehmer:innen: Jahrgänge 2014 und jünger (U12) | Jahrgänge 2010 bis 2013 (U16)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 8 € || Jahrgänge 2007 und jünger: 4 € Teilnehmer:innen: Jahrgänge 2015 und älter

description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a traditional community race with a variety of competitions for all age groups. The event takes place at the sports facility of the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule and offers diverse loop courses used by children from kindergarten age to experienced runners. The longer runs follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop with start and finish near the event area, creating a special atmosphere. In addition to the athletic competition, community experience is also emphasized, supported by a prize draw and an enthusiastic volunteer team.
course_highlights: Varied loop courses on the school grounds for children
Slightly modified 2.5 km loop for longer runs with start/finish near the event area
Atmospheric course through residential streets, field paths, and athletics tracks
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site up to one hour before each start, with additional fees (€5 including €2 deposit for rental bib). Kindergarten children and elementary school students run an exciting loop course on the school grounds. The longer runs use a 2.5 km loop, which is run twice (5 km) or four times (10 km). Participation in the charity run includes automatic entry into the prize draw. The proceeds from the charity run go to the craft community of the Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is organized by SG Bredenbeck-Holtensen e.V. and takes place on the grounds of Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule, featuring various race categories and a focus on community and health. Participation supports the local community and promotes youth sports.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is a race under the motto "Run for Runners by Runners" and takes place on June 13, 2026, at the Heinrich-Germer Stadium in Magdeburg. The event is characterized by enthusiasm for running and the Sudenburg district. There are various race routes for children, teenagers, and adults that lead through the city and the stadium. The focus is on encouraging as many people as possible to run and to do so with a smile on their face.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heinrich-Germer Stadium with a final stadium lap
Round course of 2.2 kilometers, run two or five times depending on the distance
The route passes through Salzmannstraße, Walmbergsweg, Braunlager Straße, Halberstädter Straße, and Lemsdorfer Weg
additional: Race bib pickup on June 12, 2026, from 14:30 to 18:00 at Sporthaus sport39 (Halberstädter Str. 21) or on the event day until 9:00 at Heinrich-Germer Stadium. Late registrations are possible from June 8, 2026, until the day of the event, but with a late registration fee. There is an award ceremony for children's races at 10:15 a.m. and for the longer races at 11:45 a.m. Participation conditions include liability waiver, fair play, and waste disposal obligations. The races are scoring routes for SRL MD and EOC-Cup. Online registration only; participation in June 2026; part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP Series; the goal is to promote the joy of running in the city.

name: 5. Biber Backyard Ultra
description: The Biber Backyard Ultra is a unique ultra-running event in Simmerath/Lammersdorf scheduled for June 13, 2026. Participants run a 6.7-kilometer loop every hour with varying elevation gains until only one runner remains. The course passes through forest and field paths as well as trails with a challenging incline. The event is characterized by its special Ultra-Backyard format, where each loop must be completed within one hour. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and challenges endurance and tactics alike.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with approximately 110 meters of elevation during the day
Trail passages and many forest and field paths
Hourly start with one hour per loop
additional: Registration traditionally opens on December 6 at 00:01. The course is divided into a day and a night section. There is no lap time measurement; only the number of completed laps is counted. Start announcements are made 3, 2, and 1 minute before each lap. Personal support and aids during the lap are not allowed. The event has a family atmosphere with sponsorship from outdoor manufacturer OMM. The course is split into day and night segments, with 110 meters of elevation during the day and 60 meters at night. Catering is available at the start/finish area, along with showers, sanitary facilities, accommodation options, and community events on site.

name: DUD Ultra
description: The DUD Ultra 70km is a road ultramarathon in Duderstadt, Germany, taking place on a short loop around the Duderstadt Wall. The loop is under 5 km long with 36 meters of elevation gain per lap, allowing runners to complete the same course multiple times throughout the day. The race has a time limit of 12 hours, a participant cap, and an entry fee of 100 euros. The compact course layout enables spectators to see the runners multiple times, as a single aid station services the entire loop. The DUDultra organizer also offers additional distances such as 50 km, 100 km, and a 100 km relay race.
course_highlights: Loop under 5 km with 36 m elevation gain per lap
Compact course with a single aid station
Spectators can see runners multiple times along the course
additional: The race has a 12-hour time limit and a participant cap. There are additional distances offered as part of the event: 50 km, 100 km, and a 100 km relay for four runners. Weather conditions in June are typically around 23 °C with a minimum of 13 °C and mostly sunny. The race takes place on a loop around the Duderstadt Wall, with limited participant numbers and multiple ultra distances available.

name: Ottermeerlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Einzelläufer 25 Euro bis 09. Juni 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Staffeln 50 Euro bis 09. Juni 2026

description: The Ottermeer Run in Wiesmoor is a traditional race taking place on June 13, 2026. The event offers a varied course with an encouraging atmosphere and is open to individual runners and relay teams. Notably, there is a 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and is aimed at runners aged 18 and above. Every finisher receives a personalized medal in the shape of the Ottermeer contours with the mascot Otti as a reward.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the cafeteria 'Lüttje Haven' in Wiesmoor
Varied course with motivating spectator cheers
Personalized medal in the shape of the Ottermeer contours with mascot Otti
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 09:00 AM until one hour before the start. The minimum age for individual ultramarathon runners is 18 years, for relay teams 8 years. Michis Physiotherapy offers massages on-site for donations. The bib number must be visibly worn on the chest and returned after the race. The number of participants is limited to 400. Participation from 18 years, medal with Ottermeer motif, on-site physiotherapy support, accompanying program, team and family event.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
price_range: 25 € für den 24h Lauf, andere Laufzeiten variieren
description: The 24-hour race at Friedensstadion Halberstadt will take place on June 12, 2026, starting at 6:00 PM and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in cooperation with the Halberstadt Leisure and Sports Center. The goal of the race is to keep the tartan track continuously occupied by runners for the entire 24 hours. The event is part of the VfB Germania club festival, which features various sports departments and invites participation. In addition to the race, traditional activities such as pulling a coach on the track are offered. The event provides a sporting challenge and a social program for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 24 hours of continuous running on the tartan track at Friedensstadion
Event embedded in the VfB Germania club festival with diverse sports offerings
Traditional coach-pulling on the track as a special highlight
additional: The race takes place on the tartan track of Friedensstadion. It is aimed that the track will be continuously occupied by runners throughout the entire 24 hours. The club festival offers, in addition to the race, the opportunity to try various sports such as archery, table tennis, judo, athletics, and gymnastics. Multiple race distances, club festival, Harzer Lauf-Cup race series, registration until June 4, 2026, live results on-site and online.

name: Ahrathon Erlebnislauf
location: Weingut Sonnenberg, Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany

price_tiers.distance: 21 km Halbmarathon I - Nur schnelle Läufer!!! - Vor KHM

description: The Ahrathon experience run on June 13, 2026, in Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler offers a diverse running experience from a 500m kids' run to the 42km marathon. The start and finish are located at the Sonnenberg winery, where a family festival and a closing festival with live music take place. The course leads through the picturesque Ahr Valley with refreshment stations offering water, fruit, wine, and gourmet snacks. The event is characterized by a special atmosphere with wine presentations and creative costume runs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sonnenberg winery in Bad Neuenahr
Refreshment stations with water, fruit, isotonic drinks, and wine from renowned wineries
Family festival at the start/finish area and closing festival 'Rock & Wine' from 5:00 PM
additional: Refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, energy bars, and at selected stations, wine from renowned wineries. Marathon participants pass refreshment points twice, while half marathon and 21km races pass once. There is a family festival at the start/finish area and a closing festival with live music from 5:00 PM. Age group winners receive wine gifts, costume runners are judged for creativity, and there are material prizes for the winners of the shorter races. The event features wine tastings, distances from 5 km to marathon, costume runs, along the wineries in the Ahr Valley.

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature experience run in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and takes place on June 13, 2026, for the 10th time. The route leads through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund and offers runners a special natural experience along the peninsulas and islands of the region. The race is characterized by its tradition and the special flair created by the combination of nature, challenge, and community. Registration opens on July 1, 2025, with the deadline on May 31, 2026.
course_highlights: Scenic diversity along the Baltic Sea coast from Rostock to Stralsund
Natural experience on the peninsulas Fischland, Darß, and Zingst
Route sections around the Saaler Bodden and on the islands of Poel and Usedom
additional: The start takes place early in the morning at 04:06 AM in the glow of flickering fire bowls. The route has been updated and includes location information for all supply points. Registration is exclusively via the Tollense Timing GmbH portal. There are prizes for the fastest male and female runners on the main route. Nature experience run, route length over 117 km, relay and beach sections, sand passages, elevation profile up to 23 meters, registration required.

name: Gaißeschennerlauf Kieselbronn
description: The Gaißeschennerlauf is an annual running event organized by the Kieselbronn Gymnastics Club in Kieselbronn, Baden-Württemberg. The race has been held regularly since 2003 and is part of a local popular race series. The event offers runners the opportunity to experience a scenic route, which is presented on the website with a video and external profiles on AllTrails. The name Gaißeschennerlauf gives the event a special local identity.
course_highlights: Two distances: 450 m and 21 km
Route profiles available on AllTrails
Part of a regional popular race series
additional: Registration is via MY RACE RESULT. The weather in June is typically mild with an average of 23 °C and occasional rain. Registration via MY RACE RESULT; race on the sports grounds Heinloch and surrounding area; takes place in June 2026

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival in Harsefeld will take place on June 13, 2026, and combines athletic challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can participate in various distances, from children's and toddler runs to short, long-distance, and relay races. In the evening, the market street transforms into a lively party zone with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a regular part of the Harsefeld event calendar and offers, in addition to sports, a colorful children's program and culinary stands.
course_highlights: Children's run approx. 2,000 meters
Short distance approx. 5,100 meters and long distance approx. 10,200 meters
Relay 4 × approx. 2,550 meters
additional: Registration opens on April 1, 2026. Official festival running shirts with logo available for order. Anniversary gift for all runners upon pickup of the bib number. Schools and kindergartens can run checks that are honored on stage. Open-air disco until 11 PM with 2006 revival party. Various race distances, children's program, music & party, registration from April 1, 2026, festival shirts, sponsors: Friedrich and Margret Tobaben Foundation.

name: Himmelgeister Brückenlauf
location: Steinkaul, Himmelgeist, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Himmelgeister Bridge Run is a traditional half marathon that has been held annually in Düsseldorf-Himmelgeist since 2004. The course runs along the Rhine almost into the heart of Düsseldorf and offers a scenic running route. The race starts early in the morning around 8 a.m. at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the post-run party in the beer garden of Haus Krevet. In 2026, the race will take place for the last time, as the organizing team will withdraw after the anniversary.
course_highlights: Run along the Rhine with a view of Düsseldorf
Start at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist
8 refreshment points along the 21.1 km course
additional: Race bib collection on June 12 from 1 p.m. to 7 p.m. and on June 13 from 6:15 a.m. to 7:45 a.m. at the starting point. Timing is done with a chest transponder behind the race bib.
