Clothing can be left at the beer garden of Haus Krevet at your own risk. Post-run party with raffle and award ceremony starting around 10:30 a.m. Separate awards for the best women, men, and teams; no age group classifications. Recommended travel by bus line 835 or carpooling; parking at Aldi parking lot is prohibited. Anniversary race, start at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist, last event in 2026, participation according to DLV guidelines, no shower facilities, online results and photos.

name: Hohenlimburger Lennelauf
description: The 3rd Hohenlimburger Lennelauf will take place on June 13, 2026, around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg. The event is aimed at runners and walkers of all ages and offers suitable distances for every age group. The race is organized by the Elseyer Turnverein 1881 e.V., known for its diverse sports programs for the whole family. The event promises a sporty and communal atmosphere in a beautiful park setting.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg
Suitable for runners and walkers of all ages
Family-friendly event
additional: The race offers various distances for running and walking, suitable for all age groups. Registration is via the Elseyer Turnverein. Telephone contact times are available on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Fridays at specific times. The course is on asphalt, spikes are not allowed, limited starting spots, on-site catering, use of transponders for timing.

name: Holzgerlinger Lauf - Waldtrail
price_range: 15.- € bis 18.- € für Erwachsene, kostenlos für Kinder und Jugendliche
description: The Holzgerlinger Lauf - Waldtrail takes place in 2026 for its 41st edition and is part of the Schönbuch Cup as the third scoring race. The course runs in two laps over tartan track, asphalt, and forest ground through the beautiful Holzgerlinger forest. The first half is mostly flat, while the second half is hilly with a final ascent accompanied by drum sounds. Overall, runners pass through the filled stadium three times, where spectators cheer with music – at the start, after the first 5 km lap, and at the finish line.
course_highlights: Two laps over tartan track, asphalt, and forest ground
Beautiful, wind-protected run through the Holzgerlinger forest
Three passes through the filled stadium with music and spectator cheering
additional: The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses with elevation profile. On June 6, 2026, a taster run without registration will take place. The course is well paved and mainly through the forest. In 2024, the event was listed among the top 100 best running events by the Württemberg Athletics Association (WLV). The event also includes a taster run for newcomers, team and pair competitions, and an after-race party.

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The 13th Kalimandscharolauf 2026 will take place on June 13, 2026, in Zielitz and is organized by SV Kali Wolmirstedt e.V. Athletics Department. The event is hosted by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz Plant. The race is an off-stadium event and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open until June 6, 2026.
course_highlights: Run across the greened Friedrichshall slag heap with scenic views
Hilly, challenging course for various disciplines
Diverse accompanying program including walking and Nordic walking
additional: The event includes categories such as Magdeburg, Börde, and mountain running, with registration closing on June 6, 2026. It is part of a sustainable concept utilizing former industrial sites.

name: Kefenröder Dorflauf
description: The 35th Village Run in Kefenrod will take place on June 13, 2026, and is organized by the Turnverein 1908 Kefenrod e.V. The event offers runners of all ages the opportunity to participate in a traditional race set in the idyllic surroundings of Kefenrod. Registration is available through the Oberhessencup website, allowing for easy pre-registration. The race is a staple of the club's activities and promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.
course_highlights: Four laps through Kefenrod with varied elevation profile
Course lengths of 1 km and 10 km for different performance levels
Festive award ceremony with culinary offerings and a communal atmosphere
additional: Registration is via the Oberhessencup website (ohc18). No start times or fee structures are directly provided on the website. The race is part of the club life of TV 1908 Kefenrod e.V. and is included in the local race calendar. Besides the competition, it offers a convivial atmosphere with coffee, cake, beer, and barbecue specialties at the award ceremony.

name: Kehler-Rheinuferlauf
description: The Kehler Rhine Bank Run is a traditional race event celebrating its 10th anniversary, taking place in Kehl am Rhein. The event offers races for children and teenagers, a 5 km corporate run, as well as 5 km and 10 km main races on measured loop courses. The route runs attractively along the Rhine and through the Rhine floodplain, with musical entertainment along the way. Part of the registration fees will be donated to the Kehler animal shelter, making the race socially committed.
course_highlights: 5 km course through the Kehler Rhine floodplain and over the Passerelle to Strasbourg
10 km course with an additional section on forest paths in the Kehler Rhine forest
Mostly asphalted route with musical entertainment along the course
additional: Personalized bib numbers for registrations until 31.05.2026. Bib number pickup from 4:00 PM at the KFV club house in the Rhine stadium. Beverage stations at km 3, 6, 8, and at the finish with still water. Separate changing rooms and showers for men and women available. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Valuables can be stored at the late registration desk (no liability). There is a finish buffet after the race. Companies can set up a stand (3x3m) in front of the grandstand for €200, including three race entries. Courses on a measured loop course, bib numbers for registrations until 31.05.2026, registration for corporate runners and children’s races possible, donations to the Kehler animal shelter.

name: Ketteler-Lauf, Lauf dem Krebs davon
description: The Ketteler Run is a charitable race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Offenbach and is themed "Run Away from Cancer." The event supports the care of cancer patients through the proceeds of the run. The starting shot will be at 3:00 PM on Oberen Grenzstraße in Offenbach. Pre-registrations allow for the collection of race numbers and finisher T-shirts as early as June 12 at the Ketteler Hospital. The event is an established tradition and combines athletic commitment with a social cause.
course_highlights: Start on Oberen Grenzstraße, approx. at house number 119, Offenbach
Charitable run in support of the care of cancer patients
Opportunity to pick up race numbers and finisher T-shirts in advance at Ketteler Hospital
additional: Race numbers and finisher T-shirts can be picked up on June 12, 2026, from 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM at the reception area of Ketteler Hospital. On the day of the event, pickup is possible from 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM in the hospital courtyard. The run includes distances of 5 km and 7 km, with on-site registration available. The event is part of an annual series of charity runs to combat cancer and offers finisher T-shirts to participants.

name: Kidsmarathon
description: The Pillenstein KIDSmarathon on June 13, 2026, is an inclusive running event for up to 4,000 children aged 1 to 11 years. Children can choose their distance freely, with fun and participation as the main focus. There is no timing, and all participants are winners. The event offers a great atmosphere with a varied program and is barrier-free, enabling children with disabilities to participate.
course_highlights: Barrier-free routes of 200m, 400m, and 800m
Running distances for children aged 1 to 11 years freely selectable
Accompanying persons can run if needed
additional: No timing, all children are winners. Puma Finisher Shirt for early registration and while supplies last. Medical care available if needed. Safety and road closures are ensured. Late registrations are no longer possible; the event is fully booked. A companion can be provided for children with special needs. Distances: 200m, 400m, 800m; no timing; barrier-free routes; participation from 1 year old; no late registrations; including Finisher Shirt with early booking.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a traditional, DLV-approved popular race and part of the Schaumburger Laufserie. It takes place in the beautiful spa park of Bad Nenndorf and offers courses for various age and performance groups, including 1000 m, 2500 m, 5 km, 10 km, as well as 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants running on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good infrastructure with changing rooms and shower facilities.
course_highlights: Course route on paved paths through the spa park
Start and finish on the Kurpromenade at the Wandelhalle
Variety of distances from 1000 m to 10 km as well as walking variants
additional: Changing rooms and shower facilities are available at the sports center, accessible by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through the LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is guaranteed. A maximum of 300 starters for the 1000 m and 2.5 km races. 5 km Nordic walking and walking with timing without placement. First race for the Samtgemeindepokal. Scoring race of the Schaumburger Laufserie. The race is held as part of the Landesgartenschau, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th run around Lake Senftenberg will take place on June 13, 2026, offering runners various course lengths around the picturesque Lake Senftenberg. The event is open to all age groups and skill levels, from children to the challenging 17.7 km lakeside loop. The races start at 09:00 AM in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere and comprehensive catering as well as changing and washing facilities. Registration is available online via myRacePartner, with late registration possible until the day of the event for a small fee.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Senftenberg with a length of 17.7 km
Additional distances: 10.0 km, 5.4 km, 3.2 km, and a 200 m children’s run
Start and finish at the Seesporthalle Großkoschen with good infrastructure
additional: Late registrations are possible online from June 12, 2026, 18:00 until June 13, 2026, 09:00, for a late registration fee of €2.00. Parking instructions and snack provisions are free until 13:00 on the day of the event. Changing and washing facilities are available at the start and finish areas. Participation is at your own risk with a liability waiver from the organizer. Registration is via myRacePartner; free parking until 13:00; availability of changing and washing facilities; children’s and family runs included.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: The Luckenwalde Tower Festival takes place from June 12 to June 14, 2026, around the Market Tower in Luckenwalde. It is a traditional city festival that is open and accessible to all visitors, regardless of their financial means. The festival offers a diverse cultural program and invites guests from near and far to celebrate together. The city relies on an open festival organized by locals for locals and welcomes voluntary donations to support the event.
course_highlights: Various race distances, including a 10 km main run and an 800 m sprint
Integrated into the large Tower Festival with cultural and family-friendly activities
Children's and youth races as well as relay races for all age groups
additional: The Tower Festival begins each of the three days at 12:00 PM. The festival operations end at 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday, and at 10:00 PM on Sunday. No regular cultural fee is charged; instead, voluntary donations are requested, which can be handed in at the Tourist Information. The Tourist Information is open during regular hours. The event takes place as part of the Luckenwalde Tower Festival, celebrated from June 12 to June 14, 2026, in Luckenwalde, featuring music, food, rides, and family activities.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that advocates for greater openness and courage in dealing with mental health issues. The goal is to make a stand against stigma and to raise awareness for mental health. The run represents communal activity without competitive pressure and is open to all people, regardless of age, fitness level, or physical limitations. In addition to the run, there is a diverse accompanying program with music, interviews, culinary offerings, and a market of possibilities with information on mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: Run for everyone without competitive pressure, also for wheelchair users
Event held on the Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Supporting program with music, interviews, and a market of possibilities
additional: Registration is available online via the Davengo portal or in person at the KIELER FENSTER, Ambulant Center. The event takes place annually on the Saturday before the start of Kiel Week. There is an accompanying program with participatory activities for the whole family and a market of possibilities with self-help groups and social organizations. The MUT-LAUF 2026 will be held on June 13, 2026, with registration through the Davengo portal. Participation fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a friendly supporting program are offered.

name: Nordheimlauf
description: The Nordheim Run takes place on June 13, 2026, in Nordheim (Württemberg) and celebrates its 25th anniversary. Five different races are offered, including children's runs, a para-run, a school run, a fun run, and the main 10 km race. The course is varied, fully asphalted, and features approximately 150 meters of elevation gain in the main race. Timing is done electronically with transponders, and refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish. The race is part of the Ensinger-Zabergäu-Cup 2026 and offers a family-friendly and sporting atmosphere for all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Varied, fully asphalted course
Approximately 150 meters of elevation gain in the 10 km main race
Refreshment stations with mineral water along the route and at the finish
additional: Start and finish area at the sports grounds on Lauffener Straße opposite the outdoor pool. Timing with transponder on the shoe, which must be returned after the race (rental costs included in the entry fee). Online registration until June 10, 2026, 10 PM; late registrations on race day until one hour before the respective start. Nordic walkers will have their times recorded but will not be included in the rankings. Fruit provision from the 10 km main race. Group registration for teams is possible. Course profiles, parking options, route over 5 and 10 km, varied asphalted routes with about 150 meters of elevation, team competitions, online registration available.

name: Oelder Citylauf
description: The Oelder City Run is a traditional race classic in the heart of Oelde, inspiring runners of all ages for over 45 years. The event offers a diverse program with children’s, school, and inclusion runs as well as road races over 5 km and 10 km. The races take place in front of a large audience with a fairground character and are part of the Volksbank Cup race series. The course is internationally measured and runs through the city center of Oelde with start and finish at the marketplace.
course_highlights: Internationally measured 2.5 km loop, which is run multiple times depending on the distance
Course runs through the city center of Oelde with start and finish at the marketplace
Various races for all age groups including children’s and inclusion runs
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for a late registration fee of 3.00 EUR. Race documents will be issued at the event center on the marketplace. Certificates for children’s and children’s runs are available on-site, for other races online. Shower facilities are available at the sports hall of the comprehensive school Oelde, approximately 300 meters from the finish. Registration is via Raceresult; the event is known for its diverse categories and friendly atmosphere.

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight as part of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The race offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is embedded in a diverse sports and leisure program with numerous other competitions and activities. The event is aimed at sports enthusiasts of all ages and offers, in addition to the athletic competition, a lively supporting program and a large OSTSEE Party with free admission. The combination of sporting event and festival makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at APEX Ostsee-Sportpark Cottbus Willmersdorf
Course for running and walking as part of the SPARKASSEN Half Marathon
Diverse supporting program with sports and leisure activities
additional: OSTSEE Party with free entry in the evening from 8:00 PM in the festival tent. Free OSTSEE Shuttle Service from the main train station to the sports park. Diverse supporting program with children's runs, beach tennis, volleyball, archery, and other sports. Start times from 8:45 AM, registration possible, participation in a trial run with registration until 12.06.26

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon will take place on June 13, 2026, in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The course covers 21 kilometers and starts at 10:00 AM from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Participants can pick up their race documents from 7:00 AM at the start and finish area. The race is suitable for participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic Sea coast. There is no registration on-site; registration must be completed in advance.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer course along the Baltic Sea coast
Start and finish at the Möbel Höffner grounds
Race through Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee
additional: Race documents available from 7:00 AM at the start and finish area. No on-site registration possible. Participants must be at least 18 years old. Course length is 21 km.

name: Panorama-Baumwipfel-Lauf 2026
price_range: 2,00 € für bestimmte Läufe, andere nicht spezifiziert
description: The Panorama Tree Top Run 2026 is an attractive running event in the Steigerwald, attracting runners from all over Germany. The varied routes lead through vineyards and the Steigerwald Nature Park with winding trail and forest paths. The half marathon and 12 km routes run over the tower of the Tree Top Path Steigerwald and back over the Oberschwarzach Herrenberg. Start and finish are at the Panorama Terrace at the sports facility / Sebastiani House Oberschwarzach, and the running route offers new beautiful views after every bend.
course_highlights: Routes through vineyards and Steigerwald Nature Park
Winding trail and forest paths
Half marathon and 12 km over the tower of the Tree Top Path Steigerwald
additional: The event includes several race distances, including family and experience runs, with start and finish at the Panorama Terrace at the sports facility / Sebastiani House Oberschwarzach. Registration is online, the routes are scenic and lead through forest and vineyard paths.

name: Rettichfestlauf
description: The Rettichfestlauf in Schifferstadt is a traditional running event taking place on June 13, 2026. The races lead on fast and varied courses around the Waldfesthalle, partly on asphalt paths and partly on forest trails. Distances offered include 5 km and 10 km, as well as shorter runs for children, toddlers, and minis. The event is family-friendly and offers suitable running opportunities for all age groups.
course_highlights: Course route near the Waldfesthalle with asphalt and forest paths
Loop length of the main routes 2.5 km
Fast and varied running courses
additional: Start times: School run (1200 m) at 17:30, toddler run (650 m) at 17:45. There is also a mini run over 200 m without timing. Registration is expected to start in March 2026. The event takes place at the Waldfesthalle in Schifferstadt. Start and finish at the Waldfesthalle, online registration, children and school runs, timing with transponder, catering at the finish area.

name: ROCKS AND RUN 3. Rielingshäuser Steinbruch-Lauf
location: Rielingshäuser Steinbruch, Marbach am Neckar, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The ROCKS AND RUN 3rd Rielingshäuser Quarry Run will take place on June 13, 2026, in Marbach am Neckar. The race offers a distance of 2.5 km for all age groups, including special runs for children and adolescents. It is a great opportunity for families to be active together and enjoy the sporting atmosphere. The event typically occurs in June with mild temperatures and mostly sunny days.
course_highlights: 2.5 km course
Runs for all age groups including Youngster-Run and Kids-Run
Event location at Rielingshäuser Quarry near Marbach am Neckar
additional: The event is family-friendly with special runs for children and adolescents. The weather in June is typically mild and sunny with temperatures around 23°C and occasional rain. The event takes place in Marbach am Neckar, with typical weather around 23°C and occasional rain. It is ideal for families and running enthusiasts seeking a relaxed and social running event.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg is a challenging running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Altenburg. Participants can choose from various distances, including marathon, relay marathon, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, student and children's races, as well as walking events. The course leads through the historic city of Altenburg with diverse sections, including climbs in the city forest and along the Great Pond. The accompanying program offers not only a sporting challenge but also a variety of entertainment with music, a children's festival, and a lecture by running legend Uta Pippig.
course_highlights: Start at the Altenburg marketplace with a view of the Red Spitze
700-meter-long ascent through the city forest to the Bismarck Tower, the highest point of the course
Refreshment points at 5 km and 7.5 km, as well as atmosphere and party at the refreshment stations
additional: Race number pickup and late registration on June 12 from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM and on the event day from 7:00 AM until 30 minutes before each start at 'Goldener Pflug'. Changing rooms, showers, and baggage storage are available on site. Extensive accompanying program with sports fair, lectures, live music, children's festival, and a big party on the event day. The marathon has a time limit of 6 hours and 30 minutes, with the turnaround point closing after 2 hours and 45 minutes for the second lap. Runner catering, medical support, cultural program, professional timing, collectible race bibs, drinks, hot meals, showers, event T-shirts (pre-order until March 31, 2026), and secure baggage storage.

name: Steinfurter Altstadt - Abendlauf
description: The Steinfurt Old Town Evening Run is a traditional race event that will take place on June 13, 2026, marking its 38th edition. Organized by the Turnerbund Burgsteinfurt, the race offers various age categories and distances that run through the historic old town of Steinfurt. The event is particularly family-friendly and is characterized by a lively atmosphere with large starting fields. For young runners, medals and trophies are awarded, making the race a popular event for young and old alike.
course_highlights: Runs through the historic old town of Steinfurt
Age categories from children to masters athletes
Medal and water bottle for every young runner at the finish line
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on the day of the event from 1 PM at the old town hall at the market square. Late registrations are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Each young runner receives a medal and a water bottle; the top three in each category are awarded trophies. Races for different age groups, on-site registration, medals, trophies, reusable race bibs, entry fee via SEPA direct debit, no refunds available.

name: Straßenlauf Gollhofen mit Mittelfränkischer Meisterschaft über 10 km
location: Gollhofen, Landkreis Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Gollhofen Road Race takes place on June 13, 2026, for the 26th time and includes the Middle Franconia Championship over 10 km. The event is organized by FC Gollhofen and offers runners the opportunity to participate in a traditional competition. Further details and information are available in the announcement on the website. The event is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km road race with Middle Franconia Championship
Traditional race with over 25 years of history
Event in the municipality of Gollhofen, Würzburg district
additional: On June 14, 2026, starting at 1:00 PM, the German Sports Badge will be awarded. The girls' trial training is on July 4, 2026, from 10:00 AM with registration until June 26 via email. Registration for the road race is via the link provided on the website. Further details are included in the flyer and the announcement. The race takes place on a street course at the Gollhofen sports facility. Registration is online, and the event also includes youth categories. The event offers a good opportunity to meet the running community in the region.

name: Söltjerlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 3,- € Kinder und Jugendliche bis einschl. Jg. 2007

description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel, where every lap counts. The event is open to all age groups and performance levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest circuit approximately 3.8 km long with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health and invites attendees to stay after the run with catering and an award ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest circuit approx. 3.8 km
Refreshment point on the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede inn with catering
additional: Shuttle service from 09:30 AM is available to arrive on time for the 11:00 AM start. Late registrations are possible online until 12.06.2026 with a late registration fee of 3 euros. Each participant receives a certificate indicating the kilometers run. The top individual finishers and the top 10 teams will receive prizes. Parking is limited; it is recommended to use alternative parking and the shuttle bus. Dogs are only allowed on a short leash and are not permitted as team members. The competition is open to all age groups, with sponsors donating per lap for local projects. Venue at the Bergschmiede, supported by local sponsors such as Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollense Lake Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollense that attracts over 2,000 runners annually. With various distances suitable for young and old, the race offers a diverse running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging with some elevation, which is why the race is also known as "The Toughest in the North." Over 300 volunteers ensure an unforgettable running experience with certificates, functional T-shirts, and trophies for the best performers.
course_highlights: Race courses around the picturesque Tollense Lake
Challenging elevation on all routes
Family-friendly running festival with a variety of distances
additional: All participants receive a certificate and a functional T-shirt. Trophies are awarded to the top 3 overall male/female finishers, with medals and certificates for age group winners. There is a bus transfer for relay teams, which is requested during registration. Multiple distances are available, including relay marathon and children's runs; registration at tollenseseelauf.de; well-known event in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run will take place on June 13, 2026, and offers an attractive, fast course through the center of Haren. The 5 km and 10 km runs are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and are eligible for rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes as well as recreational runners. There are also special races for children and adolescents over 400 m, 750 m, and 1.5 km. Additionally, there is a team classification in the 5 km run, where teams from companies, clubs, or groups are scored.
course_highlights: Attractive and fast course through the center of Haren
5 km and 10 km courses are DLV-measured and eligible for rankings
Special races for children and adolescents over 400 m, 750 m, and 1.5 km
additional: Finishers' shirts are provided to all participants of the 5 km and 10 km runs. Payment of entry fees is via direct debit. There is a team classification in the 5 km run for teams of at least 3 people. Participation is free for children from Haren's daycare centers and schools if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded for school rankings. Free participation for children in school and daycare teams, registration until June 7, 2026. Prizes for winners and teams. Parking facilities nearby.

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Familienlauf 2,5 km Kinder ab 6 Jahre 15,00 EUR

description: The Waaker Bystopen Attack is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers courses of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km, and 10 km with over 30 natural and artificial obstacles. Participation is possible both as an individual runner and in teams, with team scoring requiring at least 4 runners. In addition to the main race, there is a Bambini Attack for the little ones, which runs without registration. The event emphasizes experience, team spirit, and outdoor activity in nature.
course_highlights: Over 30 natural and artificial obstacles
Course around the 387.2-meter-high Waaker Büsteppe
Refreshment points with water and fruit along the route
additional: Start documents can be collected from 08:00 at the Waake sports field. Bib numbers are attached to the wrist and additionally written on upper arms and lower legs; no longer any bibs on the stomach. There are two refreshment points on the course and one at the start-finish area. After the race, showers and sanitary facilities are available at the Waake elementary school. Food and drinks such as beverages, grilled items, fries, cake, and more are provided before, during, and after the race. Bags can be deposited free of charge and supervised in a truck. The Bambini Attack takes place parallel on the sports field without registration. Warm-up before each start. Obstacle race, family run, team and relay classifications, online registration, T-shirt optional for a fee.

name: Waldlauf Reutlingen-Ohmenhausen
description: The 45th Forest Run in Reutlingen-Ohmenhausen is organized by SV 1923 Ohmenhausen e.V., Department of Recreational Sports and Athletics. The races take place on Saturday evening in early summer and feature courses through the forest in the hilly Swabian Alb region on well-maintained, partly asphalted paths. There are various competitions for different age groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km hobby run, and a 2 km students' run. The event is family-friendly and offers electronic timing as well as refreshments at the finish line.
course_highlights: Courses through the forest in the hilly Swabian Alb region
Well-maintained paths, partly asphalted and free of traffic
Water stations at km 3 and 7 (10 km) or km 3 (5 km)
additional: Late registrations are possible until 5:30 PM on the day of the event with a late registration fee of €2.00. Start and finish are located at the sports grounds of SV 1923 Ohmenhausen e.V. in Reutlingen-Ohmenhausen, Hornstraße. The course is not wheelchair accessible, dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. All finishers of the 5 km and 10 km runs receive a free non-alcoholic Berg Cyriakus. Electronic timing with transponder, certificates, and result lists are available online. There is a mixed-team classification in the main race (at least 3 runners). Pre-registration is open until June 10, 2026; late registrations on the event day are possible. Dogs are prohibited, baby joggers are not permitted, water and drinks are available along the course, and electronic timing is provided.

name: Werner Volksbank Stadtlauf 20. Team- / Firmenlauf
description: The 24th Werner Volksbank City Run 20. Team / Corporate Run will take place on June 13, 2026, in Werne. This running event offers the opportunity to be active together with colleagues or friends and to strengthen team spirit. The event includes two distances, 1 km and 10 km, and is especially aimed at teams and companies who want to run together.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km and 10 km
Start location in Werne
Typical June weather with an average of 23°C and mostly sunny days
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. The event promotes physical activity and team spirit, with registration via Raceresult. The weather in June is expected to be warm and sunny at around 23°C.

name: Autohaus Lutz Nightrun
organizer: SV 1911 Traisa e.V. und Turngemeinde 1879 Traisa
description: The Autohaus Lutz Nightrun is a short race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Mühltal-Traisa. The event offers two distances, 650 meters and 5.6 kilometers, and is held in typical June weather with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions. The run is ideal for runners seeking a short, fast challenge. Please check the details directly with the organizer before registering.
course_highlights: Two distances: 650 m and 5.6 km
Event location Mühltal-Traisa
Typical June weather with around 23 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please verify event details with the organizer before registration. Short distance of 650 m, longer route of 5.6 km, start times from 6:30 PM, main race at 10:00 PM, including children's and relay races.

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
location: Pastors Wisk Visbek Park, Visbek, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 1st Bürgerlauf Visbek will take place on June 13, 2026, in Park Visbek (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different age groups and performance levels. The event includes children’s and school runs as well as middle-distance and main runs over 5 km and 10 km, complemented by a walking or hiking route. Bib number distribution will be on the day of the event from 3:00 PM, and all runs will be professionally timed. The proceeds will benefit the Bürgerstiftung Visbek, making the race a sporting event with social commitment.
course_highlights: Runs in Park Visbek with a natural course
Professional timing for all races
Part of the Volksbanken Laufcup in Vechta
additional: Bib number distribution on the day of the event from 3:00 PM. Late registrations and payments on-site are possible in individual cases. Parking is available near the Catholic parish hall, St. Raphael kindergarten, the sports and swimming hall, Gerbertschule, and Blumen Ostmann. Catering with a beverage cart as well as fries and bratwurst on site. The event is registered with the German Athletics Association and insured. Terrain: city/flat, online registration until June 11, 2026, bib numbers from 3:00 PM, professional timing, parking nearby, on-site catering.

name: Drebber-Marathon
location: Schulstraße 1, Jacobidrebber, Drebber, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Drebber Run on June 13, 2026, offers a diverse selection of competitions for all age groups and performance levels. The course takes place on an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the district of Jacobidrebber, with start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay competitions from children's runs to the marathon, there is an attractive supporting program for spectators and participants. Especially emergency services are invited to participate as a relay team in the Blue Light Cup and showcase their performance.
course_highlights: Officially measured 2.34 km loop through Jacobidrebber
Start and finish at the sports field with decorated course
Various distances from 500 m children's run to marathon
additional: The route will be closed from 1:00 PM, and spectators and participants are asked not to cycle on the course from 2:30 PM. Parking is available at the sports field, and directions are signposted. There is a dedicated start program for children from 2:30 PM with bib number distribution at the club house. A supporting program with catering and activities for children is available on the schoolyard. Certificates with photos will be sent after the run. The event honors winners in various age groups and team classifications. Emergency services can participate with relay teams in the Blue Light Cup and will receive a code for a free starting fee upon registration. The start and finish are located in front of the school at Schulstraße 1, Drebber. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and community involvement.

name: Dünenlauf
description: The Dünenlauf Sandhausen takes place on June 13, 2026, at the Walter-Reinhard-Stadium and offers flat, varied courses through forest and over a sand dune. There are runs for children (Bambini), 5 km, and 10 km with timing. The event is a DLV-approved popular race and takes place in all weather conditions. Catering is provided, and the course is closed to road traffic.
course_highlights: Flat, varied course through forest and over a sand dune
Refreshment station on the 10 km course after approximately 5 km
Bambini runs take place in the stadium
additional: Race bib distribution in the 1st floor of the Walter-Reinhard-Stadium. Bambini runs start from 3:00 PM in several blocks with timing. The 5 km run starts at 5:00 PM, and the 10 km run at 6:00 PM. Changing rooms are available in the stadium. First aid support provided by the DRK local group Sandhausen. The course is closed to road traffic. Prizes and certificates for the top three in each age group. Flat, varied course through forest and sand dune, refreshment stations on the course, online registration, in all weather, start at Walter-Reinhard-Stadium.

name: Enni Donkenlauf
description: The ENNI-Donkenlauf on June 13, 2026, in Neukirchen-Vluyn offers a diverse running program for all age groups and performance levels. The courses mainly run over flat, asphalted, and low-traffic economic roads and side streets, ideal for fast times. In addition to competitions, there are non-competitive runs and walking offers open to everyone. The event is family-friendly and includes special classifications for schools and youth groups.
course_highlights: Flat, predominantly asphalted and low-traffic economic roads and side streets
Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses
Minis-Run and Donki@school on the synthetic track of the sports center
additional: Registrations on the day of the event are possible from 11:30 a.m. in building "G". The Minis-Run and Donki@school runs take place on the synthetic track of the sports center. For safety reasons, dogs, baby joggers, and bike escorts are not allowed. Parking spaces are limited; it is recommended to travel by bicycle or public transport. Smoking is prohibited throughout the school grounds, and dogs are not allowed on the sports field. Various distances (500 m to 10 km) can be registered for either on-site or online. No age group classifications are available for some runs.

name: Handewitter Sommerlauf
description: The Handewitter Summer Run on June 14, 2026, offers a diverse running event for the entire region with courses for all performance levels. From children’s races over 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, Nordic Walking, relay races to the half marathon and wheelchair race, there is something for everyone. The event takes place around the Wikinghalle in Handewitt and is characterized by a well-organized atmosphere, a lively mood, and an unforgettable finish experience. The courses, measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV), are flat with few elevation changes, making them ideal for beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Flat courses with few elevation changes
Start and finish at the Wikinghalle in Handewitt
Diverse distances from 400m for children to half marathon
additional: Participants who register within the deadline receive a personalized bib, event shirt, and medal. Group registration is available via Excel list. The event relies on volunteers to assist with orientation, organization, and catering. The participant list is automatically updated and accessible online. The courses are measured, registration is online, support is provided by volunteers on-site, there are various running options, it is family-friendly, and it fosters a community atmosphere.

name: Gorch-Fock-Lauf Wilhelmshaven
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 0.6 km
description: The Gorch-Fock-Run in Wilhelmshaven takes place annually in June and offers distances for all age groups, including youth runs, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. The course runs mostly along the coast and the inner harbor, starting at Jade-Allee and finishing in Pumpwerk-Park. The race route is measured and certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and guarantees fair competition conditions. In addition to the sporting competition, there is also a club and school run with attractive prize money to promote youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: DLV-certified course with quality seal
Course route along the coast and the inner harbor
Start at Jade-Allee, finish in Pumpwerk-Park
additional: Start area at Jade-Allee, finish in Pumpwerk-Park. Timing is done with an integrated chip in the bib number. A church service will be held on June 13, 2026, at 6:00 PM in the Christus-Garnisonkirche. There are several refreshment stations along the route. Club and school runs with prize money for the five most participating clubs/schools. Changes to registration are possible online via a self-service link; no on-site changes. The event also includes a race church service, club and school competitions, medals, shirts, and prize money. Registration is online, with early bird discounts available. The start is at Jade-Allee, and the finish is in Pumpwerk-Park.

name: Volkslauf Isernhagen
price_range: Adults 12,00 EUR, Kinder und Jugendliche 8,00 EUR, optional T-Shirt 15 EUR
description: The 25th Volkslauf Isernhagen will take place on June 14, 2026, and offers runners of all ages and skill levels a warm and traditional running event. There are four race distances to choose from: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and the classic 10 km run, which is measured by the NLV and counts towards the Laufpass. Timing is professionally handled with the runtiming system, and all participants can look forward to well-marked routes, a great atmosphere, and a colorful supporting program. T-shirts and medals are included in the entry fee for children and teenagers; adults can optionally purchase a T-shirt.
course_highlights: Four different distances: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
10 km route measured by the NLV and valid for the Laufpass
Professional timing with runtiming system
additional: Late registrations on the day of the event are not possible. Registration is done online via the RUNTIMING portal. All participants will receive a refreshment at the finish line. T-shirts and medals are included in the entry fee for children and teenagers; adults can optionally purchase a T-shirt for €15. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Participation is at your own risk. There are trophies and material prizes for the top three finishers in each distance and category, as well as cash prizes for the fastest team. Multiple race distances, team competition, online registration via RUNTIMING, no late registrations on the event day, medals and T-shirts for participants.

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony, and Hesse. The event offers various race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 13 km, some of which are loop courses and others are point-to-point routes. In addition to the main races, there is a Bambini run for preschool children without timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive activity. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region's unification after German reunification.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports field in Arenshausen
Loop courses for 1.2 km, 2 km, and 13 km runs
5 km run as a point-to-point course with a stadium lap
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start with an additional fee of 2.00 EUR, excluding children's runs. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall. Parking is available directly at the sports field in Arenshausen. Nordic walking (approx. 8 km) starts around 14:00 without ranking or entry fee. Bambini run (400 m) for preschool children without timing or placement. No entry fee for the main race, online registration from May 1 to June 11, 2026. Parking available, changing rooms and showers at the sports hall.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
location: Sportplatz Schackensleben, Schackensleben, Börde, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Schackensleben Hopfenlauf is a traditional running event in Schackensleben, about 25 km west of Magdeburg in the Börde district. The start and finish of all courses are at the sports field, from where various distances are offered: 400 meters for children, 1.4 km for youth, as well as 6.0 km and 10.8 km for adults. The longer routes lead through the town and the surrounding landscape with typical Börde hilly profile, on roads and paved field paths. Refreshments are available with drinks, coffee, cake, and grilled food, and after crossing the finish line, there is a raffle with attractive prizes. The Hopfenlauf is part of the Novo Nordisk Landescup and the Elbe-Ohre-Cup.
course_highlights: Routes through the town and the surrounding area with Börde-typical hilly profile
Run on roads and paved field paths with multiple refreshment stations
Start and finish at the sports field with good changing and shower facilities
additional: The 0.4 km and 1.4 km routes are completed on the track and immediate surroundings. After crossing the finish line, participants receive drinks and fruit for energy. In the club house at the sports field, there is excellent catering with coffee, cake, lard sandwiches, drinks, and grilled food. Traditionally, a raffle with attractive prizes takes place parallel to the award ceremony. Multiple distances, online registration, facilities such as changing rooms, showers, catering, and raffle. Supports the German athletics system through official timing.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women's Run Hamburg is a road race for beginner and ambitious female runners in the Elbe metropolis Hamburg. The event offers a 10 km measured loop course starting and finishing at Ballindamm. In addition to the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10 over 1 kilometer. Participants receive a finisher medal and can use showers and changing facilities after the race.
course_highlights: Measured 10 km loop course according to IWB and AIMS
Start and finish at Ballindamm in Hamburg
Girl’s Run over 1 km for girls aged 5 to 10
additional: Showers and changing facilities are available after the race at Gerhart-Hauptmann-Platz. There is a clothing deposit for personal items. The bib number includes a disposable timing chip and must be worn visibly on the running shirt. Photos can be purchased after the race from a photography partner. The event also includes a Girls’ Run over 1 km for girls aged 5 to 10, starting at 11:30 AM. It offers changing and shower facilities as well as on-site catering.

name: Eschathlon - Der Eschborner Halbmarathon
description: The Eschathlon is a popular city run in Eschborn that attracts numerous running enthusiasts every year. The focus is on the half marathon, which features an attractive course around Eschenplatz. In addition to the half marathon, there are other competitions such as 10 km run, 5 km run, 20 km relay, FIT walk, and children's races. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with an accompanying program and catering, making it ideal for runners of all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Loop course around Eschenplatz in Eschborn
Relay exchange zone at Neugasse 1A
Course with refreshment stations and volunteer positions
additional: Start and finish are located at Eschenplatz in Eschborn. The 20 km relay consists of 4 x 5 km laps with a exchange zone at Neugasse 1A. T-shirt guarantee is available for registrations until April 30. Late registrations are possible until the day of the event, but without T-shirt guarantee. The accompanying program and catering are available from 09:00 to 14:00 on site. Half marathon on June 14, 2026, children's races, relay races, registration from the end of March, early bird discounts until April 30, additional quota from May 1.

name: EVL-HalbMarathon Leverkusen
description: The EVL Half Marathon in Leverkusen is a traditional and challenging half marathon taking place on June 14, 2026, for the 24th time. The course covers 21.1 kilometers through the sports city of Leverkusen, including a special highlight: passing through the BayArena, the home stadium of Bayer 04 Leverkusen. The hill climb on Sauerberg presents an additional challenge. The race is open to all performance levels, from beginners to elite runners, and offers a unique running experience with lots of atmosphere and community spirit.
course_highlights: Course runs right through the BayArena
Hill climb on Sauerberg
Varied 21.1 kilometers through Leverkusen
additional: Start and finish on Bismarckstraße between Ostermann-Arena and BayArena. Participants must be born in 2010 or earlier for the half marathon, 2016 or earlier for the 10 km run, and 2018 or earlier for the 5 km run. Bib numbers are non-transferable and must be worn visibly. There are also Bambini runs with available spots. The event shirt for 2026 is available. The organizer recommends a good training structure with regeneration and nutrition tips from running coach Andrea von Horn. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The course passes through Leverkusen, including the BayArena; registration for Bambini runs; event shirt and merchandise; podcast with tips and stories.

name: Heidenheimer Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The Heidenheimer Sparkassen City Run on June 14, 2026, offers diverse races for beginners to half marathon runners through the city center of Heidenheim. The half marathon takes place on two nearly identical laps through the city, passing landmarks such as the Pauluskirche, the city library, and Brenzpark. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km runs as well as school and children’s races. All participants receive timing with an integrated transponder in their bib number and a generous finish area with refreshments.
course_highlights: Half marathon on two nearly identical laps through Heidenheim
Course runs through city center, Brenzpark, and past Schlossarkaden
Finish area next to Pauluskirche with large spectator support
additional: Timing is done via single-use transponders in the bib number. Functional shirts in city run design can be ordered during registration. Baggage drop-off from 7 a.m. in the town hall underground parking garage. Medical support provided by the German Red Cross. Award ceremonies take place in front of Pauluskirche. Photos will be made available online after the race. Event in Heidenheim with various race distances, online and on-site registration, bib number pickup, medical support, baggage storage, and refreshments on race day.

name: Herzogstadtlauf Straubing
description: The Herzogstadtlauf in Straubing is a traditional community run taking place on June 13 and 14, 2026, appealing to runners of all ages. From children's races to various distances including the BMW Half Marathon, the event offers a diverse program with attractive routes through the historic city and the city park. In addition to the sporting challenge, a comprehensive supporting program with stage performances and DJ music creates a lively atmosphere. The event promotes community and health and is a highlight in the Eastern Bavarian running calendar.
course_highlights: Loop course through the historic area of Straubing with start and finish at Hagen
Route along Joseph-von-Fraunhofer-Halle, ice stadium, and former LAGA site
Varied routes through city park, old town, and city center with notable points such as Ludwigsplatz and Theresienplatz
additional: On Saturday, children's races with multiple start times from 15:30 to 19:00 are held; on Sunday, main races start from 09:00 with warm-up program. There is a functional shirt available in a special design offered annually. Registration is possible online, including group and corporate registrations. For children's races, a school registration with card is possible until April 17. The supporting program features stage performances, cheerleaders, and DJs to entertain during the event. Various race routes, functional shirts, medals, refreshments, timing by ZEITGEMAESS, sports physiotherapy support, certificates, prizes, vouchers, and a free finisher video are provided.

name: Hohenneuffen-Berglauf mit BW Trail
description: The 37th Hohenneuffen Mountain Run will take place on June 14, 2026, in Linsenhofen with the finish at Hohenneuffen Castle. The main course covers 9.3 km with approximately 535 meters of elevation gain and 180 meters of descent. Additionally, there is the 24th Student Mountain Run with various distances and elevation gains, open to participants from 1st grade onwards. The start is in Balzholz at the town hall, and the finish is at the Kindergarten Jahnstraße. We look forward to many runners from near and far.
course_highlights: 9.3 km course with approx. +535 / -180 meters of elevation
Start in Balzholz at the town hall, finish at Hohenneuffen Castle
Student mountain run with distances from 1.56 km to 3.25 km and up to 100 meters of elevation
additional: Course length approx. 9.3 km, elevation gain approx. +535 / -180 meters, online registration, children and youth races, start in Linsenhofen, finish at Hohenneuffen Castle

name: Internationaler Brüder-Grimm-Lauf
organizer: Verein zur Förderung des Brüder-Grimm-Laufes e.V.
price_range: Startgebühr, ermäßigt für Mitglieder: 5 Euro Rabatt, sonst unklar
description: The International Brothers Grimm Run is a traditional 3-day event that takes place from Hanau, the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm, over approximately 82 km to Steinau, where the fairy tale collectors spent their childhood. The route is divided into 5 stages and offers a challenge for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. The course runs along historic trade routes, past historic buildings, scenic landmarks, as well as spa and leisure resorts in the Spessart and picturesque villages in the Kinzig Valley. The event will be held from June 12 to June 14, 2026, with registration opening on November 11, 2025.
course_highlights: Approximately 82 km long route from Hanau to Steinau in 5 stages
Course along centuries-old trade routes and historic buildings
Scenic sights and spa towns in the Spessart and Kinzig Valley
additional: The route is mostly asphalted, partly through open terrain and forest. The elevation profile is flat with minimal inclines (maximum height approx. 130 m). The stages include paths such as bike paths, forest trails, and paved roads. Start and finish points of each stage are in different towns along the route, e.g., Niederrodenbach, Neuenhaßlau. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Multi-day running event, 5 stages, registration from November 11, 2025, participant limit 550, individual stage booking possible.

name: Mainauenlauf 2026
description: The Mainauenlauf 2026 will take place on June 14th on the grounds of the former State Garden Show in Bayreuth. The scenic, challenging hilly course runs through green park areas with magnificent panoramas over the city. Various distances are offered, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, Nordic walking, as well as children's and youth runs. A special highlight is the atmospheric finish line in the Finisher Park with excellent catering and a unique finisher medal. Additionally, city championships across all distances will be held for the first time.
course_highlights: Challenging hilly 5 km loop with 85 meters of elevation per lap
Highest point of the course: Col Bellota
Finish in the Mainauenlauf Finisher Park with catering and medal
additional: Showers are open at the School Center East until 3:00 PM. There is a photo booth at the start/finish area. Clothing bags can be handed in at the Finisher Park and collected until 3:00 PM. Group warm-up on Saturday at 6:30 PM in the Finisher Park. Refreshment stations at km 2, 3, 6, 7 with water, isotonic drinks, baked goods, and fruit. Sanitary facilities are available near the finish area and at the Sports Center East. Courses: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, relay races, Nordic walking, children's and youth runs; start on the grounds of the State Garden Show; refreshments at several points; finish in the Finisher Park.

name: Mendener Citylauf mit Halbmarathon und Schülerläufen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km 10 € (Team Meldung ab 6 Starter/-innen erhalten 25% Nachlass)

description: The 10th Menden City Run on June 14, 2026, offers an athletically attractive and exciting running event with fast courses in the city center of Menden. The event includes children's runs, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. Several event points along the route create a lively atmosphere, and participants are enthusiastically received at the finish on the town hall square. The Marathon Club Menden e.V. warmly invites runners of all generations to participate in this traditional race.
course_highlights: Fast courses through the city center of Menden
Multiple event points for good atmosphere along the course
Finish on the town hall square with enthusiastic reception
additional: Participation fees for children and students from Menden kindergartens and schools are covered when registering centrally through their respective schools via Mendener Bank eG or the Menden Sports Association. Team registrations from 6 runners receive a 25% discount on the 5 km distance. Online registration with direct debit or PayPal is possible. Late registrations on the event day are also possible. The course is in Menden, registration online, late registration on the event day, parking at Neumarkt.

name: Metropolmarathon
organizer: Laufteam Fürth 2010 und Team Klinikum Nürnberg
description: The Sparkassen Metropolmarathon 2026 takes place on June 13 and 14 in the cities of Fürth and Nuremberg. The running event connects two cities with varied course routes, numerous competitions, and a colorful supporting program. With around 9,000 participants and 600 volunteers, the Metropolmarathon offers a weekend full of activity, fun, and community. The races range from marathon, half marathon, 10 km runs, and Nordic walking to children's and youth races.
course_highlights: Start in Fürth, finish at the main market in Nuremberg
Varied routes with many refreshment stations
Professional support from the Laufteam Fürth 2010 and Team Klinikum Nürnberg clubs
additional: Pacemakers are used in the half marathon and marathon. There are individual certificates available for download, medical services, changing and shower facilities. A prize draw for participants who also take part in the DATAGROUP Triathlon Nuremberg 2026 is offered. Routes: marathon, half marathon, 10K, Nordic walking, youth race, KIDSmarathon; start in Fürth, finish in Nuremberg; supporting program along the route; refreshments, pacemakers, certificates, medical services, changing rooms, and showers.

name: Nesselwanger Seenlauf
description: The 1st Nesselwanger Seenlauf, presented by Endress+Hauser and organized by the Skiklub Nesselwang e. V., is the successor to the previous company run and is aimed at people of all ages. The race promotes movement and community and offers various routes for children, teenagers, adults, and families, also suitable for strollers. The start and finish are located at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu. The event appeals to individuals as well as companies, clubs, and running groups.
course_highlights: Baby race approx. 0.4 km for birth years 2019-2021
Children's race approx. 1.6 km for U10, U12, U14
Lake run approx. 10.7 km with start and finish at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu
additional: Start and finish at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu. The event includes several runs: Baby race (0.4 km), Children's race (1.6 km), Village run (5.2 km), and Lake run (10.7 km). The race is also suitable for families with strollers. Routes for children, families, companies, and clubs; registration until June 4, 2026; participation from age 4; various competitions including baby race, children's race, village run, and lake run.

name: NEW-Citylauf
description: The 25th NEW-City Run in Erkelenz on June 14, 2026, is a popular running event that takes runners of all performance levels through the city center. The event offers a sporty and communal atmosphere that appeals to both beginners and ambitious athletes. With a varied course and an exciting atmosphere, the NEW-City Run is a highlight in the regional event calendar. Participating invites you to experience the joy of running together with family and friends.
course_highlights: Course through Erkelenz city center
Varied running route
Sporty atmosphere and communal experience
additional: The event takes place on Sunday, June 14, 2026. Registration and further information are available at www.new.de/laufserie. The organizer is the city of Erkelenz, contact via city marketing. Run in the city center, anniversary, suitable for all performance levels.

name: Niederelberter Gickellauf
description: The Niederelberter Gickellauf is a popular running event in Niederelbert that offers various race distances for children and adults. In addition to children's races over 800 meters and 2 kilometers, there are also 5- and 10-kilometer courses. The event is embedded in a family festival that promotes social togetherness and emphasizes the recreational sports philosophy of SV Blau-Weiss 1908 Niederelbert e.V. The run encourages both sporting ambition and community spirit in the region.
course_highlights: Children's races over 800 m and 2 km
Race courses over 5 km and 10 km
Family festival with various highlights
additional: The Gickellauf takes place as part of a family festival that promotes social cohesion across departments. Children's and adult races are offered, the event is part of the recreational sports program of SV Blau-Weiss 1908 Niederelbert e.V. Various courses, online registration possible, no entry fee

name: RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf
description: The RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf takes place in 2026 for the 43rd time and is organized by the Laufreff Schafhauser Wald e.V. in Dunum, Lower Saxony. The event is supported by the Raiffeisen-Volksbank eG, Aurich, and offers a friendly and welcoming atmosphere for runners and walkers of all performance levels. The courses lead through the beautiful Harlinger landscape with start and finish in Dunum. In addition to the Volkslauf, there are also walking and Nordic walking options as well as an extensive photo and results archive from previous years.
course_highlights: Start on Vorackkerweg, finish at Dunum School
10 km Volkslauf with 2 laps
Half marathon and other routes with interactive course maps
additional: The event includes various distances: 10 km Volkslauf (2 laps), half marathon, 5 km Volkslauf, 7.5 km walking, and children’s and youth runs. Start and finish are in Dunum, and the courses are available as interactive maps. Training times for the Laufreff are Mondays at 19:00 and Wednesdays at 18:00, each meeting at the NIGE sports field or stadium at Peldmühle from September. Everyone is welcome, from beginners to professionals. The event takes place in June, with official, homologated courses for official performance records. It supports the German solidarity system in sports and is aimed at runners of all ages, including children and adolescents.

name: saarBRÜCKENlauf
description: The Laufgemeinschaft Saarbrücken cordially invites you to the saarBRÜCKENlauf, a guided run over (almost) all the bridges in the state capital Saarbrücken. Two course lengths are offered: a 10 km loop with 7 bridges and a 20 km loop with 17 different bridges. The run is not a competition but a pleasure run with various pace groups to collectively manage the challenging route with ramps, stairs, and many turns. The start is at 10 a.m. at the Kulturbiergarten opposite the Kraftwerk Römerbrücke.
course_highlights: Guided run over (almost) all Saarbrücken Saar bridges
Two course lengths: 10 km with 7 bridges and 20 km with 17 bridges
Challenging route with ramps, stairs, and frequent turns
additional: There are different pace groups (60, 70, 80 minutes for the short course and 2:00, 2:20, 2:40 hours for the long course). No timing, no bib numbers. Participation only for sufficiently trained runners without health concerns. The run is not a competition but a pleasure run. Due to the route, groups should stay together; falling back into slower groups is possible. The run is a guided pleasure run without timing, suitable for groups and offers refreshments at the finish area at Kulturbiergarten. The event is only suitable for fit runners.

name: Sauerland-Höhenflug-Trailrun
description: The Sauerland Höhenflug Trail Run is a popular running event in Sauerland, taking place on June 14, 2026. The event offers various course lengths from 0.4 km up to the half marathon, running through the diverse landscape of Sauerland-Höhenflug. The trail run is open to runners of all ages and performance levels and is organized by the Skiclub Hagen-Wildewiese e.V. in cooperation with Sauerland Tourism and the Sauerland-Rothaargebirge Nature Park. The event is part of the Volksbank-Sauerland-Laufcup and features a special sprint classification on the last 200 meters of the longer courses.
course_highlights: Courses from 0.4 km to half marathon through Sauerland
Sprint classification on the last 200 meters at 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Various age groups and categories, including youth runs
additional: The trail run includes multiple age groups and distances, including children’s runs, youth races, and main courses. Timing is provided by RaceResult through Time and Voice. The final times for the half marathon are limited to 3:15 hours. The event is part of the Volksbank-Sauerland-Laufcup 2025. Late registrations are possible on-site, with an additional fee of €3. Course lengths: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; online registration; natural experience in Sauerland; annual event in June.

name: Sparkassenlauf
location: Hessisch Lichtenau, Landkreis Kassel, Hessen, Germany
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a traditional running event with DLV-certified courses over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon. The races lead through Wittringer Forest and feature a flat, fast loop on paved hiking trails, asphalt, and tartan track. All participants receive a personalized bib with their name as well as a finisher medal. The event also hosts the district championships in road running and offers net times and live timing.
course_highlights: Flat, fast loop through Wittringer Forest on paved hiking trails and asphalt
Start and finish at the stadium on Bohmertstraße with entry on the tartan track
Two refreshment stations along the course, with additional stations if needed
additional: Personalized bibs with first names for all participants. Net times and live timing are provided. The course is certified by DLV until 2027 and eligible for best lists. Official bike escorts and marshals ensure a safe flow of runners. The cut-off time for the Fun Walk is 10:15 AM. The race is part of the district championships, offering medals, shirts, and a festive atmosphere, including live results and personal support.

name: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund
description: The Kappeln City Run Loop is a traditional race event held annually in Kappeln, Schleswig-Flensburg district. The event offers runners of various age and performance levels the opportunity to run on a diverse course through the city and surrounding area. The race is organized by TSV Kappeln and is a popular event for sports enthusiasts from the region. The atmosphere is family-friendly and motivating, with a well-organized process and friendly support.
course_highlights: Course runs through the city of Kappeln and the surrounding landscape
Varied terrain with city and nature sections
Well-marked and supervised running route
additional: The event is organized by TSV Kappeln, which also offers additional sports programs and training times for various sports. There is a participant list, results, and a live tracking list for the race. More details about the schedule, course, timing, and awards are available on the website. The event includes running and Nordic walking competitions, with results usually available shortly after crossing the finish line, and offers for children and youth.

name: Taunussteiner Waldlauf 30.7
description: The Taunusstein Forest Run is a traditional running event that has been attracting around 700 runners annually for over 30 years to the picturesque forests and hills of the Untertaunus. The main course over 15 kilometers offers a challenging experience with varied terrain and approximately 250 meters of elevation. For beginners and children, there are shorter distances of 5 and 2 kilometers, ideal for experiencing the race atmosphere. The event is characterized by its scenic diversity and a lively program at the finish area.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through forests and fields between Hahn, Wingsbach, and Watzhahn
Main course 15 km with about 250 meters of elevation and challenging profile
Refreshment stations at km 3, 6, 7, 10, and 13 on the 15 km course
additional: Start and finish at the Gesamtschule Obere Aar (Pestalozzistraße 3, 65232 Taunusstein). Bib number pickup from 07:30 in the cafeteria of IGS Obere Aar, recommended to collect at least 40 minutes before start. Cut-off time for the 15 km race is 2 hours and 30 minutes. All finishers receive a medal. The fastest men and women in each distance will receive prizes, which are only handed out on race day. 2 km runners participate in a raffle. Showers and changing facilities are available on site. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Walkers are allowed, will be scored separately, but without prizes. On-site registration is possible for an additional fee of 2 €. Results and certificates are available online. There are refreshments, cake, a barbecue, and drinks in the start/finish area. The event is family-friendly, welcomes walkers, and offers catering and drinks at the finish area. Registration is possible both online and on-site.

name: TVE-Sommerlauf 2026
description: The TVE Summer Run is a traditional community race organized by the Turnverein 1890 Edingen e.V. in Edingen-Neckarhausen. The event offers races for various age groups from the youngest to seniors, with official timing and certificates. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for best lists. Runners enjoy a varied route along the Neckar with start and finish at the stadium.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sports & Recreation Center with a track lap
Course runs along the Fischkinderstube and along the Neckar towards Wieblingen
Officially measured and best list-eligible course
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start of each race, provided the participant capacity has not been reached, with a late registration fee of 3 euros. Certificates can be downloaded online and printed out by participants. There are age group and overall winners' classifications with material prizes for places 1-3. Running and Nordic Walking event, various distances, registration until June 13, 2026.

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Freizeit-, Vereins- und Schulteams beträgt 70 € (10 € pro Starter)

description: The Alfeld Bernd-Meyer Relay Marathon is a traditional relay marathon taking place on June 14, 2026, in Alfeld (Leine). The event is aimed at runners from the entire region and is organized jointly by several local running clubs and the city of Alfeld. The course is approximately a 3 km loop, run twice, starting and finishing at the marketplace. Each team consists of 7 runners who must be registered by name, and timing is done electronically with disposable transponders. In addition to the relay marathon, there is also a children's run of about 700 meters.
course_highlights: Loop course of about 3 km, to be run twice
Start and finish at the marketplace in front of the citizen's office
Course through the city center and park areas with varied route
additional: Each relay team consists of 7 persons, who must be registered by name and adhere to the order on the day of the event. The starting numbers are personalized and equipped with disposable transponders for electronic timing. Participants can keep their bib numbers as souvenirs. A maximum of 80 teams can participate. The children's run starts at 10:30 a.m. (girls) and 10:45 a.m. (boys) over approximately 700 meters. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere, including preparatory and training sessions, and is a significant event in the regional running calendar.

name: Bad Kohlgruber Schluchtlauf
location: Sport- und Freizeitzentrum am Erle, Bad Kohlgrub, Oberbayern, Germany
description: The Bad Kohlgruber Gorge Run is a scenic race in the pre-Alpine region, which, despite its name, is not a mountain run. The course is gently hilly and consists of 20% asphalt and 80% forest paths. The event takes place at the sports and leisure center at Erle in Bad Kohlgrub and offers free drinks along the route and at the finish. Refreshments such as coffee, cake, food, and drinks are available, and certificates are provided for all participants as well as trophies for the class winners.
course_highlights: Gently hilly pre-Alpine course
20% asphalt, 80% forest paths
Free drinks around 6 km and at the finish
additional: Number bibs can be collected from 07:45 AM; award ceremony around 11:00 AM in the finish area; medical support provided by the Bad Kohlgrub mountain rescue; in case of fewer than 6 participants in a category, awards are given in the next lower category; event takes place in all weather conditions; road traffic regulations must be observed; course runs through pre-Alpine land, field paths, forest paths, and asphalt sections; no mountain running characteristics; free drinks; prizes for all participants; trophies for the top runners in each category; event takes place regardless of weather

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedt City Run will take place on June 14, 2026, in Barmstedt. The event offers measured loops over 5 km and 10 km, which are eligible for best lists. In addition to the main races, there are also Nordic walking, walking, as well as children's and Bambini runs. Start and finish are at the marketplace in Barmstedt, and the course runs through the city center and around Rantzauer See with various surfaces such as cobblestones, asphalt, and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured loops over 5 km and 10 km, eligible for best lists
Course through Barmstedt city center and around Rantzauer See
Various surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt, firm sandy paths
additional: Timing is done with a rental chip on the ankle (except for children's runs), which is retained at the finish. Chips not returned will be charged at 40 euros. Baby joggers and dogs are not allowed for safety reasons. There are different age classes and minimum ages for the races. The course may vary slightly due to construction work; updates will be posted on the website. Courses are measured, various surfaces, online registration possible, no late registrations, catering and medals included.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Volkslauf is a traditional running event held annually in June at the sports field in the Sports Center Barsbüttel. The event offers various running distances from 400 meters to 10 kilometers, mostly flat and running over asphalted or firm sandy agricultural paths. The courses mostly run through the traffic-free Barsbüttel farmland and offer beautiful views, especially on the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. Refreshments for runners and spectators are also provided.
course_highlights: Running routes mostly flat and run over asphalted or firm sandy agricultural paths
Courses run through the traffic-free Barsbüttel farmland with beautiful views
10 km route runs along a small avenue and past the Stapelfelder Moor
additional: Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. The shortest route (400 m) takes place entirely on the tartan track in the stadium. The 1 km and 2 km routes partially lead out of the stadium, while the longer routes (5 km and 10 km) offer beautiful views and run over firm sandy paths and asphalted field paths. Refreshments for runners and spectators are provided. Event takes place on roads, registration online via TrainerDay, catering for participants and spectators.

name: BORNE TO RUN (48-Stunden-Lauf)
description: BORNE TO RUN is a 48-hour charity run in Unna that presents an extreme challenge for endurance and willpower. Participants are pushed to their limits over long, demanding hours. This race is aimed at runners who are ready to face a real test and support a good cause.
course_highlights: 48-hour run with distances of 43.2 km and 172.8 km
Event location in Unna with typical June weather around 23°C and mostly sunny
Charity event focused on endurance and willpower
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. The run takes place from June 12 to June 14, 2026. Registration is possible until June 11, 2026. Donations go to the German Children's Hospice Service and NABU.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatus Run takes place on June 14, 2026, around Donatus Lake at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen.
