The event offers various race distances from 400 meters for children, 1200 meters for school children, up to the half marathon and 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and provide a family-friendly atmosphere with additional walking and family runs. The course is varied and well marked, with start and finish areas located very close to Erftstadt train station. After the races, award ceremonies are held promptly, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: Varied course lengths from 400 m to half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt train station with good accessibility
Family run and Nordic walking as additional offerings
additional: Late registrations are only possible until the participant limit is reached and incur an additional fee of 3 euros. Award ceremonies take place directly after each race on the sports grounds. Parking is only available at Erftstadt train station, which is just 100 meters from the start and finish areas. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Donatus Lake, online registration, parking at Erftstadt train station, start and finish areas at SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds.

name: Eifelmarathon
description: The Eifel Marathon on June 14, 2026, in Waxweiler offers a diverse running event with a marathon, ultramarathon, trail run, half marathon, 10 km fitness run, hiking marathon, and children's run. The courses lead through the scenic Eifel region with varying elevation gains and well-equipped refreshment stations. Start and finish are in Waxweiler, with a shuttle service for the half marathon start in Hamm. The event is part of the new Mini-Cup Germany and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Marathon course with 42.195 km and 764 meters of elevation
Ultramarathon with 51.4 km and 983 meters of elevation, including a scenic forest loop
Half marathon starting in Hamm with shuttle service, running along the reservoir and the Prüm river back to Waxweiler
additional: Race bib pickup on Saturday, June 13, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:00 with a pasta party. On race day (June 14, 2026), bib pickup from 07:00 to 09:00. The finish cutoff time for all runs is 16:00. Every participant receives a medal. Refreshment stations are staffed from 09:30. Shuttle service for the half marathon from Waxweiler to Hamm. Hiking marathon approximately 30 km on the Eifel Marathon course. Part of Mini-Cup Germany with prize money for participants completing three German races. Course approximately 30 km (Waxweiler - Hamm - Waxweiler), start at 08:00, finish cutoff at 16:00, refreshment stations from 09:30, marked course, medals for all participants.

name: Famberglauf
description: The Famberglauf is a running event held in June in Fambach, organized by SV Schwarz-Weiß Fambach 09 e.V. The program offers four different distances: a half marathon of 21.1 km, the 10.9 km Famberglauf, the 5 km Famberg Sprint, and a 1000 m children's run. The event is aimed at runners of all ages and performance levels and emphasizes a family-friendly club race rather than a major competition.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.1 km
Various distances from 1000 m to 21.1 km
Event in Fambach with a family club character
additional: The event includes four races on the same day, including a children's run. The number of participants is low, indicating a family club event. The weather in June is typically sunny with temperatures around 23 °C. Multiple race distances, including half marathon, sprint, and children's run; event part of the landscape cup 'Rhön - Thüringer Wald - Werratal'; limited participant numbers possible.

name: h Lauf Reichenau
description: The Reichenau 24-hour race is an exceptional ultra-distance run on Reichenau Island, appealing to individual runners, six-person teams, and corporate teams. The event takes place around the clock, from Saturday noon to Sunday noon, challenging participants' endurance and stamina on a prepared course around Hochwart. The race has established itself as an impressive sporting challenge, attracting both amateur athletes and ambitious competitors. The atmosphere is characterized by community and sporting ambition, supported by a runner's camp and dedicated organization.
course_highlights: Loop course around Hochwart on Reichenau Island
Running continuously for 24 hours from Saturday 12 PM to Sunday 12 PM
Prepared field paths and scenic route
additional: Participation possible as an individual runner, six-person team, or corporate team. There is a runner's camp at the 'Mofarennen-Acker' as a resting place. The event is organized by two running clubs. The best individual runners are awarded with vegetables. The course around Hochwart features unpaved paths, no asphalt, and is suitable for both hobby and professional runners. The route is closed to traffic.

name: Hahner Kitzenhauslauf
description: The Hahner Kitzenhauslauf is a popular running event in the tri-border area of Germany, Belgium, and the Netherlands. The natural, hilly, and varied courses in the southern Aachen region offer runners a challenging and scenic experience. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners from the region and beyond. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized competitions.
course_highlights: Natural running routes in the southern Aachen region
Hilly and varied terrain
Scenic course layout
additional: Courses for children, students, ten-kilometer race, half marathon; scoring races of the Regio Aachen Laufcup; catering, certificates, photos, live results

name: Integrationslauf des VfB Reichenbach
description: The VfB Reichenbach Integration Run in Reichenbach-Steegen is an annual running event that has enriched the community calendar since 2016. The race promotes togetherness and integration through sport by overcoming barriers and enabling the building of contacts. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a shared sporting experience in the region.
course_highlights: Fun run in the local community of Reichenbach-Steegen
Promotes integration and community through sport
Held since 2016 with a break during the COVID-19 pandemic
additional: The event takes place on the sports grounds in Reichenbach-Steegen and fosters community spirit through sporting activities for all age groups.

name: KarlsruheLäuft 100 Jahre Berufsfeuerwehr Karlsruhe
description: The Karlsruhe Professional Fire Brigade will celebrate its 100th anniversary in 2026 with a diverse event program for the entire city. The anniversary includes sporting competitions, historical highlights such as classic car meetings and hand-pump fire engine competitions, as well as ceremonial acts and castle light shows. The events offer exciting insights into the history and technology of the fire brigade and invite everyone to join in celebrating and remembering.
course_highlights: Various running distances including children's runs, relay races, 5 km and 10 km
Festive anniversary of the Karlsruhe Professional Fire Brigade with a special focus on fire brigade themes
Event location near the West Fire Station - Günther Klotz Anlage
additional: The anniversary year 2026 offers, in addition to sporting competitions, historical events such as the classic car meeting with around 120 historic fire engines and the competition for historic hand-pump fire engines. There is also a Landesflorianifeier, a theater performance for children, and diverse insights into fire brigade technology and history. The events take place among other locations at Karlsruhe Castle and the Daxlanden fire station. The registration deadline is June 10, 2026; the event is part of the anniversary celebrations and is open to runners of all ages.

name: Kirchenkirnberger Wald- und Wiesenlauf
price_range: kostenlos für Kinder- und Jugendläufe, Startgebühren für längere Rennen
description: The 3rd Kirchenkirnberger Forest and Meadow Run will take place on June 14, 2026, in Murrhardt. It is a short race with two distances, passing through forest and meadow landscapes. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere with typical June weather, mild temperatures, and mostly sunny days. Runners of all ages are warmly invited to participate and enjoy the nature around Murrhardt.
course_highlights: Run through forest and meadow landscapes
Two distances: 450 m and 10.8 km
Typical June weather with mild temperatures and sunshine
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. Event in June with routes through nature, focusing on community and health, regional event

name: Kirschlauf
description: The Cherry Run in Kleinfahner, organized by USV Erfurt, is a traditional race with over 20 years of history. On June 14, 2026, the 24th edition will take place, featuring scenic routes with challenging elevation paths. The event offers various distances, including a main race over 14 kilometers, a fun run over 4.5 kilometers, as well as children's and toddler races. The award ceremony is traditionally conducted by the Thuringian Cherry Queen, and the race is part of the TLV Running Cup.
course_highlights: Main race over 14 kilometers with scenic elevation path and views over the northern Thuringian Basin
4.5 km fun run with challenging topography in the Imtal valley
Finish through cherry orchards above Kleinfahner with spectacular views
additional: Race bibs are available from 8:00 a.m. at the event tent near the mill. Late registrations are possible online from June 13 at 2:00 a.m. and on race day until 30 minutes before the start, with a fee of 5 euros. Award ceremonies will begin around 9:45 a.m. for children's races and around 11:30 a.m. for other races. Registration is open until June 9, 2026; late registrations are possible. The course features elevation paths and finishes in Kleinfahner, including children's races and Nordic walking.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Castle Garden Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in the Ludwigslust Castle Park and offers runners of all ages a diverse selection of courses. The distances range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, complemented by walking routes over 5 and 10 km. A new addition to the program is a toddler run for the little ones without registration and scoring, which is rewarded with an official medal at the finish line. The event is traditional and warmly invites both beginners and professionals to enjoy the beautiful park landscape.
course_highlights: Running courses through the historic Ludwigslust Castle Park
Varied distances from 2 km to 15 km as well as walking routes
Toddler run for children born in 2021 and later with medal
additional: The toddler run is without registration, free of charge, and without scoring, approximately 500-600 meters long. Accompanying adults are explicitly welcome. Registration for the other runs begins on March 15. Run in Ludwigslust Castle Park, no registration required, no fees, no scoring, medals for all participants, parking available, drinks and refreshments, changing and shower facilities, 40th anniversary in 2026, route partially outside the park due to park restrictions, post-race party as part of the Linden Festival.

name: Melibokuslauf mit 3. Mountainbike-Gipfelsprint
description: The Melibokus Run is a traditional running and mountain biking event in Alsbach-Hähnlein, taking place in 2026 for the 55th time. It offers various running routes, including a half marathon trail, a 10 km and a 5 km running trail, as well as youth races for children and teenagers. Additionally, the mountain bike summit sprint takes place, featuring a challenging course with 450 meters of ascent and 130 meters of descent over approximately 13.4 km. The running routes are evaluated by ITRA and offer diverse trails in nature around the Melibokus. The event is open to runners and mountain bikers, with e-bikes not permitted.
course_highlights: Half marathon trail with 21.2 km length
Mountain bike summit sprint with 450 m ascent and 130 m descent over approx. 13.4 km
ITRA-evaluated running routes with diverse trails
additional: Race packets and late registrations from 8:00 AM at Sperbergrund, 500 meters above the Bürgerhaus Sonne. Mountain bike summit sprint starts at 09:00 AM, half marathon at 09:30 AM, 10 km run at 09:45 AM, 5 km run at 10:00 AM. Youth races start from 11:00 AM. Gravel bikes are allowed in the mountain bike summit sprint, e-bikes are not. Results are available immediately after the race in the large sports hall at Melibokusschule. GPX files of the routes are available. The mountain bike summit sprint route length is approximately 13.4 km. Online registration is possible, with GPX downloads available. Public transport stops are in Alsbach-Hähnlein. Age restrictions apply for the competitions.

name: Ortslauf Wallertheim
description: The Wallertheim local race is a traditional running event held annually in Wallertheim and is part of the Wingertscup. It offers various distances from 900 meters for children to 10 kilometers for experienced runners, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, electronic timing with transponder technology, and convenient online registration. It is open to runners of all performance levels and provides a sporting community experience in the beautiful nature of Rheinhessen.
course_highlights: Distances from 900 m to 10 km
Electronic timing with transponder technology
Part of the Wingertscup with point collection opportunities
additional: Online registration via br-timing.de with direct debit; event is the 3rd stage in the Wingertscup; routes for children, beginners, experienced runners, and walkers; team registrations possible via provided form. Registration until June 12, 2026, late registrations until 30 minutes before start are possible, changing and shower facilities in the multi-purpose hall, catering with cake buffet, prizes for winners and certificates for all participants.

name: Isernhagener Volkslauf
description: The 25th Volkslauf Isernhagen will take place on June 14, 2026, and offers a warm welcome to runners of all ages and skill levels. There are four race distances to choose from: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and the classic 10 km run, which is measured by the NLV and counts towards the Laufpass. The event is characterized by well-marked courses, professional timing with the runtiming system, and a lively Volkslauf atmosphere with over 400 participants. T-shirts and medals are included in the entry fee for children and teenagers; adults can optionally purchase a T-shirt. Late registrations on the day of the event are not possible.
course_highlights: Four race distances: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
10 km course measured by the NLV and Laufpass-eligible
Professional timing with runtiming system
additional: Registration is available online via the RUNTIMING portal until June 11, 2026, 24:00. Late registrations on the event day are not possible. All participants receive a refreshment at the finish line. T-shirts and medals are included in the entry fee for children and teenagers; adults can optionally purchase a T-shirt for €15. The event takes place in any weather. Start and finish are located at the sports grounds of TSV Isernhagen, Auf der Heide 32, 30916 Isernhagen H.B. Parking is available nearby. More than 400 participants annually. Online registration via RUNTIMING, no registration on the event day.

name: 55. Melibokus Lauf
description: The Melibokus Run is a traditional race in Alsbach-Hähnlein, taking place on June 14, 2026, for the 55th time. The event offers various running courses, including a half marathon trail, a 10 km and a 5 km running trail, as well as a mountain bike summit sprint. The courses are evaluated by ITRA and feature diverse trails with challenging climbs and beautiful views. There are dedicated school runs for children and teenagers over 400 m, 800 m, and 1500 m. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with start and finish in Sperbergrund.
course_highlights: Half marathon trail (21.2 km) with challenging trails
Mountain bike summit sprint: 450 m ascent, 130 m descent over approximately 13.4 km
ITRA-evaluated courses with available GPX files
additional: Start and late registration from 8:00 AM in Sperbergrund, 500 m above the Bürgerhaus Sonne. Mountain bike summit sprint starts at 9:00 AM, half marathon at 9:30 AM, 10 km at 9:45 AM, 5 km at 10:00 AM. School runs start from 11:00 AM at the sports grounds at Hinkelstein. Gravel bikes are allowed in the mountain bike summit sprint, e-bikes are not. Late registration incurs an additional fee of €3.00 each. Results are available immediately after the race in the large sports hall at Melibokusschule. The race also includes mountain bike summit sprints and trail running elements; registration required; detailed course and event information available.

name: COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Schellbronn
description: The COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Schellbronn is a mountain run and trail running event with a distance of 3.14 km. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Bad Wildbad and offers runners a challenging and varied course. It is part of the Sauerland Trailrunning Challenge and attracts trail running enthusiasts who want to combine nature and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Trail run on a 3.14 km long course
Mountain run character with varied terrain
Part of the Sauerland Trailrunning Challenge
additional: The event is part of a series of trail and mountain runs in the region, with results and media coverage available. The course is diverse and offers both sporting challenge and natural experience.

name: 95. Terrainkurweg Marathon
description: The 95th Terrainkurweg Marathon in Salzgitter is a challenging run on a hilly course with approximately 150 meters of elevation gain and loss. The route passes through the Vöppstedter Forest, past the Liebenburg Forest House, and along the Salzgitter golf course. The event is not an official DLV event and is aimed at well-trained runners. Catering is provided in a covered area with drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: 9.1 km long loop through the Vöppstedter Forest
Round course with approximately 150 meters of elevation gain and loss
Course route along the Salzgitter golf course
additional: Catering in a covered area with hot tea, broth, cola, water, spritzers, as well as pretzels, nuts, bananas, cake, and chocolate bars. No liability, participation at own risk. Not an official DLV event. The marathon is part of an event in the Terrainkurweg area taking place in the Salzgitter region. No specific information on registration or participation fees is available.

name: LKZ Firmenlauf
description: The LKZ Company Run is organized by MTV Ludwigsburg in cooperation with the Ludwigsburg Kreiszeitung and will take place on June 17, 2026. The 4.5 km course runs around the Ludwig-Jahn Stadium and MTV Ludwigsburg. Over 100 companies send several thousand runners, Nordic walkers, and walkers each year, supported by numerous volunteers. Besides the sporting competition, fun and community spirit are the main focus, celebrated after the race with cool drinks and an after-run party. MTV members can participate free of charge.
course_highlights: 4.5 km course around Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
Start and finish at MTV Ludwigsburg
Strong participation from over 100 companies with several thousand participants
additional: Participation is possible from the year of birth 2012. Registration via email with indication of year of birth and competition (running or walking) until May 15, 2026. MTV members run free of charge. Volunteers are sought for start and finish processing as well as course management. After-run party until late at night. Race distance approximately 4.5 km, registration via email, free participation for MTV members, event on June 17, 2026, including team pavilions and awards for winners.

name: Sommernachtslauf am Hufeisen
description: The Summer Night Run at Hufeisen is a traditional race in the municipality of Linsengericht, organized by the Gelnhausen Running Team for over 20 years. The event is characterized by its family-friendly nature and its great popularity in the Main-Kinzig district. The start and finish area is located at the Hufeisen parking lot, nestled in a forested area between the districts of Geißlitz, Großenhausen, and Lützel. As part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge, the race is a fixed component of the regional running series and offers runners an attractive course in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Hufeisen parking lot in a forested area
Course mainly through the closed forest area of Vorspessart
Beautiful views of the Kinzig and Biebertal valleys
additional: The race is part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge, the largest running series in the region. The event has a family-friendly character and enjoys steady popularity. The course is run respectfully on forest paths to protect nature and wildlife. The race is known for fast times, takes place in the Hufeisen forest area, and features various race categories including children and youth competitions.

name: Volksbank Stadtlauf Selm 2026
location: Campus Selm, Selm, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Volksbank City Run Selm takes place for the fourth time as part of the popular city festival weekend. The officially measured course runs through the beautiful Auenpark and is very popular among athletes from Selm and the surrounding region. The event offers races for various age groups, from children (bambini) to open runs over 5 and 10 kilometers. Mayor Thomas Orlowski will participate in the 10-kilometer run himself, emphasizing the family-friendly and sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Officially measured course through Auenpark
Various races for children, youth, and adults
Start and finish at Campus Selm
additional: The city run begins with the bambini race at 4 PM in the stadium (400 m). Followed by school races over 1 km and 2.5 km, as well as open runs over 5 km (6 PM) and 10 km (7 PM). Award ceremonies take place between the races. Volksbank Selm-Bork eG is the main sponsor of the event. Multiple race distances, start in Auenpark, children and youth races, registration now open.

name: 21. Laatzen Leinelauf
location: Laatzen, Region Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 21st Laatzen Leinelauf will take place on June 19, 2026, offering runners courses over 3.5 km, 6.5 km, and 10 km through the idyllic Leine-Masch with nature, water, and wide meadows. The event also includes a Bambini run over 1.2 km as well as a walking category over 6.5 km. The 10 km route features a team competition for mixed teams. Parallel to the run, the traditional Laatzener Winzerfest takes place, complementing the race evening with culinary and musical highlights.
course_highlights: Run through the Leine-Masch with nature, water, and wide meadows
Refreshment stations and musical support on the 6.5 km and 10 km routes
Team competition for mixed teams on the 10 km route
additional: Race number pickup from 3:00 PM in the park of the Old Town Hall. Timing by RUNTIMING GbR. Late registrations on race day on-site from 3:00 PM until about 30 minutes before each race are possible. Trophies for winners of the 10 km, certificates and surprises for the top places and teams. Bambini run participants receive a small surprise. Event runs parallel to the Laatzener Winzerfest with musical and culinary accompaniment. Routes lead through the Leine-Masch, ending at the wine festival, suitable for walkers, teams, and children.

name: 40. Braunschweiger Nachtlauf
description: The 40th Braunschweig Night Run on June 19, 2026, offers a diverse sports program for all age groups, from Bambini to open races. The runs take place through the city center of Braunschweig with start and finish at Bohlweg, while the Bambini races start at Burgplatz. The event is known for its special atmosphere and support from the Braunschweigische Sparkassenstiftung, which enables and further develops the event. The bib number serves as a ticket for public transportation in Braunschweig on the event day. All finishers receive certificates available for download, and baggage check-in is open until 11:30 PM.
course_highlights: Route through Braunschweig city center with start and finish at Bohlweg
Bambini races start at Burgplatz
Bib number serves as a ticket for public transportation (Zone 40) on the event day
additional: Registration is via Davengo from February 16, 2026, to June 14, 2026. There are Bambini, children, youth, open, and team races with different start times from 6:00 PM. The route will be closed to public traffic from 4:00 PM. Baggage check-in is located at Schlossplatz. Accompanying persons can register directly for the Bambini races, while accompanying runners for children’s races must register separately. Group or individual registration for teams is possible; a team is defined as four or more runners. Registrations are possible via Davengo, with options for individual and team starts. The event is open to all age groups and offers a festive atmosphere in the city center.

name: SportScheck RUN Hamburg
description: The SportScheck RUN Hamburg is a traditional night run around the Outer Alster, taking place in a lively evening atmosphere. Runners can complete the 7.5 km loop around the Alster once or twice, depending on the distance. There are special runs for children over 1 km and 1.8 km. The start and finish area in Alsterpark offers a special atmosphere with a cheering zone, photo point, and a large medal wall that makes the Hanseatic flair come alive at dusk.
course_highlights: 7.5 km loop around the Outer Alster with start/finish area in Alsterpark
Course runs along the Alster shore, through Winterhude and Uhlenhorst, past the Atlantic Hotel and over the Kennedy Bridge
Night run with a special atmosphere at dusk
additional: There are two children's runs: 1 km DAK Bambini RUN (up to 7 years old) and 1.8 km DAK Kids RUN (7 to 12 years old). In the start/finish area, there is a cheering zone, a photo point for finish photos, and a large medal wall with a finisher medal. The certificate and photos can be downloaded from the SportScheck homepage. The event is a distance event, where results, certificates, and photos are available.

name: MidSummerRun 2026

late_fee.price: 3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter
3,00 Euro für Jugendliche, 5,00 Euro für Jahrgang 2007 und älter

description: The MidSummerRun 2026 will take place on June 19th in Hamburg and is organized by Laufreff Alstertal e.V. for the fifth time. The sustainable running event offers three competitions: a children's run of approximately 970 meters, a 5 km run, and a 10 km run along the wild upper course of the Alster, one of Hamburg's most beautiful running areas. The start and finish are located on the meadow in front of the Wellingsbüttel gatehouse, where a future fair with sustainable partners and a food truck will ensure the catering. The MidSummerRun stands for environmental protection and sustainability and was awarded second place at the Hanse Environmental Prize.
course_highlights: Course along the wild upper course of the Alster
Start and finish on the meadow in front of the Wellingsbüttel gatehouse
Sustainably organized run focusing on environmental protection and 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals
additional: The registration fee includes free transportation with HVV. There is a participant limit of 200 for the children's run and a total of 600 for all competitions combined. Late registrations are possible from June 10, 2026, and on the day of the event if the limit has not been reached. The event offers on-site first aid at the finish area. Recycled advertising banners are used for picnic blankets, and a food truck is available on-site for socializing after the run. Children's run approximately 970 meters, 5 km, 10 km, sustainable organization, start and finish on the meadow in front of the Wellingsbüttel gatehouse, eco-friendly medals, sustainable catering.

name: Bad Wildbader Stäffeleslauf
description: The Bad Wildbader Stäffeleslauf is a unique running event in the picturesque Black Forest, held annually in Bad Wildbad. The event offers various participation categories, including the Mini-Stäffeleslauf with approximately 500 steps and the challenging Fire Brigade-Stäffeleslauf with 1987 steps. Runners experience a sporting challenge in a beautiful setting and can test their limits in this special stair race. The event is open to all age groups and fitness levels and promises fun and excitement.
course_highlights: Mini-Stäffeleslauf with approx. 500 steps over 0.30 km
Fire Brigade-Stäffeleslauf with 1987 steps over approx. 0.72 km
Run through the scenic Black Forest landscape
additional: The race takes place at Uhlandplatz in Bad Wildbad. There are no specific details about start times, waves, entry fees, or late registration on the available pages. The event is in June, with age categories from 8 years old, including special categories for children and firefighters, in a scenic environment.

name: Benefizlauf - Laufend Gutes tun
location: Niederwangen, Wangen im Allgäu, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Niederwangen charity run is an inclusive running event organized in support of Lebenshilfe. The event combines athletic effort with social commitment and is open to runners of all ages. The course takes place through the beautiful surroundings of Niederwangen and offers a great opportunity to do good and stay active together. The run is supported by various local partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: Inclusive running event in support of Lebenshilfe
Run through the scenic surroundings of Niederwangen
Event with social engagement and community character
additional: Various sports including triathlon, swimming, cycling, running, children's sports, ball sports, recreational sports, inclusive events, online registration

name: Brunsbüttler Citylauf
location: Stadion Bildungszentrum am Ziegelweg, Brunsbüttel, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Brunsbüttel City Run is a city running event in Brunsbüttel, Schleswig-Holstein, featuring 5 km and 10 km races as well as a short stadium run for children. The start and finish are located at the stadium of the Education Center on Ziegelweg. The event is aimed at adults, teenagers, school groups, corporate teams, and children, and is not only for club athletes. The 5 km course is a loop, while the 10 km course is run twice. For the youngest participants, there is a approximately 400 m children’s run in the stadium, allowing families to watch everything easily.
course_highlights: 5 km loop through the city
10 km course as two laps of the 5 km route
Children's run approx. 400 m in the stadium
additional: Timing is done with transponders issued upon pickup. Changing facilities are available. All participants receive a medal. The children's race takes place in the stadium, so families can watch everything from one location. Runner and family event with modern timing, changing facilities, and medals for all participants.

name: Erftflitzer Lauf
description: The Erftflitzerlauf in Neuss-Holzheim is a family-friendly running event with a long tradition since 1993. The event offers various competitions for children, teenagers, and adults, ranging from short Bambini runs to 5.5 km for adults and youth. The race is characterized by its fun nature, emphasizing community spirit and the joy of running. The course takes place through the beautiful surroundings of Holzheim and provides suitable challenges for all age groups.
course_highlights: Various distances from approximately 400 m to 5.5 km
Relay races with 3 x approximately 400 m for different age groups
Family-friendly atmosphere with fun and community elements
additional: The Erftflitzerlauf includes several competitions with start times from 17:30, beginning with Bambini and children’s runs, followed by youth and adult races as well as relay races. The event is designed as a fun run without winner prizes; instead, there is a raffle. The age groups are clearly defined, with races for children born from 2019 up to adults. The event takes place at the sports facility in Holzheim. Races for all age groups, family-friendly, central location, known as Erftflitzerlauf since the 1990s.

name: Fürstenwaldlauf
description: The Fürstenwaldlauf is a traditional scenic race in Upper Swabia, taking place for the 45th time in 2026. It is held as part of the Öchsle Festival in the city of Ochsenhausen on June 19 and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere. The main race is a quarter marathon, mostly run on forest paths with some challenging sections, starting and ending with a stadium lap at the Hopfengarten sports complex. Additionally, a 5 km course is offered, which begins on the same route as the main race but turns back after 2.5 km. The race is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV).
course_highlights: Quarter marathon on predominantly forest paths with challenging sections
Start and finish with a stadium lap at the Hopfengarten sports complex
5 km course with turnaround after 2.5 km on the same route as the main race
additional: The 2026 schedule includes various races: Bambini run (300 m) at 4:00 PM, school runs (800 m) starting at 4:30 PM, followed by the main race and 5 km run. Start and finish are located at the Hopfengarten sports complex, address Hopfengarten 3, 88416 Ochsenhausen. There are catering and health services on site. The race is approved by the DLV. The course runs on forest paths, online registration is possible, children's races take place in the stadium, catering included, parking available, DLV approved.

name: Heel-Lauf
description: The Heel Run in Baden-Baden on June 19, 2026 offers runners, walkers, and children a diverse range of routes in one of Germany's most beautiful running locations. The main course over 10 km connects industrial areas, nature, and the city center with a special Heel Run flair. The shorter 4 km runs and walking routes pass through green avenues and park landscapes, ideal for beginners and enthusiasts. There are also children's races, including Bambini and school runs, with medals at the finish line, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: 10 km run: start at the Heel industrial site, natural passages along the Oos River, 40 meters of elevation on the Hochstraße, passing through the Baden-Baden spa gardens and city center with pedestrian zone and Lichtentaler Allee
4 km run: start and finish in front of the Baden-Baden theater, run through the shady Lichtentaler Allee and idyllic Klosterwiese
4 km walking: Nordic walking through Baden-Baden's beautiful green spaces with start and finish at the theater
additional: Start and finish of the 10 km route at the Heel industrial site, finish line for all runs in front of the Baden-Baden theater, medals for all children's races, walking route also possible with Nordic walking poles, varied course with industrial, natural, and city center sections. name: Högl-Berglauf
description: The Högl Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race that has been held annually in Ainring since 1980. The course covers 9.8 km with 480 meters of elevation gain and ends above the Neubichler Alm. In 2004, the German Mountain Running Championship was held on the extended route. In addition to the main race, the Schüler-Gipfel-Sprint is a regular part of the program and offers an exciting challenge for young runners.
course_highlights: 9.8 km course with 480 meters of elevation gain
Finish above the Neubichler Alm
Tradition since 1980 with German Mountain Running Championship 2004
additional: The Högl Mountain Run will take place in 2026 on June 19th. Registration will be published on the official announcement page. The Schüler-Gipfel-Sprint is integrated as a fixed part of the program. Registration is presumably through the club, event on June 19th, including Schüler-Gipfel-Sprint, traditionally at the Ski-Club Hut.

name: Jemgumer Dörploop
description: The Jemgumer Dörploop is a versatile running competition in Jemgum, Lower Saxony, offering various distances for all age groups. From children and school runs to challenging courses over 21.2 km and relay races with electronic timing, there is something for every runner. The event takes place at the sports center in Jemgum and provides a friendly atmosphere with refreshments at the finish area. The course consists of laps of 5.3 km, which are run multiple times depending on the distance.

Relay race with 4 × 5.3 km laps
Water stations on the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective start. There is no registration fee for children and school runs; for all other competitions, the late registration fee is €3.00. Timing is done electronically via reusable transponders on the foot, which must be returned after the race (€10.00 fee if not returned). Drinks and fruit are offered at the finish area by EDEKA Blank. Race modes, relay races, electronic timing, late registration up to 60 minutes before start, water stations, fruit at the finish.

name: Lauf - Lauf durch den Sportpark Koblenz
organizer: Meddy's Lauf- und Walking-Treff Koblenz e.V.
description: The 29th International Run through the Sportpark Koblenz will take place on June 19, 2026. The flat course runs through Oberwerth Stadium, the Sportpark Koblenz, and the traditional Wasserwerksrunde, mostly on asphalt and paved paths. The race offers categories for the main run, youth, and children as well as kids' races and walking/nordic walking. The event is characterized by a family-friendly club atmosphere and good infrastructure with changing rooms, showers, and free parking.
course_highlights: Flat course through Oberwerth Stadium and Sportpark Koblenz
Traditional Wasserwerksrunde
Asphalt and paved paths
additional: Start and finish are at Oberwerth Stadium. Timing is done via transponder in the race bib. Bib pickup on the event day at the stadium grounds. Late and change registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for a fee of €2.00. Changing rooms and showers are available in the stadium. Free parking and a bus stop (EPG ARENA/Stadium) are nearby. The route passes through the stadium, sport park, and Wasserwerksrunde; registration until June 18, 2026; bib pickup on the event day; results online; changing rooms and showers in the stadium; free parking; bus stop nearby.

name: Legdener Volkslauf / Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The legendary Midsummer Night Run in Legden is a popular community race through the town center of Legden, taking place on June 19, 2026. The event is characterized by a relaxed atmosphere without much competitive pressure, as only the times of the first three runners are recorded. Offered are children's races, a kids' run for older children, as well as 5 km and 10 km runs for youth and adults, plus a 5 km route for walkers and Nordic walkers. Wheelchair users are warmly invited to participate in the 5 km walking. The course has been slightly adjusted due to road closures and now runs via Windmühlenweg, Osterwicker Straße, and Melroseweg.

5 km and 10 km routes with adjusted course via Osterwicker Straße and Melroseweg
Children's races with two age groups (400 m for birth years 2022 and younger, and 2020 and 2021)
additional: Race bib pickup on June 19, 2026 from 5:30 PM at the Dahliendorfstadion. Late registrations are possible on the event day until 30 minutes before the respective start. Prizes will be awarded via raffle based on race bib numbers. Group registrations are accepted until June 15, 2026, thereafter no longer. Routes for children, youth, adults, walkers, and wheelchair users; route changes due to road closures.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 2: 34. Wöbbeler Volkslauf "Rund um den Hahnenberg"
description: The 34th Wöbbeler Volkslauf is the second race of the Lippe Summer Series 2025 and takes place on June 19, 2026, in Schieder-Schwalenberg OT Wöbbel. The course runs around Hahnenberg and offers runners a varied challenge. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and promises a pleasant atmosphere with typical June weather, mostly sunny conditions.
course_highlights: Course around Hahnenberg
Distances: 1 km and 8.3 km
Typical June weather with around 23°C and mostly sunny
additional: Start location is Schieder-Schwalenberg OT Wöbbel. The event is part of the Lippe Summer Series 2025. It is recommended to check the details with the organizer before registering. name: Seelbach Schwarzwald Sonnwendlauf
description: The Seelbach Black Forest Solstice Run is a traditional running event taking place on June 19, 2026, for the 20th time in Seelbach. With over 1,000 participants from all over Germany and neighboring countries, the race offers a unique atmosphere that appeals to both ambitious runners and recreational joggers as well as children. The flat, officially measured 10 km course of the main race, along with relay and charity runs, invites participants to achieve sporting excellence and enjoy a communal experience. The event is characterized by a strong commitment to sustainability and social responsibility, supported by numerous volunteers and local clubs.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 10 km course (2 laps of 5 km each)
Atmospheric start and finish area at the Seelbach sports hall
Musical accompaniment and numerous spectators along the route
additional: Automatic timing with bib chip (main race and children’s runs) and relay baton chip (relay) by Race Result. Participant limit: 700 for the main race, 100 teams for the relay classification. Award ceremonies take place after the races in the sports hall. The charity run is a 3 km race without timing for a good cause. Children’s runs with various distances from 333 m for age groups U8 to U14. Large supporting program with musical entertainment, solstice celebration from 5:00 PM, and numerous volunteers and clubs supporting the event. Course length: 333 m to 10 km, registration online or on-site, on-site catering, prizes for winners, participation fees between 5 and 30 euros. The event takes place at the Seelbach sports hall.

name: Wallauer Mittsommerlauf
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Wallauer Midsummer Run is a family-friendly race with approximately 1,500 participants. It offers various distances: a 0.5 km Bambini race for the youngest, a 1 km school race for children up to 12 years old, a 3 km run, and an officially measured and record-eligible 10 km main race. The courses are gently rolling loops on paved paths in and around Wallau and are suitable for runners of all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Flat to gently rolling loop courses
Paved paths in and around Wallau
Officially measured 10 km main race by HLV
additional: The race offers training plans for optimal preparation for different performance goals. Courses are flat to gently rolling on paved paths; race suitable for all age groups

name: Sandhofer Straßenlauf
location: Sandhofer Felder, Mannheim-Sandhofen, Mannheim, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sandhofen Road Race is an attractive 10 km loop course through the Sandhofen fields in Mannheim-Sandhofen, ideal for both competitive runners and recreational and hobby runners. The course is officially measured by the DLV, flat, paved, and mostly asphalted, with marked kilometers. In addition to the main race, there is a student race over 1,200 meters, giving young athletes a taste of competition. The race is part of the engelhorn sports Brooks Laufcup 2026 and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with catering, medical services, and changing facilities on site.
course_highlights: 10 km flat, paved, and mostly asphalted loop course
Course runs through the Sandhofen fields
All kilometers are marked

Changing and shower facilities are available in the SKV Sandhofen tennis hall (women) and gymnasium (men) as well as on the sports field.
