Online registration is possible, with the race starting on June 19, 2026, from 7:30 PM. Results will be published online.

name: 3. Schluchthof Backyard Ultra
location: Kleinostheim am Main, Landkreis Aschaffenburg, Bayern, Germany
description: The 3rd Schluchthof Backyard Ultra takes place in Kleinostheim am Main, near Aschaffenburg. This lovingly organized, private backyard ultra race emphasizes a family atmosphere and a small number of participants, so that each round is run together. The event offers a distinctive environment in a green corner between Rhine-Main and Spessart, where running occurs hour by hour until only one runner remains.
course_highlights: Small field size for communal running each round
Distinctive environment in Lower Franconia between Rhine-Main and Spessart
Backyard Ultra format: hour by hour until the last runner
additional: The event is not a mass event, but a race among like-minded individuals with a fluid boundary between participants and spectators. The event is private and not an official competition, the course is slightly shorter than the standard backyard ultra distance, and the event emphasizes community and challenge.

name: 41. Volkslauf in Baunatal
description: The 41st Volkslauf in Baunatal is a mass participation event under the motto "Baunatal runs," where anyone can participate regardless of club affiliation. The running routes mainly lead over paved paths and mostly through forested areas. The 5 km course is designed as a turnaround route, while the shorter runs from 200 m to 1000 m take place in the Parkstadion. The event is part of the Nordhessencup, a popular running series in the region.
course_highlights: Running and walking paths mainly over paved routes
Courses mostly through forested areas
5 km course as a turnaround route
additional: Registration is only online via Raceresult. The registration deadline is the day before the event, 19.06.2026, at 23:00. Bib number distribution takes place near the upper main grandstand. The 200 m to 1000 m runs take place in the Parkstadion. The event is a mass participation event with registration exclusively online. The weather in June is usually sunny with mild temperatures.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 1
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian North Sea islands, attracting running enthusiasts from Germany and other countries for over two decades. The first stage takes place on Borkum, the largest island, renowned for its unique nature, maritime flair, and healthy high-sea climate. The route runs along the promenade with start and finish at the same location. The race offers a combination of sporting challenge and the experience of the North Sea coast in a family-friendly and fair competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven North Sea islands with approximately 10 km per stage
Start and finish on the promenade of Borkum
Landscape with dunes, endless beaches, and UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer
additional: Race bib distribution on race day from 10:45 to 12:00 in the Kulturinsel Borkum. Sports bag storage from 11:30 to 14:30. Changing rooms and toilets in Kulturinsel Borkum, showers at Gezeitenland Borkum. Award ceremony at 15:00. Race bib with integrated chip for timing; the bib must not be folded. Information events on June 19th in Bensersiel for preparation. No waiting list or transfer list; start places are non-transferable. Stages on seven islands, limited capacity due to ferry and infrastructure restrictions, no waiting list, no transfers.

name: Gellershäuser Abendlauf
location: Sportplatz in Gellershausen, Edertal, Hesse, Germany
organizer: Turn und Sportverein Hessen 1848 Frankenberg Eder e.V.
description: The Gellershäuser Evening Run takes place at the sports field in Gellershausen, Edertal, and offers races for children, students, as well as a 10-kilometer run and a half marathon. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and attracts runners of various age groups. The course runs through the scenic surroundings and provides a pleasant running atmosphere in June. Information on registration, course, results, and photos is available.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10-kilometer courses at the Gellershausen sports field
Races for children and students integrated
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup
additional: Typical weather in June: around 23°C during the day, 13°C at night, mostly sunny with an average of 65 mm of precipitation. Children's and youth races with distances around 400 m and 1000 m; the event promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.

name: Gerolsteiner Stadtlauf
description: The 39th Gerolsteiner City Run will take place on June 20, 2026, at a new venue in Gerolstein-Roth. Due to construction work, the race cannot be held in Gerolstein itself. Start and finish are at the sports field with catering, changing rooms, and showers. The race is part of the 4-RegioCups, a series of 12 races in the regions of Eifel, Mosel, Hochwald, and Saar. Various distances are offered for children, teenagers, and adults, which are open as inclusive races for disabled and non-disabled runners.
course_highlights: New venue: sports field in Gerolstein-Roth
Turnaround routes for 500 m and 1,000 m races
Loop courses for 2,500 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m races
additional: Number bib distribution and event start at 2:00 PM at the sports field Gerolstein-Roth. Timing is via an integrated chip in the bib. All routes are inclusive for disabled and non-disabled runners. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Late registration fee for all races is 2.00 euros. Participants can register for the 4-RegioCups, which consists of 12 races. The event offers catering, changing rooms, and showers. Registration is via chiplauf.de.

name: Hennigsdorfer Feuerwehr- und Bahnenlauf
description: The Hennigsdorf Fire Brigade and Railway Run is a sporting running event taking place on June 20, 2026, at the OSZ sports field in Hennigsdorf. The 6th edition offers various races from 400 meters to 5 kilometers, including Handicap Race, Bambini Run, Volkslauf, and Nordic Walking. Participants include members of the volunteer fire brigade, police, and THW. Entertainment and safety are provided by the Hennigsdorf fire brigade with emergency vehicles, the DLRG, and an information stand from EMB Energie Mark Brandenburg. All finishers receive medals and certificates, and catering is also available.
course_highlights: Various routes from 400 m to 5 km
Participation of fire brigade, police, and THW
Event at the OSZ sports field with children's parkour and emergency vehicles
additional: The event is scheduled to take place from 8:30 AM to approximately 2:30 PM, hopefully in sunny weather. There is a varied supporting program with children's parkour, medical support by the DLRG, and information stands. Medals and certificates are awarded to all finishers. Catering for participants, helpers, and spectators is provided. The event is held at the OSZ sports field with different types of races, participation from fire brigade and police, children's parkour, medical support, and catering.

name: Heuchelheimer Mitternachtslauf
description: The Heuchelheim Midnight Run is a traditional race in Heuchelheim taking place on June 20, 2026. The event offers various distances for children, students, all participants, relay teams, and the main 10-kilometer race. The course runs through the streets of Heuchelheim with some inclines, especially at Mühlberg. All participants receive medals and certificates, and registration is primarily via the MyRaceResult portal. The race is suitable for both individual and relay participants and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 600m loop with slight incline on Brauhausstraße
2500m loop with notable incline at Mühlberg (approx. 150m)
Main race over 10 km with four laps on the 2.5 km course
additional: Registration is possible from April 25, 2026, via MyRaceResult. On the day of the event, late registration is available from 5:30 PM until half an hour before each start. For relay races, advance registration is recommended; late registrations are only possible up to one hour before the start. Timing is done using a transponder. Certificates can be printed via MyRaceResult. Course description, registration via MyRaceResult, entry fees, timing with transponder, catering, award ceremony, showers, age categories, start times, awards, liability notice.

name: Suderburger Abendlauf
description: The Suderburger Evening Run is a mass participation event for the whole family, held annually in June in Suderburg since 2022. The races take place across the heath landscape and the surrounding forests of the Lüneburg Heath on sandy and weatherproof forest and farm roads. In addition to traditional individual competitions, there is also a relay race over 3 x 1.9 km. The start and finish are located at the sports field on Tannrähm, and the event is experiencing increasing participant numbers.
course_highlights: Courses through heath landscape and surrounding forests
Mostly sandy and weatherproof forest and farm roads
Varied distances from 500 m to 20 km as well as a relay race
additional: There are seven races ranging from 500 m to 20 km in different age groups. Late registrations are possible on race day up to 30 minutes before the start for a late registration fee of €4.00. Changing and shower facilities are available at the start/finish. Refreshments with soft drinks are provided at the finish as well as water stations on the longer routes. The event is not a traditional athletics competition but a mass participation event for all age groups. Races take place on wooded, hilly paths in the Lüneburg Heath; online registration; changing and shower facilities available; refreshments at the finish; weather-independent event.

name: Tiergartenlauf 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Wer sich bis zum 10.6.2026 anmeldet bekommt eine Startnummer mit seinem Vornamen.

description: The Velen Animal Garden Run is a family-friendly fun run taking place on June 20, 2026, for the 18th time. With a total of 11 races, it offers routes for all age groups and fitness levels, from mini-marathon to school runs, as well as 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon distances, including Nordic walking. A special highlight is the relay race for families, friends, and colleagues, where four people run consecutively 1400 meters each. The event is held at the comprehensive school Velen and features a wide-ranging program with catering, music, and showers. Proceeds are donated to charitable organizations.
course_highlights: Running routes lead through the animal garden
Varied distances from 421.95 m mini-marathon to half marathon
Relay race with 4 x 1400 m as a special highlight
additional: Start and finish at the comprehensive school Velen, An der krummen Mauer 5. Certificates for all participants, age group rankings on the certificate, medals for the top 3 finishers. Mini-marathon without timing. Extensive supporting program with refreshment stands, music, finish line catering, beverage stations along the route, shower facilities in the sports hall, and a valuables deposit. Registration on the day of the event possible until 30 minutes before the start, cash only on the event day. Routes for all age groups, online registration, certificates available online, navigation addresses provided, shower facilities, valuables deposit.

name: Vohwinkeler Fuchslauf 2026
location: Sportplatz Waldkampfbahn, Wuppertal-Vohwinkel, Wuppertal, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 2,00 € Nachmeldegebühr ab 17. Juni 2026, sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt
description: The Vohwinkeler Fox Run 2026 will take place on June 20, 2026, at the Waldkampfbahn sports field in Wuppertal-Vohwinkel. The event offers various running distances for all age groups, from toddler runs to school runs, as well as 5 km and 10 km courses for youth and adults. The routes lead through Osterholz and Eulenkopfweg, providing a varied running environment. The event places special emphasis on the participation of the youngest, who will receive a finisher medal regardless of the distance. Late registrations are possible until shortly before each race, offering flexibility for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Waldkampfbahn sports field in Vohwinkel
Course through Osterholz and Eulenkopfweg
Toddler and school runs on the sports field track
additional: Late registrations are possible on June 19 from 16:00 to 18:00 at Kaiserstraße 55, 42329 Wuppertal, as well as up to 60 minutes before each race at the sports field. The event includes toddler runs (approximately 400 m), school runs (800 m and 1600 m), and 3.2 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances. Every toddler finisher receives a medal. Running courses for children, youth, and adults, online registration, on-site late registration possible, start and finish at Waldkampfbahn, medals for all children participants.

name: 19. Burgberglauf Gehrden
price_range: 3 € pro Kind für Bambini- und Kinderläufe, sonst keine Angaben
description: The Burgberglauf 2026 will take place on June 20th in Gehrden and offers runners various distances on a challenging 3.3 km loop course with approximately 50 meters of elevation. The route passes through forest terrain and fields, requiring good basic fitness. There is a separate flat loop course for children under 12 years old, while toddlers start on shorter rounds around the sports field. The event is family-friendly and features, in addition to the races, a raffle with attractive prizes as well as catering for spectators and participants.
course_highlights: Challenging 3.3 km loop course with approximately 50 meters of elevation
Route passes through forest terrain and fields
Separate flat loop course for children under 12 years old
additional: Start and finish at the sports field of Matthias-Claudius-Gymnasium, Knülweg 10, 30989 Gehrden. Changing rooms and showers available in the sports hall. Parking not possible in the event area. Bib number distribution from 11:00 AM in the sports hall. Fully electronic timing with chip on shoe, chip must be returned after crossing the finish line (€10 fee for loss). Raffle with attractive prizes, main prize a pizza oven. Toddler races (300 m and 700 m) start at 2:00 PM, registration for toddlers also possible on-site on the event day (€3 cash). Catering for spectators with bratwurst, drinks, and ice cream. Route: challenging 3.3 km loop, forest paths, paved; registration only online; bibs in the sports hall; no parking in the event area; toddler races without placements, medal included.

name: Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn
description: Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn is a 50 km trail ultra marathon in Langenhagen, Germany, starting at night with a time limit of 8 hours. The race takes place in June and is characterized by simple organization with a low entry fee, a finisher medal awarded on-site, and results and certificates published online. The number of participants is small, making it a more local and challenging endurance test. The course runs along the northern edge of Hanover, near Hanover Airport, through Bissendorfer Moor and Kananoher Forest, with varied terrain and moderate elevation gain.
course_highlights: 50 km trail ultra marathon with asphalt, gravel, forest floor, and trail
Loop course on the northern edge of Hanover, near Hanover Airport
Approximately 130 meters of elevation gain, mostly flat terrain
additional: The race has a time limit of 8 hours and starts at night. The number of participants is small, typically in the single digits to high teens among finishers. Finisher medals are awarded on-site, results and certificates are available online. The weather in June is usually sunny with an average of 23°C during the day and 13°C at night. Start at night, 130 m elevation change, small runner group, finisher medal included.

name: Abendlauf TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen
description: The evening run of TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen takes place on June 20, 2026, in Wolfhagen-Ippinghausen. The event offers races over 10 km, half marathon, and marathon on paved and tarmacked forest paths with start and finish at the Weidelsburg Stadium. The course leads through the city forest with scenic sections such as the Stöcketeich and features several refreshment stations. The event is open to all age groups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with certificates for all participants.
course_highlights: 21 km loop for the half marathon, marathon runs the loop twice
Start and finish at the Weidelsburg Stadium with a scenic loop through the city forest
Multiple refreshment stations (4 for the half marathon, 9 for the marathon) and showers/changing rooms available
additional: Spikes are not allowed in any weather conditions. Start times staggered by age groups from 4:30 PM (bambini) to 5:00 PM (10 km/half marathon/marathon). Each participant receives a certificate. Parking is available at the sports field, Waldecker Straße, and Vor dem Busche. Insurance through HLV for all participants, including non-club members. Courses on paved forest paths and sports field, no spike usage, registration via Raceresult, insurance provided by HLV.

name: AlbChallenge 2026 der Jubiläumsrun
description: The Alb Challenge 2026 is a varied obstacle race as part of the 100th anniversary celebration of the Skizunft Bad Herrenalb. The course runs across the Schweizerwiese and includes various obstacles that promote fun, challenge, and team spirit. Participants can be individuals, pairs, or teams of four aged 16 and above. In addition to the sporting challenge, there is a team competition with a hut evening as a prize, as well as an award for the best costume.
course_highlights: Obstacle race on the Schweizerwiese
Various obstacles along the course
Team competition with hut evening as a prize
additional: Participation is possible from age 16. Registration as an individual, two-person, or four-person team. Team competition with prize: hut evening at the Hahnenfalzhütte including a beer barrel. Costume contest with prize. Event as part of the 100th anniversary celebration of the Skizunft Bad Herrenalb. Obstacle race on the Schweizerwiese, team and costume prizes, for participants aged 16 and above.

name: Babenberger Volkslauf
location: Kirchweihsamstag, St. Urban, Bamberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Babenberger Volkslauf is a family-friendly panoramic run that has taken place since 1999 on the Kirchweih Saturday of St. Urban in Bamberg. The event offers a great opportunity for running enthusiasts to meet in a friendly atmosphere and run together for a good cause. Start and finish are at the St. Urban church, and the event annually supports social projects in the district. The organizers look forward to numerous participants and a successful event in June 2026.
course_highlights: Start and finish at St. Urban church, Babenbergerring 26a, 96049 Bamberg
Family and panoramic run with scenic route
Tradition since 1999 on Kirchweih Saturday of St. Urban
additional: Registration on the day of the event from 2:00 PM at the competition office. The event annually supports social institutions, in 2026 the St. Urban kindergarten. Organized by Bürgerverein Bamberg Süd-West e.V. The run supports the St. Urban kindergarten, registration from 2:00 PM, route details and further information available on the website.

name: Binner Abendlauf
description: The Binner Evening Run is a traditional running event held as part of the sports festival of the Sports and Youth Association Binnen e.V. The race offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and family-oriented atmosphere in Binnen. The event attracts runners of all ages and is a fixed part of the regional sports calendar. In addition to the run, there is a diverse sports festival with other activities and offerings for the whole family.
course_highlights: Running routes through the beautiful surroundings of Binnen
Family-friendly atmosphere at the sports festival
Traditional evening run with a long history
additional: The Binner Evening Run takes place as part of the SJB Sports Festival, which will be held on June 20 and 21, 2026. The event includes, besides the run, other sports and leisure activities. Results of previous races are published on the website. There are no explicit details about start times, fee structures, or participant limits on the available pages. The event is part of the 2026 sports festival, results will be published, and it offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: City Marathon Wiesbaden
description: The City Marathon Wiesbaden takes place on June 20, 2026, and offers a diverse running weekend in the Hessian state capital. Organized by Sporthilfe Wiesbaden e.V., the event includes not only the marathon but also a half marathon, 10K and 5K runs, a 3K children's run, and relay competitions. The weekend traditionally begins with a school class run for children from first to tenth grade. The event promises a sporting highlight for runners of all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Diverse courses: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km children's run
Popular relay competitions
School class run for children from 1st to 10th grade
additional: The running weekend is organized by Sporthilfe Wiesbaden e.V. There are no details about start times or registration fees on the website. The event includes not only the main races but also children's and relay competitions. It features multiple race distances, including school class runs, and offers a weekend full of sporting highlights in Wiesbaden.

name: Die 49. Nacht von Borgholzhausen
description: The Night of Borgholzhausen is a special running event taking place on June 20, 2026, in the city center of Borgholzhausen. From the Bambini race to school running and the atmospheric 10 km night run, there is something for all age groups and performance levels. The event is characterized by a unique atmosphere, marked by live music, cheerleaders, DJs, and torches along the route. Teams, beginners, and ambitious runners experience an unforgettable evening full of community and running enthusiasm.
course_highlights: Asphalted streets through the city center of Borgholzhausen
Atmosphere along the route with cheerleaders, live music, and DJs
Torch-lit route and garden parties along the course
additional: The event starts with the Bambini run at 6:00 PM (300 m, no time pressure, registration via kindergartens). Followed by two school running events for elementary school children (approx. 1.6 km) and secondary school students (approx. 3 km). The corporate run (5 km) and the 5 km run are suitable for beginners and teams. The highlight is the 10 km night run, which is supported by a special atmosphere with many spectators and music. Individual registrations are possible online until shortly before the last start at 9:30 PM. Various race distances, beginner running course, atmosphere with music and torches, online registration.

name: Dieburger Stadtlauf
description: The Dieburg City Run takes place annually in the center of Dieburg and offers races for various age groups from toddlers to the main 10 km run. The course runs from the marketplace through the old town and is easily accessible for all participants. In addition to the athletic competition, team and school competitions are also a focus, making the race a popular event for the whole family and the local community. The event is part of the Long-Run Cup and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere and good organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dieburg marketplace
Course runs through the historic old town
Loop courses with clear route (toddlers to 10 km main run)
additional: Race number pickup from 2 PM at the Pater-Delp-House near Town Hall/Marketplace. Late registrations are possible until 4 PM on the event day, subject to available starting spots. There are no showers or changing rooms near the start and finish. School and team competitions are part of the 4 km run. The main run is a scoring race for the Long-Run Cup. Courses on the marketplace, various running distances, online registration, no showers/changing rooms nearby.

name: Europalauf 2026
location: Hennef, Siegtal, Allner See, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 20th Hennefer European Run on June 20, 2026, offers a diverse range of races from 1000 meters up to the half marathon (21.1 km). The routes lead through the center of Hennef, along Lake Allner, and through the picturesque Sieg Valley. The event is family-friendly, featuring beginner-friendly runs for children and beginners as well as challenging courses for ambitious runners. Special emphasis is placed on inclusion, with dedicated races for people with disabilities. The event is organized by the Hennefer Gymnastics Club in cooperation with the city of Hennef and takes place in a friendly, volunteer-driven atmosphere.
course_highlights: Diverse routes from 1000 m to 21.1 km through Hennef, Lake Allner, and Sieg Valley
Half marathon with over 150 meters of elevation gain and five bridge crossings
Panoramic courses with views over the Sieg Valley to the Siebengebirge
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 8:00 AM until 60 minutes before the respective start at the town hall, with a late registration fee of €2 per person and race. Start and finish are located at the Historic Town Hall of Hennef (Frankfurter Straße 97). Changing rooms and showers are available at Kronos Aktivclub. Timing is professionally managed with disposable chips from runtiming. The award ceremony takes place at 1:00 PM in front of the town hall. There is a team challenge with cash prizes for the best teams in the HIT Panorama Run. The courses are not suitable for wheelchair users, and coaching by bicycle leads to disqualification. Various routes are available, including accessible, panoramic, and challenging half marathon with elevation meters and bridges.

name: Feldbergfestlauf
description: The Feldberg Fest Run is a traditional cross-country race around the Great Feldberg in the Taunus, taking place as part of the oldest mountain festival in the German-speaking region. The approximately 6,300-meter course runs through varied terrain and offers runners a challenging experience in a natural environment. The event attracts numerous participants each year and is a fixed part of the Feldberg Festival.
course_highlights: Cross-country run around the Great Feldberg
Course approximately 6,300 meters long
Natural and varied running route in the Taunus
additional: The race takes place in typical June weather, starting point is on the Great Feldberg, and it includes various sporting activities around the Feldberg.

name: FORT FUN Westernlauf
location: Fort Fun Abenteuerland, Bestwig-Wasserfall, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld (inkl. Eintritt in den Freizeitpark): zwischen 12 € und 17 € pro Person

description: The FORT FUN Western Run on June 20, 2026, is a popular running event at the FORT FUN Adventure Land amusement park in Bestwig-Wasserfall. Participants can choose from a total of 12 different race distances on the park grounds and the adjacent forests. The event is particularly family-friendly and offers beautiful views as well as the opportunity to enjoy the attractions of the amusement park afterward. The event is organized in cooperation with TuS Valmetal and is ideal for active children, teenagers, and families.
course_highlights: Run on narrow paths in the amusement park and adjacent forests
Beautiful views along the routes
12 different race distances for all age groups and skill levels
additional: Companions receive a discounted admission price of €24.90 per person. Toilets and showers are available on site. The event is especially family-friendly and offers access to the attractions of FORT FUN Adventure Land amusement park in addition to the run. Entry fee includes admission to the amusement park, 12 race distances, and park attractions.

name: Freundschaftslauf LT Rennschnecke Dudweiler
description: The Friendship Run of the running club "Rennschnecke" Dudweiler e.V. takes place on June 20, 2026, in the Dudweiler city forest around Gehlenberg. The event offers a sporting leisure activity in a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for runners of all performance levels. Food and drinks are provided. The three groups with the most participants will be awarded, emphasizing the community aspect.
course_highlights: Run through the training area around Gehlenberg in Dudweiler city forest
Refreshment station at the halfway point with water and snacks
Community run including walking and Nordic walking
additional: The three groups with the most participants will be awarded. Food and drinks are provided. The event lasts approximately from 15:00 to 16:00. Best arrival via Rentrischer Straße 42, 66125 Saarbrücken, which is about 50 meters from the training ground. Run in Dudweiler city forest, start at 15:00, participation in run and walk, group awards, food and beverages.

name: GVG Horremer Abendlauf
description: The GVG Horremer Evening Run is a sporting running event organized by SCB Horrem and Aktion Horrem, conducted according to the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV). The event offers races for various age groups and performance levels, including school runs and a fun run. The course features, among other things, a 5 km loop that is run twice during the 10 km race. The event emphasizes fairness and fun for all participants, from beginners to experienced athletes.
course_highlights: 5 km loop that is run twice during the 10 km race
School run with a 1.5 km distance
Event conducted according to DLV guidelines with scoring and award ceremony
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on the day of the event from 2 PM at Friedrich-Ebert-Platz (Horremer Market Square). Changing and shower facilities are available at Horremer Halle. Free massages for runners provided by the School of Physiotherapy Kerpen-Horrem. Online pre-registration is free and non-competitive for children’s runs. Timing is done using disposable transponders. Preferred race number can be requested during pre-registration for an additional 5 €. Registration opens on 09.02.2026. Timing with disposable transponder. Weather in June is typically around 23°C and sunny.

name: Hofmann-Flechtkulturlauf-Obermain
description: The Hofmann Fletch Culture Run Obermain (FKLO) is a broad-based community race in Lichtenfels, taking place on June 20, 2026, for the 14th time. The event offers a variety of running and Nordic walking routes along the flat "Path of Fletch Culture" and is aimed at hobby and ambitious runners without high performance pressure. Parallel to the race, the Lichtenfels Wine Festival takes place, making the day a sporty and social community event. Special features include the Blue Light Championship for emergency services as well as competitions for company bosses and teams on the 10.4 km route.
course_highlights: Flat route along the Path of Fletch Culture
Variety of running and Nordic walking routes (5.3 km and 10.4 km)
Event in the city center of Lichtenfels with a wine festival atmosphere
additional: Race number pickup on site, timing on the routes, competitions for blue light organizations, company bosses, and teams, event parallel to the Lichtenfels Wine Festival, good connection with the VGN transport association. Route lengths: 5.3 km and 10.4 km, running and Nordic walking, combined with wine festival and cultural activities.

name: Hüttlinger Muffigellauf
description: The Hüttlingen Muffigelläufe on June 20, 2026, offer a diverse running and activity experience for all age groups and performance levels. From the toddler run for the youngest, through children’s, school, and youth runs, to more challenging courses such as the 10 km run at Kocherknie and the 7 km run at Limes, there is something for everyone. The Walk around the Limes also invites relaxed participation. The event is organized by the dedicated running club of TSV Hüttlingen and emphasizes fun, community, and unforgettable moments.
course_highlights: Bambinilauf 780m for children born in 2019 and later
7 km run at Limes and Walk around the Limes
10 km run at Kocherknie
additional: Race number pickup from 11:00 AM at the competition office in the DRK Begegnungsstätte (Muffigelbrunnen), Bachstr. 8, 73460 Hüttlingen. Parking and changing rooms/showers available at the Limeshalle, Sulzdorfer Str. 12. Award ceremonies for the top three finishers of each race on the festival stage starting at 5:30 PM. Team scoring possible. Various race distances, registration on-site possible, race number pickup at the competition office, parking at the Limeshalle.

name: km Staffellauf-100 jahre TSV Brokstedt
description: The 100 km relay race for the 100th anniversary of TSV Brokstedt is a special endurance event taking place in Brokstedt. Teams of youths and adults with 7 to 15 members, including at least 2 women, run in pairs over 50 laps to cover 100 km. For children up to 13 years old, there is a shortened version with 25 laps and 50 km. The event is held at the sports field in Brokstedt and offers a sporting challenge for teams who enjoy running together.
course_highlights: 50 laps of 2 km each for the 100 km relay race
Pairs running in teams
Separate children's relay with 25 laps (50 km)
additional: A maximum of 100 teams can participate. Local teams may register from December 1, 2025. Registration is via email to staffellauf@tsvbrokstedt.de, including the team leader's name and the estimated number of runners. Withdrawal of the entire team is not possible. Start and finish are at the A-platz (Am Sportplatz 2b, 24161 Brokstedt). The race involves 50 laps for pairs, children's teams with 25 laps, a common finish line, a festival with a play area, food trucks, and an anniversary celebration from 8 PM.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
price_range: 2 € Nachmeldegebühr (bei Anmeldung bis 18.06.2026, sonst 30 Minuten vor Start)
description: The 46th Midsummer Night Run on June 20, 2026, in Konzen offers a diverse running program for all age groups and performance levels. The event includes children's runs, popular runs over 4.2 km, 6 km, and 10 km, as well as walking routes through the picturesque Eifel hedgerow and meadow landscape. The short distance of 4.2 km is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup as a tenth marathon and is especially suitable for beginners and fit children. The Running Team Konzen looks forward to numerous participants who want to enjoy the run together in a relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: Running routes through the beautiful Eifel hedgerow and meadow landscape
Pleasantly flat course for Eifel conditions
10 km walking route with the same course as the running route
additional: Start for the children's runs is at 3:00 PM with free start. Food and beverages are provided before, during, and after the runs. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. Terrain in hedgerow landscape, online registration possible until June 18, 2026, late registrations until 30 minutes before the start.

name: Never Give Up Hindernislauf
description: The Never Give Up obstacle race 2026 takes place on June 20th in Heinum near Gronau and offers a unique running experience for the whole family. Adults can participate in a challenging main race of approximately 12 km with over 30 diverse obstacles along idyllic forest and field paths on the edge of the Seven Mountains. Additionally, there is a 5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults, as well as a Kidsrun for children from 4 years old with a roughly 2 km course full of exciting obstacles. Fun, team spirit, and crossing the finish line together are the main focus, accompanied by professional timing, medals for all finishers, and catering at the finish area.
course_highlights: Main race approximately 12 km with over 30 obstacles
Course runs through forest and field paths on the edge of the Seven Mountains
5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults
additional: Professional timing for adults and children; medals and certificates for all finishers; catering with drinks, snacks, a cake buffet, and street food at the finish area; obstacles can be overcome alone or in teams; large part of the obstacles are on or around the sports field for good spectator experience. Obstacle race through forest and fields, registration via RunTiming, family and kids runs, volunteers wanted

description: The Nordholzer Windmill Run is a traditional running event in the Wurster North Sea coast, offering various distances for children, adolescents, and adults. The courses run over measured road routes officially recognized by the German Athletics Association (DLV). In addition to the races, there are also hiking and walking options open to all age groups. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, where every participant receives a medal and a certificate.
course_highlights: Measured road courses with DLV protocol
Distances from 400 m for children to half marathon (21.0975 km)
Competition at the Willi-Wicke sports field as start and finish area
additional: Race bibs are issued from 2:00 PM at the Willi-Wicke sports field clubhouse. Timing is done via transponder, which is rented with the race bib (20 Euro fee if not returned). Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the start/finish area. The children’s run is free, and accompaniment without scoring is allowed. The 5 km course is counted as a district championship. Late registrations are possible up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee. Each participant receives a medal and a certificate, walkers and hikers receive a participation certificate. Courses are measured, timing via transponder, changing rooms/showers/toilets available, district championship on the 5 km course.

name: Referees Run
description: The Referees Run is an annual 10-kilometer race held in Borgholzhausen since 2005 as part of the community event "Night of Borgholzhausen." The Gelsenkirchen Referees Association traditionally forms one of the largest groups in this race. The event promotes camaraderie among referees and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, and is supervised by Stefan Tendyck.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer race course
Part of the community event "Night of Borgholzhausen"
Traditionally large participation of the Gelsenkirchen Referees Association
additional: The race is part of the event "Night of Borgholzhausen." Information is provided by Stefan Tendyck. There are no listed prices or registration options on the website. The Gelsenkirchen Referees Association is traditionally well represented. The Referees Run regularly attracts numerous referees from Westphalia and promotes camaraderie within the refereeing community.

name: Römerkanal-Volkslauf
description: The Roman Canal Volkslauf takes place on June 20, 2026, in Kreuzweingarten and offers a weekend full of activity and community. The popular race attracts many participants who are cheered on by enthusiastic spectators along the course. The following day, June 21, village games and a large raffle complement the sporting event, providing fun, games, and great prizes. The event is organized by TuS Kreuzweingarten and supported by e-regio to promote regional community experiences.
course_highlights: Various race distances including 4.6 km and 10.4 km
Family and community activities
Run through the scenic city forest and Kreuzweingarten
additional: On Sunday after the race, village games and a large raffle take place. The event is organized by TuS Kreuzweingarten and supported by e-regio. Customer centers in Kuchenheim and Kall are reachable on weekdays from 8 am to 4 pm. Running event with community activities, running course in the city forest, winter running series, family and running events, donation campaigns.

name: Samstagslauf Großenmeer
description: The Saturday Run Großenmeer is a traditional community race taking place for the 15th time on June 20, 2026. Organized by the Großenmeer Gymnastics Club 1921 e.V., the race offers a sporting opportunity for runners from the region and beyond. The event is open to various race distances and all age groups. Registration is conveniently available via Laufmanager.net, and the organizers look forward to numerous participants.
course_highlights: Varied course routes for different performance levels
Run through the scenic region around Großenmeer and Ovelgönne
Traditional race with a family-friendly atmosphere and regional connection
additional: The registration is via Laufmanager.net. The race is organized by Großenmeerer Turnverein 1921 e.V., which also supports other sports offerings in the region. There are no explicitly stated start times or prize categories on the website. The event is part of the Ovelgönne-Jade Sports Association. Course routes, online registration, various race distances, regional sports offerings.

description: The Saucony BLN 10K is a spectacular new race taking place on June 20, 2026, at the historic Tempelhofer Feld in Berlin. The event combines fast, urban running with a unique atmosphere at one of the city's most historic locations. Start and finish are located in the listed Hangar 6, accompanied by a Cool Down Zone with DJs, drinks, and street food. The course consists of two fast laps of 5 kilometers each, passing historic aircraft and through the hangar, offering an unforgettable running experience with urban lifestyle and music.
course_highlights: Two fast 5-kilometer laps across Tempelhofer Feld
Start and finish in the listed Hangar 6
Course passes historic aircraft and runs through the hangar
additional: The starter package includes an event shirt, timing with a transponder on the shoe, refreshment points, toilets along the route, post-race catering, individual rankings, finisher medal, insurance, online certificate, paid race video, access to the sunset party on the apron. Entry begins at 4 PM, sunset party until 10 PM, event ends at 11 PM. Guests need a valid guest ticket, which runners can receive free of charge until May 31, 2026. Bags up to A4 size are allowed; no luggage storage on site. The course runs across Tempelhofer Feld, including start/finish in Hangar 6, with a Cool Down Zone, music, street food, neon-design medal, limited event shirt, urban festival atmosphere.

description: The Schwandorf Charity City Run takes place on June 20, 2026, for the 20th time and offers runners of all ages a diverse selection of disciplines. The event combines athletic ambition with social commitment, as the net proceeds go to local non-profit organizations such as the Water Rescue Schwandorf and the Nature Conservation Union Schwandorf. The races range from a toddler run to school and main runs, as well as Nordic walking and a Run & Bike team competition. All participants receive a charity medal and an online certificate, and medical support ensures safety. The event is family-friendly and also features a Stutz’n relay rally as a fun special.
course_highlights: Diverse courses from 200 m to 10 km, including toddler, school, main run, and Run & Bike
Courses are viewable digitally on Google Maps, and the Zwergerllauf takes place at Sepp-Simon-Stadion

additional: Registration and bib pickup are possible on the day of the event in various time slots until 1:30 PM. All participants receive a charity city run medal and an online certificate. Registration is open until June 14, 2026; family-friendly; net proceeds go to Water Rescue Schwandorf, Nature Conservation Union Schwandorf, and a self-help group for Post Covid, Post Vac, and ME/CFS affected individuals.

name: Sommerlauf Waren(Müritz) (LC/NLC)
description: The 4th Summer Run Waren (Müritz) is a running event organized by the SV Waren 09 e.V. Laufteam. The race takes place at the Müritz Stadium in Waren (Müritz) and is aimed at children, teenagers, active runners, and masters. The event offers a sporting opportunity for runners of all ages in a beautiful setting. Registration is available through the platform tollense-timing.de.
course_highlights: Various race distances for all age groups
Event held at Müritz Stadium with a stadium-near course
Part of the Laufcup MV, ideal for competitive and recreational athletes
additional: Stadium-remote race, including children and youth competitions, registration via the organizer's website, popular summer event in the region

name: Stuifenläufe
description: The Stuifenläufe in Wißgoldingen is a traditional running event taking place on June 20, 2026, for the 74th time. The event includes various races, such as school runs, a kindergarten run, the Stuifen round run, a mountain run, and Nordic walking. The courses lead through diverse terrain with forest paths and a challenging steep ascent to the mountain summit. The races are suitable for runners of all ages and skill levels and offer a beautiful combination of nature experience and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Stuifen round on gravel forest path
Mountain run with approximately 800 m steep ascent and 130 m elevation gain
Nordic walking on the 9 km route of the Nordic Walking Park Waldstetten
additional: Start and finish are located about 100 meters east of the large Wißgoldingen Stuifen parking lot on the circular trail. The Stuifen round and mountain run start counterclockwise and are marked with red ground markings. The Nordic walking route is signposted and conducted with timing without ranking. Online registration is possible about three weeks before the event. There are no detailed specifications about the terrain, but the event is known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse running options.

name: Zeutschel-Spitzberglauf
description: The Zeutschel-Spitzberglauf is a scenic race around Tübingen that delights with its varied forest and panoramic routes along the vineyard slopes near Wurmlinger Chapel. The race takes place as part of the Hirschauer sports weekend and offers different distances for main runners, hobby runners, Nordic walkers, as well as children’s and youth races. The event is part of the VR-Cup and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and an attractive supporting program.
course_highlights: Main race approx. 12.9 km with 260 meters of elevation
Hobby race and Nordic walking approx. 6.47 km with 110 meters of elevation
Panoramic routes along the vineyard slopes around Wurmlinger Chapel
additional: Start times: Dwarf race 4:30 PM, children and youth race 5:00 PM, main race, hobby race, and Nordic walking 5:30 PM. The children and youth races are 800 meters long and suitable for the sports badge. Nordic walkers run the same route as the hobby runners. Electronic timing, certificates, and results online. No dogs or baby joggers allowed. Scenic race with forest and panoramic routes, part of the VR-Cup, hobby, youth, children races, Nordic walking, no dogs/baby joggers, electronic timing.

name: 10K Hamburg - Volkspark
description: The 10K Hamburg Volkspark is an exciting 10-kilometer running format that takes place on continuously closed and secured loop courses in Hamburg. The route runs on paved and asphalted paths and offers runners of all performance levels an attractive running experience. The event is part of the 10K Hamburg series, which is held at various attractive spots in the Elbe metropolis. Participation is exclusively online, and the event is already sold out.
course_highlights: Continuously closed and secured loop courses
Route on paved and asphalted paths
Attractive running course in Volkspark Hamburg
additional: Clothing depot for personal belongings/change of clothes available on the event day. It is recommended to travel by public transport, e.g., S-Bahn station Stellingen about a 20-minute walk to the event site on Max Schmeling Straße. Registration is exclusively online. The cup ranking includes all 10K Hamburg events with point allocation for the 30 fastest men and women. The run is publicly accessible, with recommendations for using public transportation. The event offers a fixed distance of 10 kilometers and medals for all finishers.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 1
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 kilometers into seven pleasant evening stages, each ranging from 5 to 7 kilometers. The first stage starts on Sunday, June 21, 2026, in Förste and passes through the beautiful Sösetal valley with views of the Lichtenstein and the famous Lichtenstein Cave. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers and also offers a Kids' stage over 750 meters in the Schützenpark. The stages take place daily until June 27, 2026, and are organized by regional clubs.
course_highlights: Round courses of 5 to 7 kilometers per stage
Route with views of the Lichtenstein and Gipskarst impressions
Passage by the world-famous Lichtenstein Cave
additional: The first stage starts on Sunday at 10:45 AM at the sports field in Förste. The award ceremony takes place on Saturday, June 27, 2026, at 6:00 PM, including a raffle of material prizes. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers; membership in a club is not required. Minors need written parental consent. After the first stage, there will be a refreshment with pasta specialties from MTV Förste. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, supports local sponsors, and features varied routes that promote both nature and local knowledge.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 2
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. It takes place annually and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad. Participants can run all seven stages or individual stages, each approximately 10 kilometers long. The event places great emphasis on a successful running experience and the protection of the islands from overload.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands
Approximately 10 km running distance per stage
Run over promenades, dune landscapes, and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer
additional: Race bibs are issued about 1 hour after the arrival of the special ferry until 30 minutes before the start. Race bibs with integrated chip for timing are provided. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available on the islands. Sports bag storage is offered. There are info events on June 19th before the race. The award ceremony takes place at 3:00 PM on Borkum. Stages on seven North Sea islands, approximately 10 km running distance per stage, registration is already fully booked, no waiting list, limited capacities due to ferry and infrastructure.

description: The Apple Run at Kelterei Heil takes place on June 21, 2026, in the scenic landscape around Weilmünster-Laubuseschbach. The course passes by orchards, through forest and field paths, a closed state road, and along a bike path back to the start and finish area on the premises of Kelterei Heil. Two distances are offered: 5 kilometers (one lap) and 10 kilometers (two laps). The race is open to everyone, from professional runners to recreational athletes, and also features a free children's run for young runners up to 9 years old.
course_highlights: Course passing orchards and through forest and field paths
Section on a closed state road L3063
Return along a bike path to Laubuseschbach
additional: The 5 km run starts at 10:00 AM, and the 10 km run at 10:15 AM. A free children's run for children up to and including 9 years old takes place at 12:00 PM. There is a team classification with special prizes for the largest group and the fastest women's team. A team must consist of at least 8 people, with at least 2 runners on each distance. Only the two fastest runners per distance are counted for the team. The course passes orchards, forest and field paths, a closed state road L3063, and a bike path; finisher shirts are optional; team classification is possible.

name: Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Spendenlauf
description: The Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Charity Run is a running event in support of the organization "FUCHSBAU" - grief counseling for children and adolescents e.V. Since 2010, the organization has been supporting young people confronted with the death of close relatives. The charity run was established in 2024 to finance the important work of Fuchsbau, as the organization has been fully dependent on donations since 2023. The event promotes community and social engagement in Barsinghausen and will take place again in 2026.
course_highlights: Running for a good cause in Barsinghausen
Community experience with supporting program and entertainment
Event location: REWE Sportpark Barsinghausen
additional: The charity run is supported by prominent figures, including artistic moments and entertainment such as Hoppeburg rental. The Stadtwerke Barsinghausen ensure the supply of drinking water. Jan Haller is the patron of the 2026 event. There is a dm running challenge and a supporting program. The event takes place at the REWE Sportpark. Run within 4 hours, with various activities and on-site catering, race on sports facilities, sponsors for laps, family festival.

It offers three different distances of 2 km, 7.5 km, and 16 km, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start takes place at the Landkostarena, surrounded by the idyllic lakes and forest landscape of the region. The event is open to all age groups, with children and adolescents up to 13 years participating for free.

name: Buchholzer Stadtlauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Buchholz City Run is a traditional race with cult character in the Nordheide region, taking place on June 21, 2026. The course runs right through the city center of Buchholz and is accompanied by numerous spectators, creating a special atmosphere and motivation. Various distances offer suitable challenges for all age and performance groups, from children's runs to the popular relay race in teams. Additionally, there is running training with certified coaches, and all participants receive special medals and certificates.

name: Dahlenburger Moorlauf
description: The Dahlenburger Moorlauf is a popular community run with manual timing, attracting around 200 participants annually. The event offers races for children, walking, and two main races over 4600 meters and 8800 meters. The course is flat and mostly asphalted, with children's races taking place on the tartan track. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a picturesque setting in the Dahlenburger Moor.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly asphalted course
Children's races on the tartan track
Run through the scenic Dahlenburger Moor
additional: Race bibs are available from 08:30 at the DSK sports facility/Dornweg in Dahlenburg. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for a fee of 3.00 €. Manual timing. Showers are available at the swimming pool (admission required) or at the club house. Refreshments with water stations along the course as well as coffee, cake, and soft drinks at the sports field. Parking is available in front of the swimming pool and the school. Courses, registrations, community spirit, various race types.

name: Draisinenlauf Altenglan
description: The Draisinenlauf Altenglan on June 21, 2026, is a half marathon event featuring individual and relay competitions (2-person and 4-person relays). The course runs along the Glan-Blies cycling trail on the Draisinen track, is officially measured, flat with only 45 meters of elevation gain, and almost entirely asphalted. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers a unique atmosphere in the Kuseler Musikantenland, accompanied by passing Draisinen. Safety is provided by medical services from the DLRG OG Altenglan and the DRK Kreisverband Kusel. Medals are awarded to all finishers of the children's and youth runs, and prize money is available for the fastest half marathon runners.
course_highlights: Officially measured, flat course with only 45 meters of elevation gain
Route along the Glan-Blies cycling trail on the Draisinen track
Almost entirely asphalted running course
additional: Timing is done with disposable transponders issued with the bib number. Bib numbers must be visibly worn on the chest. There is no walking discipline. Prize money for the half marathon: €150 for 1st place, €100 for 2nd place, €50 for 3rd place. Special prizes for the most participating clubs and schools as well as for the oldest participants. The event is approved by the DLV (5-point scoring according to DLO). The course is flat, measured, almost entirely asphalted; relay and individual starts; provisions every 2.5 km; registration only via BR-Timing; bib numbers with transponder; certificates for all finishers; travel by train is possible; on-site catering and award ceremonies.

The club with the most starters wins 4 crates of their choice (beer, non-alcoholic, or radler). New start times: 9:30 AM for the 5.5 km run, 10:45 AM for the 10 km run. Multiple courses (5.5 km, 10 km, Kids Run, Schülerlauf), team and corporate competitions, new start times, no longer a charity event.

The event is suitable for all age groups, including special routes for children and wheelchair users. Participants receive certificates, and there are material prizes for the best runners as well as team trophies.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Norderney (2. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. It takes place from June 20 to June 27, 2026, and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad. The individual stages lead over varied routes with maritime flair, dune landscapes, and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer. The event offers a unique running experience with start and finish on the islands, including comprehensive infrastructure such as race number distribution, sports bag storage, and award ceremonies on site.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian islands with approximately 10 km per stage
Running routes through dune landscapes, beaches, and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer
Start and finish on the islands with maritime flair and healthy North Sea air
additional: Race numbers are issued on-site on each island, e.g., at the tourist information on Norderney from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Sports bag storage is available on the islands, e.g., at the Conversationshaus on Norderney from 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM. Showers, changing rooms, and toilets are available on the islands. There is no waiting list or backup list, and race numbers cannot be transferred. The stage race on seven islands has limited participant capacity due to infrastructure and ferry capacities; registration is full, and there is no waiting list.

name: Globus-Theißen-Lauf
description: The Globus-Theißen Run is a community running event in Theißen, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on June 21, 2026, for the sixth time. The race offers routes for all age groups, from toddlers over 1.5 km, 3 km, 7 km to 14 km. The event is held at the miners' stadium and is part of the Rangliste-Burgenland for adults as well as the Wiesen-Grundcup for children and adolescents. Refreshments include a cake buffet, coffee, and hearty foods, and there is children's entertainment during the award ceremony. The event is a community project by Globus-Theißen, local clubs, and residents.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m (toddlers) to 14 km

name: Grafschafter Ahrtal-Lauf
description: The Grafschafter Ahrtal Run is a traditional race event organized jointly by the clubs SV Dernau, SV Hönningen/Ahr, and Grafschafter SV. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 400m and 1km children's runs, 5km and 10km races, as well as a 5km walking competition. Start and finish are at the sports field in Grafschaft-Vettelhoven, and the course runs over field paths, partly with gravel and paved sections. The event is part of the Ahrtal-Team-Cup race series and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities on site.
course_highlights: Course over field paths, partly with gravel and paved sections
Start and finish at the sports field in Grafschaft-Vettelhoven
Various distances for children and adults
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day until half an hour before the start. Parking is available directly at the sports field. Changing and shower facilities are located in the sports clubhouse at the sports field. Award ceremonies take place around 10:45 AM for the 5/10km races and around 12:30 PM for age groups of the 10km race, followed by the children's runs. The courses lead through the Grafschafter Forest and the vineyards of the Ahr Valley; online registration is possible; parking at the sports field; changing and shower facilities in the sports clubhouse; proceeds go to local sports clubs.

name: Hunsrück-Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Strecke Hunsrück-Trail 25 km - Läufer mit Distanzerfahrung (m/w, Jahrgang 2005 und älter)

tiers.description: Strecke Hunsrück-Trail 13 km - (m/w, Jahrgang 2010 und älter)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Strecke Hunsrück-Trail 7 km - (m/w, Jahrgang 2012 und älter)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Strecke Einsteiger-Trail 3 km - (m/w, Jahrgang 2014 und älter)

description: The Hunsrück Trail is a running event in the Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park, taking place on June 21, 2026, in Mörschied. The event offers four distances ranging from 3 km to 25 km, passing through the diverse nature of the national park. The races are suitable for various age and experience levels and provide a great opportunity to experience the landscape. The event is part of the ITRA National League and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and good organization.
course_highlights: 25 km trail with 3 refreshment stations
Start and finish at the sports club house of TuS Mörschied
Automatic timing with reusable bibs
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on the day of the event at the sports club house. Food and drinks after the race with coffee and cake sales as well as open fire cooking. No late registrations on site. Timing is automatic with Race Result, bibs are reusable. GPX routes are available on the event day. Trail run in a national park, registration only in advance, limited participant number, post-race catering.

name: KSC Schlossparklauf
description: The KSC Schlossparklauf takes place on June 21, 2026, for the 28th time and is held for the first time in summer. New this year is a partner run for companies. The event includes a main race, a youth and school race, and the partner run, with limited participant numbers. The course is a loop of approximately 3.25 km from the BBBank Wildpark to the castle and back. The main race consists of three laps, while the youth and school race runs one lap. Start and finish are located at the BBBank Wildpark.
course_highlights: Loop course of approximately 3.25 km from BBBank Wildpark to the castle and back
Main race with 3 laps, youth and school race with 1 lap
Start at 'Nackter Mann' in front of the south stand, finish in front of the west stand of BBBank Wildpark
additional: Participant limits: 1,100 in the main race, 300 in the youth and school race, 800 in the partner run. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event if the participant limit has not been reached. Start and finish are located at BBBank Wildpark. The partner run for companies is new in 2026. Loop course approximately 3.25 km, not officially measured, start at 'Nackter Mann' in front of the south stand of BBBank Wildpark, finish in the Wildpark, online registration available, various race distances, race shirt available for a fee, partner run for companies.

name: Lamspringer Klosterlauf
description: The Lamspringer Monastery Run is an annual running and hiking event with start and finish at the Lamspringer Waldstadion. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including children's runs, and is part of the South Lower Saxony Cup. Runners, walkers, and hiking enthusiasts are warmly invited to experience the diverse routes through nature around Lamspringe. The event combines athletic ambition with fun and community in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Lamspringer Waldstadion
Multiple running and hiking trails with different distances
Includes children's runs and routes from 400 m to 23 km
additional: Registration on site possible until 1 hour before the start. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, 15 km, 23 km. The event is part of the South Lower Saxony Cup. Start and finish location is the Lamspringer Waldstadion; various distances (1 km, 5 km, 8 km, 13 km, 22.9 km); changing and shower facilities; on-site catering; part of the South Lower Saxony Cup.

name: Lauf in die Sonne
description: The Run into the Sun takes place on June 21, 2026, in 71397 Nellmersbach and is organized by Hot Socks Leutenbach e.V. There are two race distances, 10 km and 5.8 km, which start together at 08:00 AM. The event offers a comprehensive breakfast buffet and awards trophies to the top runners. Additionally, a traveling trophy is awarded for the best team. The number of participants is limited to a maximum of 222 starters.
course_highlights: Two distances: 10 km and 5.8 km
Start and finish at the multi-purpose hall in Nellmersbach
Large breakfast buffet after the race
additional: Maximum of 222 starters. Race documents can be collected from 07:00 AM. Award ceremony at 10:30 AM. Trophies for 1st to 3rd place in each individual category and a traveling trophy for the best team. Run into the Sun, running event, 10 km & 5.8 km, breakfast included, registration from Easter, max. 222 starters.

name: Meilenlauf beim WGV-Leichtathletik-Festival
description: The WGV Athletics Festival on June 21, 2026, in Stuttgart offers a diverse program centered around athletics. The highlight is the Street Mile, a new running format in the heart of the city open to all running enthusiasts. The festival is complemented by the KLEINformat! Charity Run, where each lap completed benefits a good cause, as well as an elite mile featuring top athletes and a children's mile for the youngest participants. The festival combines elite sports, amateur sports, and social engagement in a unique event right in Stuttgart's city center.
course_highlights: Street Mile exactly 1609 meters long in the middle of Stuttgart city center
KLEINformat! Charity Run with approximately 800-meter laps through Marktplatz, Schillerplatz, Planie, Karlsplatz, and Dorotheen Quartier
Elite mile with top athletes starting at 12:40 PM
additional: The KLEINformat! Charity Run starts at 11:00 AM and lasts 75 minutes. The lap is approximately 800 meters long and flat. The Street Mile begins at 12:15 PM and is open to all running enthusiasts. The elite mile starts at 12:40 PM, and the children's mile at 1:00 PM. Participation in the charity run is free of charge, with voluntary donations possible. The Street Mile is a new format, being offered for the first time in Stuttgart. Registration is possible until June 21, 2026; various race categories for children and adults; event held as part of an athletics festival with additional sporting activities.

name: Reinhardswaldwalking
location: VfL Veckerhagen, Reinhardshagen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: VfL Veckerhagen 1897 e.V. cordially invites you to the 15th Reinhardswald Walking Day on June 21, 2026. Distances of 3 km, 6 km, and 11 km are offered, passing through farmland, forest edges, and the Reinhardswald. The start and finish are at the central sports facility of VfL Veckerhagen. Along the way, there are refreshment stations with drinks, and at the finish, beverages, coffee, cake, and sausages are available. The three largest participating groups will receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through farmland, forest edges, and Reinhardswald
Start and finish at the central sports facility of VfL Veckerhagen
Refreshment stations with drinks along the route
additional: The three largest participating groups will be rewarded with cash prizes. To facilitate planning, a non-binding notification of the approximate number of participants is requested by June 13, 2026. It is recommended to bring the completed registration form to speed up on-site registration. Participants can choose between 3 km, 6 km, 8 km, and 11 km; the event promotes community and nature experience; catering and prizes for groups with the most participants.

name: Sababurger Tierparklauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 3 ,- Euro / Bambinis, Kinder, Jugendliche (bis einschließlich Jahrgang 2007)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 ,- Euro / Alle weiteren Läuferinnen und Läufer

description: The 16th Sababurg Animal Park Run will take place on June 21, 2026, in the picturesque Sababurg Animal Park and the adjacent Reinhardswald. Runners will be accompanied by enthusiastic spectators and will experience a unique natural setting on carefully selected routes. The race is a charity run in support of the planned Amphibian World, which is to be established as a new nature learning site in the animal park. The Animal Park Run is also part of the Reinhardswald Run and Walking Cup and offers routes for various age groups and performance levels.
course_highlights: Running routes in Sababurg Animal Park and the adjacent Reinhardswald
Beautiful views of the animal park, the animals, and Sababurg
Routes over paved park paths, suitable for beginners and professionals
additional: Race bibs with transponders will be issued on race day and must be worn visibly at the front. Timing is via transponder. Refreshment points with mineral water and bananas are available approximately every 3-4 km. Changing, shower, and toilet facilities are available. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Children may be accompanied by an adult but not carried. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed on the race routes. The race is part of the Reinhardswald Run and Walking Cup series. Registration is open from May 1 to June 19, 2026. No registration on race day.

name: Sachsenlauf Coswig
price_range: 2 € erste Stunde, danach 1,50 € (Parkgebühren im Parkhaus an der Moritzburger Straße)
description: The Saxony Run Coswig is a traditional sporting event that has been held annually in June since 1980. The races lead on forest, woodland, and field paths through the Friedewald to the Moritzburger Hügelland, with a special highlight: passing through the Moritzburger Stud Farm to the castle pond and horse hill on the 21.1 km course. In addition to running routes, there are also walking and hiking options suitable for different fitness levels and ambitions. The event is part of the Meißner Sparkassencup and the Niederlausitzcup and also offers separate races with surprises at the finish for children and bambinis.
course_highlights: Running routes on forest, woodland, and field paths in Friedewald and Moritzburger Hügelland
Passing through the Moritzburger Stud Farm with castle pond and horse hill (21.1 km course)
Hiking routes on the Karras circular trails with biotopes such as Moselwiese and Seerosenteich
additional: Start and finish are located on Friedewaldstraße at the corner of Sachsenlaufweg. The award ceremonies take place in the schoolyard. Changing rooms and sanitary facilities are available in the nearby Spitzgrund sports hall. The cut-off time for all routes is 14:00. Parking is available for a fee in the Moritzburger Straße parking garage. Public transportation (VVO bus lines 400, 401, 405) is recommended for arrival. There are dedicated races for children and bambinis (500 m and 800 m) with small surprises at the finish. The bib numbers include a disposable transponder for timing. Late registrations are possible on race day until 10:00, payment only in cash. Route adjustments due to state championships, parking in the parking garage, travel by bus and train are recommended. Catering and award ceremonies are held in the finish area, with children’s and hiking routes also available.

name: Schlossinsellauf Lübben
description: The Schlossinsellauf Lübben is a traditional race event on the idyllic castle island in the town of Lübben in the Spreewald. It offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults, including Bambini runs, children's runs, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, as well as a Run & Bike half marathon. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a varied course layout that takes place both on the castle island and in the surrounding Spreewald area. The race is part of the Spreewaldcup and attracts numerous runners each year.
course_highlights: Courses on the idyllic castle island in Lübben
Varied distances from 550 m Bambini run to half marathon and Run & Bike
Part of the Spreewaldcup with a diverse course layout
additional: Total participant limit of 1000 starters. Registration is binding and non-cancellable. Entry fees will be collected via direct debit. There is group and club registration. Age categories are defined for children and youth runs. The event is part of the Spreewaldcup. Facilities include changing rooms, lockers, showers, medical services, catering, and entertainment on site. Various race distances (Bambini, children, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, Run & Bike), registration opens from 01.02.2026, participant limit 1000.

name: Sohrener Sommerlauf
description: The Sohrener Summer Run is a regional running event in Sohren, part of the Hunsrücker Running Series. The event is organized by TuS Sohren, a local sports club with various departments, which characterizes the run as a community and non-commercial event. There are two distances offered: a short run of 150 meters and a road race over 10 kilometers. The race typically takes place in pleasant summer weather and provides runners from the region with a nice opportunity to engage in sports.
course_highlights: Part of the Hunsrücker Running Series with regional road races
Distances: 150 m and 10 km
Organized by the local sports club TuS Sohren

name: Sonnwend-Freundschaftslauf
description: The 3rd Solstice Friendship Run in Völklingen offers runners a varied event with historic and modern courses. On June 21, 2026, participants will start on the traditional 10-mile route as well as on distances of 8 km, 10 km, and Nordic walking. The event is supervised by experienced runners and takes place near the Hermann-Neuberger-Halle and the swimming pool. The Köllertal Running Friends look forward to numerous participants and a sporting community.
course_highlights: Historic 10-mile course
Additional routes of 8 km, 10 km, and Nordic walking
Start and finish near Hermann-Neuberger-Halle / Völklingen swimming pool
additional: Start times: 09:00 AM for the 10-mile course, 09:30 AM for 8 km, 10 km, and Nordic walking. Running support by experienced runners. The event is part of a tradition that promotes community spirit and offers an opportunity for runners to network and celebrate the beginning of summer.

name: Spessarthelden - Laufen gegen Gewalt
description: The Spessart Hero Run Against Violence is a charity run in Bad Soden-Salmünster organized by Tuğçe Albayrak e.V. and the city. The event sends a strong message against violence and is supported by former Federal President Christian Wulff as patron. There are various running distances suitable for all age groups, and the event promotes community and social engagement in the region.
course_highlights: Running distances: 500 meters, 5 kilometers, and 10 kilometers
Charity run with social engagement against violence
Event in the Bad Soden-Salmünster region
additional: There is a special school registration for all groups under 18 years old. The event is held as a charity festival with various sponsors and supporters. Start and finish at Spessart Forum; parking available; accessible by train, bicycle, or on foot; running event with team classification and special offers upon presentation of the starting number.

name: Stunden-Lauf Herne
location: Sportpark Eickel, Herne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld (bis zum 15.06.2026): 65 Euro. (DUV-Mitglieder entrichten ein um 5 Euro niedrigeres Startgeld).

description: The 24-hour run in Herne takes place at the Sportpark Eickel, a modern and sporty setting with a paved 2-km loop course. The challenge is to run as many kilometers as possible within 24 hours, either as an individual or in relay teams. The event offers not only the athletic competition but also entertainment with mini-golf and on-site catering. Timing is done electronically via a transponder on the bib number, and camping is possible directly at the venue.
course_highlights: Paved 2-km loop course at Sportpark Eickel
Electronic lap timing with transponder on the bib number
Start and finish directly at the mini-golf facility
additional: Race documents will be issued on the day of the event from 08:00 to 11:00 at the mini-golf facility. Timing is electronic with a transponder, which is passed on like a baton during relay exchanges. Refreshment stations with drinks and food are available; participants can also store their own provisions. Camping is possible directly on site. The course is a paved 2-km loop around Sportpark Eickel. Course: Loop course around Sportpark Eickel; participation as an individual or relay team; fun and catering on site.

name: Töpfermarktlauf Bürgel
description: The Pottery Market Run in Bürgel is a traditional race that has been established as a sporting highlight in the Saale-Holzland district since the 1990s. The event offers various courses, including the challenging 12 km main race and the 6 km beginner race, which lead through the diverse landscape around Bürgel. All participants receive a handcrafted, pottery medal as a memento. The event is family-friendly with children’s and students’ races and takes place on Sunday morning to enable as many running enthusiasts as possible to participate.
course_highlights: 12 km main race with a challenging elevation profile for experienced runners
6 km beginner race with a varied route around Bürgel
Refreshment stations along the course and support at the finish line

name: Waiblinger Stadtlauf
description: The Waiblingen City Run takes place on June 21, 2026, and offers runners of various age groups and skill levels the opportunity to participate in different courses. The event is family-friendly and accompanied by a diverse entertainment program at the town hall square. The athletics department of VfL Waiblingen ensures the catering. By participating in the children's or youth run, the Tour Ginkgo is also supported, which helps seriously ill children and their families.
course_highlights: School run: 2 laps approx. 1400 m
10 km and 6 km run as well as walking: 1 lap approx. 2 km
Diverse entertainment program at the town hall square
additional: Registration will be possible at the beginning of 2026. The athletics department of VfL Waiblingen takes care of the catering. Volksbank Stuttgart donates 1 euro for each successful participation in the children's or youth run to Tour Ginkgo in the Rems-Murr district. Online registration available; event takes place in June 2026; contact by phone and email

name: Wallernhäuser Dorflauf
