Over eight days, participants run, walk, or Nordic walk approximately 10 kilometers per stage, enjoying the unique nature, maritime flair, and healthy high-sea climate. The event attracts running enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad and offers a fair competitive experience with a family-friendly atmosphere. Due to limited capacities on the islands, the number of participants is restricted, ensuring an exclusive running experience.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands with about 10 km per stage
Running routes along beaches, dune landscapes, and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wadden Sea
Start and finish points centrally located on the islands, e.g., promenade on Borkum and spa square on Norderney
additional: Race bibs are issued on each island approximately 1 hour after arrival of the special ferry until 30 minutes before the start. Race bibs with integrated chip for timing are provided. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available on the islands. Sports bag storage is offered. Award ceremonies take place in the afternoon on each island. Optional race bib pickup can be arranged on the Friday before the race in Bensersiel. Functional shirts, headbands, and bottles are available as merchandise. The stage race takes place on seven North Sea islands, with no waiting list and a limited number of participants due to infrastructure and ferry capacities.

name: XTrail Breitnau
description: The XTrail Breitnau is a versatile running event in the Hochschwarzwald that brings together runners and Nordic walkers of all ages in one day. Four different races are offered: the popular XT-Run with half marathon and 10 km routes, the XT-Walk with 12 and 8 km routes, the XT-Challenge as an obstacle sprint for age groups U8 to U20, and the XT-Kids race for the youngest participants. The courses lead through varied terrain with trails, steep ascents, and panoramic views, and offer an attractive starter package as well as professional timing. The event is organized by the Skizunft Breitnau e.V. and takes place on June 27, 2026.
course_highlights: Half marathon course with steep ascents and trails through the Ravennaschlucht
Nordic walking routes on natural paths through moss, fir forest, and Hohwartshöhe
Obstacle sprint with serpentines ascent and varied course layout in the spa garden
additional: Race bib distribution on the day of the event from 08:00-11:00 and 12:30-13:45 at the fire station. For XT-Kids and XT-Challenge, bibs are issued as sets per club. Participation conditions and equipment requirements must be observed, e.g., trail running shoes with profile sole for RUN, Nordic walking poles for WALK. Nutrition is provided on the course and at the finish, personal digital certificate, finisher medal for XT-Kids, exclusive trophies and prizes for overall and age group winners. Late registrations with fee are possible until June 26 at 18:00, and on the event day until one hour before start. Multiple race types, routes, age groups, online registration, bibs, nutrition, prizes, and possible route changes.

name: 19. Muko-Spendenlauf Hannover
location: Sportplatz des VfL Eintracht Hannover, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: 10 Euro Startgeld, 15 Euro ohne Anmeldung, Spenden möglich

description: The 19th Muko-Charity Run Hannover is an inclusive race taking place on June 28, 2026, at the sports field of VfL Eintracht Hannover. The event is open to all age groups and performance levels, whether running, walking, or strolling, with or without disabilities. The goal is to raise funds for the House of Guardian Angels, a parent and patient hostel for cystic fibrosis families near the Medical University of Hannover. Each lap on the 400-meter gravel track is sponsored with one euro. The run promotes community and solidarity in the fight against cystic fibrosis.
course_highlights: Lap on a 400-meter gravel track
Inclusive race for all age and performance groups
Event at the sports field of VfL Eintracht Hannover
additional: The run takes place from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Each participant can run, walk, or stroll as many laps as they like. Sponsors pay one euro per lap or a fixed total amount. A donation receipt is issued for donations of 20 euros or more. Certificates are awarded after the run. An online donation tool will be available (activation pending). Hygiene rules must be observed, disinfectants are available on site. Running on a 400m gravel track, donations via sponsors, online donation tool, changing rooms and showers available, no dogs allowed, catering at the club restaurant, children's program, patronage by Tina Deeken.

description: The Hella Hamburg Half Marathon is a major running event in Hamburg held annually on the last Sunday of June. On an officially measured, flat, and asphalted 21.0975 km course, up to 24,000 runners experience a unique running party through the Hanseatic city. The route passes approximately 50 sights and is accompanied by numerous event points with DJ support and live music. The event is known for its great atmosphere and the traffic-free course, secured by police and marshals.
course_highlights: Officially measured, best-list eligible half marathon course (21.0975 km)
Flat, continuously asphalted point-to-point course
Around 50 sights and numerous event points with live music and DJ support
additional: Start time Sunday from 08:30 a.m., finish closing at 1:40 p.m. (maximum finish time 3:30 hours). Participants born in 2010 or earlier are eligible. Cancellation option for 10.00 euros available until June 9, 2026. Medal engraving (8.00 euros), functional shirt (35.00 euros), and official socks (20.00 euros) can be ordered online until June 9, 2026. Bib distribution takes place in the foyer (details not fully specified). The course is flat, asphalted, traffic-free; registration online; bib pickup at the exhibition grounds; timing with transponder; separate classifications for men and women.

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The 24-Hour Burginsellauf in Delmenhorst is a challenging ultramarathon on a flat, approximately 1.3 km long loop course along the Burginsel and Graftwiesen. The event offers individual and team competitions as well as a 6-hour run and a 3-hour student run. The route is traffic-free, illuminated, and mostly shaded, making it ideal for endurance runners looking to test their limits. During the run, there is a 24-hour open refreshment station and a tent area for rest breaks. The German Championship in the 24-hour run is held as part of this event.
course_highlights: Flat, approximately 1.3 km long loop course along the Burginsel and Graftwiesen
Traffic-free, illuminated, and predominantly shaded route
Automatic digital timing with live intermediate standings
additional: The race starts on June 27, 2026 at 12:00 PM and ends on June 28, 2026 at 12:00 PM. The course is measured according to DLV standards. There is a 24-hour open refreshment station with fruit, cereals, hot and cold drinks, as well as warm dinner and breakfast for 24-hour runners. Showers and changing rooms are approximately 250 meters away in the Stadtbad-Turnhalle. Public parking and motorhome spaces are available on the Graftwiesen. For teams, 5 starting places are included in the entry fee; additional persons cost 20 EUR each. Relay participants must be registered via a link in the confirmation email. There will be a large laser show and live music in the evening. The event also includes a 3-hour student run starting from age 8, with catering included, race numbers with chips, a medal for 24-hour runners, a participant limit due to high demand, and a tent area for rest.

name: AHRTuS-Lauf mit Ahrtal-TEAM-Cup
description: The AHRTuS Run is a club-organized race day above Calvary Hill in Ahrweiler, prepared by volunteers from TuS Ahrweiler in Quarzkaul. The program begins with races for toddlers, children, and adolescents, followed by 5 km and 10 km runs as well as a 6.2 km Nordic walking route. The adult course mainly runs through shady forest paths and narrow trails with some elevation, including a climb through Maibachklämmchen with numerous wooden bridges. The 10 km race is also the final event of the Ahrtal-TEAM-Cup, where club teams compete for the last points. The event combines a family-friendly atmosphere with sporting competition and offers medals for children, a bouncy castle, a play bus, and live music at the start and finish areas.
course_highlights: Shady forest paths and narrow trails
Climb through Maibachklämmchen with many wooden bridges
10 km race as the final of the Ahrtal-TEAM-Cup
additional: The event offers races for toddlers, children, and adolescents, a 6.2 km Nordic walking option, finisher medals for children, a bouncy castle, a play bus, and live music at the start and finish areas. The participant number is approximately 250 runners. Besides the races, the event features family activities, medals for finishers, a bouncy castle, a play bus, and live music at the start and finish areas.

name: Benefizlauf Aachen
location: Waldstadion Aachen, Aachen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Aachen Charity Run is a traditional running event taking place on June 28, 2026, at the Waldstadion Aachen. The 24th edition offers various distances for all age and performance levels, from ambitious runners to recreational runners. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, volunteer commitment, and support for non-profit organizations. Participants can look forward to a beautiful course in the stadium and a good mood.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the most beautiful stadium in Aachen
Various distances for young and old, fast and leisurely
Running event with sunny atmosphere and good mood
additional: Registration is via my.race|result. The event is organized by volunteers; helpers are sought for course marshals, refreshment stands, and setup/takedown. There are training offers for members, including beginner running groups and regular training in the Aachen Forest. Various distances, registration via the website, non-profit event.

name: BikeNavy Run
location: Sportflugplatz Nordholz, Wurster Nordseeküste, Niedersachsen, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ab 5 Euro ab 5 Jahren bis 8 Jahren

description: The BikeNavy! Run is a unique running event that takes place on the grounds of the Nordholz Airfield, which is not accessible to the public otherwise. The course runs within the controlled zone of the Marine Aviation Support Base Nordholz and offers participants a special atmosphere with views of historic and modern aviation history. After the race, there is an opportunity to visit the Marine Aviation and Airship Museum AERONAUTICUM. The event is ideal for runners seeking an extraordinary and unforgettable running experience.
course_highlights: Course over the grounds of Nordholz Airfield
Route within the controlled zone of Marine Aviation Support Base Nordholz
Close to the Marine Aviation and Airship Museum AERONAUTICUM
additional: On the day of the event, catering is available from 9:00 AM, a charity raffle, free participation in the show race "Last Man Standing" from 10:30 AM, as well as various races for children and adults. Ample parking is available at Nordholz Airfield. Access is also possible by public transport and bicycle. The event offers various categories, including children's runs, duathlons, and cycling races, as well as entertainment, registration, and charity activities. After the race, there is an opportunity to visit the nearby Marine Aviation and Airship Museum AERONAUTICUM.

name: Eschelbronner Schreinerdorflauf
description: The Eschelbronner Carpenter Village Run takes place on June 28, 2026, and offers a course approximately 10 km long, running on paved paths through the Eschelbronner Forest and fields. The profile is challenging but suitable for all runners. Start and finish are at TV Heim on Schlossstraße 23 in Eschelbronn. Additionally, there is a walking route with timing after 7.5 km, which can also be used for the sports badge evaluation.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km long course on paved paths
Course runs through Eschelbronner Forest and fields
Challenging profile, but suitable for everyone
additional: Walking route with timing after 7.5 km available for sports badge evaluation. Start and finish at TV Heim (Schlossstraße 23). Course on paved paths, start at 9:00 AM, registration from 8:00 AM, including a walking category with timing after 7.5 km.

name: Halderner Volkslauf
description: The Halderner Volkslauf is a traditional race that brings together young and old and promotes the sense of community among friends and families. The event will take place again on June 28, 2026, with the half marathon remaining a permanent part of the program due to positive feedback. The event offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all performance levels and invites participation.
course_highlights: Running together of young and old
Half marathon as a fixed part of the offering
Event in Rees-Haldern with a family-friendly character
additional: The event includes a half marathon, online registration is available until June 22, and results from previous years are published.

name: Hardtwaldlauf 2026
description: The Hardtwaldlauf in Karlsruhe is a traditional race event taking place on June 28, 2026, for the 40th time. Offered are races over 5 km and 10 km, running through the Hardtwald forest and suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The event features professional timing with disposable transponders and a friendly atmosphere with certificates and prizes for various age groups. The race bibs are distributed on the day of the event from 7:30 a.m., and changing and shower facilities are available on-site.
course_highlights: Races through the Hardtwald in Karlsruhe
5 km and 10 km courses with net time measurement via disposable transponder
Race bib distribution at the tennis hall on the MTV grounds from 7:30 a.m.
additional: Late registrations are possible online until half an hour before the respective start, with a late registration fee of €2.00 per start. Parking is available along Adenauerring and at Klosterweg, but not at the large Birken parking lot opposite the BBBank Wildpark. Changing and shower facilities are available at MTV Karlsruhe. Certificates can be printed online. There are special prizes for the top three women and men in the 10 km race, as well as material prizes and certificates for age groups and the five fastest women and men in the 5 km race. The race begins and ends on the MTV grounds, with parking nearby. Participant information and results are available online, and the event is part of the Karlsruhe running calendar.

name: Internationaler Trierer Stadtlauf
description: The 40th International Trier City Run will take place on June 28, 2026, in the city center of Trier. The new course leads through the historic backdrop of Germany's oldest city, passing landmarks such as Porta Nigra and the Imperial Baths. There are suitable distances for all performance levels, from the Bambini run for children to the half marathon as the main discipline. The city run combines athletic challenge with community and a special atmosphere in one of Germany's most beautiful cities.
course_highlights: New course through Trier city center
Passing historic landmarks such as Porta Nigra and Imperial Baths
Run through the heart of Germany's oldest city
additional: Distances: Half marathon, 10 km run, 5.4 km youth run, Bambini run. Registration is via an external site silvesterlauf.de. The event combines sport, community, and history. Organizer is CITY SPORT Trier with a retail store in Trier city center. Various distances, flat routes, historic landmarks, start times in the morning, online registration, limited participant number of 1,800, participation for all age groups.

name: Kilometer für Kinder
description: Kilometer für Kids is an annual charity event that was launched in 2014 to support children and adolescents in need through sporting challenges. Participants accumulate kilometers by running, cycling, or swimming, which they then honor with a donation per kilometer. The project not only promotes sports but also social cohesion and the joy of movement. The goal is to give children new courage after life setbacks and to highlight the societal importance of physical activity.
course_highlights: Individually customizable self-made triathlon with swimming, cycling, and running
Guided bike rides and running groups for support
Swimming part at the Wiedenbrück outdoor pool
additional: Participants can assemble their triathlon individually, also as a team or relay. The kilometers collected are donated for a good cause. The event takes place in North Rhine-Westphalia, with the goal of hosting an event in every federal state in the future. Since 2014, the event has supported children's charity projects in Germany, with nearly 25,000 euros in donations so far. It promotes sporting activity for a good cause and is held annually in Pronsfeld.

name: Kreuzwertheimer Landschaftsläufe
description: The Kreuzwertheim landscape runs offer three varied races for different age groups on June 28, 2026. The 14 km long "Run into the Kingdom of Heaven" takes place through a landscape conservation area and vineyards with challenging inclines. The new 7 km run around Kaffelstein features gentle inclines and beautiful views of the Main Valley. For children and adolescents, there is a 2.2 km hilly forest run. The event is family-friendly, with team rankings, material prizes, and a floral surprise at the finish line.
course_highlights: 14 km loop through landscape conservation area and vineyards with approximately 300 meters of elevation
7 km run with gentle inclines and views of the Main Valley
2.2 km hilly forest run for children and adolescents
additional: Late registrations are only possible online from June 28, 2025, until one hour before the respective race, with a late registration fee of €4 (except for the children's run). Start and finish are at the Kreuzwertheim sports field, Philipp-Günzelmann-Weg. There is a team ranking for the 14 km run (2-person teams). A special prize is awarded to the club, company, or group with the most participants. Food and drinks are available on site. All participants receive certificates; children receive a "Golden" or "Silver" running shoe as an award. Results lists and certificates are available online. The event includes various race distances, including children's runs, with attractive routes through vineyards and nature reserves. There are team and age group rankings, on-site catering, and awards in the form of trophies and medals.

name: Losheimer Trailfest
location: Losheim am See, Saar-Hunsrück, Saarland, Germany
description: The Losheimer Trailfest on June 27 and 28, 2026 offers a diverse trail running experience in the premium hiking region Saar-Hunsrück-Hochwald. Participants can expect spectacular trails with bizarre rocks, winding streams, bogs, and romantic stream valleys. The ultra distances have been expanded: the T 60 has become the T 100 with 100 kilometers, and the T 45 has become the T 50 with 50 kilometers, both looping around the Saarschleife. There is a Youth Trail suitable for young runners, and with the T Ch Challenge, runners can experience various routes over two days. The event area at Losheimer Seegarten invites to relax and celebrate.
course_highlights: Spectacular trails around the Saarschleife
Bizarre rocks, bogs, and romantic stream valleys
Flowing paths with tough climbs and adventurous downhills
additional: Shuttle bus service on Saturday from 08:30 AM from Losheim to the start line in Mettlach for T 50 and T Ch. Mandatory equipment for T 100 includes a headlamp with spare batteries, personal cup, mobile phone with emergency number, rain gear, and a survival blanket. Catering at several stations with water, isotonic drinks, fruit, snacks, and regional specialties. Massage service in the afternoon for long-distance runners. Pasta party on Friday evening (€10) available upon registration. Dogs are allowed in the event area at Seegarten but not in the beach bath. KidsRun is a short loop on the event grounds. Trail running, hiking, kids' races, scenic trails, registration deadline, participant limits.

name: Ohndorfer Volkslauf
description: The Ohndorf Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event held annually in Ohndorf and is part of the Schaumburg Running Series. The event offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and performance levels. Online registration is possible until the day of the event, with on-site registration available until 30 minutes before the start. The race is increasingly popular and provides a great opportunity to engage in sports together and experience community spirit.
course_highlights: Various race distances for all ages and performance levels
Family and team-oriented event with competitions
Traditional, family-friendly race event in Ohndorf
additional: Online registration is open until 3 PM on the day of the event. On-site registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start time. The Kurparklauf is canceled in 2026, so there will be no Samtgemeindepokal ranking. Multiple race distances, team competition, family-friendly atmosphere, weather in June usually sunny.

name: Rems-Murr 24h Charity-Lauf
description: The 7th Rems-Murr 24h Charity Run will take place on June 27 and 28, 2026, at the Herbert-Winter-Stadium in Winnenden. The event invites all running enthusiasts, families, clubs, and teams to run laps for 24 hours — whether running, walking, or strolling. The run supports Clowns with Heart Rems-Murr e.V. as well as the Salbengehren tent camp at Ebnisee, with the proceeds benefiting these organizations. Participation is the main focus, not performance, and everyone can join with a sponsor or as a team.
course_highlights: 24-hour run at Herbert-Winter-Stadium Winnenden
Set in a beautiful environment with lots of forest and Ebnisee
Refreshments with water, fruit, and muesli bars, additional food and drinks available for purchase
additional: Participation as a solo runner or team is possible. Each participant finds a sponsor who donates per lap or with a fixed amount. Donation receipts will be issued. Tents can be set up in designated areas, and motorhomes are allowed in the parking lot. On-site catering available, self-supply possible. 24-hour charity run, registration online and on-site, on-site catering, support for local charitable projects.

name: run + fun in Tuttlingen
description: run&fun Tuttlingen is a versatile running event taking place on June 27 and 28, 2026, in Tuttlingen. The event offers a wide range of competitions, including the B. Braun Marathon, half marathon, relay races, Nordic walking, as well as children and youth runs. The courses are mostly flat along the Danube and through the city, providing a fast and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by several Tuttlingen clubs and the city, ensuring a family-friendly and sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat course with only 28 meters of elevation change
Route along the Danube and through Tuttlingen
Start and finish at the Tuttlingen festival grounds
additional: Online registration opens on November 15, 2025, and closes on June 9, 2026, at 24:00. Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start but without guarantee of a starting place. The marathon and half marathon courses are flat and run over two laps (marathon) or one lap (half marathon), starting and finishing at the Tuttlingen festival grounds. Medals are awarded to all participants, and prizes for places 1-3 in each age group. Luggage drop-off is available at the start. Self-catering is only permitted on marathon Sunday within a narrow time window. Participation with a baby jogger in the marathon is not allowed. Accompanying by bicycle or aids results in disqualification. The multi-day running event features various courses for all age groups, registration via the website, and is one of the summer highlights in Tuttlingen.

name: Schwalbacher Volkslauf - Sport gegen Armut
location: Schwalbach am Taunus, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Schwalbach Volkslauf is an inclusive charity run organized annually by the Turngemeinde 1887 e.V. Schwalbach. It offers various race distances for all age and performance groups, including 10 km, 6 km, 3 km open race, 1 km handicap race, and a children's run. The event stands for active inclusion and brings together people of different backgrounds and abilities in a friendly atmosphere. The run supports social projects and makes a statement against poverty.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 370 m to 10 km
Inclusive participation for people with and without disabilities
Friendly atmosphere with great commitment from helpers and volunteers
additional: The run includes different distances, including a handicap race and a children's run, to promote inclusion. The event is supported by Lebenshilfe Main-Taunus e.V., which is committed to people with disabilities in the Main-Taunus district. Multiple race distances, including a race for children and people with impairments, sponsorship by GLOBUS Eschborn, held in June in Schwalbach am Taunus.

name: Seester Sternenlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Handicaplauf für Menschen mit Behinderungen (auch Rollstuhlfahrer/innen): 8 EUR (Begleitperson frei)

description: The Seester Star Race takes place on June 28, 2026, for the tenth time and is a charity run in support of the Children's Hospice Sternenbrücke in Hamburg. The event offers various running routes for runners, walkers, Nordic walkers, and children, including a special 10 km loop through the historic Lindenallee at Gut Seestermühe. Food and drinks such as grilled sausages, coffee, and cake are provided, and there is a great atmosphere along the route with decorated streets. The organizing team looks forward to many participants and spectators at this joyful and successful event.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the historic Lindenallee at Gut Seestermühe
Race distances of 1 km (children), 3 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Start and finish at Seester Elementary School
additional: Start and finish at Seester Elementary School, Dorfstr. 43, 25370 Seester. Parking is only available in Schulsteig as a dead-end street. Late registrations are not possible; changes to the race distance until one day before the event are free of charge. Participation is at your own risk. Seester Star Race functional shirts, tank tops, and sports/canvas bags can be ordered for an additional fee. The race is a charity event focused on community and philanthropy, featuring various routes for runners and walkers as well as a children's race. Participation is open to all and supports the important work of the Children's Hospice.

name: Steps for Life
description: Steps for Life is a charity run organized by SV Würtingen for the 20th time to support a aid project. In the anniversary year 2026, kilometers will be collected to build a children's house in the remote mountain region around Musikot (Nepal). The event offers race distances of 4, 8, and 15 kilometers in the beautiful surroundings of the Swabian Alb. The race times are recorded with a professional timing system, and there is also a Kids Race as well as a Bambini run on race day. Participants can choose between the virtual race period from June 19 to June 27 and race day on June 28.
course_highlights: Race distances of 4, 8, and 15 kilometers on the Swabian Alb
Professional timing system with tracking boxes at start, intermediate, and finish points
Kids Race approximately 2 km and Bambini run approximately 800 m on race day
additional: Virtual race period from 19.06. to 27.06.2026 daily from 5 am to 10 pm with multiple starts possible. On race day 28.06.2026 registration is open from 8:00 to 9:00 am, no late registrations thereafter. Musical accompaniment on race day. Awards for age group winners, individual runners with the most kilometers, and the team with the most kilometers. Distances of 4 km, 8 km, and 15 km; sponsorship per kilometer; support of a aid project in Nepal; scenic route on the Swabian Alb.

name: Tippkötter Sommerlauf in Rheine
location: Bentlager Wald, Rheine, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Tippkötter Summer Run in Rheine will take place on June 28, 2026, in the Bentlager Forest and offers nature-oriented running routes with views of the saline and Bentlage Monastery. The finish line is spectacularly located in the stadium of FC Eintracht Rheine, where all runners cross the finish line on the penalty spot. The event is enhanced by music, professional commentary, and surprises, making it a special running experience for participants of all ages. In addition to the main race, there is also a primary school run, making the event a family-friendly sports festival.
course_highlights: Nature-oriented routes through the Bentlager Forest
Course passing the saline and Bentlage Monastery
Finish in the stadium of FC Eintracht Rheine on the penalty spot
additional: Electronic timing with transponder start number. Race documents available in the VIP room of FC Eintracht Rheine. Use of headphones is prohibited and may lead to disqualification. Participants in the Bambini run receive a participation medal. Trophies for overall winners of the 2 km, 5 km, 5 km walking, and 10 km runs. Age group awards with medals only for the 2 km run. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. Adequate changing rooms and showers available. On-site catering with drinks, fries, sausages, steaks, and waffles. Parking available at Rheine Zoo. The 5 km and 10 km routes are officially measured and suitable for best lists. The event will take place in June 2026, featuring various race distances, electronic timing, on-site catering, parking at Rheine Zoo, and no parking directly at the event area.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event set in one of southern Germany's most beautiful landscapes, featuring gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns, and an exhilarating atmosphere along the course. The route offers a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal with varied sections passing through Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar. The flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim invites a strong final sprint. The marathon is open to adult runners aged 18 and over and is part of a diverse running program in Bottwartal.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns such as Steinheim, Beilstein, and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Monthly free training runs in various pace groups on the last Sunday of each month in Steinheim. Weekly summer holiday runs during the summer break every Tuesday evening at 7:00 PM. Year-end run at the end of the year with a 10 km race and afterwards punch & mulled wine. Registration for all runs is via the partner Datasport. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible until shortly before the race. The event takes place at the Riedstadion in Steinheim an der Murr and is a popular opportunity for runners to prepare for the marathon. It is recommended to check the details with the organizer before registering.

name: Uni-Lauf Bamberg
description: The Bamberg University Run is an open community race and will take place for the 12th time in 2026. It includes various race distances, including a 10 km main race, which is also held as the Bavarian University Championship and Upper Franconian Championship, a 10 km relay race, a 2 km students' run, and a 500-meter children's run. The flat, officially measured course leads through ERBA Park, along the Main-Danube Canal, through the Hain forest, and the city center of Bamberg, offering scenic views of historic buildings. The event provides a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to runners of all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Flat loop course with start and finish in the courtyard of the university building
Course runs along the Main-Danube Canal, through the Hain, and the city center with views of the Old Town Hall and Michaelsberg Monastery
Relay handover at Buger Spitze at km 5.5
additional: Start times: 500 m children's run at 9:15 a.m., 2 km students' run at 9:30 a.m., 10 km main race at 10:00 a.m. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 8:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. on-site (cash only). In the finish area, there will be water, energy drinks, fruit, and baked goods. Two refreshment stations on the 10 km route (around km 5 and km 7). Starting positions are assigned in blocks based on expected finish time (under 40 min, 40-50 min, 50-60 min, over 60 min). Team rankings and special awards for the fastest Bamberg students and Bavarian University Championship. Participation is open to all performance levels; registration exclusively online; parking available at the underground garage on the premises; public transport connection via bus No. 906, stop Spinnerei.

name: Weiner Family Run 2026
description: The Wiener Family Run 2026 is a family-friendly running event organized by the running club of FC Schwarz-Weiß Weiner on June 28, 2026. It is aimed at runners, walkers, children, and toddlers, offering various distances from approximately 500 meters up to 10 kilometers. The focus is on the joy of movement and shared experience in a relaxed atmosphere. The start and finish area is located in the Sparkassenpark Weiner, and the routes lead through the Weiner farming community. Additionally, participants can enjoy a family-friendly program with moderation and catering.

name: Zwiefalter Berglauf
description: The 20th Zwiefalter Mountain Run will take place on June 28, 2026, in Zwiefalten and offers a varied program for runners of all performance levels. The event includes several races, including the Great Mountain Run over 9.8 km, the Sparkassen Run over 6 km, a Genusslauf (Nordic Walking) also over 6 km, as well as children's races. The course leads through an idyllic landscape with partly protected areas and provides a great opportunity to engage in sports together and have fun. The event is aimed at young and old and promotes movement within the community.

Sparkassen Run and Genusslauf (Nordic Walking) over 6 km
Idyllic landscape with sections through protected areas

Raffle of race bibs with prizes for all participants. Kilometer collection activity with recognition of the largest collectors during the award ceremony. The event promotes movement for all age groups and performance levels. Courses: 9.8 km mountain run, 6 km run, children's and Nordic Walking races; online registration; start at Zwiefalten sports grounds; award ceremony from approximately 12:45 PM.

name: Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell

The races pass through diverse landscapes with refreshment stations along the course and provide a family-friendly atmosphere with medical support from the Red Cross. After the race, showers are available, and Nordic walking is also possible without timing.

The route takes you through a scenic landscape around Großostheim and combines athletic challenge with nature experience and a family-friendly atmosphere. The race is a fixed part of the regional sports calendar and invites both hobby and competitive runners alike.

Participants are responsible for their own provisions, as there are no refreshment points, and they record their time manually, submitting a photo of the clock as proof via email. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with a participant limit of 18 persons, and only takes place if at least five participants register.

The event attracts around 800 participants annually and concludes with an award ceremony on the fruit market stage as part of the Saarburg Market Days. There are various distances for different runners, from the toddler run to the main 10 km race.

description: The Marburg Night Marathon takes place on July 3, 2026, for the 27th time and is the largest running event in the Middle Hessen region. The event offers a classic marathon, a half marathon, and a relay marathon with up to four participants. The course runs through the picturesque old town of Marburg, along the Lahn River, and features a flat, record-eligible loop with views of the Landgrave Castle and the Elisabeth Church. The start is atmospherically at 7 PM on the historic marketplace, and the finish is at the university stadium. All participants receive a high-quality medal depicting a notable Marburg building each year.

There are courses for 10 km, 5 km, and children's races. Various distances (0.25 km to 10 km), family and hobby runs, sports festival with music and catering, part of the Three Rivers Cup.

name: Eicherscheider Heckenlauf mit Halbmarathon 2026
description: The 46th Eicherscheider Hedge Run with Half Marathon will take place on July 4, 2026, in Simmerath-Eicherscheid in the Eifel. The races lead through the hilly beech hedge landscape around the federal gold village Eicherscheid on the edge of the Eifel National Park. Competitions are offered over 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon (21.0975 km), each run on a hilly loop course. Children's and youth competitions are also part of the event. The start times are staggered in the afternoon and evening, allowing for a relaxed participation.
course_highlights: Hilly loop courses through the beech hedge landscape
Run through the federal gold village Eicherscheid on the edge of the Eifel National Park
Family-friendly event with children and youth competitions
additional: The competitions start in a staggered manner: 5 km at 15:45, 10 km at 16:35, and the half marathon at 18:00. The finish line is the same for all competitions. For precise location details, RUNME Premium is required. There are also competitions for children and adolescents; further information can be found in the official announcement of the organizer. The event is family-friendly, with start times varying depending on the distance. Registration is via the official website.

name: Fichtelgebirgsmarathon mit Halbmarathon und 10km-Lauf
description: The Fichtelgebirgsmarathon on July 4, 2026, is the largest running event in the Fichtel Mountains with three different courses for young and old. The races feature challenging elevation gains and beautiful landscapes, guaranteeing participants a unique natural experience. The event has been organized for over 20 years by sports enthusiasts who are members of the IfL-Fichtelgebirge, ensuring perfect organization. Online registration is available until July 2, 2026.
course_highlights: Marathon with 42 km and 800 meters of elevation
Half marathon with 21 km and 400 meters of elevation
10 km run with 225 meters of elevation and finish line in the Kurpark Bad Alexandersbad
additional: The event is organized by volunteer club members. There are three routes with different elevation profiles and lengths. The finish line for all routes is in the Kurpark Bad Alexandersbad. Detailed route data is available on Komoot. The event is known for its challenging course with elevation gains and the beautiful nature of the Fichtel Mountains. Online registration is possible until July 2, 2026.

name: Gocher Steintorlauf
description: The 30th Goch Steintorlauf will take place on July 4, 2026, as part of the Goch Football Summer. Organized by SV Viktoria Goch, Department of Athletics/Running Group, over 800 runners of various age groups are expected in the city center of Goch. The event offers races ranging from a children's run to a 2,000m hobby group and corporate run, up to a general public course around the Steintor. The event provides suitable distances for both competitive athletes and hobby runners in an open and healthy outdoor atmosphere.
course_highlights: Runs around the historic Steintor in the city center of Goch
A variety of distances from children's run to general public course
Integration into the Goch Football Summer with over 800 participants
additional: Registration is via TAF-Timing. The event is conceived as an open-air event within the framework of the Goch Summer. Races are offered for different age groups and performance levels, including children's run, 2,000m hobby group and corporate run, as well as general public courses. The event takes place all day from 08:00 to 17:00. Running event with various distances, registration via TAF-Timing, registration deadline is June 17, 2026.

name: Hochstraßenlauf
description: The Hochstraßenlauf in Weisendorf is a traditional running event taking place on July 4, 2026, for the 40th time. Start and finish are at the Heimatverein Weisendorf Museum. Due to the high temperatures of recent years, the start time has been moved to the morning to provide better conditions for runners. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with scoring for the Weisendorf City Championship.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heimatmuseum Weisendorf
Run through the surroundings of Weisendorf with scenic routes
Various age groups and scoring for Weisendorf City Championship

Scoring for the Weisendorf City Championship is available when providing postal code 91085 and registering accordingly. The event takes place in the morning to avoid the heat and offers a wide range of running and walking options. Registration is possible until July 2, 2026.

name: Honiglauf des TuS Horn
description: The traditional Honey Run of TuS Horn offers running and walking routes for all age groups around Horn. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, where winners are rewarded with a glass of the coveted Horn honey. Various distances from children’s to 10 km runs enable participation for children, teenagers, and adults. The event takes place at the Horn community center and offers not only sporting ambition but also fun and community.

Distances from 150 m to 10 km for all age groups
Winners rewarded with Horn honey

The top finishers receive trophies or medals and a glass of honey, all participants receive certificates and material prizes. Honey is raffled among the present walkers. Route through paved paths and well-maintained forest trails in Hardtwald
Finish on the blue tartan track of the athletics stadium

The participant limit is 1200. 10 km flat, measured course through Hardtwald and campus, registration via RaceResult, start and finish at KIT Campus South, late registration possible, start on July 4, 2026.

Fun run and main race with inclines
Start and finish at the sports field in Bengel

Changing and shower facilities are available in the Bengel gymnasium next to the sports field. Parking is available in front of the gymnasium. Various race categories including walking, children’s and youth runs; registration online or on-site; event takes place around Bengel and Springiersbach.

Participation of children and adults
Organization and sponsorship by the Friends of Eduard Spranger School

The run takes place on July 4, 2026, and regularly attracts many participants from the region. Results are published online.

description: The Nördlingen City Run takes place on July 4, 2026, and offers races for children, students, adults, and walkers. name: Wangener Altstadtlauf
description: The Wangener Old Town Run has been a fixture on the event calendar in Wangen im Allgäu for over 25 years. The races take place in the historic old town with narrow alleys, cobblestones, and the large marketplace, creating a special atmosphere. In addition to the main race, there are children's and school runs as well as the "Wangener Stolperer," where participants can run as many laps as possible within 30 minutes. The event is aimed at both competitive runners and hobby athletes and promotes a communal sporting experience in the city center.

Cobblestones as a special surface
Large marketplace as a distinctive section of the course
additional: The "Wangener Stolperer" is a 30-minute run where each participant decides how many laps they can complete within the given time. There are also children's and school runs alongside the main race. The event is open to all age and performance levels. It includes races for children, students, and hobby runners, with distances ranging from 0.46 km to 5.19 km. The 'Wangener Stolperer' is a special highlight, allowing participants to run as many laps as possible in 30 minutes. The event fosters community spirit and sporting enthusiasm in the historic old town.

name: Eßlinger Zeitung Lauf

In addition to the main race, there are also children’s and students’ runs. The EZ Run is a member of the German Road Races.

In addition to the run, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, warm-up activities, and free post-race refreshments. The corporate run is part of the BW-Running series and emphasizes inclusion and shared experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km route at the Dr.-Heinrich-Zeller-Stadium and surroundings
Group warm-up session shortly before the start
Free post-race refreshments with alcohol-free Erdinger, fruit, vegetables, and water
additional: From 5:00 PM, a DJ will provide music to get everyone in the mood. After the run, there will be an award ceremony on stage and the opportunity to relax and socialize with the team. Registrations are free until the registration deadline, after which a fee applies. The minimum age for participation is 16 years. Race on July 8, 2026, team event, training tips, post-race refreshments, meeting points.

name: City-Sport-Abendlauf
description: The City Sports Evening Run in Rostock is a popular summer race held annually in the Barnstorfer Forest. Hundreds of runners gather for an evening run that combines the joy of running with a good cause. The proceeds from the race are donated to charitable organizations, most recently to the Rostock Hospice at Klinikum Südstadt. The race has established itself as a fixed date in the Rostock running scene and is enjoying increasing participant numbers.
course_highlights: Evening run through the Barnstorfer Forest
Summer race date with a pleasant atmosphere
Supporting charitable organizations through donations
additional: Online registration is not possible. Registration is via a PDF form that must be printed, filled out, and submitted in person at the store. The race proceeds are donated to charitable organizations. The donation account has changed; details are available at the store. The race takes place on a 2.5 km loop course, with no timing, includes an event shirt, refreshments, a bouncy castle, a raffle, and registration is open until July 22 at the City Sports specialty store.

name: Freisinger Sparkassenlauf
description: The Freising Sparkassen Run is a popular summer race in the Isar meadows around the SC Freising stadium. It offers courses for children, teenagers, as well as main races over 5.5 km and 10 km, mostly on gravel and forest paths along the Isar. The event is open to all sports enthusiasts and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere with individual and team competitions. Catering is provided on site, and there is a raffle with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at SC Freising stadium with a loop through the Isar meadows
5.5 km race with 2 laps, 10 km race with 4 laps
Mostly gravel and forest paths, short asphalt sections
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on the day of the event from 4:00 PM at SC Freising stadium. Late registrations on site are not possible. There are individual and team classifications (teams of 4 runners with a common team name). Each participant receives a certificate available for download. Showers, changing rooms, and toilets are available. Catering includes an espresso bar, cake, and grill offerings. Raffle with attractive prizes, including a box of Prosecco for the best women's team. QR code for race bib pickup will be sent via email. Courses on asphalt, gravel, and forest paths; online registration until July 7, 2026; race bib pickup from 4:00 PM on the event day; races for children and youth are free of charge.

name: VRun Dachau 12. Dachauer VR Firmen- und Schülerlauf
description: The VRun Dachau is the popular running event for sporty corporate teams and students in the Dachau region. Organized for the twelfth time by Volksbank Raiffeisenbank Dachau eG in collaboration with ASV Dachau, this event emphasizes team spirit and community. The races include a student run over 2.8 km and a corporate and authorities run over 5.6 km. In addition to the sporting experience, there are attractive prizes and a raffle for all finishers.
course_highlights: Student run over 2.8 km
Corporate and authorities run over 5.6 km
Community running experience for teams from companies and schools
additional: Number pickup from 16:00 to 18:45; student run starts at 17:00, corporate and authorities run at 19:00; award ceremony around 20:00; each finisher receives a gift; prizes and certificates for the top three in each category; raffle of prizes for all present finishers after the races; late registrations on the event day are not possible. Race distances: 2.8 km for students, 5.6 km for companies/authorities; registration until June 30, 2026; team and community aspect emphasized.

name: run4healthineers
description: Run4Healthineers is a community running event that brings employees together on-site in Erlangen as well as virtually across Germany. The event offers various running distances, including three main routes, a kids' run for children, and for the first time, an inclusive running group. With over 2,000 participants and approximately 17,400 kilometers run, the focus is on fun, movement, and commitment to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health within Siemens Healthineers staff.
course_highlights: Three different running distances on-site in Erlangen
Kids' run for children
Inclusive running group for the first time
additional: The event takes place both on-site in Erlangen and virtually across Germany. Participation benefits a good cause. In 2025, over 2,000 participants took part, with a total of around 17,400 kilometers run. The event features an inclusive running group and is focused on charity, health, and community. Further details for 2026 have not yet been published.

name: 4. Dorstener 24-Stunden-Lauf
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr beträgt pro Person 12,00 Euro

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Läuferinnen und Läufer unter 16 Jahren können für 6,00 Euro starten

description: The Dorstener 24-Hour Run is a non-profit charity run held in Dorsten near the city center at Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof. The course is approximately 1 km long and runs through a scenic park area between the Lippe River and the Wesel-Datteln Canal. Participants can run, walk, or stroll within 24 hours, at their own discretion, and complete any number of laps. The entry fee goes 100% into the donation pot, which supports various social organizations. The race is open to all age groups and performance levels, from short laps to half marathons or marathons.
course_highlights: Loop course of about 1 km in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof
Scenic route between the Lippe River and Wesel-Datteln Canal
Central location near Dorsten city center
additional: The event is a charity run where all entry fees go 100% into the donation pot. There is no requirement to run for 24 hours straight; each participant can decide how many laps to run, walk, or stroll. The event is organized by interevent GmbH and supported by numerous local sponsors. Functional shirts can be ordered for 27.00 EUR. Start and finish are at Bürgerpark, with online and on-site registration. Parking is available on Kurt-Schumacher-Straße and in the VHS parking garage. Performances from 50 km are recorded in the leaderboards.

name: BarockLauf Ludwigsburg
description: The BaroqueRun Ludwigsburg is a delightful race through the Blooming Baroque with start on the baroque marketplace in the heart of Ludwigsburg. The event offers various distances for runners of all ages, including 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km handicap and children’s runs, as well as a 500 m children’s race. Registration is exclusively online, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful course through the baroque park landscape.
course_highlights: Start on the baroque marketplace in the heart of Ludwigsburg
Enjoyable run through the Blooming Baroque
Various distances for all age groups
additional: Registration deadline for individual and group entries is June 30. Late registrations are possible online until 30 minutes before the start, but at additional participation fees. An transfer of registration to another person is possible until June 30 for a fee, afterwards only on-site. There is no entitlement to a refund of the starting fee. The bib number is personal and may not be transferred for safety and insurance reasons. The event also includes children’s and youth runs as well as walks, with a family-friendly atmosphere and a focus on community and charity.

name: Borener Meile
description: The Borener Mile is a traditional road race over 1609.34 meters, taking place on July 10, 2026, for the 35th time as part of the Borener Dorftage in Boren. The race is organized by Borener SV, an active sports club on the Schlei, particularly engaged in running and triathlon. The event offers runners a short, fast course and is a popular competition in the region. Results and photos of past races are available on the website.
course_highlights: Road race exactly 1609.34 meters (one mile)
Traditional event as part of the Borener Dorftage
Organized by the regional sports club Borener SV
additional: Road race, registration available, results and photos of previous events available

name: Roruper Abendlauf
description: The Roruper Evening Run is a traditional running event in Rorup, a district of Dülmen in North Rhine-Westphalia, which has been attracting runners every summer for over three decades. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon as the main discipline, as well as 10 km, 3 km, school run, and Pampers run for children. The course is flat and paved, with a ten-kilometer loop that is run once or twice depending on the distance. The finish line is located in the stadium of SV Brukteria Rorup, where runners complete a lap around the stadium before crossing the finish line. In addition to certificates and trophies, there are also cash prizes for the best female and male runners in the half marathon and 10 km run.
course_highlights: Flat, paved course
Ten-kilometer loop with a longer first lap for the half marathon
Finish with stadium lap at SV Brukteria Rorup stadium
additional: All competitions start at the sports field in Rorup. Certificates are awarded to all finishers, trophies for the winners, and honorary prizes for the top three runners in each age group. The half marathon and 10 km run are associated with cash prizes for the top three male and female participants. Courses are officially measured; online registration available until 30 minutes before start; parking available; course refreshments; finish in the stadium of SV Brukteria Rorup.

name: Saarland Mittelpunktlauf
description: The Saarland Center Run in Eppelborn is a traditional running event taking place on July 10, 2026. Organized by SV Habach e.V., the race offers a sporting challenge in the Saarland region. The event is aimed at runners of various performance levels and promotes regional running sports. The course leads through the scenic surroundings of Eppelborn and provides a varied running experience.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Eppelborn
Traditional running event in Saarland
Organized by SV Habach e.V.
additional: Registration deadline is July 8, 2026; the event is a stadium-remote race in Eppelborn.

name: Schwaigfeldlauf
description: The Schwaigfeld Run is a popular race in Olching organized by the Citizens' Association Schwaigfeld e.V. It offers a sporting challenge in a friendly neighborhood atmosphere and has established itself as a regular event. The course runs through the Schwaigfeld and features a new route premiere, suitable for both experienced runners and running enthusiasts. The race combines sport, fun, and community and is supported by numerous sponsors.
course_highlights: New route premiere in Schwaigfeld
Run through the neighborhood of Olching
Event with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The Schwaigfeld Run is organized by the Citizens' Association Schwaigfeld e.V. and takes place annually. The event is supported by local sponsors. Impressions and results of past races are available on the website. There are no explicit details about start times, waves, or late registration fees on the pages. Various race distances for children, teenagers, and adults. Registration until July 8, 2026. On-site registration possible against a fee.

name: 27. Gläserner Mönch Lauf
description: The Glass Monk Run is a traditional trail race in the Pre-Harz region, returning after a seven-year hiatus. The course is known for its undulating profile with over 100 meters of elevation per lap and the legendary ascent over 222 steps to the "Glass Monk." Participants can choose from various distances, from the Bambini race to the 18 km extreme run, and experience pure nature between rocks and forest. The event combines athletic challenge with local pride and takes place around the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt.
course_highlights: 222 steps to the "Glass Monk"
Undulating profile with over 100 meters of elevation per lap
Pure nature between rocks, forest, and cobblestones
additional: Start and finish at Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt OT Langenstein. Electronic timing with transponder (deposit 5 €). Late registrants do not receive a full starter package. Award ceremony from approximately 12:15 PM, children's races immediately afterwards. Minimum age and participation conditions must be observed. Limited starting places, various race distances, natural trail with elevation meters.

name: 6. O-SEE Backyard Ultra
description: The O-SEE Backyard Ultra is a unique elimination race around Lake Olbersdorfer near Zittau. The race in the Backyard Ultra format challenges endurance, mental strength, and community spirit, as all runners complete a full lap of 6.7 km together every hour until only one runner remains. The winner qualifies directly for the German Championship and has the chance to participate in the World Championship in Tennessee. The race is limited to 200 participants and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with genuine team spirit.
course_highlights: Loop course of 6.7056 km around Lake Olbersdorfer
Course profile with 40 meters of elevation on perfect hiking trails
Nightly marked route with start and finish at Westparkstadion Zittau/Pethau
additional: The race is a Silver Ticket Race, limited to 200 runners. Each lap must be completed within 60 minutes, with the next lap starting on the hour. The winner is the last runner to finish a lap within the time limit. There is a DUV license, and results are published on Facebook and the website. For children, there is the "Backyard for Kids" race with 5 laps of 1000 meters each, starting at 12:00 PM on July 12, 2026. Limited to 200 participants, start and finish at Westparkstadion Zittau/Pethau, minimal elevation change, 24-hour endurance format, also suitable for team competitions.

name: Aichacher Stadtlauf
description: The Aichach City Run is a traditional running event organized by LC Aichach for over 40 years. The event offers races for various age groups and skill levels, including school and youth runs as well as competitions through the historic old town of Aichach. The races take place in the Wittelsbacher Land and are characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and good organization. Training opportunities for preparation are offered at the Landkreisstadion.
course_highlights: Runs through the historic old town of Aichach
Various distances for children, youth, and adults
Training opportunities at Josef-Bestler-Stadion
additional: Preparatory training evenings at Landkreisstadion on 03.06.2026 and 17.06.2026 from 6:30 PM. Children's training on Friday in the Vierfachturnhalle. Registration for championships is via Mathias Bronner (mbronner@gmx.net). The event also includes training sessions in June 2026 and other local running events. Registration and detailed information should be inquired with the organizer.

name: Alb-Run Heroldstatt
location: Sportzentrum Heroldstatt, Bannholz 10, Heroldstatt, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
organizer: SC Heroldstatt e.V. in Kooperation mit SUN Sportmanagement GmbH

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr beträgt für beide Strecken 36,00 EUR.

description: The Sparkassen Alb-Run in Heroldstatt is a running event for endurance athletes taking place on July 11, 2026. The varied course leads through the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve Swabian Alb with beautiful landscapes, small trails, and a reasonable amount of elevation gain. There are two attractive distances to choose from: 9 km and 16 km. The event offers professional timing, on-course refreshments, finish line refreshments, baggage storage, showers, and a supporting program for a comprehensive running experience.
course_highlights: Run through the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve Swabian Alb
Varied course with small trails and approximately 350 meters of elevation gain
Two distances: 9 km (orange markers) and 16 km (blue markers)
additional: Start and distribution of race packets at the Heroldstatt Sports Center. Race packets can be picked up on July 10, 2026, from 18:00 to 20:00 and on July 11, 2026, from 11:00 to 12:30. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible on-site on July 11, 2026, from 11:00 to 12:30, subject to availability. Timing is done with ankle transponders, which must be returned before leaving the finish area. The course is marked with white-red streamers and colored arrows. Baggage storage is available in the finish area. Showers and charging stations are available. Fans are welcome as pedestrians and cyclists on the course. Trail race with scenic highlights, small trails, and elevation gain; start on July 11, 2026, at 13:00 at the Heroldstatt Sports Center, Bannholz 10.

name: Bad Buchauer Stadtlauf mit Federseehalbmarathon
description: The 25th Bad Buchau City Run with Federsee Half Marathon will take place on July 11, 2026, offering runners a varied experience. The half marathon route leads through the historic city center of Bad Buchau, the spa park, and the largest nature reserve in southwest Germany around Lake Federsee. The course is mostly flat with an elevation difference of approximately 35 meters and runs partly on asphalt, partly on gravel paths, as well as about 1 km of wooden walkway through a pristine primeval forest. Along the route, several refreshment stations with water, isotonic drinks, and fruit are set up.
course_highlights: Half marathon route around Lake Federsee in the largest nature reserve in southwest Germany
Start and finish in the historic city center of Bad Buchau with two small laps through the city and spa park
Approximately 1 km long wooden walkway through pristine primeval forest
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day until 30 minutes before the respective start. Late registration fee: €5 for half marathon and 10 km run, €3 for 5 km run. Race documents can be picked up from 07:00 at the race office in the foyer of the Bad Buchau spa center. Along the route, there are 8 refreshment stations with water; at Seekirch (km 12) and at the finish, additional isotonic drinks and fruit are offered. Parking and footpath maps to shower facilities are available. Course maps, online registration, late registration on race day, parking, refreshment stations, scenic wooden walkway.

name: Bahnstadtlauf 2026
price_range: 11€ für Erwachsene, 5€ für Kinder und Jugendliche unter 16 Jahren

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Kinder und Jugendliche unter 16 Jahren

description: The Bahnstadtlauf in Heidelberg is a family-friendly race with various distances for children, adolescents, and adults. The event takes place as part of the Bahnstadt Festival and offers exciting races as well as live music and catering. The courses run through the Bahnstadt, with short-term changes possible due to construction work. The races include children's runs, school runs, as well as 5 km and 10 km races with age group classifications.
course_highlights: Course through the Bahnstadt Heidelberg
Children's and school runs with age-appropriate distances (1.1 km and 2.2 km)
5 km and 10 km races with age group classification and award ceremony
additional: Registration and bib distribution are possible from 16:00 to 17:30. Late registrations are accepted until 45 minutes before the respective start with a late registration fee of €4, provided there are still starting places available. Award ceremonies take place after each race. During the Bahnstadt Festival, there will be live bands and catering on site. Course changes possible due to construction work, timing with Race Result, multiple race categories, start times from 17:30.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: The SCB Langendamm invites you to the 4th Bergheide-Cross 2026. The course runs from the access road of the shooting range of the local small-bore rifle club through the recreational and landscape protection area "Osterberg". The race offers three distances for different evaluation and age groups, as well as walking on the shorter route. Additionally, there is a student race over 1000 meters for children and adolescents. The event is approved by the DLV and takes place on July 11, 2026, starting at 4:00 PM.
course_highlights: Course through the landscape protection area "Osterberg"
Start at the access road of the shooting range of the local small-bore rifle club
Three distances: 10.4 km, 5.2 km, and 1000 m student race
additional: The 1000-meter student race is for children and adolescents aged 6 to 14, and registration is only on-site and free of charge. The 5.2 km race is open from age 14, and the 10.4 km route from age 16. The main race starts at 5:00 PM, and the student race begins at 4:00 PM. Walking is offered on the shorter route. Free registration for the student race on-site, race in the Osterberg nature area, family-friendly event.

name: Crosslauf Fichtenau
price_range: 13 Euro für den Crosslauf, 10 Euro für den Jedermannslauf, 3 Euro Nachmeldegebühr
description: The cross-country race in Fichtenau is a traditional running event taking place on July 11, 2026, as part of the Festival at the Lake. The event offers two varied courses through the beautiful community of Fichtenau: a fun run over 5.2 km for everyone who enjoys movement, and a challenging cross-country race over 10 km for sporting challenges. The races are held in the so-called "Magic Triangle" of Crailsheim/Dinkelsbühl/Ellwangen and attract runners of all ages. The organizing team looks forward to numerous participants and offers convenient registration with SEPA direct debit.
course_highlights: Two varied running courses through the community of Fichtenau
Fun run over 5.2 km ideal for recreational athletes
Cross-country race over 10 km as a sporting challenge
additional: Registration closes 30 minutes before the start. Late registrations on the event day incur an additional fee of 3 euros. The entry fees can be conveniently paid via SEPA direct debit. Race distances: 5.2 km and 10 km, registration until July 8, 2026, start at the Festival at the Lake, sporting challenge, online registration possible

name: Dietfurter 7-Täler-Lauf
location: Sportplatz der 7-Täler-Halle, Dietfurt an der Altmühl, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 33rd 7-Täler-Lauf in Dietfurt an der Altmühl will take place on July 11, 2026, and is a traditional race that counts as a scoring event for the BLSV-Läufercup 2026. For the first time, there is an option to participate in the walking category. Also new is the Team-Fun Run, where teams of at least three people compete for prizes for the fastest team, the coolest outfit, and the lucky loser. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with race number distribution, changing rooms, and showers in the 7-Täler-Halle, as well as medals for children and awards for the best in each age group.
course_highlights: Run through seven valleys in the scenic surroundings of Dietfurt
First-time availability of walking category
Team-Fun Run with special prizes for teams
additional: Late registrations are possible on July 11, 2026, from 15:30 until one hour before the start at the 7-Täler-Halle, with a late registration fee of 5€. Race number distribution, changing rooms, and showers are located in the 7-Täler-Halle. Children receive a medal immediately after crossing the finish line. Team scoring is only possible with group registration. The race takes place on July 11, 2026, at 16:00, at the sports field of the 7-Täler-Halle. No information on prices or registration is provided.

name: LAUF10
description: LAUF10! is a training project of the Bavarian Athletics Association designed to get couch potatoes fit for a 10-kilometer run in ten weeks. The program is aimed at everyone who wants to run from zero to ten kilometers and has already inspired many thousands of participants. In addition to running, there is an official fan shirt that can be ordered. LAUF10! promotes the joy of running and fitness within a supportive community.
course_highlights: 10 kilometer running course
Training program over ten weeks
Official functional shirt as a fan item
additional: The official LAUF10! shirt (functional shirt by ERIMA) can be ordered for 24.90 euros plus shipping. Shipping will begin no earlier than the end of March. LAUF10! is a project of the Bavarian Athletics Association with extensive partner associations and training offers. Training starts on 27.04.2026, final run on 11.07.2026 in Wolnzach, specifically designed for beginners.

name: Sauerborner Laufabend
description: The Sauerborner Laufabend is an established running event in Bad Soden-Neuenhain, taking place on July 11, 2026. The races start and end at the Sauerborn sports field and lead over a profiled course with asphalted field and paved forest paths. Two distances are offered, 5 km and 10 km, open to different age groups. The event is family-friendly and offers changing rooms and shower facilities in the nearby sports hall.
course_highlights: Profiled course over asphalted field and paved forest paths
Start and finish at Sauerborn sports field
Elevation profile of the course available
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start without a late registration fee. Race documents can be collected from 4 p.m. at the sports field. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall at Sauerborn. Limited parking spaces at the sports field. Animals, scooters, inline skates, skateboards, bicycles, and Nordic walking poles are not allowed on the course. Participation is at your own risk. The course runs over asphalted field and forest paths; registration until July 9, 2025; limited parking; changing rooms and showers available; observe safety rules.

name: Sidonia-Escape-Lauf
description: The Escape Walk "Sidonia 1639" is an exciting outdoor team event in Kelberg, ideal for friends, families, and birthday celebrations. Over a course of approximately 4 km in the nearby forest, participants are tasked with supporting Sidonia in the year 1639 during the turmoil of the Thirty Years' War by solving mysterious clues. The game lasts between 2.5 and 3 hours and is suitable for participants aged 9 to 99. Participants solve challenging tasks at seven puzzle locations and experience a fascinating story full of secrets and adventures. The start and finish are at the family swimming pool in Kelberg, and the necessary game backpacks are issued at the town hall.
course_highlights: Approximately 4 km long adventure trail in the forest
7 puzzle locations with mystical clues
Start and finish at the family swimming pool Kelberg
additional: The game can be booked for 2 to 8 people per team. There are 5 puzzle backpacks available, which are handed out at different times to maintain the mystical atmosphere. The event takes place from March to October in good weather and requires sturdy footwear and appropriate outdoor clothing. Tips and solutions are included in the backpack. The game is played at your own risk. Free parking is available at the town hall and swimming pool. The Escape Walk event is seasonal, running from March to October, weather-dependent, and requires sturdy footwear. The running event will take place in July 2026; details about distances and registration are available on the race registration page.

name: Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf
price_range: Spende zugunsten der Kinder- und Jugendarbeit des SCO
description: The Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf is a traditional race in Oberreichenbach scheduled for July 11, 2026. The course runs through scenic landscapes with ponds, forests, and historic paths, offering a varied and natural running experience. There are different competitions for participants of all ages, including the main race, youth and children’s runs, as well as Nordic walking. The event provides not only a sporting challenge but also Franconian specialties and a family-friendly atmosphere with award ceremonies and on-site medical services.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports home Oberreichenbach
The race course passes the community pond and the picturesque village of Tanzenhaid
Sections with forest paths, historic trade routes, and several ponds
additional: Pre-registrations until June 13 receive a free T-shirt. Entry fees are debited via direct debit, with refunds available up to two weeks before the event. Late registrations are to be paid in cash with an additional fee. Catering includes Franconian specialties and a salad buffet at the sports home. Medical services are provided by BRK. Results lists and certificates are available online. Award ceremonies take place after each race. The 10 km main race can be registered for online with direct debit; a T-shirt is included if registered by June 13. Refreshments include water. The event features a night run with effects, creative relay and costume competitions.

name: Taubertaltrail
description: The Taubertal Trail is a spectacular trail running event that takes participants through the breathtaking landscapes of the three valleys in the Taubertal. The event invites runners of all performance levels to test their limits and experience nature on challenging courses. Organized by SC Adelshofen e. V., the Taubertal Trail offers a unique combination of sporting challenge and scenic beauty.
course_highlights: Run through three picturesque valleys in the Taubertal
Marked trails with varied terrain
Stunning natural and landscape views
additional: Mandatory equipment from 11 km: at least 0.5 liters of liquid, own cup or flask, mobile phone with emergency numbers, ID and health insurance card, weather-appropriate clothing and suitable footwear. Wear race bib visibly at the front. Trail markings may be missing due to weather conditions; a GPX file is recommended. Waste disposal only allowed in refreshment zones. Medical care provided by medical services, fire brigade, and course marshals along the route. Distances range from 5 km to 60 km, including trail and hike disciplines, with a children's trail and diverse terrain through fields, meadows, forests, and vineyards. Participants receive medals, certificates, showers, and on-site catering.

name: X-treme Battle Heroldstatt
description: The X-treme Battle Heroldstatt is a challenging obstacle course and trail run on the Swabian Alb that tests strength, endurance, and willpower. Participants can choose between an obstacle course with exciting challenges and an adrenaline rush or a varied cross-country run without obstacles over a 16 km route with approximately 350 meters of elevation. The course leads through the natural landscapes of the Swabian Alb with beautiful scenery and small trails. A real highlight for endurance athletes and teams who want to compete together.
course_highlights: 16 km long route with approx. 350 meters of elevation
Varied course with small trails and beautiful landscapes
Top-class obstacle course with exciting challenges
additional: Start and distribution of race materials at the Heroldstatt Sports Center. Distribution times: Friday 18:00 - 20:00, Saturday 12:00 - 14:00. Parking in the Heroldstatt industrial area, access to the sports center is closed during the event. Drinks and catering are provided. There is also a Kids Battle on Sunday, 12.07.2025 at 14:30. Route: 16 km with approx. 350 meters of elevation, obstacles, trails, landscapes; start at Heroldstatt Sports Center; parking in the industrial area; race number distribution on 10.07.2026 and 11.07.2026.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: The Barigauer Tower Run is a traditional race in Oberhain near Königsee, taking place on July 12, 2026. The event offers runners an attractive course with scenic sections around the Barigauer Tower. The race is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts seeking a sporting challenge in a natural environment. The organization is carried out by the Königsee Running Club, which ensures a family-friendly atmosphere and smooth proceedings.
course_highlights: Scenic course around the Barigauer Tower
Natural running paths in Oberhain (Königsee)
Traditional race with a family atmosphere

name: BÄRENFELS SOMMERTRAIL 63-KM mit MARATHON, HALBMARATHON und 11-KM
description: The BÄRENFELS SUMMER TRAIL on July 12, 2026, offers an unforgettable trail experience in the pristine nature of the Saarland-Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park. The event includes four distances ranging from 11 km to 63 km with challenging elevation gains and takes place on a wild and romantic trail loop around Bärenfels. Runners and walkers can enjoy the diverse landscape of Nahesteig and look forward to an athletic adventure in a unique natural setting.
course_highlights: Wild and romantic trail loop around Nahesteig
Elevation gain from 350 to 1800 meters depending on the distance
Nature experience in Saarland-Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park

Trail and nature run in Saarland/Pfalz National Park, online registration, start times at 09:00 AM, early start for walkers at 07:00 AM.

description: The Dinkelsbühl Relay Race takes place on July 12, 2026, in the historic old town of Dinkelsbühl. The relay consists of four runners, each completing approximately a 3-kilometer loop around the old town. The course passes landmarks such as the Old Promenade, the Wörnitztor gate, the city park, and the music pavilion, accompanied by an inclusive drumming group. There is also a Funtasia Kids-Run with age-appropriate circuits for children. The event offers not only a sporting competition but also a lively supporting program with music, a bouncy castle, and catering.

Passage by Wörnitztor gate and city park with music pavilion
Children's courses of 700 m and 1200 m on well-visible loops
