The route passes through historic paths such as the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg, and Fürstenweg, with a notable ascent to Schlossberg and through the castle garden. Start and finish are located on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing facilities are available in the Gedern sports hall.
course_highlights: Historic old town of Gedern
Four laps of 2.5 km with a varied loop course
Sections over Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg, and Fürstenweg with ascent to Schlossberg
additional: Start and finish on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing rooms in the Gedern sports hall (Franseckystraße 32A). The longer distances consist of four laps of 2.5 km each. The course includes a paved castle courtyard and castle garden. Organizer is the Top-Time timing team. Courses for children, teenagers, and adults, start/finish on Lauterbacher Straße, changing rooms in the Gedern sports hall.

name: Hambacher Volkslauf
description: The Hambach Volkslauf takes place on August 15, 2026, in Niederzier-Hambach and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, as well as a half marathon. Additionally, there are walking and Nordic walking routes over 10 km. The courses are measured by the DLV and are part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and welcomes numerous participants.
course_highlights: Measured courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Walking and Nordic walking over 10 km
Part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup
additional: Registration is now possible via the website. Course maps and the race announcement are available as PDFs. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup. Courses are measured, registration is online, and it is part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup.

name: Hüttenfelder Volksbankkerwelauf
description: The Hüttenfelder Volksbank-Kerwelauf is a traditional running event with over 30 years of history, offering runners of all performance levels an attractive opportunity to test their endurance and have fun together. Three races are offered: a half marathon (21.1 km), a 10 km run, and a 2 km school run for children. The course mostly runs through shaded forest and provides a very flat, pleasant running environment with historic ammunition bunkers as special highlights. The start and finish are located at the Hüttenfelder allotment gardens, and after the races, an award ceremony takes place at the Kerweplatz at the Bürgerhaus.
course_highlights: Super flat course mostly through the forest
Start and finish at the Hüttenfelder allotment gardens
Historic decommissioned ammunition bunkers along the course
additional: Water and isotonic drink stations in the forest and at the start/finish. No on-site registration possible. Award ceremony at 6:30 PM at the Kerweplatz at the Bürgerhaus. The 2 km school run runs over paved field paths and shaded forest edges. The course passes through forest, historic bunker facilities, water and refreshment stations, participation from age 7, on-site registration from 1:00 PM, various start times depending on age group.

name: Josef Kaderhandt-Waldlauf Plus
price_range: Waldlauf (20 km und 20 km Plus): 20€, 7,8 km Lauf: 5€
description: The 42nd Josef Kaderhandt Forest Run in Menden is a traditional running event organized by the Marathon Club Menden e.V. The course runs over paved forest paths through the scenic Sauerland and offers a sporting challenge with demanding sections. In addition to the classic 20 km forest run, runners can participate in the 20 km Plus Marathon, which can be extended to an ultramarathon of over 50 km by completing additional laps. The start is in Waldemei near the Kolping Memorial Stone, and the finish is at the Bürgerbad Leitmecke. There is also a 7.8 km fun run open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Paved forest paths in Sauerland
Challenging and scenic course
Variable ultramarathon up to 50 km through multiple laps
additional: The cut-off time for all categories is after 6 hours of running. The start is in Waldemei Menden, with the finish at Bürgerbad Leitmecke (new). Parking is centrally designated; please do not park in residential areas or on Gisbert-Kranz Straße. The course includes 3 laps for 20 km, 4 or more laps (up to 8) for the 20 km Plus and ultramarathon, as well as a 7.8 km fun run. Participants can register online; late registrations are possible on the event day in cash. The course runs over paved forest paths, starting in Waldemei and finishing at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. This event is the 42nd edition of the race.

name: Kelheimer Volksfestlauf
location: Festgelände Am Pflegerspitz, Kelheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Kelheim Folk Festival Run is a traditional race event held annually in August at the festival grounds Am Pflegerspitz in Kelheim. It offers various distances for different age groups, including 2 km for students, 5 km for youth, and 10 km for adults. The event is a regular part of the city of Kelheim's event calendar and is organized by run & bike Kelheim e.V. Race documents are issued on the day of the event from 12:00 PM at the beer tent, and the award ceremony takes place in the beer tent after the races.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the festival grounds Am Pflegerspitz
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km depending on age group
Scoring for the Landkreis Kelheim Running Cup
additional: Race documents are issued at the beer tent from 12:00 PM until 30 minutes before the start. The award ceremony is approximately at 4:30 PM in the Volksfest beer tent. Timing is provided via Race Result. Online registration is available until August 14, 2026, with late registration on the event day thereafter. Participation is part of the Landkreis Laufcup 2026; results and registration are available online.

name: Städtedreieckslauf
description: The City Triangle Run is a traditional race through the three cities of Burglengenfeld, Teublitz, and Maxhütte-Haidhof. The 16th edition of this event will take place on August 15, 2026, attracting numerous runners for a good cause with five competitive categories. The course is flat and runs over field paths and public roads, with traffic regulations to be observed. The race offers a great opportunity to experience the region athletically and to reach the finish line together.
course_highlights: Flat running routes
Field paths and public roads
Course through three cities: Burglengenfeld, Teublitz, and Maxhütte-Haidhof
additional: The course is flat and runs over field paths and public roads. Traffic regulations must be observed. Charity event, registration from June 1, donations for non-profit organizations, joint celebration after the race at the community festival.

name: Städtelauf Plauen - Hof
description: The Städtelauf Plauen - Hof is a traditional race in the Saxon-Bavarian border region, celebrating its 35th edition in 2026. The course connects the Vogtland metropolis of Plauen with the Bavarian city of Hof and attracts runners and Nordic walkers from the region and beyond. The race is known for its sporting atmosphere and cross-border city partnership. Every year, numerous participants take part in excellent weather conditions and enjoy the scenic route.
course_highlights: Traditional race course in the Saxon-Bavarian border region
Connection between Plauen and Hof
Popular route for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: Various routes, Nordic walking possible, scenic route, joint finish in Hof

name: WoKiMen
location: Parc de Tarbes, Altenkirchen, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: WoKiMen is a family-friendly running day at Parc de Tarbes in Altenkirchen, offering various running and activity options for children, adults, teams, walkers, Nordic walkers, and even dog owners. Children can run 0.5 km or 2 km, while adults can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The TeamChallenge is a relay race with three 1-km segments. In addition to the runs, there is a diverse program with yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course. The day ends with a relaxed Chill & Grill event featuring Nepali specialties, Italian wood-fired pizza, popcorn, coffee, and cake.
course_highlights: Family-friendly event with runs for children and adults
Various distances from 0.5 km to half marathon (21 km)
Additional program with yoga, Zumbathlon, and adventure course in the park
additional: The 5-km course is especially open to walkers, Nordic walkers, and runners with dogs. The TeamChallenge consists of three 1-km relay segments. The event takes place at Parc de Tarbes and offers a family atmosphere with a Chill & Grill conclusion. The event is open to everyone, with activities for children and adults, team relays, dog runs, and a varied supporting program. It is aimed at families, hobby runners, and community groups.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and skill levels, taking place on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course runs through a natural environment and offers a motivating challenge for both ambitious runners and hobby athletes. The event promotes community and joy of movement and is a special experience for both competitive participants and recreational runners. Start and finish are located in the spa park at the canal, and timing is done with a transponder.
course_highlights: Natural course around Beerster See
Start and finish in the spa park at the canal
Free drinks on the other side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race documents are issued at the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at Moortherme upon presentation of the start number. Timing is done with a transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is after 1:45 hours. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course length 7.6 km, walking, Nordic walking 1.1 km, 0.5 km, 14.6 km; race documents at the Amtsscheune; in all weather; timing with transponder.

name: HuBuT - 8. Hunsbuckel-Trail
description: The HuBuT - Hunsbuckel-Trail is a challenging trail running event in the Hunsrück with three course lengths: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km), and UltraTrail (47 km). The runs take place through diverse low mountain landscapes with green meadows, deep forests, single trails, gorges, and award-winning hiking trails. A special highlight is crossing the Geierlay suspension bridge, Germany's most beautiful and highest suspension bridge. The start and finish point is the idyllic town of Laubach, offering participants an unforgettable natural experience.
course_highlights: Diverse low mountain landscape with elevation profile between river valleys and ridges
Crossing the 360 m long and 100 m high Geierlay suspension bridge
Running on pristine terrain, single trails, award-winning hiking trails, and through deep gorges
additional: Start and finish are in Laubach. There are three courses: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km), and UltraTrail (47 km). The UltraTrail route includes crossing the Geierlay suspension bridge. The trail features single trails, forest paths, gorges, and historic sights such as the Balduinseck castle ruins. There is a winter edition with a 6-hour run in February. The event offers multiple distances, including UltraTrail, HalfTrail, ShortTrail, and a winter edition with a 6-hour run; it takes place in Laubach in the Hunsrück; typical weather in August is warm.

name: Ortskernlauf
description: The Roßdorf Old Town Festival is a traditional event held annually on the third weekend of August, celebrating its 42nd anniversary in 2026. It brings together the diverse community of Roßdorf and offers a lively program with live acts on three stages, a children's and family area, as well as numerous clubs and local organizations. The Old Town forms the social center where visitors from near and far celebrate together. The Old Town Run on Sunday is a sporting highlight with start and finish in the Old Town.
course_highlights: Start and finish area in the Old Town of Roßdorf
Warm-up from 11:00 AM, start of the Old Town Run at 12:00 PM on Sunday
Diverse community and festive atmosphere in the Old Town
additional: The Old Town Run takes place on Sunday with warm-up from 11:00 AM and start at 12:00 PM at the start & finish area in the Old Town Run. Children's program and children's band are from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The festival offers live acts on three stages, a kids and family area, as well as numerous clubs on site. Athletic run, registration from summer 2026 on the website of the Skifreunde Roßdorf.

name: Ronneburger Stunden-Paarlauf des Laufprojekt Büdingen
location: Stadion im Jugendzentrum Ronneburg, Ronneburg, Hessen, Germany
description: The Ronneburg Hour Pair Race organized by Laufprojekt Büdingen e.V. is a unique running competition where teams of two runners take turns completing laps on the 400m synthetic track in the stadium at the youth center in Ronneburg. The event takes place on August 16, 2026, and offers three competitions over 15, 30, and 60 minutes. The laps run are added up and converted into a total distance, with the pair covering the greatest distance winning. The event is open to all gender combinations and promotes team spirit and endurance in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400m synthetic track at the stadium in the youth center in Ronneburg
Pair exchange after each lap
Competitions over 15, 30, and 60 minutes
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site until one hour before the start of the competition. Registration can be done as an individual or as a pair; individual registrations will be grouped into pairs by the organizer. Payment is made via direct debit upon registration or in cash at the bib pickup during late registration. The event is expected to end around 3:00 PM. Course along Lake Lopau
Part of the Heideblütenfest week in Amelinghausen
additional: The Amelinghausen Running Group meets regularly on Mondays and Wednesdays to run together. There is also a beginner's course that gradually introduces newcomers to running. The event is part of a lively running community with participation in many community and marathon runs across Germany. The race takes place in August, typically with summer weather around 25°C, with possible rain. There are also children's runs and other community races during the festival week.

name: Jahn-Gedenklauf
description: The Jahn Memorial Run in Lanz is a traditional race organized by SV Jahn Lanz e.V. The event takes place at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Stadium and offers various distances, which are also counted towards the Prignitz Cup. The start time is at 10 a.m., and the race is open to runners of all ages and performance levels. The event is supported by the Kreissportbund Prignitz e.V. and is a fixed date in the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Short distance: 6.6 km
Long distance: 12.5 km
Outside the Prignitz Cup: 3 km
additional: Tracks are not accessible with spikes, registration possible on-site, start at the stadium

name: Jan Schüpp Bürgerlauf Wittmund
location: Stadion an der Breslauer Straße, Wittmund, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Jan Schüpp Wittmunder Bürgerlauf is a running event organized by MTV Wittmund, starting at the stadium on Breslauer Straße in Wittmund. The course leads through the city center, past the marketplace and castle square, offering a challenging and varied running route. In addition to the main races, there are also children’s and youth races, which are offered free of charge. The event is well organized with support from police, fire brigade, and the German Red Cross (DRK), and is very popular among runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium on Breslauer Straße
Course runs through the city center past the marketplace and castle square
Challenging route with varied course layout
additional: Parking is available at the stadium and on the Schützenplatz on Auricher Straße. The event is medically supported by police, fire brigade, and DRK. There are children’s and youth races free of charge, as well as main races with an entry fee. The event is accompanied by a moderator and supported by local sports clubs. The run includes distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 1200 meters, with a supporting program, on-site registration, and parking options at the stadium and Schützenplatz. The event is very popular among participants and offers a festive atmosphere.

name: Michelsmarktlauf
description: The Michelsmarktlauf is a traditional running event in Reichelsheim that takes place annually in August. On August 22, 2026, the 30th edition of the Michelsmarktlauf will be held, featuring a main race over 10 km, a school run over 1.4 km, and a toddler run over 400 meters. The event is organized by the athletics department of KSV Reichelsheim and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km
School run over 1.4 km
Toddler run over 400 meters
additional: The event offers a variety of distances and is very popular among families, school groups, and running enthusiasts from the region. Online registration is possible.

name: middenmang-Loop 2. Emder Vielfaltslauf
description: The middenmang run is an inclusive diversity run in Emden, taking place for the third time on August 22, 2026. The race is open to all age groups and people with and without disabilities to experience the joy of running together. Various competitions and courses, from the Kinner-Loop for children to the 10-km middenmang-Loop for experienced runners, offer something for everyone. The run is part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series and promotes community, activity, and inclusion.
course_highlights: Diverse courses for children, adolescents, and adults with and without disabilities
Inclusion run focused on running together and overcoming barriers
Part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series with 5 km and 10 km courses
additional: The middenmang run includes various competitions and courses for all ages and abilities. The event emphasizes inclusion and community. The 5 km and 10 km runs are part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series. Registration is available online via the website. Contact person is Inga Weerts. Inclusion run with different courses for all age groups and abilities, part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series.

name: Münsterland-Sternlauf - Benefizlauf
location: Universitätsklinikum Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Münsterland Star Run is a charity run in support of the Children's Cancer Aid Münster e.V. at the University Hospital Münster. Five routes lead in a star shape from different towns in the Münsterland region to the common goal at Leonardo-Campus in Münster. The run is designed as a stage race, where participants can set their own pace and run one or more stages. 100% of the proceeds are donated to the association for the promotion of children with cancer Münster e.V. to support the treatment and care of affected children.
course_highlights: Five routes lead in a star shape from different towns in the Münsterland region to Münster
Mostly business, walking, and bike paths as well as traffic-calmed streets
Accompaniment by stage leaders and DRK ambulance vehicles, refreshments at stage points
additional: The run is not a competition; participants determine their own pace. One or more stages can be run, and start and finish are possible at each stage point. Participants are responsible for their own return transport. For the first time, cashless donations are possible. Donation receipts are issued from 200 euros. Accompaniment by stage leaders and DRK ambulance vehicles. Refreshments are offered at stage points in cooperation with the Kolpingsfamilien. The run takes place in Münster and promotes social cohesion through sporting engagement.

name: Ring of Feier - 2.Hermeskeiler City Lauf
organizer: Kulturbeirat der Stadt Hermeskeil, Hermeskeiler Turnverein
description: The Ring of Feier - 2nd Hermeskeil City Run takes place on August 22, 2026, in Hermeskeil. It is a short race with distances of 150 meters and 5 kilometers. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere with typical August weather, temperatures around 25°C, and mostly sunny days. Participants should check the organizer details before registering.
course_highlights: Short distances: 150 m and 5 km
City run in Hermeskeil
Typical summer weather with mostly sunny days
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, August 22, 2026, in Hermeskeil. Weather conditions in August are typically 25°C with lows around 14°C and an average of 60 mm of precipitation. The event is designed as a short city run. Besides the races, the event also offers music, catering, and team competitions, making it a convivial city festival.

name: Gladbecker Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a traditional running event welcoming runners of all ages. The event offers various distances from a mini marathon to a half marathon as well as a team relay. All courses are certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for best lists. Participants receive finisher medals and personalized bibs with their names, making the running experience special. There is also a district championship ranking and extensive award ceremonies.
course_highlights: DLV-certified courses: 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Personalized bibs with first names for all participants
Live timing and net times for all races
additional: Finisher medals for all participants, personalized bibs with first names, live timing with net times, changing and shower facilities at the stadium, valuables can be handed in at storage stations, trophies and certificates for winners and age groups, team and club rankings, district championships with certificates and badges, no scoring for Bambinis and walking disciplines. Courses at Gladbeck stadium, online registration, late registration until 1 hour before start, medical support by the German Red Cross, various distances and categories

name: Rotherbaum 10K Hamburg - K Rotherbaum
description: The 10K Rotherbaum is an officially measured 10-kilometer race in Hamburg conducted according to international competition standards. The course is a loop, registered with the German Athletics Association and AIMS, ensuring that finish times are eligible for record lists. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a cup ranking across all 10K Hamburg races with attractive prizes. Registration is exclusively online, and participants are advised to use public transportation for their arrival.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km loop course
Start and finish near the Hallerstraße subway station
Record-eligible finish times according to IWB and AIMS
additional: Clothing deposit for personal belongings available on event day. The cup ranking includes all 10K Hamburg events with points awarded to the 30 fastest men and women. Official registration confirmation will be sent via email after the registration deadline. Public transportation, especially to the Hallerstraße subway station, is recommended for travel. The race is part of the Hamburg 10K series, which includes various running events in Hamburg. Registration is possible online, and different categories are offered.

name: Der Alstertallauf
price_range: Halbmarathon: 40,00 € (Nachmeldungen 45,00 €), 10 km: 30,00 € (35,00 €), 4 km: 20,00 € (25,00 €), Kinder- und Schnupperläufe ab 10,00 €
description: The Alstertallauf is a family-friendly race on the upper Alster hiking trail, considered the most beautiful running route in Hamburg. It is aimed at both young and old running enthusiasts as well as recreational athletes and offers various distances. The event takes place near the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium in Hamburg and is known for its friendly atmosphere. In 2022, over 200 runners participated, with race distances ranging from 410 meters to 10 kilometers.
course_highlights: Run on the upper Alster hiking trail, regarded as Hamburg's most beautiful running route
Family-friendly race for all ages and performance levels
Various distances: 410 m, 1,500 m, 4 km, and 10 km
additional: Start location is the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium, Wellingsbütteler Landstraße 43, 22337 Hamburg, marked from U-Klein Borstel. The event includes multiple distances for different age groups and performance levels. Results and impressions from previous years are available online. The event is organized by Hamburger Turnerbund von 1862 e.V. Registration via www.davengo.com, start/finish at Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium, no parking available, public transportation recommended, changing rooms and showers on site.

name: Eschweiler Citylauf 2026
description: The Eschweiler City Run takes place on August 23, 2026, for the third time and is organized by the Marathon Club Eschweiler, which has been hosting a popular race in Eschweiler for the 40th time. The start and finish are located in Eschweiler city center on Marienstraße and Grabenstraße. The event offers school runs as well as two distances for adults: 5 kilometers and 10 kilometers, with the 10-kilometer race also counting as the LVN-Nordrhein Championships. The City Run is part of the newly established Regio Aachen Running Cup and offers runners an attractive course through the city center.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Eschweiler city center (Marienstraße and Grabenstraße)
Distances: 5 km and 10 km with RAC scoring
Part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup
additional: Start and finish are on Marienstraße in Eschweiler city center. There are school runs and two distances for adults. The race is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. The 10 km course is also counted as the LVN-Nordrhein Championships. Various activities, children's program, on-site and online registration, different race distances.

name: Gettorfer Staffelmarathon
description: The Gettorf Relay Marathon is a team marathon taking place on August 23, 2026, at Sportpark Gettorf. The course consists of a roughly 4.2 km loop, which is run ten times. Teams consist of 5 to 10 people who pass the chip-timed baton in the exchange zone. Alternatively, the duo marathon can be completed by two people who share the ten laps freely. Timing is done electronically via transponders and shoe chips, and intermediate times are recorded for each runner.
course_highlights: Loop course of approximately 4.2 km at Sportpark Gettorf
Ten laps per team or duo
Electronic timing with baton transponder and shoe chip
additional: The deadline for both competitions is 4:45 PM. Each person may run a maximum of two laps. Team re-registration (change of team members) is possible online until the registration deadline. Bib numbers are mandatory and provided by the organizer. Online registration is available, with early bird discounts, supported by local partners such as AOK NordWest, Zippel’s Läuferwelt, Förde Sparkasse, EGE.

name: FlorSTADT Halbmarathon 2026
description: The FlorSTADT Half Marathon is a popular race in Florstadt, Hesse, taking place on August 23, 2026, for the 11th time. The event offers not only the half marathon but also additional runs over 10 km, 5 km, 1.8 km, and 300 m, allowing the whole family to participate. The course runs through the beautiful forest and is secured, with plenty of water stations and medical support. The race is part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge and is an excellent preparation for the Frankfurt Marathon. Food and drinks are provided, and a personal certificate is available for download.
course_highlights: Hesse's most beautiful forest half marathon
Plenty of water stations along the course
Secured course with medical support
additional: Moderation by Runningvoices, free download of photos, organic fruit at the finish, warm-up with Smarttraining Ortenberg, playground right at the start/finish area, event for the whole family, personal certificate for download, support by the Gadde crew. The event is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge, offers electronic timing, medical support, and photo service. The weather in August is typically warm around 25°C.

name: Bielebohlauf
description: The Bielebohlauf Oppach is a running event in the Lusatian Mountains offering various distances from 400 meters to 20 kilometers. The runs take place on forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads around Bieleboh. The longer routes are challenging and include steep inclines. There are special Bambini and children's runs for kids. The Oppach stadium provides catering and entertainment, and finishers receive certificates and clips online.
course_highlights: Routes through the landscape of the Lusatian Mountains around Bieleboh
Forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads
Challenging longer routes with steep inclines
additional: Registration on site possible with a 5€ late registration fee. Dogs are allowed on the walking route; leash and muzzle are mandatory in the stadium. Trophies and gifts for course winners from 4.9 km and age group winners. Age-appropriate gifts for winners of the 1.5 km route. Results, finisher clips, and certificates are available online immediately after the race. Food, drinks, and entertainment are provided in the stadium. Routes with inclines, dogs allowed on walking route, food and drinks available.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf
location: Sporthalle am Riegelsweg, Breitungen/Werra, Thuringia, Germany

description: The Breitungen Pleßlauf takes place on August 23, 2026, in Breitungen/Werra and offers running distances from 1 km up to 30 km as well as Nordic Walking over 10.7 km. The event is organized by SV Lauftreff Breitungen e.V. and starts and ends at the sports hall on Riegelsweg. The races feature varied routes suitable for both children and experienced runners. In addition to the sporting challenge, there is timing with a disposable chip, trophies and material prizes for the fastest participants, as well as finisher medals for the main distances.
course_highlights: Running distances from 1 km to 30 km
Nordic Walking over 10.7 km
Start and finish at the sports hall on Riegelsweg in Breitungen
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 45 minutes before each start with a late registration fee of €5 for the main distances and Nordic Walking. Timing is done with a disposable chip from GO timing. Race documents can be picked up on August 22, 2026, from 12:00 to 15:30 and on the event day from 07:00 at the sports hall. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the sports hall. Trophies are awarded to the three fastest finishers in the main distances, along with material and monetary prizes for the winners. All finishers of the main distances receive a medal with laser engraving. Course profiles, mountain running, online registration, results, photos, videos, dates in 2024-2026.

name: ews Volks- und Spendenlauf
description: The 14th ews Volks- und Spendenlauf takes place across Bad Segeberg, passing scenic locations such as Kalkberg and Lake Segeberg. Since 2011, the race has been a fixed part of the city's sports program, combining athletic performance with the enjoyment of shared activity and charitable engagement. The event annually supports selected projects, with donations in 2026 distributed among three projects. The race is a community event that unites movement and social commitment.
course_highlights: Across Bad Segeberg
Past Kalkberg
Along Lake Segeberg
additional: Team registrations are only possible via a paper form, which must be sent by email to info@volkslauf-bad-segeberg.de by October 2, 2023. Bib number distribution will take place on August 23, 2026, at the registration office. Registration is done online with a consent to liability waiver and data protection. The focus is on fun in movement and charitable engagement. Run across Bad Segeberg, including walking and Nordic walking, donations for local projects, registration until June 2026, team and individual starts possible.

name: RAG Hartfüssler Trail
location: Förderschule soziale Entwicklung Saarbrücken, Saarbrücken, Saarland, Germany
description: The Hartfüssler Trail on August 23, 2026, in Saarbrücken offers challenging trail running routes through diverse natural and cultural landscapes. The 58 km ultratrail course leads over abandoned forest paths, historic mining facilities, and the wild-romantic Netzbachtal with geological features. The highlight is the ascent to the Halde Grühlingstraße with a literary granite staircase path and an impressive view over the entire trail. Start and finish are located on the schoolyard of the Fördersschule soziale Entwicklung Saarbrücken, embedded in a listed mining ensemble.
course_highlights: Abandoned forest paths and crossing under the highway at the Saarbahn tracks
Wild-romantic Netzbachtal with geological features (Holzer conglomerate)
Ascent to Halde Grühlingstraße with granite steps and panoramic view
additional: Start and finish are on the schoolyard of the Fördersschule soziale Entwicklung Saarbrücken in the Grubensiedlung Von der Heydt, accessible by Saarbahn (stop Heinrichshaus) or car. There are cutoff times at aid stations (Göttelborn km 30.8 at 12:30 PM, Halde Grühlingstraße km 53.1 at 5:00 PM) with a time limit of 10 hours. Aid stations, medical support, timing, and personalized bibs are included. Dogs are not allowed, poles are permitted. Fair cancellation policies and CO2 compensation for travel are offered. Trail races of 30 km and 58 km, scenic forest and historic mining sites, cutoff time 10 hours, start/finish at Fördersschule soziale Entwicklung Saarbrücken.

name: TuS Hiltrup Halbmarathon
location: Stadion am Osttor, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TuS Hiltrup Half Marathon is an established running event in Münster with start and finish at the Stadion am Osttor. The course runs in a loop within the stadium, along the canal promenade, and through the Hiltrup residential area, offering a varied and attractive running environment. In addition to the classic half marathon, there is also a relay race, which is particularly interesting for teams. The event is open to runners born in 2008 (individual start) and 2010 (relay) and offers a family-friendly atmosphere within a large sports club.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Stadion am Osttor
Run along the canal promenade with views of the canal
Course through the Hiltrup residential area with varied terrain
additional: Individual entries for the half marathon are fully booked, only relay spots are still available. The cut-off time is 12:00 PM, after 3 hours of competition. The course is barrier-free, and detailed information about the route and traffic regulations on race day is available for residents. The course is measured, start at Stadion am Osttor, individual and relay races, registration online, start times at 9:00 and 9:05 AM, cut-off after 3 hours.

name: 1. Laufchallenge Mellendorfer TV
description: The Sparkassen Running Pass 2026 for the Hannover region offers 43 running events, making it the largest running series of its kind in Germany. Participants can collect stamps at various events in the Hannover region and thus discover the region through running. Each successful participation is rewarded with a stamp, and avid runners can earn attractive prizes in gold, silver, or bronze. Participation is directly at the individual races, which take place at many beautiful locations with different activity options. Additionally, there is a Running Pass app with an event calendar and a digital running journal.
course_highlights: Diverse running events at beautiful locations in the Hannover region
Collect stamps at a total of 43 running events in 2026
Exclusive prizes for avid runners in gold, silver, and bronze
additional: The Running Pass is available both in a traditional fold-out format and digitally via the Running Pass app. The app offers an event calendar as well as a digital running journal. Participation is directly at the individual races, which are spread throughout the year. Participation within the Running Pass series involves collecting stamps, available both digitally and in print, and is part of the largest running series in Germany.

name: H Lauf 2026
description: The 10-hour run in Hanau is a charity event held on the grounds of the Paul-Gerhardt School. The event starts at 9:00 AM and runs until 7:00 PM, with participants running for a good cause. The run offers a special opportunity to experience endurance and community while supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Run on the grounds of the Paul-Gerhardt School Hanau
Endurance run lasting 10 hours from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM
Event for a good cause
additional: The run takes place on the grounds of the Paul-Gerhardt School Hanau. There is a program and a flyer available for download as a PDF. The event is a social initiative where donations are collected. The run is held on the school grounds with a duration of 10 hours, ideal for those who want to challenge their endurance.

name: Die Generalprobe
description: The General Rehearsal is an urban road race in Berlin, serving as the perfect preparation for the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON. On August 23, 2026, runners can test their form on a super-flat loop course through the Berlin districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf. The event offers a quarter marathon, a half marathon, as well as races for children and youth. The event is characterized by a lively atmosphere and a personal medal for all finishers.
course_highlights: Super-flat loop course through the Berlin neighborhoods of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf
Two race distances: quarter marathon (10.5 km) and half marathon (21 km)
Course passes through typical Berlin residential districts with urban flair
additional: Timing is done with MIKA TAG transponder, attached to the back of the bib, which does not need to be returned. The Kids & Youth races start at 08:15 AM with distances from 200 m to 800 m; late registrations are possible on the event day. The start and finish for the main races are at Schlossstraße, Berlin-Steglitz. The participation limit is 4,000 runners. The course runs through the districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf; medals for all finishers; results and certificate downloads; age group winners receive a free start for the following year.

name: B2Run Hamburg
description: The B2Run Hamburg on August 25, 2026, is a corporate run covering approximately 5.6 km, ending with a spectacular finish inside the Volksparkstadion. The course is varied and mostly flat, ideal for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners. The event promotes team spirit, motivation, and community feeling and is perfect for companies and individual participants from Hamburg and the surrounding area. In addition to the sporting experience, the run offers a professional supporting program with moderation and music.
course_highlights: Approximately 5.6 km long, varied and mostly flat loop course
Spectacular finish inside the Volksparkstadion
Course suitable for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners
additional: The event is a large team event with plenty of opportunities for team building and networking. There is a professional supporting program with moderation and music. Individual participants without a team are very welcome. The course is designed so that teams can run to the finish together. 5 km course, finish inside the Volksparkstadion, team event, supporting program with music, support from the foundation 'Menschen für Menschen'.

description: The Office City Run 2026 in Frankfurt am Main is a sporting event with heart, taking place live on August 27, 2026, at the Hahnstraße sports facility in Niederrad. The races over 5 km and 10 km lead along a flat, fast, and mostly shaded course past the golf course and Goldstein cemetery. Besides the athletic competition, the focus is on a good cause: the proceeds support the expansion of the Vocational Training Centre in Nairobi, which offers young people prospects. The event combines sport, team spirit, and social engagement in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat, fast, and mostly shaded course
Course along the golf course and Goldstein cemetery
Asphalt and very good forest paths with kilometer markers
additional: Number bib collection from 16:45; 5 km run starts at 18:15, 10 km run at 19:05; cut-off time at 20:20; raffle and award ceremony from 20:30; age group classification from U20 to M/W75 in 5-year steps; medical service on course and at the finish; water stations on the course; a transponder for timing is attached to the bib. The event also includes cycling with 30 km and 50 km options, registration until August 23, 2026, start times at 18:15 and 19:05, participant limit of 1,100, flat course on asphalt and forest paths.

name: 24. Duderstädter Sparkassenlauf
description: The 24th Duderstadt Sparkasse Run will take place on August 28, 2026, in the historic pedestrian zone of Duderstadt. The event starts at 4:00 PM with the opening ceremony in front of the town hall, which is also the finish point for all races. Various distances are offered, from a 600 m Bambini run, 1.25 km school rounds, to 5 km and 10 km races. Children and adolescents receive finisher medals, and for the 5 km and 10 km races, neckerchiefs are given. Winners are rewarded with cake. The event is supported by the town of Duderstadt, Sparkasse Duderstadt, and other sponsors.
course_highlights: Races through the historic old town and pedestrian zone of Duderstadt
Finish line in front of the beautiful town hall
Varied distances from 600 m to 10 km with children and youth races
additional: The event begins with the opening at 4:00 PM by the patron Mayor Thorsten Feike and the board of Sparkasse Duderstadt. The Bambini races have participant limits of 250, the school rounds between 300 and 400 participants. Neck scarves are given as finisher gifts for the 5 km and 10 km races. No registration is possible on-site after the deadline. The award ceremony starts from 6:00 PM. Multiple race distances, registration via the website, medals for children, neckerchiefs for longer races, event in the historic city center.

name: 5. LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf
location: Sportplatz Waldauer Wiesen, Kassel, Hesse, Germany
description: The 5th LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Run is an evening running event held at the Waldauer Wiesen sports field in Kassel. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from a 500 m children's run to an 18 km race. The shorter children's races start first, followed by the longer runs in the early evening. The routes are well marked and include loops around Bugasee and Wahlebach, with refreshment stations and childcare on site.
course_highlights: 5 km course as a out-and-back route
9.5 km loop around Bugasee with Wahlebach loop
18 km course consists of two laps of the 9.5 km route
additional: Marked routes, two refreshment stations, catering and childcare are available. Online registration via the event portal is possible. Walking is no longer a separate category, but participants can also walk the 5 km or 9.5 km routes. The race courses lead around Bugasee, registration is done online via Raceresult, limited parking options, public transportation is recommended. The event also offers childcare and on-site catering.

name: Domabergsprint
description: The Doma-Bergsprint in Calw-Stammheim is a challenging mountain run over 2.2 kilometers with an elevation gain of 245 meters. The course leads from the Nagold Valley up to just below the highest elevation of the district and includes three easily runnable trails as well as a longer gravel section. The race is approved as a charity run and is characterized by its steep paths, suitable for both young and older runners. Participants have the opportunity to time themselves and to complete the race two weeks before the official race day.
course_highlights: 2.2 kilometer course with 245 meters elevation gain
Three easily runnable trails
Longer gravel section with ditches created by heavy rain
additional: The race is an approved charity run where participants time themselves. There is an option to complete the race 14 days before the official race day. Self-timing with the possibility to participate before the race; no specific information on registration or starting fees.

name: Ibbenbürener Aaseelauf 2026
description: The Ibbenbüren Aasee Run is a traditional race event taking place in 2026 for the 41st time. The event offers races for children of preschool and elementary school age, as well as a 5 km open run, a 5 km team run, and a 10 km main race for ambitious and recreational runners. The course runs around Lake Aasee with start and finish at the Ost stadium in Ibbenbüren. The event is limited to 1,000 participants and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and good catering along the route.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ost stadium, Ibbenbüren
Loop around Lake Aasee with three laps in the 10 km main race
Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish area
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 3:00 PM until 1 hour before the respective race start for a fee of €2.50. Changes to registration are also possible on the event day for a fee. €1 from each registration is donated to a charitable organization. Free parking is available at Ost stadium. Race documents are issued on the event day from 3:00 PM. Timing is done with transponders on the back of the bib number. Registration is only online, with limited starting places. Participation fee starts at €2.50 for late registrations. Support for charitable projects is possible.

name: Leunaer Saaleanlagenlauf
description: The Leuna Saaleanlagen Run takes place on August 21, 2026, in Leuna and offers various race distances from 1.4 km to 9.6 km. The event is especially aimed at children and students, providing a family-friendly atmosphere. The race runs through the Saaleanlagen and promises pleasant weather conditions with mostly sunny weather in August. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Runs through the Saaleanlagen in Leuna
Distances from 1.4 km to 9.6 km
Family-friendly event focused on children and students
additional: Typical weather in August: around 25 °C, low of 14 °C, average 60 mm of precipitation, mostly sunny. The event takes place in August with typical temperatures around 25°C. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories.

name: Sparkassen-Abendlauf
location: Hohenhorster Wald, Recklinghausen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Evening Run in Recklinghausen is a summer race organized by the Recklinghausen Athletics Club in cooperation with Sparkasse Vest Recklinghausen. Two courses are offered: 5 km (two laps) and 10 km (four laps) through the Hohenhorster Forest. Both courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings. As part of the evening run, the district championships over 10 km are also held, for which a valid start license in the FLVW district Recklinghausen is required.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses in the Hohenhorster Forest
Officially measured and ranking-eligible race courses
District championships 10 km integrated into the evening run
additional: The 5 km course consists of two laps, the 10 km course four laps through the Hohenhorster Forest. Participants in the 10 km district championship must check the appropriate box during registration and possess a valid start license. Courses in the Hohenhorster Forest, district championships as part of the race.

name: Sparkassen-Tauchscher-Stadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen-Tauchscher City Run is a traditional running event organized by the Athletics Club Taucha e. V. in the city of Taucha. On August 28, 2026, the 21st edition of this city run will take place, which also incorporates the state championship in the 10 km road race. The event offers runners of all ages an attractive competition opportunity in a lively atmosphere. Registrations will be possible from February 2026.
course_highlights: Integrated state championship in the 10 km road race
City run through the city of Taucha
Traditional running event of the Athletics Club Taucha e. V.
additional: Registration opens in February 2026; the event also includes special competitions and city festival elements.

name: 32. Zeitzer Stadtlauf
description: The Zeitz City Run takes place in Moritzburg Castle Park Zeitz and is organized by SG Chemie Zeitz. The event begins at 9:15 AM with the start of the main races at 10:00 AM. The registration office is located in front of the main stage in the city park, and changing and shower facilities are available in the brick halls on Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is via Stephanstraße. The run offers a great opportunity to be active and enjoy the atmosphere in the castle park.
course_highlights: Run in the historic Moritzburg Castle Park Zeitz
Start of the main races at 10:00 AM
Changing and shower facilities in the nearby brick halls
additional: The registration office is located in front of the main stage in the city park. Changing and shower facilities are available in the brick halls on Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is via Stephanstraße. The race starts at 10:00 AM, with changing and shower facilities in the brick halls. The park entrance is via Stephanstraße. The weather in August is usually sunny, ideal for an outdoor run.

name: 37. Heideblütenlauf
description: The 37th Heideblütenlauf will take place on Saturday, August 29, 2026, in Schneverdingen and is a traditional running event held as part of the Heideblütenfest. The event is organized by TV Jahn Schneverdingen and offers runners of all ages the opportunity to experience the beautiful heathland scenery. The course runs through the picturesque surroundings and is supported by numerous volunteers and supporters ensuring smooth proceedings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Running courses through the heathland of Schneverdingen
Start in front of the town hall on Schulstraße
Event as part of the Heideblütenfest
additional: The event is supported by numerous local partners and helpers, including the town of Schneverdingen, the German Red Cross, the Johanniter, the Volunteer Fire Department, and the Heidekönigin. Certificates can be printed for all participants, including for children in the Bambino category. Registration is handled by TV Jahn Schneverdingen, with more details available on the website. Online registration begins on April 1, 2026. The start and finish are located on Schulstraße in front of the town hall, with results and certificates available online.

name: 39. Jever-Fun-Lauf
price_range: 4,00 € bis 36,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The 39th Jever-Fun-Run on August 29, 2026, is a traditional running event in Jever that brings together people of all ages and skill levels. The course runs through the city center past well-known landmarks and is lined with cheering spectators. The focus is on the enjoyment of movement and community, not competition. There are various runs for children, teenagers, and adults, including walking, corporate, and team categories, as well as a main race over 10 English miles.
course_highlights: Loop course of 2.864 km through downtown Jever
Course passes by well-known landmarks
Cheering spectators line the route
additional: The official functional shirt can be ordered until June 7, 2026, for 20.00 euros, afterwards for 25.00 euros (while supplies last). Merchandise items such as sports socks, caps, and multifunctional scarves are also available and can be picked up in Jever on Wednesdays. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until one hour before the respective start. The time limit for the main race (10 English miles) is 150 minutes. Multiple race categories, registration deadlines, start times, and other event details are available on the official website. The event takes place on August 29, 2026.

name: 8. Stolberger Schloss-Lauf
location: Schloss Stolberg, Stolberg im Harz, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Stolberg Castle Run 2026 is a charity run in the Südharz region with start and finish directly at the historic Stolberg Castle. The event offers various competitions for runners of all performance levels, including half marathon, relay, 10 km, 5 km, walking, as well as open and children's runs. The diverse routes lead through the historic old town, forest paths, and highlands of the Südharz, combining athletic challenge with scenic and cultural highlights. By participating, each runner supports regional projects in and around Stolberg, giving the run a special charitable character.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stolberg Castle with historic backdrop
Diverse routes through old town, forest paths, and highlands of the Südharz
Unique finish experience at the castle
additional: The event includes not only main races but also walking, open, and children's runs. Participation supports regional projects in and around Stolberg. Accommodation options are offered by Ritter von Kempski Private Hotels & Resorts directly in and around Stolberg. The race routes partly lead over unpaved and natural forest paths with associated risk of accidents. Multiple distances, children's races, relay race, support for regional projects, accommodation options nearby.

name: SUNSET Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is an exceptional relay race covering approximately 250 kilometers, running from Hamburg-St. Pauli to St. Peter-Ording. The route passes through the UNESCO World Heritage Site Wattenmeer National Park and offers breathtaking natural scenery, idyllic villages, and marshlands with a sea breeze. The event lasts over 24 hours and challenges teams of 5 or 10 runners to complete the course together. Start times are assigned based on the reported average pace, and digital course maps are provided before the race.
course_highlights: Approximately 250 km through the UNESCO World Heritage Site Wattenmeer National Park
Start in Hamburg St. Pauli, finish on the beach in St. Peter-Ording
Diverse natural reserves, marshlands, and sea breeze
additional: Participants must be born in 2010 or earlier (Ultra teams from 2008). Team sizes: 10-person teams (each runner covers 3 sections) or Ultra 5-person teams (each runner covers 6 sections). 5-pack teams are combined with a similar 5-pack team. Team categories are assigned automatically upon registration (men, women, diverse, mixed). For 10-person teams, 2 vans are required as team vehicles; for 5-person teams, 1 van. Start times are allocated based on the reported average pace. The event lasts over 24 hours. Digital course maps are provided before the event. The relay race includes various categories, participation is open from 2008 onwards, with detailed information on registration, costs, and procedures, including navigation with course maps.

name: Birklauf
description: The Birklauf of MTV Gelting 08 is a traditional race event taking place on August 29, 2026, starting at 3:45 PM in the Birkhalle Gelting. The event stands for sport, fun, and pure nature, offering runners of various age groups the opportunity to compete. Timing is provided on all routes except the Sprottenlauf over 750 meters, and all finishers receive a medal. The results are age group-specific, and there are awards for the top three runners.
course_highlights: Timing on all routes except Sprottenlauf 750 m
Results by age groups
Medal for all finishers
additional: Registrations are possible until August 22, 2026. The event is organized by MTV Gelting 1908 e.V. All finishers receive a medal, and awards are given to the top three places. The Sprottenlauf over 750 m is without timing. Routes pass through the Geltinger Birk nature reserve and Nordschauwald. Registration until August 22, 2026, race bibs from 3:00 PM, catering with fruit and drinks.

name: Edersee-Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1.2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Edersee Run is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup and will take place on August 29, 2026, in Vöhl-Herzhausen at Lake Eder. The race is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, an association that promotes sports and community for all age groups. The event is very popular and offers runners an attractive opportunity to engage in sports and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Eder. Pre-registration will start soon, and the club sincerely thanks its supporters and sponsors.
course_highlights: Various race distances for all age groups
Flat, fast courses at Lake Eder
Family and children runs included
additional: The race is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup. The event is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, which also offers other sports programs and training groups. The race bibs are supported by sponsors. Pre-registration for 2026 will start soon. Multiple race distances, family-friendly, event within the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup, start and finish at the Grillhütte Herzhausen.

name: Elstertal-Lauf
description: The Elstertal Run of the 1st SV Gera is a traditional race event with various course options for runners of all ages. On August 29, 2026, individual competitions over 10 km and 15 km as well as relay races for companies and students will take place. Additionally, there are children's runs and a challenging stair climb with approximately 1300 steps. The event is part of the Thuringian and Gera Running Cup series and offers a varied course through the region.
course_highlights: 15 km individual course for men, women, and youth
Company and student relays over 5 x 3 km with variable number of runners
2500 m stair climb with about 1300 steps
additional: Children's runs as part of the Osterland Cross (600 m, 800 m, 1000 m / 3 km). The relay competitions allow 2 to 5 runners per team; with 4 runners, one runs 6 km. The individual courses are part of the Thuringian and Gera Running Cup series. Multiple race types including stair climb; training plans and detailed information available.

name: Flörsheimer Lebenslauf
location: Flörsheim am Main, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The 15th Flörsheim Lifeline on August 29, 2026, is a traditional race commemorating the rescue from the plague in 1666. The approximately 10 km course runs in two laps from the Main Riverbank through Eddersheim, the city park, and the old town to the historic Gallusplatz, the finish. The motto "Remember - Run - Thank" reflects the religious and community character of the event. The proceeds benefit the support associations of Ried School and Paul-Maar School. In addition to the main race, there are also children’s and youth races offered without an entry fee.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course in two laps
Route from the Main Riverbank towards Eddersheim, through the city park and old town
Finish at the historic Gallusplatz, the center of Flörsheim
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective race without late registration fees at the Gallus Center at the race number distribution. There is a Bambini race (about 800 m) for children born in 2017 and younger without an entry fee, as well as a beginner and youth race over approximately 2.6 km for children born in 2018 and older without age category division. Children receive certificates and medals. The course is about 10 km, with multiple race categories. Online registration until August 27, 2026, on-site late registration possible.

name: Karlis Härtetest
description: The Karlis Härtetest is a traditional race organized by the Pretzsch Running Team. The race takes place annually in autumn near Leipzig and offers a challenging cross-country course that tests runners of all ages. The club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V. has a long history in running and promotes community and sporting ambition through this event. The event is known for its special atmosphere and the opportunity to prove oneself on a varied course.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country course at the Kanuzentrum near Leipzig
Various challenges for runners of all ages
Traditional event with strong club affiliation
additional: The organizer is the club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V., which also organizes other running events and challenges. There are no explicit details about start times, prize categories, or registration procedures on the searched pages. The race will take place on August 29, 2026, and is known for its demanding course and friendly atmosphere. It is suitable for both hobby runners and ambitious competitors.

name: Lauf rund um Tiefwarensee
description: The 20th race around Lake Tiefwarensee in Waren (Müritz) is a traditional running event taking place on August 29, 2026. Organized by Müritzer LSV, the course runs around the picturesque Lake Tiefwarensee and offers runners an attractive and varied running environment. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and is a regular feature of the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Tiefwarensee
Start and finish at the sports field at Lake Tiefwarensee, Güstrower Straße
Scenic route in Waren (Müritz)
additional: Registration address: Peter Hoffmann, Am Pappelgrund 10; Event number: 26V08000010060000; Category: remote stadium event (6.5.1) Registration deadline is August 27, 2026. The event is part of a regional running and nature experience program that highlights the beauty of Lake Tiefwarensee and the surrounding nature.

name: LimLauf 2026
description: The Limlauf takes place in 2026 for the 31st time in Limbach, Kirkel, and is one of the largest running events in the Saarpfalz district. Participants can choose between a traditional half marathon and a 2 km youth run for young runners. The course is officially measured, flat, and fast, allowing for quick times. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with award ceremonies, refreshments, and a varied accompanying program.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses with kilometer markings
Flat and fast course layout
4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for the youth run
additional: Online pre-registration is closed; late registrations on the event day are possible from 14:00 to 16:30 in the village hall. Changing rooms and showers are available for women in the village hall and for men in the school gymnasium. Medical assistance is available at the finish area and mobile on the course. Results are broadcast live on a large screen in the village hall. Parking is available at several locations with exits without crossing the course. Award ceremonies take place immediately after the races in the village hall. Registration on the event day begins at 14:00 in the village hall. Prizes are awarded for winners and team competitions. Parking is available at the school gymnasium, swimming pool, dog shelter, cemetery/Palatia. Medical services are on-site.

name: Maare Mosel Lauf
description: The Maare-Mosel Run is a scenic adventure race in the Eifel, taking place on August 29, 2026, in Gillenfeld. The course passes by mysterious maars, rugged rocks, and gently rolling hills, offering runners a unique natural experience with magnificent views. There are three main routes for beginners and professionals, as well as age-appropriate children's races. In addition to the sporting event, participants can enjoy an attractive supporting program with live music and award ceremonies.
course_highlights: Course past the deep blue Pulvermaar
Round trip around the Schalkenmehrener Maar with 240 meters of elevation
Scenic nature reserves Mürmes and Sangweiher
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site with a late registration fee of €5. Race bibs will be sent by mail upon registration until 7 days before the event; otherwise, they can be picked up on the day of the event from 15:00 at the school in Gillenfeld. There is a lively supporting program with live music and award ceremonies starting at 19:30. The races take place on the grounds around Gillenfeld's primary and secondary school plus. Three routes are available, including a 5 km route around Pulvermaar; scenic trail with elevation meters; online registration is possible.

name: Mindener Volkslauf
description: The Minden People's Run is the largest running event organized by SV 1860 Minden, with over 1,000 participants annually. On August 29, 2026, the 50th anniversary race will take place, featuring many new highlights along the course and in the stadium. Parallel to the anniversary, the club will celebrate the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden with numerous activities. The event offers a great atmosphere and an after-run party following the corporate run, inviting everyone to join in the celebration.
course_highlights: Course with new highlights and varied sections
Start and finish in the stadium with special atmosphere
After-Run Party after the corporate run
additional: The 50th Minden People's Run offers an after-run party following the corporate run. Registration is expected to open in May 2026. In 2025, 1,467 active participants reached the finish line. The event also celebrates the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden with many individual activities until the end of the year. The event takes place in August, with registration starting in May 2026. It is the largest event of the club with a special focus on community and anniversary celebrations.

name: Monte Sophia XXII und 65. HAG-Lauf
description: The Monte Sophia Mountain Run and the Heinrich-Antons Memorial Run (HAGL) are traditional scenic races in the Rhenish lignite mining area near Niederzier. The Monte Sophia Run covers 25 km with 380 meters of elevation gain and takes place over the Sophienhöhe, a former spoil heap with varied paths, distinctive natural and cultural points, and beautiful views. The HAGL offers a shorter alternative of 10 km, while the Broisterd Round with 5.3 km is also suitable for beginners. The event also includes children's runs and a 10 km walking route, making it ideal for landscape runners and marathon preparers.
course_highlights: 25 km Strecke mit 380 Höhenmetern über die Sophienhöhe
Markante Punkte wie Steinkompass, keltischer Baumkreis, Goldene Aue und Römerturm
Wechselnde Steigungen von sanft bis steil auf festen Kieswegen und Asphalt
additional: Umkleiden und Duschen sind in der Turnhalle nutzbar. Verpflegungsstellen mit Wasser, Tee, Obst und Cola sind auf der Strecke und im Ziel vorhanden. Kinder erhalten Medaillen und Urkunden, die ersten drei jeder Altersklasse erhalten Sachpreise. Doppelstarter erhalten für jeden Lauf eine separate Startnummer. Radbegleitung, Babyjogger, Hunde und Kopfhörer sind verboten. Landschaftslauf mit verschiedenen Strecken, inklusive Kinderläufe und Walking, im Rheinischen Braunkohlerevier, anspruchsvoll mit Steigungen

name: Mußbacher Eselshautlauf
location: Vereinsgelände des TV 1860 Mußbach e.V., Mußbach, Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The 3rd Mussbach Donkey Skin Run is a community race with four different distances, appealing to participants of all fitness levels. The courses lead over field paths and through the Ordenswald forest, with start and finish lines at the club grounds of TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. A special highlight is the after-run party with a DJ, accompanied by refreshments from a food truck and the economic committee. The event is secured by the German Red Cross and offers sanitary facilities as well as a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Courses over field paths and through the Ordenswald forest
Start and finish at the club grounds of TV 1860 Mußbach e.V.
After-Run-Party with DJ and refreshments from a food truck
additional: Race bib pickup on the day of the event from 3:30 PM in the gymnasium of TV 1860 Mußbach e.V. Sanitary facilities (toilets & showers) are available on the club grounds. Late registrations are possible on race day until 4:30 PM. The 10-kilometer run determines the city champion of Neustadt an der Weinstraße. All finishers receive a medal, and the top three in each age group receive an additional prize and a certificate. Courses through field paths and forest, online registration, late registration on race day possible, parking available, DLV-approved, participant limit 300, medals for all finishers, music and refreshments after the race.

name: Mühlhäuser Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtverwaltung Mühlhausen, Kreissportbund Mühlhausen, SV 1899 Mühlhausen e. V.
price_range: Schülerläufe: 1,00 Euro; Hauptläufe 5 km / 10 km: 6,00 Euro (Jugend), 12,00 Euro (Erwachsene)
description: The Mühlhäuser Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Mühlhausen, taking place annually since 1997. It offers a sporting contrast to the Mühlhäuser fair with three race distances of 1.7 km, 5 km, and 10 km, bringing together runners from the region. The start and finish points are traditionally at the Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. The event is organized in cooperation with the athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. and attracts approximately 800 to 1100 participants each year.
course_highlights: Three courses through the historic old town (1.7 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Start and finish at the Untermarkt in Mühlhausen
Established since 1997 with regional running community
additional: The race is traditionally held as part of the Mühlhäuser fair and is designed as a sporting contrast to the fair. Organization is in cooperation with the local athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. No prices or start times are published on the website. The start and finish are at the Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. Three distances: youth runs from 9:00 a.m., 1.7 km; main runs of 5 km and 10 km; online registration until August 22, 2025; accompanying program at the Untermarkt.

name: Panorama - Run - Bad Laasphe
location: Wabachstadion, Bad Laasphe, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Panorama Run in Bad Laasphe is a varied race as part of the SummerCityGames, organized by TV Laasphe. The course starts from the Wabachstadion and leads over paved paths and forest trails to the highest point of the route, featuring a challenging ascent and a predominantly downhill second half that offers a beautiful view. There is a 6 km youth/open race as well as a 12 km main race, which runs the course twice and thus presents a real challenge. The event also offers changing rooms and shower facilities directly at the sports field.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wabachstadion Bad Laasphe
Paved paths and forest trails with a steep ascent to the highest point
Predominantly downhill second half of the course with a beautiful view
additional: Late registrations are possible 60 minutes before the competition begins with a 3 € late registration fee. Bibs are issued at the club house on the sports field. Changing rooms and shower facilities are available at the sports field. Course description: 6 km and 12 km run, uphill and downhill, paved paths and forest trails; registration until 28.08.2025; late registration 60 minutes before start for a fee; start/finish at the sports field Bad Laasphe; changing rooms/shower available

name: Panoramalauf rund um die Burg Are
distance_verbose: Ultramarathon, 50 km, 50 km, 35 km, 33 km, 19 km, 16 km
price_range: 10,00 bis 24,00 Euro je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Panorama Run around Burg Are is a scenic cross-country race in the middle Ahr Valley, organized by Selbstläufer Altenahr e.V. and approved by the DLV. It offers a varied challenge with routes over 19 km, 35 km, and 57 km featuring panoramic paths, single trails, and some demanding ascents. The start and finish are at Martinshütte above Altenahr, where catering is also provided. The event takes place annually on the last Saturday in August and invites runners from near and far to enjoy the nature and landscape of the Ahr Valley.
course_highlights: Panoramic race routes with longer uphill and downhill sections
Use of the Red Wine Hiking Trail, Ahr Hiking Trail, and single trails
Routes pass over Schwedenkopf, Saffenburg, and Steinerberg (the roof of the Ahr Mountains)
additional: Aid stations provide water, tea, cola, fruit, cookies, chocolate, energy bars, bread, and potatoes (3x K19, 5x K35, 7x K57). Reusable cups are provided; participants are encouraged to bring their own to reduce waste. There is no official route security at road crossings; please cross carefully. Time limit for K35 and K57: 10.5 hours. The race is a landscape run with uphill and downhill sections, utilizing hiking trails and single trails, with multiple aid stations. Environmental awareness is promoted through the use of reusable cups. No official route security at traffic roads.

name: Salzbergener Raffinerielauf
description: The Salzbergen Refinery Run is a popular road race in the beautiful community of Salzbergen, taking place on August 29, 2026. Various distances are offered for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a school mile, a 5 km fun run, and a 10 km main race. The event is part of the EL-CUP and features exciting competitions as well as a lively supporting program for runners and spectators. The races start at the Salzbergen Secondary School and promote both individual and team competitions.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Salzbergen Secondary School
Distances: 600m Bambini run, 1700m school mile, 5km and 10km fun runs
Team competition in the main races
additional: Start times: first race at 14:30; 14:45 school mile; 15:15 5km fun run; 16:15 10km main race; 16:20 5km walking/nordic walking (without timing). Team competition for timed races, teams consist of 3 participants. Registration on-site until 45 minutes before each race, late registration fee 1.00 Euro. Race documents can be picked up from approximately 13:15 at the on-site race office. Races with team scoring, online registration, supporting program, trophies, and medals.

name: Umpfertallauf
description: The 13th Umpfertallauf offers various running courses, including the 10 km main run, a 10 km relay race, a 5 km hobby run, as well as children's and toddler races. The flat turnaround course with approximately 33 meters of elevation is also ideal for less experienced runners. The event starts early Saturday evening with start and finish at the marketplace and leads along the bike path to Schweigern. The award ceremony takes place in the festival tent and rounds off the sporting event.
course_highlights: Flat turnaround course with approximately 33 meters of elevation
Course along the bike path to Schweigern
View of vineyards and Weikersheim Castle
additional: Start and finish at the marketplace, event on early Saturday evening, award ceremony in the festival tent, Nordic walking possible on the 5 km route, various race classes at the fire brigade run in Löffelstelzen, weather in August around 25°C, sunny; start at the marketplace in Unterschüpf; participation suitable for all age groups

name: Wixhäuser Kerblauf
description: The Wixhäuser Kerblauf is a traditional community run held on the last Saturday in August in Wixhausen near Darmstadt. The event offers races for various age groups and performance levels with a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is predominantly paved, flat, and runs through residential areas as well as open fields. In addition to individual rankings, there is also a team competition for the 4 km and 6 km runs. The event is organized by TSG Wixhausen and is very popular among runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Asphalted, flat course without inclines
4 km run with two laps, 6 km run with three laps
Course runs about one-third through residential area and two-thirds over open fields
additional: Medals for the top three finishers in all age groups in runs 1-4, trophies for overall winners in runs 5 and 6. All participants receive a certificate. T-shirts as prizes for runs 1-4 for registrations by 30.07.2026, finisher shirts for adults available for an additional charge. Team competition for 4 km and 6 km runs with at least 3 participants per team. Team names can be assigned up to 30 minutes before the start. Registration until July 30, 2026, finisher shirts for an extra fee, team rankings, results available at Race Result.

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz" is a nature-oriented community run in Eichsfeld that appeals to runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied courses lead through breathtaking natural landscapes around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for both experienced runners and beginners. In addition to the sporting competition, the sense of community is at the forefront, supported by an attractive accompanying program at the sports field. The run is part of the Eichsfeldcup and is organized by SG Birkungen 07.
course_highlights: Nature-oriented courses around the Dünkreuz
Diverse competitions for young and old (400 m to 10 km)
Part of the renowned Eichsfeldcup
additional: There are 4 courses with 5 competitions: Bambini-Run (400 m), Youngster-Run (1.5 km), 6-K-Run (6 km run/nordic walking), and 10-K-Run (10 km run). The event promotes community spirit and offers an accompanying program at the sports field. Results from previous years are available at my.raceresult.com. Forest paths, fields, elevation gain, Nordic walking, course signage, medical services, transponder timing, community program.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover
location: Eilenriede Park, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Eilenriederennen Hannover is an established summer running event that takes place through the green lung of the state capital Lower Saxony. The popular race is offered in three different distances: 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon. The course is officially measured, mostly asphalted, and nearly flat, allowing for fast times. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere with musical entertainment in the beer garden and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass series of the Hanover region.
course_highlights: 100% asphalted course except for a small U-turn on unpaved paths at the 5 km distance
Loop course to the forest station and back to the zoo and Lister Tower
Course is flat and officially measured except for crossing the Messe Schnellweg
additional: Number bib distribution on the day before (29.08.2026) from 15:00 to 17:00 at the Lister Tower beer garden is recommended to avoid delays. Late registrations are possible online until 29.08.2026 14:30 and on-site without surcharge, provided the race is not fully booked. Refreshment points at km 3, 5, 7, and 10 with water, isotonic drinks, and energy gels; at the finish line with watermelons and drinks. Timing is done with a chip integrated into the start number. The event location is the district center Lister Tower, Walderseestr. 100, Hannover. Recommended travel by bicycle or public transport (city train lines 3, 7, 9, stop Lortzingstraße). The course is officially measured, with refreshment points at km 3, 5, 7, 10, and at the finish; registration online or on-site; bib distribution at the Lister Tower beer garden; the event takes place in summer.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
location: Bezirkssportanlage am Windmühlenberg, Fallersleben, Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf will take place on August 30, 2026, in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg) at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is organized by VfB Fallersleben and offers runners of various age groups and performance levels the opportunity to participate in a traditional race.
