Refreshment points with seating and sandwiches, finish buffet. Awards ceremony for the top three women and men in the running competitions at 12:00 p.m. (10 km and half marathon) and 2:30 p.m. (marathon). Marchers receive patches to sew on. Routes in forested areas, refreshment points, patches for marchers, online certificates, award ceremonies, parking, showers & changing rooms in the sports hall, travel by train.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
location: Obermühle, Bad Düben, Landkreis Nordsachsen, Sachsen, Germany
description: The Dübener Heidelauf is a traditional forest run held at the picturesque Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in North Saxony. Organized by SV Bad Düben, the event offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults. With distances ranging from 500 meters to the half marathon (21.1 km), the race appeals to both young runners and experienced long-distance athletes. The run is part of the regional athletics structure for North Saxony and Leipzig and is characterized by its family-friendly, club-oriented nature.
course_highlights: Forest run through the Dübener Heide
Course lengths from 500 m to 21.1 km (half marathon)
Event location at Obermühle in Bad Düben
additional: The race takes place in typical September weather with an average temperature of 19 °C (lowest 10 °C) and mostly cloudy skies. The event includes age groups from under 8 years to adults and is not a commercial large-scale event but a regional club race. Cross-country/forest terrain, races for various age groups, regional club event.

name: ebm-papst Marathon
price_range: 12€ für Erwachsene, 8€ für Kinder (Laufshirts, bei Anmeldung mitbestellt)
description: The ebm-papst Marathon in Niedernhall is a traditional running event taking place on September 12 and 13, 2026, for the 29th time. The event offers various disciplines such as marathon, half marathon, duo marathon, relay marathon, 10 km run, handbike, and inline skating, as well as children's races and Nordic walking. The course runs through the scenic region and provides an exciting experience for runners of all performance levels. In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a diverse supporting program with shows, children's care, and a pasta party. Every finisher receives a medal and can download a free finish-line photo.
course_highlights: Variety of disciplines: marathon, half marathon, duo and relay marathon, 10 km, handbike, inline skating
Scenic course through and around Niedernhall
Supporting program with shows, children's care, and a runner's service
additional: Late registrations are possible on September 12 and 13, 2026, until one hour before the start on-site. There is a pasta party with a fee of 8 € (cash only). Sustainable running shirts can be ordered for 12 € (children 8 €) additionally. Every finisher receives a medal and a free finish-line photo for download. Free clothing storage, showers, and massages are available on-site. Children's care from age 3 is available from 07:30 to 14:30. Runner's service with a church service on Sunday at 08:00. Relay exchange on Facebook to find running partners for the duo marathon. Various race distances, family event, children's races, inline skaters, handbikers, supporting program, sustainable running shirts.

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Folk and Family Run is aimed at active families who want to spend a lovely day running together. The focus is on fun and the joy of running, without competitive pressure. The event offers a friendly atmosphere for all age groups and promotes movement within the community.
course_highlights: Running routes over 3 km and 6 km
Family-friendly event
Start location in Eicklingen
additional: Typical weather in September: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. The event is ideal for families who want to run together and offers a relaxed, communal atmosphere. The weather in September can affect the running enjoyment but is generally pleasant.

name: Erzhäuser Heegbachlauf
description: The Erzhausen Heegbachlauf is a traditional running event organized by the Kaltduscher in Erzhausen for nearly 30 years. The goal is to offer an affordable yet high-quality running experience for all age and performance levels. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, careful organization, and a cult clothing item as a keepsake. Despite modern timing and logistics, the original spirit and special community remain intact.
course_highlights: Courses from 0.5 km to 6.4 km
Family-friendly atmosphere and cult clothing item
Charity run and community activities
additional: The event offers a cult clothing item (KKK) as a finisher keepsake, which is redesigned annually. The organization is modeled after major city marathons but keeps the entry fees low. The event is supported by long-standing sponsors, enabling high-level execution. Cult clothing item, medals, modern logistics, online registration

name: Freundschaftslauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km
description: The Friendship Run of the Bisttal-Runners Wadgassen is a running event that offers beautiful loop courses through the Wadgasser Forest. The route is suitable for both runners and walkers and passes through partly well-known, partly less frequented single trails. The event is aimed at recreational athletes from the region and provides a pleasant atmosphere for all performance levels.
course_highlights: Loop courses through the Wadgasser Forest
Suitable for runners and walkers
Partly well-known, partly less frequented single trails
additional: The Bisttal-Runners running group meets every Sunday at 10:30 AM at the Wadgassen Newspaper Museum. Participation is free and not tied to club membership. There are no fixed performance goals; everyone runs at their own pace, and the distance is chosen individually. Runs on loop courses through the forest, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, internal club events.

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteicher Volkslauf, organized by the Sports Club 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim, known as a good preparatory course for the Frankfurt Marathon. The route has been safety-optimized so that no federal roads or railway tracks need to be crossed. There are a total of seven refreshment stations with water, cola, and tea, and after the race, participants can enjoy excellent catering. The bib number distribution takes place on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before at the Sports and Culture Hall Garbenteich.
course_highlights: Safe route without crossing federal roads or railway tracks
Seven refreshment stations with water, cola, and tea
Routes of moderate difficulty with moderate elevation gain
additional: Bib numbers and transponders can be collected on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before between 16:00 and 17:00. Late registrations are possible on the event day until race start for an additional fee of 5 EUR. Changes to other distances are free of charge up to two days before the race. The route is marked and checked multiple times before the start. The race takes place on September 13, 2026, starting behind the Sports and Culture Hall Garbenteich. There is no club affiliation requirement, and the event is ideal for marathon preparation.

name: Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf
description: The Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf is a challenging mountain run that starts from Sägwasenplatz in Bad Herrenalb and leads to the Hahnenfalzhütte. The course covers 6 kilometers with an elevation gain of 519 meters, including steep ramps and gravel paths. The race is a traditional event organized by the Skizunft Bad Herrenalb and offers runners a demanding and scenic route in the heights above the Albursprung. The event combines athletic challenge with a convivial hut festival at the Hahnenfalzhütte.
course_highlights: 6 km course with 519 meters of elevation
Steep ramps and up to 21% incline
Path through the Felsenmeer and over gravel paths
additional: The race is traditionally held in conjunction with the Hahnenfalzhüttenfest. The course is partly wet and challenging, with ramps up to 21% incline. The Hahnenfalzhütte is located at 876 meters above sea level and is the finish line of the race. Participants range from young to old, with a broad age group from 14 to 78 years. The race is known for its elevation gain and steep inclines, with a festive event at the Hahnenfalzhütte including refreshments.

name: Hattinger Hüttenlauf
description: The Hattinger Hüttenlauf is a traditional race in HenrichsPark in Hattingen, offering various running and walking routes for all age groups. The course runs along footpaths with cobblestones, gravel, and asphalt beside the park ponds, starting and finishing under Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Museum Henrichshütte. In addition to the competitive race, there are classifications for children, youth, the fun run, and the 10 km Sparkassenlauf, as well as awards for the largest groups and the fastest Hattingen runners. The event is family-friendly and provides all participants with certificates for printing online.
course_highlights: Course in HenrichsPark along footpaths with cobblestones, gravel, and asphalt
Start and finish under Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Museum Henrichshütte
Race along the park ponds
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before each start. All children in the Bambini race receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online by all participants. There are classifications in age groups and awards for the largest groups (schools, clubs) as well as for the fastest Hattingen runners. Various race distances, online registration, supporters from sports and business sectors.

name: Holzlandlauf
description: The Holzlandlauf is a traditional race in the Holzland near Hermsdorf, held annually on the second Saturday in September. Starting in 2026, the race will be part of the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), which grants the courses international recognition and makes the athletes' performances visible worldwide. The event offers various distances, including 5 km, 11 km, and a half marathon, passing through the beautiful nature of the Holzland. The race is suitable for both ambitious trail runners and hobby runners and provides a special atmosphere in the region.
course_highlights: Trail runs through the Holzland with international ITRA recognition
Courses along the Birkenlinie to Bad Klosterlausnitz
Various distances: 5 km, 11 km, and half marathon
additional: Registration is via Laufservice Jena with SEPA direct debit. On race day, late registrations are accepted until 9:30 AM. Start times are staggered, with the first start at 8:30 AM at Werner-Seelenbinder-Sporthalle in Hermsdorf. In 2025, the routes were relocated due to timber harvesting, resulting in longer distances. Available distances include 800 m, 1.6 km, 11 km, half marathon, walking/nordic walking; refreshment stations; medals and certificates; no participation with dogs except assistance dogs; no political or discriminatory advertising.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a traditional running event in Kiel featuring various competitions for all age groups. The main discipline is the half marathon over 21.1 kilometers, which runs through the Kieler Westen and attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes. The popular race over 10.2 kilometers is the most participated event and offers a loop through Kiel city center with great atmosphere. Additionally, there are shorter runs for students and children, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: Half marathon runs through Kieler Westen
Popular race through Kiel city center
Various distances from about 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 AM, the popular race at 9:45 AM. Due to construction work, there may be short-term route changes, which will be announced in advance. The event is very well attended with over 10,000 runners. There are various races for students and children, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures, participant information, and offers functional running shirts for most categories.

name: Kristall Lauf Weißwasser

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voranmeldung ist bis zum 05. September 2025 23:59 Uhr online über den Baer-Service möglich

description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a versatile popular race that appeals to runners and walkers of all ages. The course runs through mixed terrain including asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, and forest trails with roots. The race is part of several regional rankings such as the Dresden District Ranking, the Sachsenenergie Runner Cup, and the Niederlausitz Cup, and also offers an official walking classification by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which promotes community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, forest trail with roots
Part of regional rankings: Dresden District Ranking, Sachsenenergie Runner Cup, Niederlausitz Cup
Official walking classification by the German Athletics Association
additional: Registrations on race day are possible on-site with an additional fee of €6 (2025) or €4 (2024). The race includes individual and team classifications. The routes are marked and binding on race day. The event is open to all age groups from children to seniors. Terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, forest trail with roots; team race with at least three runners; start at Bruno-Bürgel-Oberschule; registration on-site or online.

name: LAUF FÜR MEHR ZEIT
location: Opernplatz, Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany
description: The charity run RUN FOR MORE TIME is a well-established sporting and social event in Frankfurt am Main. Recreational runners, top athletes, and celebrities compete together on a circular course through downtown Frankfurt. Besides the athletic competition, fundraising and the joy of collective engagement are the main focus. The run offers five different distances for all age groups, from the toddler run to the 10-kilometer race, with start and finish at Opernplatz.
course_highlights: Circular course through downtown Frankfurt
5-kilometer large loop, 10-kilometer run with two laps
Refreshments with water on the course provided by the Frankfurt Running Shop
additional: Start numbers with electronic timing. Number pickup at Opernplatz on 12.09.2026 from 13:00 to 16:00 and on race day at various times depending on the race. The races take place sequentially with separate timing, starting gun, and finish line. Recommended arrival via U-Bahn station Alte Oper or parking garage Alte Oper; parking options are limited. Various race distances, registration until 01.09.2026, refreshments on the course, no showers, late registration possible.

name: Maiwaldlauf
description: The Maiwaldlauf in Rheinau-Freistett is a traditional community run organized by SV Freistett. The event offers runners and walkers an attractive course through nature around the Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion. The race is part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie and is aimed at recreational athletes of all ages. The family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized procedures make the Maiwaldlauf a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Courses through the Maiwald and surrounding nature
Start and finish at Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion
Part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie
additional: The Maiwaldlauf includes various distances, including 10 km run and 5 km run as well as walking. Detailed course maps and information about the individual routes are available on the website. The event is embedded in the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie. Organization is carried out by the recreational sports department of SV Freistett with contacts such as Alexander Dahlke and Regina Huber. The event takes place in September, with average temperatures around 19°C, and offers not only running competitions but also Nordic walking and hiking.

name: Miltenberger Landkreis Lauftag
location: Schul- und Sportzentrum, Elsenfeld, Miltenberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Miltenberg County Running Day on September 13, 2026, offers a variety of running competitions for different age and performance groups. The courses lead through the Elsenfelder State Forest and along the old Spessart steam railway track, with scenic and mostly flat sections. All participants receive T-shirts, and the top runners are awarded with prizes. The event is ideal for runners seeking a well-organized and nature-oriented running event.
course_highlights: Half marathon with 2/3 paved road and 1/3 forest floor
Scenic course through the Elsenfelder State Forest and along the Spessart steam railway track
Loop courses with minimal elevation change and pleasant running character
additional: Catering on the course and at the finish line with drinks from Rhön-Sprudel; award ceremony before the Untermainhalle; all participants receive a T-shirt upon bib submission; special prizes for new course records. Registration available from May 1, 2026; diverse running offerings; start at the school and sports center in Elsenfeld.

name: Nibelungenlauf
description: The Nibelungenlauf in Worms is a traditional running event held annually on the second Sunday in September. The event offers a diverse program with races over various distances, embedded in a cultural framework along the Rhine promenade near the Hagendenkmal and Kriemhilds Rosengarten. Since 2004, over 44,000 participants from many nations have taken part, highlighting the popularity and international character of the event. The race is suitable for beginners and professionals alike and creates a special running experience in the Nibelungen city with its atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the newly designed Rhine promenade near the Hagendenkmal and Kriemhilds Rosengarten
Three turnaround routes with clear route markings: Half Marathon (blue), 10 km (red), and 5 km (green)
Run through the historic Nibelungen city of Worms with enthusiastic spectators and cultural program
additional: The event begins on Saturday with various activities and ends on Sunday with the races and award ceremony at the Hagendenkmal. There is a team classification, and participants under 18 years old require a parental consent form. Event shirts and hoodies can be ordered during registration. The event often fills up before the registration deadline. Registration is possible online, with deadlines on September 6, 2026, and options for team registrations and event shirts. The start and finish area is the Nibelungenlauf Arena on the Rhine.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event with start and finish at the youth and school farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers various distances from 0.5 km up to the half marathon of 21.1 km, which is run as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon through several towns. The race allows participants to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on diverse routes. Approximately 350 runners participate annually, highlighting the growing popularity of the event.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode, and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the youth and school farm at Gutshof Othal
Various distances from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 AM for the half marathon, 09:45 AM for 10 km run/walking, 10:00 AM for 5 km run/walking, 10:05 AM for 0.5 km run, 10:15 AM for 1 km run, 10:30 AM for 2 km run. Routes for children, hobby runners, and competitive runners; start and finish area at the youth and school farm at Gutshof Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessau Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a traditional race in the city center of Dessau, attracting runners from the region and beyond for many years. The course runs on a loop through central streets of the city with start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban environment and is part of a diverse sports program organized by the club Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organizing major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Loop course through the city center of Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Course route via Steinstraße, Askanische Straße, and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children's run for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 meters, free for all children and students of Dessau. The organizer is the club Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organizing numerous major sports events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children's runs, corporate run, registration on-site possible, finisher medals.

name: Run for life
location: Vorplatz des Bayerischen Nationalmuseums, München, Bayern, Germany
description: The Run for Life is a charity run established in 2001 in support of the Munich AIDS Help e.V. On September 13, 2026, the 26th edition of this popular race approved by the DLV will take place. The run starts at 2:00 PM at the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum in Munich and leads along a well-known route through the English Garden. The event is under the patronage of Munich's Lord Mayor Dominik Krause and combines athletic commitment with social engagement.
course_highlights: Start at the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum / Prinzregentenstraße
Run through the English Garden
Famous and proven race route
additional: Registration for Run for Life 2026 opens from June 15. Participation is not allowed for individuals spreading the technology of L. Ron Hubbard. The event relies on volunteers who assist as course marshals, during setup and takedown, or in children's care. Payments can also be made on the day of the event if the participant limit has not been reached. Charity run, registration from mid-June, start at 2:00 PM, run through the English Garden.

name: runroll City
description: The event runroll City takes place on September 13, 2026, in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sports experience on a 7.2-kilometer flat course right in the city. The course is ideal for quick times and suitable for both intensive running training and a fast competition. Participants can enjoy movement in an urban environment and become part of a dynamic event.
course_highlights: 7.2 kilometer long course
flat course for fast times
urban race in the heart of Bielefeld
additional: The event is known for its inclusive atmosphere and the opportunity to run or skate. It is aimed at everyone who enjoys movement in the city and offers an attractive route in downtown Bielefeld.

name: Seewooglauf
description: The Seewooglauf in Ramstein-Miesenbach is organized by FV Olympia Ramstein and offers races over 10 km and 5 km as well as a 5 km walking competition. The event takes place on September 13, 2026, and is open to runners and walkers of all performance levels. The course runs through the scenic surroundings around Ramstein and provides a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km race courses
5 km walking route
Event location Reichswaldsporthalle in Ramstein-Miesenbach
additional: Starting fees from €7, registration until 30 minutes before the start, results online, small surprises for children's races

name: Sindiso-Spendenlauf
location: Hof von Walter Jahn, Zeitlarn, Bavaria, Germany
price_range: 20 Euro für Laufshirt, Spenden ab 20 Euro für Teilnahme
description: The Sindiso Charity Run on September 13, 2026, in Zeitlarn is a community event that combines running, celebration, and fundraising. The event takes place at Walter Jahn's farm and offers races for children and adults as well as a lively festival with many attractions for kids. Besides the sporting experience, supporting the educational project in Rabuor/Kenya is the main focus. Food and drinks are provided, and there are various entertainment options such as a children's train, face painting, and vehicle exhibitions.
course_highlights: 10 km run consisting of 2 laps of 5 km each
Attractions for children such as children's train and face painting
Vehicle exhibition by Wasserwacht Neutraubling, Voluntary Fire Brigade Laub, and BRK Barbing/Neutraubling
additional: The Sindiso running shirt can be purchased on race day for 20 euros after ordering via online registration. There are races for different age groups and disciplines, including 400 m toddler farm run, 1.5 km children's run, 5 km run, 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic walking. The event begins with a large party from 11:00 am and offers a variety of food and a colorful program. 10 km run (2 x 5 km), family activities, children's program, vehicle exhibition, and donations for the educational project in Kenya.

name: Stiftungslauf Salzgitter
description: The Foundation Run at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event taking place on September 13, 2026. The event offers various race competitions, including two main runs, a relay race, a short run, and walking. The start is at 10:30 AM at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt. The Salzgitter Foundation invites all running enthusiasts to join in and enjoy the fun of movement together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee
Various race competitions: main runs, relay race, short run, walking
Run along Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt
additional: The event includes two main runs, a relay race, a short run, and walking. For questions, the organizer can be reached by phone at 0172/5416779. Event at Salzgittersee with main runs, relay race, short run, and walking.

name: TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. - Wuzzelauf Altenhain
description: The Wuzzelauf Altenhain is a charity run held annually since 2008, organized by TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. It continues a local tradition where residents of the Main Taunus district refer to each other with nicknames, especially "Wuzze" for Altenhainer. The run combines athletic commitment with regional history and community spirit. The event takes place on September 13, 2026, and invites runners of all ages to participate in this special event.
course_highlights: Traditional connection to regional nickname culture
Run through the community of Altenhain in the Main Taunus district
Event as a charity run with local relevance
additional: The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in September. The proceeds benefit various charitable causes, including support for people with disabilities in the Rhein-Main area. Registration and further details are available on the official website.

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, mostly on a voluntary basis and with great passion. With around 12,000 participants, over 300 artists and bands along the route, and more than 100,000 spectators, the autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost flat and runs through the bike- and run-friendly city of Münster. At the finish area on the Prinzipalmarkt, a red carpet is rolled out, making the finish line a special experience.
course_highlights: Course almost flat
Over 300 artists and bands along the route
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a large event with several competitions such as Atruvia Relay Marathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity Run (10 km), and H+B technics Health Run (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is staffed on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 am to 3:00 pm. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts about 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as lectures and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th Forest Run of TuS Calle-Wallen is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup and takes place on September 13, 2026, in Meschede. The event offers races over 1 km and 10 km and is aimed at runners of all ages. The race leads through the forested areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. The typical weather in September is mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the forested areas around Meschede
Course lengths of 1 km and 10 km
Natural and varied running route
additional: The typical weather in September is around 19°C with lows of about 10°C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, with typical weather around 19°C and overcast skies. It is a good opportunity for the whole family to participate in a traditional race.

description: The Wehratallauf is a traditional running event that has been held annually in September in Wehr since 1990. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, including a main race over 10.2 km, Nordic Walking over 8.6 km, a student race over 2.87 km, and a children's race over 750 m. The runs take place directly at the Frankenmattstadion and in the surrounding area. A special focus is on the charity aspect, as part of the start fees are donated to the Förderverein für krebskranke Kinder Freiburg e.V.
course_highlights: Main race 10.2 km through the surroundings of Frankenmattstadion
Nordic Walking route 8.6 km
Student race 2.87 km and children's race 750 m
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 1 hour before the respective start (except for the children's race) with an additional fee of €5. Electronic timing is provided via integrated transponders in the bib numbers. Changing and shower facilities are available. There is a team classification and special prizes for clubs with the most participants. Parking is limited, especially on Industriestraße. The event will take place on September 13, 2026, with online registration, transponder bibs, prizes for the fastest runners, and course record prizes. Donations for children with cancer are also collected.

name: Wemdinger Stadtlauf
description: The Wemding City Run invites runners of all ages to explore the historic old town of Wemding and the scenic landscape on the edge of the Ries. A special highlight is the panoramic run to the pilgrimage church Maria Brünnlein, combining athletic challenge with impressive views. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. Timing is done electronically via transponders in the bibs, and there is an award ceremony on the stage at the marketplace.
course_highlights: Run through the historic old town of Wemding
Panoramic run to the pilgrimage church Maria Brünnlein with views into the Ries
Start and finish at the marketplace in the town center
additional: Race bibs and late registrations are available on the event day until 30 minutes before each start at the competition office at the Geopark information point at the marketplace. Children's run without timing and results; all children's and school runs receive medals. Timing for other runs is via transponders in the bibs. Parking is available at Johannisweiher, access via Wolferstädter Straße. Various race distances, medals, material prizes, group prizes, children's and school runs, group training before the event.

name: wep-Lauf
organizer: WEP Intersport Engels / Ralf Sester / TuS Jahn Hilfarth
description: The wepLAUF in Hückelhoven is a versatile sporting event with a family festival character, taking place on September 13, 2026. Offered are courses from the marathon to short distances for children, including a Flexi-Marathon, where participants can decide after each lap whether to continue. The start and finish area is located at Breteuilplatz, and the event includes not only the running program but also a lively supporting program with a bouncy castle, stage entertainment, and stalls. The event particularly promotes participation by children and adolescents with a school ranking. The surrounding streets are closed during the run, and free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center.
course_highlights: Marathon lap is completed four times, half-marathon lap twice
Flexi-Marathon with individual distance and certificate after completing the run
Start and finish area at Breteuilplatz, streets closed during the run

The event combines athletic activity with corporate health promotion and a professional program including moderation and music.

Runners can choose between a 1 km race for children, 5 km, and 10 km routes that lead through the illuminated city center with sights such as the Opera Square, the Lower Saxony State Parliament, Kröpcke, and the New Town Hall. The atmosphere at night makes the run particularly appealing, creating an unforgettable experience. There is a 10 km SpeedRUN for the fastest runners, where the goal is to finish in under 50 minutes. course_highlights: 5 km circular course through downtown Hannover
Passing illuminated sights such as the Opera Square, State Parliament, Kröpcke, and Town Hall
Evening start with a special atmosphere at night

name: Kassel Marathon

The event offers a variety of competitions such as marathon, half marathon, power walking, relay, corporate run, and children's races. The marathon course includes 200 meters of elevation gain and runs through the city of Kassel. Participants receive a finisher medal and a free finisher shirt. Medical support for runners is provided by the German Red Cross, and there is a massage service after the race.
course_highlights: Marathon course with 200 meters of elevation
Start and finish at Auestadion Kassel
Various competitions from marathon to children's run

description: The Belchen Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race covering 11.4 km with an elevation gain of 824 meters, running from Schönau in the Black Forest to the Belchen Hotel. About 80% of the race passes through open terrain with pasture areas, offering impressive views of Feldberg, the Kleine and Große Wiesental valleys, and the Swiss Alps. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, and is part of the Black Forest Mountain Running Cup. Participants receive a free return transport via cable car and bus, as well as luggage transport to the Belchen.

description: The Black Forest ULTRA Trail Run offers five challenging courses in the heart of the Black Forest, leading runners on narrow trails, steep climbs, and technically demanding sections through an impressive landscape. The routes are characterized by changing segments with breathtaking views, demanding elevation gains, and an unmistakable Black Forest character. Whether it's the 76 km ultra-trail with seven aid stations and drop bag service or the 55 km course with rugged, varied terrain – here trail runners experience an uncompromising adventure. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and promises an unforgettable experience for all who want to discover the Black Forest in its full diversity.

There are dedicated runs for children and adolescents with personalized timing, catering, and medals. Participants benefit from a luggage depot at the finish area and a friendly atmosphere on the Eastern Alb.
course_highlights: Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail: 32 km trail running with 1100 meters of elevation, starting underground in the Tiefen Stollen visitor mine
VR Bank-BraunenBerg-Run: 14.6 km technically easy mountain run with 446 meters of elevation

description: The Garrel Freimarktslauf is the largest community run in the region and offers a diverse running experience with its flat loop courses for young and old, beginners and professionals. The event includes distances from 400 meters for children to 10 kilometers for main races, which take place on a 2.5 km flat loop through Garrel. In addition to the athletic competition, community and fun are the main focus, supported by the RunClub Garrel, which specifically promotes beginners. Over 1,300 participants make the race a popular event with unforgettable moments.
course_highlights: Flat 2.5 km loop course through Garrel
All main races on the same loop with 1, 2, or 4 laps
Varied distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: The race offers a combined scoring for 5 km and 10 km runs. There are special races for children and adolescents, including a children's run, a taster run, and a school children’s run. The RunClub Garrel supports beginners and re-entrants with joint training sessions. The event is a large community celebration with over 1,300 participants and numerous photos and results available online. The race includes various distances and is open to runners of all ages. Registration is online, and the event is part of regional festivities.

name: Insellauf Rund um Amrum
location: Norddorf auf Amrum, Nordfriesland, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Island Run around Amrum is a popular running event for everyone, taking place annually in late summer on the North Sea island of Amrum in Norddorf. The event offers a sporting challenge amidst the unique nature of the Wadden Sea National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Participants can enjoy the varied landscape with dunes, Kniepsand (a type of sandy beach), and sea views. The race is an attractive opportunity for both locals and vacationers to combine activity and nature experience.
course_highlights: Run through the diverse landscape with Kniepsand and dunes
Course within the Wadden Sea National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Start and finish in Norddorf on Amrum
additional: The island run takes place annually in late summer. The event is part of the extensive sports program on Amrum. The venue is the AOK-Nordseeklinik Strunwai 23 in Norddorf on Amrum. The event occurs within the Wadden Sea National Park area and emphasizes nature experience and beach activities. Registration is possible on-site or via email, with catering and support from local partners.

name: Int. Bodensee-Marathon
location: Kressbronn am Bodensee, Bodenseekreis, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The International Lake Constance Marathon in Kressbronn am Bodensee is a traditional running event with over 50 years of history. The course takes place on a circular route through the town center, along the Argen river, and by the Lake Constance shoreline, with marathon runners completing two half-marathon laps. The event offers an attractive combination of sporting challenge and scenic beauty in a natural environment. Finishers receive wooden medals, and a high-quality finisher shirt can be optionally ordered. Alongside the race, a popular street festival with music, culinary offerings, and a flea market takes place.
course_highlights: Circular course through Kressbronn starting on the main street
Loop of approximately 12 km along the Argen on shaded nature trails
Marathon consists of two half-marathon laps with finish line in front of the festival hall
additional: Finishers receive wooden medals. The high-quality finisher shirt (Puma, dark blue) can be ordered for €30 during registration, with pickup on site or at the equipment partner. Shuttle service from the beach park parking lot to the festival hall is offered. Late registrations are possible on race day (8:30-11:00 am, Kids Run until 10:00 am) with a €5 late registration fee, except for Kids Run and fully booked half-marathon. The Kressbronn street festival with live music, culinary offerings, and flea market takes place on the event day in the town center. The event provides a pleasant running atmosphere, support from numerous sponsors, a shuttle bus option, and the opportunity to donate to the Kressbronn swimming pool.

name: Int. Pronsfelder Volks- und Straßenlauf
description: The 38th International Pronsfelder Folk and Street Run offers a diverse running experience in the heart of the Eifel for all age groups and performance levels. From Bambini and children's races to the general run and half marathon, there is something for everyone. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, attractive prizes, and excellent catering at the finish area. The start and finish are located at the Mais-Glandien car dealership in Pronsfeld, and the run is a sporting highlight with tradition and community spirit.
course_highlights: Diverse routes from 200 m to half marathon (21 km)
Start and finish at Mais-Glandien car dealership, Lünebacher Str. 1 - 3, 54597 Pronsfeld
Participation in the 4-Regio-Cup in the 10 km main race
additional: Medals and gifts for Bambini and children/youth. Prizes, bouquets, and vouchers in the main race. Each Nordic walking participant receives a gift. Catering and drinks at the finish area. Event with a family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. The event takes place on September 19, 2026. Online registration available. Various distances including walking and half marathon. Catering and atmosphere at the finish area.

name: Kapuziner-Kessellauf
description: The Kapuziner Kessellauf is a traditional race through the Kessel and the Kulmbach Forest, starting at the Weiher Sports Center. Since its revival in 2002, it has been a fixed part of the Upper Franconian race calendar. In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, coffee and cake, a finish buffet, and a large raffle. The event is especially family-friendly with the children's and school runs, which award medals to all participants. The event also promotes community spirit through team rankings and awards for the most participating teams.
course_highlights: Run through the Kessel and the Kulmbach Forest
Start at the Weiher Sports Center
Family-friendly children's and school runs with medals
additional: Late registrations are possible until 19.09.2026 at 9:00 PM for a fee of 5 euros. Team rankings are only for the main race, separated by men and women. The most participating team will be awarded a material prize. For Nordic walking, timing is provided without finish placement. The supporting program includes music, coffee & cake, a finish buffet, children's care, finisher medals for the school and children runs, and a large raffle. The course runs through forest and woodland paths. Children's and school runs, supporting program with music, coffee & cake, raffle, bib number distribution on 19.09.2026, participant limit of 500 people.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to various routes in the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Timing is done with a chip issued with the start number. Each participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers of each route are specially honored. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish line, and changing rooms and toilets are available at the Vorpommernhus. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: Running routes through Klausdorf, Hohendorf, Wendisch-Langendorf, Zarrenzin, Barhöft, and Prohn with views
Start and finish at the Vorpommernhus near the beach
Refreshments on the course and at the finish
additional: Late registrations are possible on September 18, 2026, from 18:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 07:00 to 09:30 at the Vorpommernhus. The award ceremony for the Landknirpselauf takes place immediately after crossing the finish line. Parking is sufficiently available around the Vorpommernhus. Registration is possible via email or online. Participation is at your own risk. Medals and certificates are provided to all participants. Refreshments are available at the finish and on the course. Parking is available.

name: Mühlenlauf in Laar
location: Laar, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: Verein zur Erhaltung der Windmühle Laar/Vechte e.V.
description: The Mill Run in Laar has been organized by SV Grenzland Laarwald since 1986 and takes place annually on the third weekend of September. Runners of all ages can choose between 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances. The start and finish are located at the historic windmill, which, together with the Mill Society, creates a cozy atmosphere. Food and drinks are available to ensure the well-being of participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic windmill in Laar
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Run through the scenic surroundings of Laar
additional: The Mill Run is organized in cooperation with the sports club. The windmill and the homeland house can be rented for celebrations. Drinks and snack offers are available on site for runners and spectators. The event takes place in September, with provisions for drinks and snacks. Pre-registrations are possible, and late registrations can be made on site. The event is held in all weather conditions.

name: Nassauer Hospiz-Charity-Run 2026
description: The Nassauer Hospice Charity Run 2026 in Seelbach is a diverse running event taking place on September 19, 2026, offering distances from 250 meters for children up to 10 kilometers for experienced runners. The event combines athletic challenge with social commitment by supporting the important work of the hospice in Nassau. Participants enjoy the magnificent nature of the Taunus and experience a family-friendly event centered around communal helping.
course_highlights: Diverse distances from 250 m to 10 km
Run through the magnificent nature of the Taunus
Family-friendly event focused on solidarity and support
additional: The run serves as a charity event to support the inpatient Rhein-Lahn Hospice. Great emphasis is placed on community engagement and donations for the hospice. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, with a natural setting in the Taunus, including distances for children and adults.

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., will take place on September 19, 2026, at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sports Facility in Neuss. The run stands for active integration, where people of all origins, skin colors, religions, and with disabilities can run or walk together. The focus is on the community experience and a symbol for integration, not on competition. The colorful supporting program with music, children's activities, and culinary offerings makes the day a festival for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: Open course for running and walking without time pressure
Diverse participants of all ages and backgrounds
Colorful supporting program with bouncy castle, bull riding, and music
additional: The run is open to all age groups, origins, skin colors, religions, and disabilities. There are no rankings; fun and community are the priorities. The supporting program offers a variety of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, children's program, music, and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker Sports Facility and is part of the SportWeek for All 2026, with inclusive sports offerings and trial activities.

name: Röderhof-Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Röderhof Benefit Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Diekholzen and offers various running and walking routes for all age groups and fitness levels. The event is a traditional charity event, emphasizing the fun of running and the collective commitment to a good cause. The distances range from 500 meters to 10 kilometers, including special wheelchair races. Start times are staggered to ensure smooth proceedings.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 500 m to 10 km
Includes wheelchair races and walking routes
Run through the scenic surroundings of Diekholzen
additional: Registration deadline online is September 15 at 21:00. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 1 hour before the start, with an additional fee of 2 euros. Payment can be made via direct debit. The event features multiple start times for different routes and categories, including special wheelchair races and walking routes. Various running disciplines, wheelchair races, walking, and donation options via PayPal.

name: Seelauf TSV-Obernzenn
description: The Seelauf of TSV Obernzenn is a traditional running event with various distances for children, adolescents, and adults. The course includes a toddler run, school runs, a middle-distance race, and a long-distance race of approximately 10.7 km. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with guest gifts for participants and attractive prizes for the top runners. Registration is exclusively online via my.raceresult.com starting May 1, 2026. Start times are staggered to ensure smooth proceedings.
course_highlights: Long-distance race approx. 10.7 km with elevation profile
Middle-distance and long-distance races for youth and adults
Children's runs of about 400 m for toddlers and school children
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start for a fee of €3. Distribution of race bibs begins at 9:15 AM at the sports clubhouse. All toddlers and school children receive a T-shirt as a guest gift, and the first 60 participants of the middle- and long-distance races receive a functional shirt. Participants in the toddler run receive a gold medal and certificate, while school run participants receive trophies, medals, and certificates. Results lists and certificates are available online. The event also includes a children's run of about 400 m and longer distances of approximately 10.7 km. The event takes place at the sports field of TSV Obernzenn and is part of the club activities.

name: Sparkassen-Altstadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen Old Town Run in Ottweiler is a traditional race that combines inclusion, emotion, and athletic excellence. The event takes place annually and offers runners of all ages and performance levels the opportunity to run through the historic old town of Ottweiler. The event promotes community and sporting ambition in a lively atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the historic old town of Ottweiler
Inclusive event focused on community
Athletic excellence in an emotional atmosphere
additional: The event promotes community spirit and sporting activity in a historic setting.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Disibodenberg
location: Disibodenberg, Odernheim am Glan, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Disibodenberg Run is a traditional community race around the Disibodenberg in Odernheim, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. The scenic course connects flat sections along the Glan river with a challenging ascent on the Eselspfad trail, shaping the character of the race. Offered are 5 km and 10 km runs, walking on the 5 km route, as well as children's and youth races starting from 200 meters. The event is sport-oriented and family-friendly, with special prizes for records, families, teams, and Walk-&-Talk groups. The award ceremony and social gathering are held in the gymnasium with coffee, cake, and grilled food.
course_highlights: Scenic course along the Glan river
Challenging ascent on the Eselspfad trail
Combination of flat sections and trail passages
additional: Preparation runs for children are held on three Tuesdays in September from 6:30 PM at the gymnasium. The entry fee is paid when collecting race materials. Special prizes are awarded for new course records, the most enthusiastic family, the largest team, and the happiest Walk-&-Talk group. The award ceremony takes place in the gymnasium, where coffee, homemade cake, and grilled food are available at reasonable prices. The event features varied terrain, parking facilities, changing rooms, and showers on site, making it a popular community event in September.

name: Wehringer Wertachlauf mit schwäbischen Meisterschaften
description: The Wehringer Wertachlauf is a local running event in Wehringen, Germany, organized by the Wehringen Running Community. The program includes a short 350-meter race and a 10 km race, classified as a short run. The course runs around the village of Wehringen and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. This edition also includes the Swabian Championships.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aue 6 near the musicians' house in Wehringen
Two distances: 350 m and 10 km
Course around the village of Wehringen, no point-to-point course
additional: The event takes place on September 19, 2026. The weather in September is typically around 19°C with a minimum of 10°C and mostly cloudy. The event is short and simple, focusing on the local character. Distances: 350 m, 10 km; including Swabian Championships; location in Wehringen

name: Welterbelauf Zollverein 2026
location: Zollverein, Essen-Stoppenberg, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Zollverein World Heritage Run takes place on September 19, 2026, on the grounds of the Zollverein Coal Mine Industrial Complex in Essen-Stoppenberg. The race routes lead over the Ring Promenade and past notable industrial monuments such as the Doppelbock headframe, the SANAA building, and the Zollverein slag heap. Various competitions are available for all age and performance levels, including a 10 km run, relays, walking events, and Special Olympics categories. The 10 km course is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for rankings. The run combines athletic challenge with the unique atmosphere of UNESCO World Heritage.
course_highlights: Route over the Ring Promenade and past the Doppelbock headframe
Passage by the SANAA building and the Zollverein slag heap
10 km course officially measured by DLV and eligible for rankings
additional: The event offers eight different competitions, including the 10 km Zollverein Run, 3 x 3.3 km Pütt relay, 5.4 km Kumpel Run and Steiger Walk, 2.7 km Coal Mine Run, 1.2 km Schülerlauf (student race), 600 m Helen Keller Run, and 300 m Bambini Run. Parking on the grounds is free for participants and visitors. The event is easily accessible by public transport and car. International competition rules of the DLV and IAAF apply. Registration begins on May 15, 2026; the event includes team relays (Pütt Run) and offers certificates and results online.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: The Wilstermarsch Run is a traditional running event in Wilster, taking place on September 19, 2026, for the 34th time. The event offers various race distances for children and adults, including 400 meters, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, passing through the scenic Wilstermarsch. In addition to the athletic competition, a lively supporting program with games, bouncy castles, a DJ, a barbecue stand, and refreshments provides entertainment and a feel-good atmosphere for participants and spectators. The run is part of the Steinburg Cup and attracts several hundred runners each year, supported by numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Runs through the scenic Wilstermarsch
Stadium rounds for children with loud support from spectators
5 km loop course through Nortorf and Wilster with varied terrain
additional: The Wilstermarsch Run includes multiple races for different age groups and distances, including children’s runs from 400 meters, 2 km children’s race, 5 km, and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km walking. There is an extensive supporting program with bouncy castles, a DJ, barbecue stand, refreshments, and photo wall. The event is supported by approximately 40 volunteers and is part of the Steinburg Cup. Prizes and vouchers are raffled among participants, and milestone gifts are given to the 33rd finishers. Registrations are planned for spring 2026. The event is family-friendly, offering entertainment for all involved.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzseelauf in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly road race taking place on September 19, 2026, for the 21st time. The varied courses lead around Lake Wutzsee through the Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all age groups from babies to experienced runners. The event is characterized by a warm atmosphere, professional timing with transponders, and a colorful supporting program. Participants can look forward to distances from 600 meters to 22 kilometers, including Nordic walking. After the races, award ceremonies are held, and each finisher receives a certificate available for download or print on-site.
course_highlights: Running courses around Lake Wutzsee in the Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park
Distances from 600 m to 22 km for all age groups
Varied routes with forest and lake passages
additional: Timing is done using transponders integrated into the start numbers via myRacePartner. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event online until 10 minutes before the respective start, except for the Bambini runs, which have no late registration fee. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races. Each finisher can download their certificate online or have it printed on-site. Course profiles for children, adolescents, and adults, online registration, start numbers with transponder, various distances, routes through forest and around Lake Wutzsee.

name: 12. PSD Bank Halbmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr bis zum offiziellen Anmeldeschluss am 9. September 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr bis zum offiziellen Anmeldeschluss am 9. September 2026, vorbehaltlich Ausverkauf

description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast and flat running event that passes through the Wandsbek district and takes runners up to the Berne subway station in the north. The course runs back through Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is characterized by a unique atmosphere with support from spectators and live bands along the route and takes place in late summer at dusk.
course_highlights: Fast and flat course through the Wandsbek district
Northernmost point at the Berne subway station
Strong support from spectators and bands along the route
additional: Drop-off of clothing bags on event day from 08:30 to 13:30 at the Wandsbeker weekly market. The start and finish are located on Wandsbeker Marktstraße in front of the Quarree shopping center. The race bib distribution takes place on September 19 and 20, 2026. Medical emergency services are available, the course is cordoned off and secured, and a finisher medal is awarded. The results list and personalized certificates are available online. The event also includes the Köhlbrand Bridge Run and offers detailed information on the course, registration, and results.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeimer Daylight Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The course runs through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition with numerous finishers and records, underscoring the high quality and sporting demands of the race. Participants can download the GPX track of the course to prepare optimally.
course_highlights: Long ultramarathon distance of over 100 km
Varied terrain with daylight running character
Course records of over 125 km (men) and 104 km (women)
additional: The GPX track of the course can be downloaded. The event has a long history with finisher numbers and course records. There are no explicit price details or start times available on the pages. The event takes place twice a year in March and September, with multiple editions since 2018. The courses are available as GPX files, facilitating preparation.

name: 21. Fun-Run
description: The 21st Maisel’s FunRun will take place on May 10, 2026, in Bayreuth and is a fixed part of the regional running calendar. The event attracts over 4,000 running enthusiasts annually, from beginners to ambitious athletes. Various distances are offered for adults, including half marathon, quarter marathon, and 5 km run, as well as several children's races without an entry fee. The finish line leads directly to the festival grounds of the Maisel’s Weissbierfest, where runners can celebrate with live music and freshly tapped Maisel’s Weisse. The course is varied and mostly flat, passing the most beautiful spots in Bayreuth and creating an excellent running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied and mostly flat course through Bayreuth
Finish directly on the festival grounds of the Maisel’s Weissbierfest
Atmospheric run with loud cheering and live music
additional: Race documents will be sent in advance by mail. An official FunRun shirt from the Bayreuth sports brand CEP can optionally be purchased. No entry fee is charged for children's races (U12, U10, U8, U6). The FunRun is part of the Maisel’s Weissbierfest, which takes place from May 7 to May 10, 2026. Distances: half marathon, quarter marathon, 5 km; children's races (U12, U10, U8, U6); early bird discount until December 6, 2025; start in Bayreuth; flat, varied course; part of the Weissbierfest.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorfer Beetroot Run is a family-friendly running event organized by the running club of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers courses over 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and the Hemminger Half Marathon (21.3 km). In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners' breakfast, cakes, waffles, grilled foods, drinks, and a varied supporting program with face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; membership in a club is not required.
course_highlights: Courses ranging from 1.4 km to 21.3 km (Half Marathon)
Start and finish at the sports field of SVE Hiddestorf
Family-friendly atmosphere with runners' breakfast and culinary offerings
additional: Race bibs and chips will be issued on the day of the event from 7:00 a.m. The timing is done with a chip that must be returned after the run. There is a free Möhrrchen Run (500 m) for children up to 6 years old, without registration or entry fee. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports and tennis hall near the start and finish. Parking is limited and up to 500 meters walking distance. Late registrations are only possible online until the registration deadline. The runners' breakfast is free for all participants and includes cheese, salami, baguette, and red wine (from 18 years). Courses over 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and 21.3 km; online registration; event takes place at the sports field in Hiddestorf; parking options are limited.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Old Town Run Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run with multiple laps. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker '95 e.V. and offers an attractive competition opportunity for runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt.
course_highlights: Loop through the historic old town of Salzwedel
5 km loop as the basis for all distances
Longer distances (10 km, half marathon) with multiple laps
additional: The event recorded 223 finishers in 2023 and offers running opportunities for all age groups, including children’s and youth races.

name: Gau-Algesheimer Alagastaluf
location: Sportpark Binger Straße, Gau-Algesheim, Rheinland-Pfalz, Germany
description: The Gau-Algesheimer Alagastalauf is a traditional community run that has taken place in Gau-Algesheim since the 1980s. The event runs over field paths and streets around Binger Straße and through the old town of Gau-Algesheim. The race offers a sporting challenge in a beautiful autumnal setting and is suitable for runners of all ages. The event is organized by SV 1910 Gau-Algesheim e.V. - Athletics Department and takes place annually in autumn.
course_highlights: Course runs through the old town of Gau-Algesheim
Run over field paths and streets around Binger Straße
Traditional autumn community run with a long-standing history
additional: The start and finish are located at Sportpark Binger Straße. The event is organized by SV 1910 Gau-Algesheim e.V. - Athletics Department. Training times are Tuesdays and Thursdays. There are reviews and galleries of past runs on the website. Terrain details are not specified; registration is expected; the event takes place at Sportpark Binger Straße.

name: Insellauf mit HM, 10km, 3x7km Staffel und Kinderläufen
description: The Reichenau Island Run is a traditional race event held annually in September on Reichenau Island. Various courses are offered, including a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 3 x 7 km relay, as well as children’s and youth races. The race routes lead over diverse and scenic paths around the island. The Island Run attracts numerous runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a variety of running options.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km courses around Reichenau Island
3 x 7 km relay with special baton handovers
Children and youth races with age-appropriate distances
additional: The Island Run takes place at the Baurenhorn sports field in Reichenau. There is a schedule with various races, including children and youth races. The event is organized by the Sports Club Reichenau 1920 e. V., with Michael Rick named as contact person. The event has a long tradition with over 800 participants last year. There is a relay of 3 x 7 km that includes special baton handovers. Courses: half marathon, 10 km, 3x7 km relay, youth race (1.6 km), children’s run (0.9 km). Start and finish at the Baurenhorn sports field. The weather in September is usually mild and cloudy, around 19°C.

name: Internationaler Hugenottenlauf
description: The 49th Hugenottenlauf in Neu-Isenburg will take place on September 20, 2026, and invites runners of all ages to a sporty and communal experience. The event offers various course lengths that run through the city and are suitable for different performance levels. In addition to the athletic competition, music, catering, and professional timing ensure a pleasant atmosphere. The event is part of the Main-Lauf-Cup and features age-appropriate divisions according to DLO.
course_highlights: Various course lengths: 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 2.95 km school run
Start and finish in Neu-Isenburg with route maps available
Music along the route provides atmosphere
additional: Age group classification according to DLO, timing, bib number distribution, changing rooms and showers, valuables depot, award ceremony, certificates and result lists, raffle, catering, medical service, photos, Main-Lauf-Cup, parking facilities and public transportation are organized. Various running routes, registration with direct debit authorization, family program, well-marked routes

name: Karlsfelder Seelauf
description: The Karlsfelder Seelauf is a traditional running event held at Karlsfelder See. The race offers an attractive course in a natural environment and is suitable for runners of all ages and performance levels. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht Karlsfeld and will take place in 2026 for the 47th time. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Running course around Karlsfelder See
Natural and varied running environment
Suitable for runners of all ages
additional: The Seelauf is organized by TSV Eintracht Karlsfeld. The event is part of the athletics department’s competition offerings. More details about registration and the official announcement are available on the official website. The courses are record-eligible and officially measured, with refreshments on the course and at the finish, pacers, result services, and registration at the stadium.

name: Stadtlauf Erding 2026
description: The Erding City Run is a traditional race event that appeals to runners of all ages. It offers various distances, including children's races, a 5 km run, and a 10 km run, all through the beautiful city of Erding. The race emphasizes inclusion and features special classifications, for example for children from the St. Nikolaus School. The event is organized by the Trisport Erding association and is a popular sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Children's races with age-appropriate distances from approximately 0.8 km to 2.5 km
Stadtwerke Run over 5 km and 10 km through downtown Erding
Inclusive classification for children of the St. Nikolaus School
additional: The Erding City Run offers special children's races with various distances depending on age group. There is a dedicated classification for children of the St. Nikolaus School over 0.8 km. The event emphasizes inclusion and is open to runners of all ages. Race routes, registration, results, photos, road closures

name: Uentroper Geithelauf
description: The 24th Uentroper Geithelauf will take place on September 20, 2026, and features a run through the green heart of Uentrop. The event is organized by the Turn- und Sportverein 46/68 Uentrop e.V. and offers a sporting community in a natural environment. The running routes lead across fields and forest paths in the surrounding area and are suitable for various fitness levels. The event emphasizes fun, community, and a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Running routes through the green heart of Uentrop
Natural paths over fields and forest trails
Suitable for different fitness levels
additional: The running groups are arranged so that no one is overwhelmed and everyone can find their rhythm. Experienced instructors support participants with technique and preparation. The flat and fast course leads through the city center, past Karlsruhe Palace and through Citypark Ost, with an atmospheric finish line at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium. A special feature is the opportunity to be accompanied by marathon angels for the last 4 kilometers, making the run a communal experience. There are attractive shorter distances for beginners and families, emphasizing fun in running.

Marathon switch at km 20.5 allows changing from marathon to half marathon

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
location: Burgberg, Bad Harzburg, Lower Saxony, Germany

Participants can complete the course by running, walking, or hiking, ending at the CANOSSA pillar on Burgberg. The race promotes inclusive children's and youth work in the Goslar district and combines sporting challenge with social engagement. After the race, participants can enjoy a festive after-race event with music, refreshments, and an award ceremony.

Breathtaking views of Brocken and mixed forests from the horizontal hillside trail

Two courses: 12 km run (start at 10:00 a.m.) for runners aged 16 and above, and 6 km run (start at 10:30 a.m.) for runners, walkers, and hikers aged 10 and above. After the race, music and refreshments on Burgberg, award ceremony around 12:00 p.m. with a unique indulgence certificate for all participants. There are no course signs, only markings, and the event promotes environmental protection by leaving no waste in nature. The event concludes with a program including music and catering on Burgberg.

The course runs on closed circuits through the city center and provides refreshment stations along the route and at the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), attractive prizes, and certificates for the top runners. The event is open to individual and team competitions and takes place in all weather conditions.

Refreshment stations on the route and at the finish area at Denkmalsplatz

description: The Druffeler Volkslauf takes place on September 20, 2026, in Rietberg-Druffel and offers competitive runs over 1 km and 10 km. course_highlights: Competitive runs over 1 km and 10 km
Start in Rietberg-Druffel
Typical September weather with around 19 °C and mostly cloudy sky
additional: The registration supports a solidarity sports initiative and a relief fund for injured runners. Typical September weather includes approximately 19 °C with a minimum of 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. Registration via laufen.de with a discount is possible; supports charitable causes; details should be confirmed with the organizer before registration.

name: EDITH LÜCKE-Frauenlauf TRIER
description: The EDITH LÜCKE Women's Run in Trier is a special race that will hold its sixth edition on September 20, 2026. The 5-kilometer route takes a sightseeing tour through Trier's Roman history, starting in front of the Imperial Baths and culminating in a finish line at the amphitheater. The race is open to women and girls aged twelve and above and emphasizes the joy of movement in community, regardless of performance level. After the race, all participants will be treated to a glass of sparkling wine to celebrate the day.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route through the former capital of the Western Roman Empire

Finish at the historic amphitheater

Various race distances (500 m to 10 km), online registration from summer 2026, start and finish area at the Rhine embankment, results and certificates after the race at br-timing.de, accompanying program with food stalls and music.

description: The Panoramic Run Kriegsheim is a running event in Kriegsheim organized by the LLG Wonnegau. The event is part of the summer race calendar of the club and offers runners an attractive route through the scenic surroundings. The LLG Wonnegau is an active club that organizes additional running and sports events in the region. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and promotes community spirit in running.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque landscape around Kriegsheim
Part of the summer race calendar of LLG Wonnegau
Attractive course for various performance levels
additional: LLG Wonnegau offers additional running events and training. The office is located in Monsheim, Silvanerstr. 4. There are no explicit details about start times, fee structures, or registration procedures for the Panoramic Run Kriegsheim on the searched pages. Start times: 9:45 AM for children’s races, 10:00 AM for main race, 5 km, and walking. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until one hour before the start. The event is planned in all weather conditions; it may be canceled in case of storms.

name: Seidenraupen Cross
location: Hülser Bruch, Krefeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Silk Worm Cross in Krefeld is one of the most interesting cross-country races in North Rhine-Westphalia, organized in a family-friendly atmosphere. Runners can expect challenging courses over 6.5 km and 16 km through Krefeld's largest nature reserve, the Hülser Bruch, featuring steep climbs, fast downhills, and a stunning natural landscape. In addition to the main races, there are also children's races at the Hülser district sports facility. The event offers a varied and natural running experience suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Run through the Hülser Bruch nature reserve with three hills
Steep climbs and fast downhills
Children's races on various surfaces (grass, sand pits, ash track)
additional: Start for hikers, walkers, and Nordic walkers at 10 a.m. Registration is open until one hour before the race. The course lengths are approximately 6.5 km and 16 km, which can also be walked. The children's races take place at the sports facility on Hölschen Dyk. The event supports social projects annually. Trail and cross elements, routes on forest and hiking trails, start and finish at the Hölschen Dyk sports field, registration until one hour before the race.

name: Sonneberger Spielzeuglauf
description: The 6th Sonneberg Toy Run and 2nd Corporate Run will take place on September 20, 2026, in Sonneberg. The event offers several race distances, including the main race, beginner race, Nordic walking, student race, and toddler race, all starting simultaneously and finishing together. In addition to individual rankings, there is a special corporate ranking for the company with the most participants and most creative, as well as the club with the most participants. The Nordic walking race is timed but without an award ceremony. The event is family-friendly and organized by Leichtathletik Sonneberg e. V.
course_highlights: Multiple race distances: main race, beginner race, Nordic walking, student race, toddler race
Start and finish at Ernst-Moritz-Arndt-Straße 26 a in Sonneberg
Joint start and finish for all races
additional: Photos will be taken during the event and published on the website and Facebook page. The corporate race includes rankings for the company with the most participants, the most creative company, and the club with the most participants. Nordic walking is timed but without an award ceremony. Multiple race types, including children’s and corporate races, rankings for companies and clubs, participation at your own risk, photos will be taken.
