description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a traditional race on the North Sea coast, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers various distances from a children's run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon of 42.195 km. The courses lead through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike, and by the water, guaranteeing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are also half marathons, 10 km, and 5 km runs, as well as relay and walking competitions. The event emphasizes community, endurance, and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course through historic old town and along the Elbe dike
Marathon over four laps with varied city and landscape running
Half marathon and other distances by the water and on paved paths
additional: The children's run is limited to 300 children from kindergartens in the Samtgemeinde Land Hadeln and has no competitive character. There are various age categories and rankings for students. The event offers free parking, baggage storage, and one hour of free use of the Sole-Therme Otterndorf (excluding sauna) upon presentation of the starting number. There is a Cuxland ranking with cash prizes for runners from the Cuxhaven district. Award ceremonies are held in stages according to distance and ranking at the Historic Town Hall. The event takes place on the Elbe dike and in the historic old town of Otterndorf, with special categories such as handbikers and walkers. It is a family-friendly event with a strong community atmosphere.

name: Tübinger Erbe-Lauf
price_range: 34 € bis 58 € je nach Lauf und Nachmeldung
description: The Tübingen Heritage Run is a diverse running event in the historic old town of Tübingen, taking place on September 20, 2026. The main course covers 10 kilometers, divided into four laps through the old town and the Umbrian-Provençal Market. In addition to the main race, there are other competitions such as the 5K run, the Team Challenge, the Junior Run, and the BG Handbike Challenge. The event offers personal timing, an exclusive finisher medal, and a unique atmosphere in the picturesque city. All participants receive breathable running socks made from organic cotton with their registration fee.
course_highlights: 4 laps through the Tübingen old town
Course over the Umbrian-Provençal Market
Closed, leaderboard-capable course with timing
additional: Free running socks made from organic cotton included in the registration fee (order by June 28, 2026, pick up at the race packet distribution). Free use of public transport within the Neckar-Alb-Donau transport association on race day. Bag storage, catering during and after the race, free massage after the run, downloadable certificate. Exclusive finisher medal. Late registrations online until 2 hours before the start for an additional fee of 5 euros (subject to availability). Race bibs, medals, catering, massage, and public transport included. Registration until September 6, 2026.

name: Uplengener RVB Herbstmarktlauf
location: Raiffeisen-Volksbank, Reetstr. 13, Uplengen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Uplengener RVB Autumn Market Run takes place on September 20, 2026, in Uplengen, Germany. The traditional race was first held in 2002 and offers runs for children and students. The start is at the parking lot of Raiffeisen-Volksbank, Reetstr. 13. The event is ideal for runners of all ages who want to enjoy an autumn running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km, 6.6 km, and 10 km
Start at the parking lot of Raiffeisen-Volksbank, Reetstr. 13
Typical September weather with about 19°C and mostly cloudy
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. Typical September weather with about 19°C, cloudy, average 45 mm of precipitation; ideal for an outdoor autumn run.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a traditional race through the village of Weddelbrook and the surrounding farmland. It offers various distances from 900 meters to 10 kilometers, allowing runners of all ages and skill levels to participate. The course leads through scenic areas, including around the lake, and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers on site. The race is known for its good organization and the opportunity to compete with other runners or simply enjoy running.
course_highlights: Course through the village, around the lake, and through the farmland
Varied distances from 900 meters to 10 kilometers
Scenic and diverse running routes
additional: The race includes multiple age and distance categories, including a children's run for ages 3-4. Photos from the race can be requested via email with the start number. The event is supported by many volunteers and takes place annually. It offers various distances, including children's and junior races, with results categorized by age. Photos and further information are available upon request.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilscher FunRun is a traditional race that has been held annually since 2005 at the sports field Wilsche in Gifhorn. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an attractive running event with a 10 km distance. The race is characterized by a friendly atmosphere and strong participation and is a fixed part of the regional running scene. The start is punctual at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organizations such as the fire brigades and the Red Cross (DRK).
course_highlights: 10 km race course as part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup
Start and finish at the sports field Wilsche
Participation of fire brigade and DRK for security
additional: The FunRun is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup with a total of 9 races. The event is accompanied by the fire brigades Wilsche and Neubokel as well as the DRK standby vehicle. A children's race and the Wilscher Marathon have been offered since 2015 as part of the Gifhorn Running Day. The registration link for 2026 will be published later. Start at 10 a.m., registration is via the organizer's website, participation is open to all running enthusiasts.

description: The AOK Company Run Haslach in the Kinzig Valley is a team event taking place on September 22, 2026, and is part of the BW-Running series. The event promotes movement, team spirit, and shared experiences in the workplace. The main race course is approximately 5 km long, with an additional 2 km "Run for All". After the race, participants can enjoy free refreshments at the finish line, and there are special meeting points for teams to experience the race day together.
course_highlights: Main race approximately 5 km long
Run for All approximately 2 km long
Participation allowed with Nordic walking poles, start at the very back
additional: The main race starts at 6:00 PM, and the Run for All begins at 5:30 PM. Registration is via a company registration with a team captain. Late registrations are possible until the registration deadline, after which only re-registrations are allowed. Participation is open from age 16. Accompanying persons such as cyclists, skaters, dogs, or fans are not permitted. Nordic walking poles are allowed; it is recommended to start at the very back. Free refreshments are available at all locations of the BW-Running series. Changes to registration data are possible up to 30 minutes before the start. Minimum age is 16 years. Registration via company registration, team and individual registrations are possible. Start times are at 5:30 PM and 6:00 PM.

description: The AOK Corporate Run Balingen is a popular team event taking place on September 24, 2026, at the marketplace in Balingen. The course is approximately 5.9 kilometers long, run in two laps of about 2.9 km each. The run promotes movement for everyone and encourages inclusion, allowing people with and without disabilities to participate together. After the run, participants will enjoy free finish line refreshments and a lively award ceremony with music. The event offers a great opportunity to experience team spirit and enrich the workday with sporting activity.
course_highlights: Course approximately 5.9 km, two laps of about 2.9 km each
Start and finish at the marketplace in Balingen
Inclusion-friendly run for all participants
additional: From 5:00 PM, a DJ will provide entertainment on stage. A joint warm-up session is held before the start. After crossing the finish line, award ceremonies and musical entertainment will take place. The finish line refreshments include non-alcoholic Erdinger in three varieties, fruit, vegetables, and water. Re-registrations are free until the registration deadline, afterwards for a fee. Minimum age is 16 years. Run for EVERYONE, team event, including training and refreshments.

name: ENTEGA Nightrun
location: Radgelände des Darmstädter Velodroms, Darmstadt, Hesse, Germany
description: The ENTEGA Night Run on September 25, 2026, is a unique running event on the cycling track area of the Velodrome in Darmstadt. The course is fully illuminated and offers a varied mix of meadow, asphalt, gravel, and hard surface. With distances of 1.6 km (student run), 2.5 km, 5 km, and 7.5 km, there is something for runners of all ages and performance levels. The special atmosphere at dusk and the pulsating energy of fellow runners make this race an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Illuminated loop course around the cycling track area
Diverse surfaces: meadow, asphalt, gravel, hard surface
Atmospheric run at dusk with dazzling lights
additional: Number pickup on the day of the event from 17:30 in the hall. Each participant receives a finisher medal. Shoes with spikes are not allowed. Water and regional products from Alnatura will be provided. Medical services on the course and at the finish. Parking available on the tennis grounds next to the event site. Valuables can be deposited in the hall for a fee of 1 €. No showers provided. Course on meadows, asphalt, and gravel; spikes not permitted; parking on TGB tennis grounds; no showers; medical services available.

name: MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The MOUNTAINMAN Reit im Winkl is a challenging trail running event in the Chiemgau Alps featuring five different course lengths from 11 to 73 kilometers. The routes pass through an impressive mountain scenery with highlights such as ski jumps, the idyllic Klausenbach Gorge, alpine pastures, and the Dürnbachhorn, offering breathtaking views of the Wilder Kaiser. The event is suitable for trail runners from beginners to professionals, with longer distances only recommended for experienced runners. There are special routes for hikers, and participation with dogs is possible on the shorter courses. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with an expo, kids' trail, community trail, and a pasta party on the eve.
course_highlights: Dreamlike mountain scenery with views of the Wilder Kaiser
Passage through the idyllic Klausenbach Gorge
Technically challenging trails with up to 3,200 meters of elevation
additional: Start and finish at the Festsaal Tiroler Straße 37, Reit im Winkl. Environmentally friendly travel by train recommended. Parking in the town with a 5-10 minute walk, free parking for overnight guests from Reit im Winkl. Participation with dogs on S- and M-courses is possible; start spots with dogs are fully booked, waiting list available. Flexi-ticket options for cancellation up to 30 or 2 days before the event can be purchased at an additional cost. Race documents will be sent approximately 4 weeks before the race by mail. On the day before, there is an expo, kids' trail, community trail with ALTRA, pre-race info, and a pasta party. Award ceremony at 3:00 PM on race day. The event includes various trail and hiking routes, including kids' and dogs' trails, with detailed information on registration, course profiles, and terrain. The winter trail event in March offers routes from 10 to 42 km with snow terrain and support options.

name: Nachtlauf über 7 Meilen und 30. Jedermannlauf über 3,1 Meilen (5 km)
description: The Zons Night Run offers two exciting races: the 7-mile run and the 5 km fun run. The event takes place in Dormagen-Zons and is known for its unique nighttime atmosphere. The course runs through the historic old town and provides runners with a special running experience. The race is open to all age and performance levels and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: 7 miles (approx. 11.3 km) through the historic old town of Zons
Fun run over 5 km as a shorter option
Night run with special atmosphere and lighting
additional: No registration possible on site. The event takes place in the historic old town of Zons. There is a supporting program and awards. Parking and travel information are available on the website. The race takes place at night and offers a special atmosphere. Late registrations are not possible. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a great opportunity to experience the historic surroundings.

description: The student race of the Rüppurr schools is a traditional running competition that takes place annually and brings together students from various schools in Karlsruhe. The event offers separate classifications for girls and boys as well as certificates and medals for all participants. Prizes are awarded for the first to third places. Registration is through the schools, and late registrations are possible on the day of the event. The race takes place around the club grounds of TUS Rüppurr and promotes the sporting talent in the region.
course_highlights: Each route has a separate track color
Separate classification for girls and boys
Preparation runs before the main event
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 15:00 to 15:30 in the gymnastics room of the TUS club house. Registration is through the schools, students under 16 require signatures from both guardians for late registration. Routes are color-coded, separate classifications for girls and boys, certificates and medals for all, prizes for the top three places, late registration possible on the event day.

name: Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a family-friendly backyard ultra race in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time on September 26, 2026. The 6.7 km course is restarted every full hour, and participants run as many rounds as they can or wish to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and enjoyment of running. The route mainly runs over forest and field paths with no significant inclines, and there are classifications for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop over forest and field paths
Start every full hour, run as long as you can or want
Classifications for 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km distances
additional: The race is a private invitation-only event with no public registration and a maximum of 70 participants. Catering with water, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and cake is provided at the start and finish areas, and participants are asked to contribute their own items. There is no mandatory equipment, but headlamps and phones are recommended. Parking, toilets, and showers are available at the SV Pechau sports field. The race includes several classifications, including 50 km, 100 km, and 100 miles, with the fastest person in each classification winning. It is not a public event but a private invitation with modified backyard ultra rules.

name: VR-Bank Mitte Herbstlauf in Dingelstädt
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Autumn Run in Dingelstädt is a versatile running event taking place on September 26, 2026. The event offers courses for all performance levels, from the kids' fun run for the youngest to the half marathon, which passes through the impressive 1530-meter-long Küllstedter Tunnel. The flat, fast courses are measured according to DLV/IAAF standards and are ideal for personal best times. The Autumn Run is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the TLV Running Cup and also hosts the Thuringian State Championships in road running.
course_highlights: Half marathon with 1530m long Küllstedter Tunnel
Flat, curve-light turnaround courses with only 2 to 50 meters of elevation
Courses measured according to DLV/IAAF standards
additional: Start and finish on a fully asphalted Kanonenbahn cycle path near Bahnhofstraße Dingelstädt. Changing rooms, registration, and award ceremony in the elementary school sports hall. Bib number pickup from 8:00 AM. Age group awards according to DLV standards. 1 km race limited to 50 starters with referee start formation. Net time measurement, placement based on gross time. The courses are flat and fast, including tunnel passages; registration in the elementary school sports hall; start and finish on the Kanonenbahn cycle path; refreshments along the route and at the finish; age group awards; part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the Thuringian State Championships.

name: Bausch+Ströbel Stadtlauf Ilshofen
description: The Bausch+Ströbel City Run Ilshofen is a traditional race event held annually in Ilshofen. The event offers runners of various age and performance levels the opportunity to compete on a diverse course through the city. The running route is well marked and passes through attractive sections of the city, making the race interesting for both participants and spectators. The city run is a popular event in the regional race calendar and is organized by TSV Ilshofen.
course_highlights: Diverse course through the city of Ilshofen
Well marked running route
Attractive sections for runners and spectators
additional: The event offers GPS-based route measurement, start and finish are located at the Roland-Wurmthaler-Halle, and registration takes place there. The event occurs annually and has been established for over thirty years.

description: The 49th Ötigheimer Autumn Run on September 26, 2026 warmly invites running enthusiasts of all performance levels. Whether beginner or ambitious runner, the enjoyment of movement is the main focus. The event offers children and school runs as well as main races over 5 km and 10 km, which are officially measured. The 10 km course runs through two laps in the Ötigheimer Forest and promises a beautiful autumnal running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses
10 km course runs through the Ötigheimer Forest
Two laps on the 10 km course
additional: There are no entry fees for all races, which are covered by former TGÖ athlete Reinhard Hofmann from Baden-Baden. Online registration until September 6, 2026, includes a personalized bib number. Start times for the 5 km and 10 km races are simultaneously at 14:45. Children and school runs, 5 km and 10 km main races, no entry fees, personalized bib number with online registration until September 6, 2026, laps through the Ötigheimer Forest, weather in September mostly cloudy.

name: Schottener Stauseelauf
description: The Schotten Reservoir Run is organized by TGV Schotten, the largest sports club in the Vogelsberg region. The event offers runners the opportunity to compete on varied courses around the reservoir. The race is part of the club's broad sports program, which also hosts numerous major events in running. Participants and visitors are warmly welcome to enjoy the athletic atmosphere and the beautiful landscape.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Schotten Reservoir
Varied terrain in the Vogelsberg region
Event organized by an experienced sports club with professional timing
additional: Registration, results, and certificates are provided via the club's own timing system "TGV SportStar". TGV Schotten is a large sports club with over 1,300 members and organizes, besides the Reservoir Run, other major events in running and other disciplines. The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from the entire region. Registration is possible on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for hobby and competitive runners to improve their personal best times.

name: Appelhülsener Landlauf
location: Appelhülsener Landlauf, Nottuln-Appelhülsen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Appelhülsener Landlauf on September 26, 2026, is a family-friendly running event in the beautiful Münsterland, offering routes for all age groups. The officially measured 5 km and 10 km runs are eligible for best lists and combine Westphalian flair with rural idyll. Refreshments are provided with aid stations and a diverse selection at the finish area. The event is part of the Westmünsterland running series and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km routes, eligible for best lists
Refreshment stations every 2.5 km with water
Start and finish area with changing and shower facilities at the sports center
additional: Race numbers can be picked up on race day from 1:00 PM at the sports center. Timing is done with Race-Result using multiple chips in the bib, which are collected at the finish. Changing and shower facilities are available directly at the start/finish area. The top three male and female runners of the 5 km and 10 km runs will be awarded. All participants of the children and school runs will receive a medal. Nordic walking is non-competitive and does not include awards. Certificates and results lists are available online; certificate printing is offered at bib pickup. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, 48301 Nottuln. Routes are officially measured. Online registration is possible until September 24, 2026; late registration on-site for a fee. Race numbers are available from 1:00 PM on race day. Parking is at Marienplatz 15, Nottuln.

name: Bahnstreckenlauf
location: Zinhaine, Bad Marienberg, Westerwaldkreis, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Wäller Railway Route Run in Bad Marienberg is a new running event starting in 2025, which from 2026 will also count as a scoring race for the Wäller Run Cup. The course is a turnaround route on the bike path between Langenbach near Bad Marienberg and Nistertal. The start and finish are located at Zinhainer Weg above the Rübsamen company, with a nearby parking lot for participants. The event is organized by TuS Bad-Marienberg Athletics and offers runners an attractive course in the region.
course_highlights: Turnaround route on the bike path between Langenbach and Nistertal
Start and finish at Zinhainer Weg above the Rübsamen company
Parking available directly at start & finish
additional: The event is part of the Wäller Run Cup from 2026. Certificates and individual results are available online. The course is a turnaround route on a bike path, suggesting a flat and fast running course. Turnaround route on the bike path, parking facilities at Zinhainer Weg, including various age classes and distances.

description: The Benin Benefit Run is a scenic cross-country race in Hirzweiler, taking place for the 19th time on September 26, 2026. The course offers a panoramic view over the Ill Valley and mostly runs on paved field paths. The event supports aid projects in Benin, with proceeds and entry fees benefiting the AG Benin. In addition to the race, participants can enjoy a rich cake buffet, grilled sausages, drinks, and the award ceremony at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler.
course_highlights: Panoramic view over the entire Ill Valley
Mostly paved field path
Start and finish at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site without additional fees. The event is part of the LLG Illtal Cup, together with the Illinger City Run and Friendship Run. There are no age categories for the children's runs and no timing for runs without scoring. The award ceremony takes place at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler. Catering includes grilled sausages, a cake buffet, and drinks. The race usually takes place in October, with catering at the Dorfwaldhalle Hirzweiler. There are no age categories in some runs, and no timing was conducted during the initial events. The event is a community effort that combines athletic challenge with social support.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES Mountain Time Trial and Mountain Cycling Race is a challenging individual time competition in the Harz, taking place on September 26, 2026, in Schierke. Participants compete on various courses up to 24 km in length with up to 900 meters of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain, and oneself, starting on Brockenstraße and finishing at the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere is characterized by sporting ambition and the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.
course_highlights: Main route over 11.2 km with 550 meters of elevation on Brockenstraße
Longer route of 24 km with 900 meters of elevation up to the Brocken plateau
Various disciplines: road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, Nordic walking
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 8:00. Electronic timing, medical support, drinks, and catering at the finish line are included. The event offers a panoramic view from the Brocken plateau to several distant cities and sights. After the race, there is a recovery walk to cheer on the subsequent starters. Participants under 15 years old require parental permission, and supervision is mandatory. Mountain individual time trial, running, roller skiing, Nordic walking, e-bike allowed for road races, various course lengths, age categories, online registration.

name: Böckstiegellauf
price_range: 18,00 EUR bis 29,00 EUR (je nach Strecke und Anmeldezeitraum)
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberger Hill Country, running from Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld to the city center of Werther. Offered are courses over 18 km and 10 km, as well as a 2.5 km student race. The route partly follows the Hermannslauf and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is well organized with bus shuttles from the finish to the start and an award ceremony in the center of Werther.
course_highlights: Run through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberger Hill Country
Route passes by the Böckstiegelhaus and Böckstiegel Museum
Start at Peter auf’m Berge, finish in the center of Werther
additional: Start and finish are at Peter auf’m Berge and at Venghauss-Platz in Werther. Bus services start at 12:00 PM from the Werther bus station to the start. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM at Venghauss-Platz, subject to available starting spots. The route is mostly in good condition, but at the junction of the 18/10 km courses at kilometer 3.7, it is very rocky. The courses pass through nature and the city. Registration is already possible, with bus transport to the start. No parking at the start location. Late registrations only if spots are available.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend of September. The main race starts at the Red School on the marketplace and leads through Eschstraße to the Town Hall Square. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition where teams of four each complete a roughly 1000-meter course four times. The event is organized by the running club of SV Bethen e. V. and supervised by the NLV district Cloppenburg.
course_highlights: Main race starts at the Red School on the marketplace
Course runs through Eschstraße and ends at the Town Hall Square
Relay race with approximately 1000-meter laps, to be run four times
additional: Relay teams receive a 50% discount on the registration fee if all four runners also participate in the main race. All competitions except the main race start and end at the Town Hall Square. The event is supported by local sponsors and takes place as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival. Competitions for various age groups, start times, course lengths, registration not yet open.

name: Crosslauf Winhöring
description: The cross-country race in Winhöring offers a varied cross-country event on September 26, 2026, for different age groups and performance levels. The event includes a main race over 7.5 km as well as a children's course over 700 meters. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Winhöring and provides a sporting challenge for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the nature around Winhöring
Main race over 7.5 km
Children's race over 700 meters
additional: Typical weather in September: approx. 19°C daytime high, 10°C low, mostly cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event takes place in September, the weather is typically cloudy, and registration is possible on the website.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
location: Mettingen, Tecklenburger Land, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 3-Valleys Run organized by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V. will take place on September 26, 2026, and leads participants through varied routes across the three valleys Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental, and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The main race over 14.1 km offers challenging, profiled terrain with impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg, and Schniederberg. For beginners and experienced athletes, there is also an 8.3 km two-valleys run as well as a Nordic walking option. Children are warmly invited to participate in an 800 m school run and a 400 m toddler run, with fun being the main focus for the little ones. The event is family-friendly and features timing with a disposable chip, as well as showers and changing facilities at Ludgeri School.
course_highlights: Scenic route through Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental, and Köllbachtal
14.1 km main run with challenging terrain and views of Querenberg, Schafberg, and Schniederberg
8.3 km two-valleys run and Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes
additional: Timing is provided with a disposable chip from Runtiming, integrated into the bib and included in the registration fee. The cut-off time is 4:30 PM; late participants will not be scored. Showers and changing rooms are available at Ludgeri School sports hall. The top three women and men in the main and two-valleys runs, as well as the top three boys and girls in the school run, will receive awards. Personal participant certificates with race times can be downloaded free of charge from the Runtiming homepage. Results are available online at www.tvmettingen.de. Award ceremonies take place after each race. The course runs through the valleys of the Tecklenburger Land, with challenging profiles, children's races, parking available, and online registration possible.

name: Durlacher Turmberglauf
description: The Durlacher Turmberglauf is a flat and fast 10-kilometer race through the historic Durlacher Old Town, along the Pfinz river up to just before Grötzingen and back. The race has established itself as a fixed date for running enthusiasts from the region and offers an attractive course for ambitious runners. Additionally, a children's run takes place in the Durlacher Schlossgarten. The event combines athletic competition with social engagement by collecting donations for charitable causes.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km race through the Durlacher Old Town
Course along the Pfinz river up to just before Grötzingen and back
Children's run in the Durlacher Schlossgarten
additional: Annual fundraising event in support of social projects. Opportunity to join the Africa Runners team and run for a good cause in team jerseys. Race on September 26, 2026, with sponsors from the region, donation campaigns for charitable causes, participation conditions and registration on the official website.

name: Emmertinger Herbstfestlauf
description: The Emmertinger Autumn Festival Run takes place at the sports field in Emmerting and is part of the local autumn festival. The event is aimed at children, adults, club runners, recreational runners, and walkers. There are various distances, including children’s runs, 5- and 10-kilometer races, as well as Nordic walking routes. The family-friendly and festive atmosphere makes the run a popular meeting point for the local running scene.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports field in Emmerting
Children's runs on short forest loops
5- and 10-kilometer races as well as Nordic walking on forest paths
additional: The event is integrated into the local autumn festival with food and drinks available throughout the day. The youngest children run 600 meters on the sports field, older children 2.5 km on a short forest loop. Nordic walkers complete one or two 5 km laps in the forest. The event is a community gathering welcoming runners of all ages and performance levels. It takes place on September 26, 2026, and besides the race program, offers refreshments and a festive atmosphere.

name: Friedrichshaller Runde
description: The Friedrichshaller Runde is a traditional running event in Bad Friedrichshall, taking place on September 26, 2026. It is part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup and offers runners an attractive course through the scenic landscape of the region. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all performance levels and combines sporting challenge with scenic highlights. The organization is carried out by the Bad Friedrichshall city marketing, which is also known for other tourist offerings in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the picturesque landscape of Bad Friedrichshall
Part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup with varied terrain
Combination of natural experience and sporting challenge
additional: Distances: 400 m, 10 km; Registration and results via my.race|result; Listed in the lauf.de race calendar.

name: Halveraner Herbstlauf
location: Innenstadt von Halver, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Halver Autumn Run takes place annually on the last weekend of September in the city center of Halver. Organized by SSV Halver in cooperation with LGHS, the race offers children's and school runs as well as a relay race for amateur athletes. The main race is run as a 4 x 900 meter relay in two scoring classes (U100 and 100+). The event has been a fixture in the local running calendar for over 20 years and runs right through the heart of Halver's city center.
course_highlights: Relay race with 4 x 900 meter laps
Course runs through the Halver city center
Separate races for children, students, and youth
additional: Registrations on the day are possible up to 45 minutes before the start at the registration office or online. An additional fee of €1.50 (online) or €2 (at the registration office) applies for late registrations on the event day. Toilets, showers, and changing facilities are available at Lindenhof School. Streets will be closed from 12:00 PM for the race. All participants receive a medal, and the top three in each age group are additionally honored with medals and certificates. Relay race, 4 x 900 meters, in the Halver city center, age groups U100 / 100+.

name: Herbstfestlauf
description: The 30th Niederstetten Autumn Festival Run takes place around the town hall in Niederstetten and offers varied courses for all age groups. The shorter runs lead through the city center, while the main race runs along the picturesque Vorbachtal valley. Participants can look forward to beautiful views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle. Various race categories from mini run to relay race are available, so everyone can participate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Niederstetten Town Hall
Main race along the Vorbachtal valley
View of vineyards and Weikersheim Castle
additional: The mini runs C and B are held without scoring. There are rankings for school and youth runs, open run, relay race, and main race. The Autumn Festival Run is part of the Tauberfranken Running Community, which organizes several regional running events with scoring for the Tauberfranken Cup. The event includes main, mini, school, and youth runs as well as relay races, with courses through the beautiful region around Niederstetten. The event promotes running in the region and offers attractive prizes for participants.

name: Hofheimer Volkslauf
description: The Hofheim People's Run is a traditional running event taking place on September 26, 2026, at the Sportpark Hofheim in Lampertheim-Hofheim. The race is organized by the Turnverein 1896 Hofheim im Ried e.V. and offers runners of all ages a friendly and family-like atmosphere. The event is known for its good organization and the opportunity to engage in sports and experience community.
course_highlights: Various distances (1 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Running, walking, and Nordic walking competitions
Event location at Sportpark Hofheim with a flat course
additional: Registration is done in writing by downloading a registration form (Word document). Contact persons for questions are Esther Heilmann and Verena Salomon with provided phone numbers and email addresses. There is a contact form on the website for further inquiries. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children and youth competitions. Start times are at 15:15 and 15:30. More details, registration, and the race announcement are available on the website.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedt Boiled Potato Race is a traditional running event that has been held annually since 2002 on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds. With race distances of 2.8 km, 5 km, and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is particularly family-friendly, featuring special children's races for kids and a varied supporting program with games, a food mile, and entertainment. The event promotes community spirit, fun in movement, and is open to individual participants, school classes, teams, and companies.
course_highlights: Three race distances: 2.8 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Children's races of about 500 m for preschool and first grade
Drink stations during the 10 km race and fruit at the finish area
additional: Registration is possible on the day of the event from 11:30 a.m. at the start/finish area. Late registration for children and adolescents costs €8.00 and is possible up to 45 minutes before the race starts. Award ceremonies for places 1-3 in overall and age categories take place at 2:15 p.m., 4:00 p.m., and 5:00 p.m. On the Friday before the race, the potato-themed program begins with the coronation festivities of the Boiled Potato Queen and an after-show party with free admission. Various race distances, children's races, supporting program, award ceremonies, raffles, after-show party, and registration from 11:30 a.m. on the event day.

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
price_range: Super Early Bird Preise (spezifische Preise nicht gelistet)
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race on September 26, 2026, suitable for all fitness levels and age groups with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) up to 20 km. The course runs across the Montgolfiadengelände, the ski slope, and through the quarry, featuring many muddy obstacles, water slides, and foam. The event offers an exciting start show, a unique atmosphere, and has been promoting team spirit and fun since 2007. Whether as a fitness enthusiast, a fun group, or family - everyone will experience an unforgettable adventure in North Rhine-Westphalia.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Montgolfiadengelände
Course runs over the ski slope and through the quarry
Spectacular obstacles with mud, water slides, and foam
additional: Start occurs in multiple starting groups (Overflieger, Slope Starter, Endurance Runner, Latecomer) for different performance levels. There are affordable group rates from 6 participants with discounts up to 20%. Optional extras include finisher shirts, timing, bandanas, and photo flat. Participants under 18 require a parental consent form. Terrain includes ski slope, quarry, water, and foam elements; registration with group discounts; various distances and a Family Edition; entertainment with bands and DJs.

name: Höhlerfestlauf
location: Stadtwald Gera, Hofwiesenpark, Gera, Thuringia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 22 km Höhlerfest-Cross ab AK M/W U20 (ab 18 J., ab Jahrgang 2008: 25 €)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 12 km Hauptlauf ab AK M/W U18 (ab 16 J., ab Jahrgang 2010): 15 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5,0 km Jedermannlauf ab Ak M/W U16 (ab 14 J., ab Jahrgang 2012): 10 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 2,5 km Lauf nur AK U14 und U12 (10-13 Jahre, Jahrgang 2016-2013): 7 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 0,8 km Lauf nur Jahrgang 2017 und später: 4 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 12 km Walking (keine Altersbeschränkung) und Handicap (ab Jahrgang 2010) : 10 €

description: The 11th Höhlerfestlauf on September 26, 2026, in Gera offers a diverse running event with courses for all age groups and performance levels. New is the 22 km cross run with obstacles and 420 meters of elevation gain, passing through the Stadtwald and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are also walking and handicap routes as well as the popular parent-child run for preschool children. The event is characterized by its special atmosphere with live music and a family-friendly vibe, supported by the city of Gera.
course_highlights: 22 km Cross run with obstacles and 420 m elevation gain
Courses through the Gera city forest and Hofwiesenpark
Refreshment points at 6, 11, and 17 km as well as at the finish
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start for a late registration fee of 5 EUR. Award ceremonies begin at 12:15 PM, with trophies for the course winners over 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km. The parent-child run is a fun event with medals and certificates for all children. Live music and a specially composed Höhlerfest song create a special atmosphere. Various running routes including obstacle course, parent-child run, live music, obstacle course for participants with disabilities, Stadtwald and Hofwiesenpark as race venues.

name: Kreismeisterschaften Waldlauf (Kreis Ludwigsburg)
location: Hochdorfer Wald, Remseck am Neckar, Kreis Ludwigsburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Remsecker Forest Run is a family-friendly race in the beautiful Hochdorfer Forest, taking place for the sixth time in 2026. The event offers exciting course routes and an unforgettable sporting experience for runners of all ages. The organizing team of SGV Hochdorf also prepares fresh forest run shirts and informative flyers to support participants. The race will be held on September 26, 2026, and warmly invites all sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Hochdorfer Forest
New, exciting course routes
Family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Weekly training sessions on Fridays at 6:30 PM in front of the forest entrance as preparation for the race. Forest run shirts are available. The registration portal will open in mid-May. Forest run in Hochdorfer Forest, registration and more information on the website, categories for children, adolescents, active participants, and masters.

name: König Ludwig Lauf - Sommeredition
description: The King Ludwig Run - Summer Edition is Bavaria's most beautiful panoramic run in the Ammergau Alps. The event offers varied courses from 6 km to 21 km, passing through the picturesque nature of the Ammergau Alps Nature Park. A free shuttle bus transports participants to the start in Ettal, and the event is ideal for trail and landscape running enthusiasts. The family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized framework make the run a special experience.
course_highlights: Panoramic routes through the Ammergau Alps Nature Park
Course lengths: 21 km half marathon, 10 km panorama run, 6 km wellness run, kids trail
Free shuttle bus from Oberammergau to Ettal to the start
additional: Registration and bib pickup are available at the start in Ettal on Saturday from 07:00 to 09:15. Online registration closes on the Wednesday before race weekend at 00:00. Parking and stops are available. The region is accessible by car, bus, and train. Airports in Munich, Memmingen, and Innsbruck are nearby. The run takes place in the Ammergau Alps Nature Park region. Registration is possible until September 22, 2026; late registrations on the event day are permitted. Accommodation options are available at the Klosterhotel Ettal.

name: Lauf Rund um den Grengel
location: Engelskirchen, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Jugendliche (5 km und 10 km) zahlen nur 7,- €

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Jugendliche (5 km und 10 km) zahlen nur 7,- €

description: The Rund um den Grengel race is a traditional community run in Engelskirchen, organized annually by VfL Engelskirchen e.V., Department of Athletics & Triathlon. The event offers various distances, including a Bambini run, school runs, a 5 km fun run, and a 10 km main race, some of which are held as municipal championships. The course is flat, passing through sports grounds, streets, and forest paths, and is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The family-friendly atmosphere and the involvement of children and adolescents make this race a special event for all age groups.
course_highlights: Flat course over sports grounds, streets, and forest paths
DLV-measured 5 km and 10 km routes
Includes municipal championships over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registrations are possible online up to 60 minutes before the respective start for a fee of €5. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Medical services are provided by the Malteser Engelskirchen. All children in the Bambini run receive a medal, certificates can be viewed and printed online. Awards for the top three overall finishers in the school run, 5 km, and 10 km. The courses are measured by the DLV; start times from 2:00 PM; registration only online; participation open to all age groups; medals for children, digital certificates; medical services on site.

name: Oldersumer Appel-Loop
description: The Oldersumer Appel-Loop is a popular race that runs through the picturesque parks of Oldersum, along the Rorichumer Tief canal, and through the "alte Seilerei" museum. The course ends in the apple park, where the Oldersumer Apple Market takes place simultaneously and offers refreshments. In addition to the main runs over 5 km and 10 km, there is also a 5 km walking route and children's races over 800 meters for various age groups. The race is part of the East Frisian 7 Race Series and provides a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Run through Oldersumer parklands
Course along the Rorichumer Tief canal
Passage through the "alte Seilerei" museum and finish in the apple park
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start of each race. The Appel-Loop is part of the East Frisian 7 Race Series, where participants can receive a series shirt by participating in at least 5 of the 7 races. Races include 800m for children, 5km walking, and 5km and 10km main runs, through parklands and the museum "alte Seilerei".

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Finale 2026 is a youth race held as part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, where ambitious runners aged 12 to 22 can measure their 5 km times. The final in Berlin is part of a series of three races, with times combined to determine the overall winners in the U20 and U23 age groups. In addition to the sporting challenge, attractive prize money and training camp subsidies are available for the best participants. The event promotes young talent and provides an exciting platform for young athletes in running.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km course in the heart of Berlin with start at Potsdamer Platz and finish at the Brandenburg Gate
Part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON with one of the flattest marathon routes among the Abbott World Marathon Majors
Refreshment points and BRITA Refill stations along the route for optimal hydration
additional: Registration is open online from 20.05.2026 to 25.09.2026 via an adult user account. The scoring is in the U20 and U23 age groups, requiring participation in at least three 5 km races of the cup series, including the final in Berlin. Minimum times apply for prize money eligibility. Race packets can only be picked up in person at the MARATHON EXPO. A warming poncho will be provided free of charge to all finishers at the finish area. The R5K is a series of five 5-kilometer races in Germany for youth aged 12 to 22, with overall rankings, prizes for U20 and U23, and training offers.

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
description: The REHAmed Hercules Mountain Run is a challenging mountain run through the Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park in Kassel, which takes place almost exclusively on paved natural paths. The course passes numerous sights such as the Löwenburg, the Steinhöfer Waterfall, and ends at the Hercules Monument. The race is open to runners and walkers and offers individual and relay categories for teams of three, making it ideal for families, clubs, and companies. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Reform School gymnasium, and a luggage transport to the finish line is organized.
course_highlights: Course almost exclusively on paved natural paths in Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park
Passage of well-known sights such as Löwenburg, Steinhöfer Waterfall, and Hercules
Relay race with three segments and baton exchanges at prominent points
additional: Luggage transport to the finish from 10 a.m. at the starting area. Return to the start is self-organized on foot or by bus line 22. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Reform School gymnasium. The relay is scored by adding the times of the three individual segments; there are no age group categories for relays. The course runs on paved natural paths and asphalt. Registration is online via RaceResult. Start and finish are located in Kassel at Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park. Medals are made of wood, T-shirts can be ordered, and showers and changing rooms are available at the Reform School gymnasium.

name: Remsecker Waldlauf
location: Hochdorfer Wald, Remseck am Neckar, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Remsecker Waldlauf is a family-friendly run through the picturesque Hochdorfer Forest in Remseck. The event offers various courses for children, teenagers, and adults, leading through diverse forest terrain with muddy, uneven grounds and narrow paths. The run combines athletic ambition with nature experience and community spirit, and is open to runners of all ages and skill levels. The event is organized by the Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and will take place in 2026 for the sixth time.
course_highlights: Running routes through the beautiful Hochdorfer Forest
Diverse courses with muddy, uneven grounds and small obstacles
Course lengths from 500 m to 7.5 km for all age groups
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event up to 60 minutes before the start, subject to available starting places, with a late registration fee of 3 euros. Each participant receives a bib with an integrated chip. Optionally, a recycled functional shirt can be ordered (children 15 €, adults 20 €). There are team rankings for the middle-distance race. Bib distribution takes place on Friday evening and Saturday morning at the start/finish area. Registration opens in mid-May, route layouts are being prepared, and training sessions are available before the event.

name: Rodheimer Volkslauf

late_fee.price: Nachmeldung möglich am Veranstaltungstag bis 30 Minuten vor Start

description: The Rodheimer Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event and part of the popular Main-Lauf-Cup running series. The start and finish are centrally located at the sports center on the large playing field, offering an attractive stadium atmosphere for all sports enthusiasts. The event includes various competitions from the Bambini run to half marathon and 10 km run, suitable for children as well as fitness enthusiasts and ambitious runners. The award ceremony is lively, and the event enjoys good participation.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on the large playing field with stadium atmosphere
Various distances from 0.15 km Bambini run to half marathon and 10 km
Part of the Main-Lauf-Cup with scoring runs for different age groups
additional: Registrations on the day of the event are possible until about 30 minutes before the respective start. The event offers scoring runs in the Main-Lauf-Cup and BBF-Junior Main-Lauf-Cup. The office is open on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays at specific times. Scenic run, family event, inclusive offerings, various running distances, on-site registration.

name: Schelder Berglauf
description: The Schelder Berglauf is a challenging mountain run in Dillenburg, organized annually by ASC Dillenburg. The course leads through varied terrain with steep ascents and offers runners a sporting challenge in a natural environment. The event attracts both ambitious runners and hobby runners and is a fixed date in the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain course with steep ascents
Natural running route through forest and hills
Traditional event with regional significance
additional: Runner information, terrain, registration, and further details are available on the website.

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank City Run Telgte will take place on September 26, 2026, and offers a diverse program for runners of all ages. The courses lead through the historic old town, along the Ems River, and through the surrounding landscape, vividly reflecting the motto "City, Country, and River." In addition to the main race over 10,000 meters, there are other competitions such as the 5,000-meter run, walking, student and children’s runs, as well as a fun run without timing. The event is suitable for both ambitious runners and casual runners and families, organized by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-meter main run through old town, Ems floodplains, and landscape
5,000-meter run with refreshment station at the halfway point
Varied routes with asphalt, tartan track, paved, and natural paths
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late registration fee of 2 euros (Bambini run once per family or group). Changing rooms are available in the old double hall at the school center near the start and finish lines. Medals, trophies, and certificates are awarded for various competitions and age groups. The course is diverse, featuring asphalt, tartan track, paved, and natural paths. Photo and video recordings will be made and published. The start and finish are located at the school center sports field, registration is online, changing rooms are in the old double hall, and there is no timing for the children’s runs.

name: Wald-und Hügellauf
description: The Forest and Hill Run in Groß-Umstadt is a traditional race that starts and ends at the Ludwig-Wedel-Stadion on September 26, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: the classic 13.2 km course and the half marathon distance of 21.1 km. The race is part of the Long Distance Cup Jugenheim and is an approved race of the DLV. The route runs through forest and hills, where runners can expect witches in the woods and the "Mountain of Truth." Refreshments are provided along the way, and after the race, there will be an award ceremony as well as showers and changing facilities on site.
course_highlights: Forest and hilly landscape with the "Mountain of Truth"
Refreshment stations with water and fruit (1 for 13.2 km, 3 for half marathon)
Start and finish at Ludwig-Wedel-Stadion Groß-Umstadt
additional: Race bibs can be collected until 1:30 PM on the day of the event. Distribution of race numbers from 12:30 to 13:30. The cut-off time for the half marathon is 5:00 PM; participants arriving after this time will no longer be scored. Showers and changing facilities are available. Participants are asked to bring their own cups to reduce their carbon footprint. Refreshments are provided after the race. Late registration is possible on-site on the day of the event. Terrain: forest and hills. Registration: online. Refreshments along the route. Showers available.

name: Weezer Staffellauf
description: The Weeze Relay Race has been held annually in mid-September since 1985 in Weeze and has established itself as a popular relay race with up to 250 participating teams. The course runs on a 5 km loop along the scenic Nierswanderweg. The race offers various relay categories, including Bambini, school children, and standard relays, attracting runners of all ages. The athletics department of TSV Weeze organizes the event with great commitment and looks forward to numerous participants in 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Nierswanderweg
Relay race with Bambini, school children, and standard relays
Race has been held annually since 1985 in mid-September
additional: The 40th Weeze Relay Race will take place on September 26, 2026. Registration details and application process will be announced at the end of July. Up to 250 teams have participated in previous events. The 38th Weeze Relay Race in 2024 recorded 32 Bambini teams, 36 school relay teams, and 55 standard relay teams finishing. Participants can register online until the end of July 2026; the event also includes student and community competitions as well as on-site catering.

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs Potato Run 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three courses: 10 km Bahrs Run, 5 km Potato Run, and an 800 m children's race. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, culinary delights, and a lively accompanying program featuring performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders. Participants must hand in their bib numbers after the race, and no late registrations are accepted. The event is part of the Running Cup and offers not only sporting challenge but also social gathering with a rich cake buffet and hearty foods.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children's race
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs Run at 10:30 AM, 5 km Potato Run at 12:00 PM, 800 m children's race at 1:15 PM. No late registrations possible, registration only in advance. Bib numbers must be handed in after the race. Culinary offerings include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with apple sauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. Performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders around 11:45 AM and 1:00 PM. Award ceremonies take place after each race. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, diverse race options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine running with social gathering.

name: 23. Vinnhorster Volkslauf
description: The 23rd Vinnhorster Volkslauf in Hanover offers flat courses along the canal and through the forest, ideal for personal best times. The race is open to everyone, including walkers and people with walking disabilities. For families, there is a baby jogger run as well as a varied supporting program with a bouncy castle, children's face painting, and a photo booth. A special tradition is the honoring of the 19th and 56th finishers, commemorating the founding of TuS Vinnhorst in 1956. The Volkslauf is an event for all age groups and running levels.
course_highlights: Flat course along the canal
Forest passages
Family-friendly activities with bouncy castle and children's face painting
additional: The race includes distances of 1.2 km, 5 km, and 10 km. Walkers and people with walking disabilities are welcome. There is a baby jogger run for families. Typical weather in September is around 19 °C with a low of 10 °C, mostly cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Flat course, family-friendly activities, special prizes for certain finishers.

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The community run through the beautiful Alstertal takes place on September 27, 2026, in Hamburg and offers runners an attractive natural course along the hiking trails on the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances from half marathon, 10 km, and 4 km to taster runs for children. The route is characterized by its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg with minor ascents and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburg Running Cup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with catering and medical support.
course_highlights: Natural course along the hiking trails on the upper reaches of the Alster
Minor ascents and stairs on the route
Loop courses for 10 km, 4 km, and taster runs with start and finish at the same location
additional: First aid vehicle and DRK emergency service on the course. Showers and changing rooms in the sports hall on the school grounds. Bag storage in the gymnasium (supervised). Finish line catering with drinks and fruit. Photos and certificates available online. Late registrations until September 27 with an additional fee are possible. The event location is the grounds of Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium, Sportplatz Struckholt, Wellingsbütteler Landstr. 43 a, 22337 Hamburg. Run in Alstertal, registration via email possible, results on DAVENGO, part of the Hamburg Running Cup.

name: 52. BMW Berlin-Marathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Teilnahmegebühr für den BMW BERLIN-MARATHON 2025 beträgt 205€.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrierung für den GENERALI 5K ist vom 27. November 2025 bis 25. September 2026 geöffnet.

description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the largest and most renowned marathon events worldwide and part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. The course is known for its flat topography and takes runners past Berlin's most beautiful sights. The event offers not only the traditional marathon but also a 5-kilometer run, inline skating races, and various participation options through charity, tour operators, or running camps. The event is characterized by a unique energy and an international running community.
course_highlights: Flattest course of the Abbott World Marathon Majors with minimal elevation change
Run along Berlin's most beautiful sights
15 refreshment stations with water and energy boosters
additional: On race day, all finishers receive a free, warm, and reusable poncho. Alternatively, for a fee of €5, a clothing drop-off with a transparent bag can be booked. The race documents must be collected in person with the start number and ID at the Marathon Expo. Public transportation within fare zones ABC from September 24 to 27, 2026, is free with the start number. Own provisions can be handed in at designated refreshment stations (no glass containers). Options include charity participation, travel packages, inline skating, training camps, and special bibs for charity runners. The event is part of the World Marathon Majors series.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a traditional race event held in the city of Northeim. The races start and end at Münsterplatz, a central location in the city. The event is organized by the Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and includes various running routes through the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Münsterplatz in Northeim
City-close running routes through Northeim
Organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V.
additional: Start and finish are at Münsterplatz, Northeim. The race office is located in the Bürgersaal at Münsterplatz. Online registration for 2026 is not yet available. The results lists from the previous year are available online. The event offers a mix of street and trail runs, taking place in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Registration is not yet available, but interested participants can look forward to September 27, 2026.

name: 7-MEILEN-TRAIL
description: The 7-mile trail in Kaiserslautern offers two challenging routes: a short 4-mile route for running and Nordic walking, and a long 7-mile route exclusively for runners. The courses lead through varied terrain with a high proportion of single-trails and are completely free of asphalt. Start and finish are located opposite the Sommerhaus restaurant on Pfaffenbergstraße. The event is ideal for trail running enthusiasts seeking a natural and demanding running course.
course_highlights: 4-mile route approx. 6.4 km with 130 meters of elevation
7-mile route approx. 11.3 km with 340 meters of elevation
Courses consist of 40-60% single-trails, completely free of asphalt
additional: Start and finish opposite the Sommerhaus restaurant on Pfaffenbergstraße. Refreshment stations: 1x at the finish area on the 4-mile route; 2x on the 7-mile route (after 6 km at the TSG fountain and at the finish). The long route is only for runners, the short route also for Nordic walking. Trail running, event date: 2026-09-27, location: Kaiserslautern, course length approx. 11 km, elevation gain approx. 340 meters

name: Aindlinger Kleeblattmarsch

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr für ein bis zwei Runden (25 oder 50 km) beträgt 30 €.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr für ein bis vier Runden (25, 50, 75 oder 100 km) beträgt 50 €.

description: The Aindlinger Cloverleaf March is a unique 24-hour march where participants can complete up to 100 kilometers in four rounds of 25 kilometers each. The route is unmarked and there are no road closures, requiring strong willpower and orientation skills. The course leads through varied, hilly landscapes around Aindling, including forest and farmland sections as well as picturesque villages. The march supports social projects, combining athletic effort with a good cause.
course_highlights: Four rounds of 25 km each with different characteristics and elevation profiles
Route without markings and road closures, pure willpower is required
Varied scenic paths through forest, farmland, Lech floodplains, and small villages
additional: Relay march only possible in the 100 km distance with four participants, no individual ranking. Functional T-shirt with Cloverleaf March print optional for €25. Registration is possible online until September 25, 2026. Members of the association receive a 50% discount on the starting fee. Event on September 27, 2026, registration until August 29, 2026, social projects are supported.

name: Altkönig-Lauf
price_range: 10 km 16,00 Euro, Halbmarathon 18,00 Euro, Schülerläufe 5,00 Euro, Walking 14,00 Euro
description: The Altkönig Run, organized by MTV Kronberg, is a traditional popular race approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), taking place on September 27, 2026. Participants can choose from a half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km runs, as well as school runs, a Bambini race, and walking/nordic walking events. The course leads through the scenic Taunus landscape with approximately 350 meters of elevation gain in the half marathon. The race is part of the Taunus Run Challenge and offers all finishers a medal, as well as trophies and cash prizes for the top runners. The start and finish are located at the MTV sports facility in Kronberg.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approximately 350 meters of elevation
Start and finish at the MTV sports facility in Kronberg
Part of the Taunus Run Challenge with three scoring races
additional: Every finisher receives a medal. The walking and Nordic walking competitions over 10 km start at 9:40 AM without scoring. School runs begin at 12:00 PM with distances of 350 m and 1000 m. There is a refreshment station on the course. Participants are asked to bring reusable cups or their own mugs to protect the environment. The award ceremony is scheduled around 1:00 PM with finisher trophies for all present participants and cash prizes for the top runners. The courses run through the Taunus on forest paths, with elevation gains of 150 meters for the 10 km and 350 meters for the half marathon. Start and finish are at the MTV sports facility in Kronberg. Registration is available online and on race day. Environmentally conscious behavior is encouraged during refreshments.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Volkslauf and Nordic Walking event organized by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is an annual event held on September 27, 2026, marking its 34th edition. The race is very popular, with a record number of participants last year. The event offers various running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and is open to athletes of all ages. Registration opens at the end of June, with late registrations accepted up to 30 minutes before each start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Course lengths of 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Includes Nordic Walking
Event location in Wittmar, Germany
additional: Late registrations are accepted up to 30 minutes before each start, except for the kindergarten run. Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information can be found in the official announcement; the event includes running and Nordic Walking disciplines.

name: Auricher Spendenlauf
location: Energie Erlebnis Zentrum, Aurich, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Aurich charity run is a non-profit running event in support of various charitable organizations such as Leukin e.V. and the Volunteer Fire Department Sandhorst. The races take place around the Energie Erlebnis Zentrum in Aurich and offer various competitions for all age groups, from toddler runs to main races over 5 and 10 kilometers. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and support from numerous helpers and sponsors. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races, and certificates are available online.
course_highlights: Toddler, handicap, and youth runs around the walking trail around the Energie Erlebnis Zentrum in East Frisia
5 km and 10 km main runs through industrial and residential areas with start and finish at the Energie Erlebnis Zentrum
The 10 km run consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site 30 minutes before the start of each competition. The award ceremonies for the toddler and senior runs are held at 12:30 PM, and for the main runs at 3:30 PM. Certificates for the top three places are awarded shortly after each race; additional certificates can be downloaded online. Races for children, youth, and people with disabilities, online registration, donation purpose, courses around the Energie Erlebnis Zentrum, race times and age groups according to DLV, course map available.

name: Kienberglauf
description: The Kienberglauf is a traditional running event organized by SV 08 Oehrenstock e.V., held annually on the last Sunday of September. The event offers various competitions for different age groups and skill levels, including Nordic Walking, children's runs, and courses ranging from 2 to 16 kilometers. The route takes participants through the scenic surroundings of Oehrenstock near Ilmenau and is a highlight of the club's activities. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, and all participants receive a certificate.
course_highlights: Scenic courses around Oehrenstock
Various distances from 800 m to 16 km
Competitions for all age groups and Nordic Walking
additional: Late registrations are possible until 9:00 AM on the day of the event for a fee of €3.00. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, and all participants receive a certificate. The event includes multiple start times for different competitions, e.g., Nordic Walking at 9:30 AM, Kindergarten Mile at 9:35 AM, and various running distances starting from 10:00 AM. Start times are between 9:30 and 10:10 AM, registration until 9:00 AM with a late registration fee, certificates and trophies for participants.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Cloverleaf Ultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, passing through three districts. The event was conceived to establish the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated four-person team, the race offers a unique opportunity for experienced ultrarunners to face a special challenge. The course consists of four cloverleaf sections of 25 miles each, run consecutively. The event emphasizes professional organization with timing, live tracking, and refreshment stations.
course_highlights: 100 miles through three districts
Four individual sections of 25 miles each (cloverleaves)
Start and finish area in Schwarme with sports hall as event center
additional: Check-in on 25.09.2026 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 26.09.2026 from 07:00 to 08:30. Briefing on 26.09.2026 at 08:30. Cutoff time on 27.09.2026 at 15:00. Participation only from 18 years old. Participant limit: 30 individual runners and 5 relay teams of 2 persons each. Includes timing, live tracking, pasta party, and a hearty breakfast. Relay start possible with adherence to the order of the cloverleaves (South, West, North, East). No shortening of the course allowed. Course length 162 km, registration required, cutoff times, sponsors welcome, volunteer search, GPX data available.

name: Kraichgaulauf
description: The Kraichgaulauf in Sinsheim-Rohrbach is a traditional race taking place on September 27, 2026, offering runners of all performance levels varied courses through the scenic Kraichgau landscape. From the short 5 km route to the popular 10 km run, the challenging half marathon, and the demanding hill marathon with 42.2 km, there is something for everyone. The courses lead through nature and offer breathtaking views, including the landmark Burg Steinsberg. The event is ideal for those who want to combine endurance, nature experience, and sporting ambition.
course_highlights: Hilly marathon with varied elevation profiles and breathtaking views
10 km route with asphalt, paved field paths, and idyllic forest sections
5 km route with panoramic views of the Kraichgau and Burg Steinsberg
additional: Race number pickup until 30 minutes before the start at Kreuzgrundhalle. Changing rooms and showers available at Kreuzgrundhalle and on the sports grounds. Parking around the hall and in the sports field area. Bag storage at the start/finish area (Grundschule Rohrbach). Refreshments with drinks, fruit, and snacks at multiple stations depending on the route. Medal for all finishers. Time measurement with disposable timing chip integrated into the race bib. Late registration possible until 30 minutes before the start, subject to availability. Limited to 1000 participants. Various distances, registration opens on April 15, 2026, focusing on nature and experience.

name: Kurparklauf 2026
location: Kurpark, Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe, Hesse, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf in Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe takes place annually and transforms the Kurpark into an attractive running course. The event offers two distances: a 10 km fun run for experienced runners and a 5 km fun run for everyone who prefers a shorter and more accessible route. Both runs start and end at Brunnenallee and lead over a 2.5 km loop through the green Kurpark, passing meadows, trees, and garden paths, without crossing heavily trafficked roads. The run is an established event, celebrating its 30th edition in 2026.
course_highlights: Run through the green Kurpark of Bad Homburg
Shared 2.5 km loop for 5 km (2 laps) and 10 km (4 laps)
Avoidance of heavily trafficked roads, natural course
additional: Participants can download their certificates after the run. Registration usually begins in early August. The event will be the 30th edition of the Kurparklauf in 2026. Distances: 5 km and 10 km; registration begins in early August; certificates available after the run.

name: Lions - Dietzenbacher Stadtlauf 2026
description: The Lions - Dietzenbach City Run is an established running event in the Hessentagspark Dietzenbach that combines athletic activity with social engagement. Every year, numerous runners of all ages participate, accompanied by families and spectators. The event offers a 4 km fun run, a competition for businesses and clubs, and a 10 km main race. The city run stands for community, movement, and responsibility for the city of Dietzenbach.
course_highlights: Run in the Hessentagspark Dietzenbach
4 km fun run and 10 km main race
Competition for the trophy for businesses and clubs
additional: The city run is a charity event supporting social causes in Dietzenbach. There is a trophy competition for businesses and clubs. The event is supported by numerous volunteers and is a regular part of the city's event calendar. The event promotes social cohesion, with team competitions for local clubs and companies; the net proceeds benefit youth education and youth sports in Dietzenbach.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marner Kohlta Lauf is a traditional race in Dithmarschen and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup as well as the Dithmarscher Corporate Cup. The event offers various distances from 400 meters for children to 10 kilometers for adults. The routes are traffic-free, well signposted, and each kilometer is marked. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish line, and timing is professionally managed with a chip on the start number. The event takes place in almost all weather conditions and offers changing rooms and showers in the Marne swimming hall.
course_highlights: Traffic-free and well signposted routes with kilometer markings
Water stations every 5 km and refreshments at the finish (mineral water, isotonic drinks, fruit)
Timing with chip on the start number without rental fee
additional: Late registrations are possible online up to 30 minutes before the start with a late registration fee of €5. Data adjustments and re-registrations are possible for a processing fee of €5. The event takes place in almost all weather conditions. Changing rooms are available, and showers can be used in the Marne swimming hall. Various race distances, registration until August 2026, routes well signposted, refreshments and changing facilities on site.

name: Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf
description: The 10th Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf is a traditional scenic race for running and Nordic Walking enthusiasts, taking place on September 26 and 27, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Möhrendorf. The course runs through forest, meadow, and field paths past numerous carp ponds and includes approximately 150 meters of elevation gain over 21.1 km. In addition to the half marathon, there are Nordic Walking and various youth and children’s races. The event offers a diverse and natural race setting for all age groups.
course_highlights: Scenic race over forest, meadow, and field paths
Course passing many carp ponds
Approximately 150 meters of elevation gain over 21.1 km
additional: Registration until September 23, 2026. Start times on September 26 from 14:30, and on September 27 until 13:00.
