location: Rothaargebirge, Bad Berleburg-Aue, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Rothaar Forest Run organized by TSV Aue-Wingeshausen is a popular and scenic forest run in the Rothaar Mountains, taking place on October 3, 2026. The event offers various distances, including loop courses and point-to-point runs, appealing to both ambitious athletes and hobby runners. The races are part of the Rothaar Run Series AOK-Cup, celebrating its 25th anniversary this year. The course passes through beautiful forest areas with moderate inclines and provides excellent catering as well as a bus transfer to the start points of the longer distances.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400m to 28km, including loop courses and point-to-point runs
Start and finish at the sports field in Aue-Wingeshausen with bus transfer to the start points of the longer distances
Scenic forest routes with moderate inclines and good catering
additional: Start times vary depending on the distance, e.g., 13:30 for the main race. There is a bus transfer from the Aue-Wingeshausen gymnasium to the start points of the long distances (15km and 28km). Race documents can be picked up shortly before the start at various locations. Showers and changing facilities are available at the gymnasium. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start at the start points. The event is part of the Rothaar Run Series AOK-Cup celebrating 25 years. Participants benefit from bus shuttle transport, catering with cake, waffles, and fries, as well as a well-established tradition in the race calendar. The event is part of the Rothaar Run Series AOK-Cup.

name: Saerbecker Kirmeslauf
price_range: Bambinilauf € 1,00; Schülerläufe 1,2 km und 2 km € 3,00; 5 km Jedermannlauf € 8,00; 10 km Hauptlauf € 10,00
description: The Saerbeck Fair Race takes place on October 3, 2026, at the Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck. The course is completely asphalted, flat, and runs along well-developed side streets, enabling fast race times. The event offers races for various age groups with timing via transponder and a ranking based on finish times. Medals are awarded to children, and there is an award ceremony for overall and age group rankings. Participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Well-developed, fully asphalted course
Flat side streets for fast race times
Start and finish at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck
additional: Timing is done with a transponder on the back of the bib. The order of finish determines the ranking. An online certificate is available for all participants. The course is secured by volunteers, but traffic rules must still be observed. Each child in the children's races receives a medal. Liability for theft is excluded. Participants must confirm they are in good health. Online registration is possible; late registration on the event day for a fee; event conducted under official supervision according to DLV/IWR rules.

name: Sparkassen-Phoenix-Halbmarathon
description: The Sparkassen Phoenix Half Marathon in Dortmund is a popular half marathon race held annually on October 3rd. The 21.1 km course runs through the southern part of Dortmund, passing Phoenix Lake, Phoenix West, Westfalenpark, and Rombergpark, and is fully measured to allow for personal best times. In addition to the individual half marathon, there are relay competitions and a KNAX Fun Run for children. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, cheer zones, and a rendezvous point for relay runners shortly before the finish line.
course_highlights: Course runs through Phoenix Lake, Phoenix West, Westfalenpark, and Rombergpark
Measured 21.1 km course, eligible for personal bests
Change zones at kilometers 7 and 14 with shuttle bus connections
additional: Race bib distribution on October 2nd from 14:00 to 17:00 and on race day from 8:30. Race bibs are personalized and sent by mail. Late registrations are possible online until October 3rd at 10:00, thereafter on-site for a fee. Relay teams receive a relay baton for timing, which can be picked up on race day with ID. Refreshments are available at kilometers 4, 11, and 17 as well as in the finish area. Changing rooms, toilets, and baggage drop-off are located at the Sparkassen Academy at Phoenix Lake. Shuttle buses transport relay runners to the change zones. A rendezvous point is approximately 150 meters before the finish for relay runners. The course passes through parks and industrial areas. Registration, advertising opportunities, and race on October 3rd.

name: Stauch Cup

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Paul Kleinknecht Kinder- und Jugendlauf 5 Euro

description: The Stauch Cup, also known as the Kupferzeller Kärwelauf, is a traditional running competition in Kupferzell. It offers various race distances for all age groups, including a toddler run, children and youth run, health run, Nordic walking, and the main race. The event takes place around the Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle, which also serves as the start and finish area as well as for changing and showers. The award ceremonies are held in the hosted hall, creating a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: RECA toddler run over 400 m
Paul Kleinknecht children and youth run over 2,600 m
Main race over 10,000 m
additional: Number bib distribution and late registrations begin at 11:00 AM. The award ceremonies take place in the hosted Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle. The town center will be closed from 1:30 PM due to the race event, parking spaces are signposted, please park outside and walk to the hall. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle. Various running disciplines, online registration, parking facilities at the Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle, weather in October usually around 14°C with occasional rain.

name: Staufener Altstadtlauf
description: The Old Town Run Staufen is a traditional running event held annually on October 3rd in the historic Old Town of Staufen. The race is part of the Markgräfler Cup and offers runners an attractive course through the picturesque Old Town. The event attracts both amateur runners and ambitious athletes and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Old Town of Staufen
Part of the Markgräfler Cup
Scenic route with regional flair
additional: The race takes place on October 3, 2026, and is a popular event for runners of all levels. The course leads through the picturesque alleys of the Old Town, making the run a special experience.

name: Stimberg-Haardlauf
description: The Stimberg-Haardlauf is a traditional race in Oer-Erkenschwick with start and finish at Stimbergpark. Various distances are offered for children, adolescents, and adults, including 500 m, 4.9 km, and 9.4 km. The adult routes are hilly and provide an interesting alternative to flat road races. The race includes individual and team classifications and is aimed at club runners, local teams, as well as youth and adult athletes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stimbergpark in Oer-Erkenschwick
Hilly routes for adults with 4.9 km and 9.4 km
Shorter distances for children and adolescents, e.g., 500 m
additional: The schedule is organized by age groups and competitions, including categories such as forest run, short and longer cross-country runs. There are individual registrations and team classifications. Typical weather in October is around 14 °C with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The race features a hilly terrain with rolling hills. Registration is done online until shortly before the event, with various categories for different age groups and performance levels.

name: Strausseelauf
description: The Strausseelauf in Strausberg is a traditional running event held annually. The event offers runners of various skill levels the opportunity to compete and enjoy the beautiful surroundings around Lake Straus. The race is organized by the Kultur- und Sportclub Strausberg e.V. and takes place at the Theodor-Fontane-Gymnasium in Strausberg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organization.
course_highlights: Run around Lake Straus
Start and finish at Theodor-Fontane-Gymnasium
Traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Application form and flyer for the Strausseelauf are available, results are published on the official website

name: Taubertal 100
location: Rothenburg ob der Tauber, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Taubertal 100 is a scenic ultramarathon with distances of 50 km, 70 km, 100 km, 2 x 100 km, and 100 miles. The point-to-point course runs from Rothenburg ob der Tauber to Bad Mergentheim, Tauberbischofsheim, or Gemünden and offers one of the most beautiful ultra-running routes in Germany. The race is IAU Bronze certified and measured, making it eligible for world records. In addition to the sporting experience, there is a runner dinner and organized return transports. High-quality functional shirts, caps, and multifunctional scarves are optionally available.
course_highlights: Point-to-point course from Rothenburg to Bad Mergentheim, Tauberbischofsheim, or Gemünden
IAU Bronze certification and measured routes over 50 km, 70 km, 100 km, and 100 miles
Beautiful landscape images along the route
additional: Runner dinner with lecture on Friday at 6:00 PM at Hotel Rappen (3-course buffet, vegetarian, no drinks). Return transports by buses from various destinations to Rothenburg at scheduled times. Accompanying persons can be brought under the same conditions. Qualification requirements for 100 km, 70 km, and 50 km distances are defined. High-quality functional shirts, sports caps, and multifunctional scarves (Buff) are optionally available, not included in the registration fee. The event is IAU accredited (Bronze for all distances), offers a scenic route, medals for finishers, and is known for its fast and attractive course. The event takes place over a long weekend, ideal for families and running enthusiasts.

name: Treiser Volkslauf
description: The Treiser Volkslauf takes place on October 3, 2026, for the 34th time in Staufenberg-Treis. The event is aimed at runners, walkers, and hikers of all performance levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a large cake buffet and delicious pea soup. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a popular running series in Hesse and the surrounding area. Registration opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result.
course_highlights: Participation in the Mittelhessen-Cup, a regional running series
Various routes for running, walking, and hiking
Large cake buffet and pea soup as refreshments
additional: Registration for the Volkslauf opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result. There is a large cake buffet and pea soup for participants. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup running series with multiple events in the region. The club also offers regular running and walking groups as well as beginner courses. Running, walking, and hiking event, community activities, refreshments including cake buffet and pea soup.

name: Volks - und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede
price_range: 2,00 EUR (zusätzliche Gebühr bei Voranmeldung bis Limit)
description: The People's and Fire Brigade Run Rhede is a traditional running event organized by the Rhede Fire Department. The event takes place annually and offers runners the opportunity to participate in a friendly and safe environment. The races start at the Rhede School Center and feature a varied course through the town. Participants receive material prizes for the top four finishers as well as certificates and live results available on-site and online.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rhede School Center, Büssingstraße 14
Varied course through Rhede
Live results on monitors in the finish area and online
additional: Late registration is possible for a fee of 2.00 EUR until 30 minutes before the respective start. Registration on October 2nd from 18:00 to 19:00 and on October 3rd from 09:00 at the registration office. The use of MP3 players is prohibited for safety reasons. Baby joggers and dogs are not allowed. Material prizes for the top four finishers (male/female). Event at Rhede School Center, registration on October 2nd and 3rd, participation conditions include safety rules such as no MP3 players, strollers, or dogs, results available live and online.

name: Volkslauf SV Traisa
description: The Volkslauf of SV 1911 Traisa takes place annually on October 3rd at the sports field Traisa in Mühltal. The event offers runners a choice between an ambitious half marathon and a classic 11 km run. The course leads through the scenic surroundings and traditionally ends at a large cake table welcoming all participants. The run is a popular opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete and enjoy the holiday together.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 11 km course options
Start and finish at the sports field Traisa
Scenic course with elevation profile
additional: The race takes place annually on October 3rd. The event concludes with a large cake table for all participants. The sports field Traisa is easily accessible by car, bus, and regional train. There are no explicit details about start waves or late registration fees on the website. The event begins at 9:00 AM for the main race and at 11:30 AM for the youth race. It is held at the sports field Traisa in Mühltal and is a convivial club race with a community character.

name: 4 Moore Ultratrail-Marathon
description: The 4 Moore Ultratrail Marathon is a non-commercial ultratrail landscape run over 53 kilometers around Langenhagen. The route passes through diverse moor and heath areas, including Kananoher Forest, Black Moor, Otternhagen Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Great Heath, and Bissendorf Moor. The course is unmarked and run via GPS navigation, with a final GPS track and a briefing sent via email beforehand. Three refreshment stations offer drinks and snacks, with participants required to carry their own drinking containers and cups. Participation is limited to 50 runners, with a time limit of 9 hours.
course_highlights: 53 km ultratrail through moors and heath areas near Langenhagen
Route passes through Kananoher Forest, Black Moor, Otternhagen Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Great Heath, and Bissendorf Moor
Unmarked course requiring GPS navigation with pre-provided track
additional: Maximum 50 participants. Time limit 9 hours. Three refreshment stations with cola, water, fruit, and snacks, some unmanned. Bring your own water bottle and cup. At the finish, coffee, cake, bratwurst, and drinks. Participants must be at least 18 years old. Participation at own risk, no liability from the organizer. Trail sections, GPS navigation, 3 refreshment stations, maximum 50 participants, 9-hour limit, start in Kaltenweide.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
price_range: Kinder: 5 €, 2.500 m-Lauf: 8 €, 5.000 m-Lauf: 10 €, 10.000 m-Lauf: 12 €, Nordic Walking: 10 €
description: The Burgdorf Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt city festival in Burgdorf. On October 4, 2026, the 14th edition of this popular event will take place, welcoming hobby runners of all ages. The courses run along the Aue river and through the city center, starting and finishing at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. The event offers races over 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, as well as Nordic walking and a children's run.
course_highlights: Course along the Aue river and through the city center of Burgdorf
Start and finish at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße
Children's run over 660 meters through central streets of Burgdorf
additional: Timing is done electronically via chip at the start number. Online certificates are available for all participants. Late registration on the day of the event from 12:30 to 13:30 with an additional fee of €4 is possible. Parking options include the train station, Schützenplatz, and Rathaus II. The award ceremony takes place at the Auebrücke after the main races. The run takes place in all weather conditions. The course runs through Burgdorf along the Aue, castle, and city park; registration is open until October 2, 2024; parking is available nearby.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The 23rd Central German Marathon on October 4, 2026, offers a unique running experience through the Central German metropolitan region with start in Leipzig and finish in Halle (Saale). The course passes through two federal states and two cities, starting at the Sportforum in Leipzig and ending in the over 1,200-year-old cultural capital Halle. In addition to the marathon, there are other disciplines such as the Handellauf half marathon, the half marathon relay, 10 km run, 10 km walk, Salzwirkerlauf, and the AOK Schnupperlauf. The event combines sporting challenge with cultural highlights and green running routes in the Handel city.
course_highlights: Start in Leipzig at Sportforum, finish in Halle at Marktplatz
Course through two federal states and two cities
Run through the green lungs of the Handel city and the city center of Halle
additional: Start and finish at different locations: start in Leipzig at Sportforum, finish in Halle at Marktplatz. Various disciplines including relay and walking. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible. Distribution of start documents takes place in Leipzig. The event combines sporting challenge with cultural and scenic highlights. Multiple distances, start and finish in Halle - Marktplatz as well as Leipzig - Elsterflutbecken; routes are still subject to approval. The weather in October is usually mild with temperatures around 14°C.

name: 26. Generali Köln Marathon
organizer: Kölner Marathon Veranstaltungs- und Werbe GmbH
description: The Generali Cologne Marathon is a unique running experience that combines top-level and recreational sports with carnival, folk festival, and running festival. The course takes runners through lively Cologne neighborhoods such as Rodenkirchen, Lindenthal, Ehrenfeld, and Nippes, ending spectacularly at Cologne Cathedral. With up to 15,000 participants, the marathon offers an exhilarating atmosphere supported by thousands of spectators along the route. The event also emphasizes sustainability and features a diverse accompanying program.
course_highlights: Start in Deutz at Ottoplatz with a panoramic view of Cologne Cathedral and the Old Town
Passage three times at Rudolfplatz with strong spectator support
Course through diverse districts such as Südstadt, Ehrenfeld, and Nippes
additional: The marathon starts in Deutz at Ottoplatz and includes multiple transition zones for relay and school marathons. There are 11 refreshment stations during the marathon and 6 during the half marathon. The event is limited to 15,000 participants for the marathon. The course passes well-known Cologne sights and districts, with the finish line at Cologne Cathedral. The event emphasizes sustainability and offers a diverse program with carnival and running festival. Registration is open, with various race disciplines, limited starting spots, special competitions for students, and a sustainable event.

name: Apfellauf 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr: 19 Euro inklusive Getränke und einem Snack.

description: The Apple Run 2026 will take place on October 4th in Mössingen-Laubuseschbach and offers runners a scenic route through orchards, forest and field paths, as well as on a closed state road. The start and finish are located on the premises of the Heil Cider Mill. Two distances are offered: 5 kilometers (one lap) and 10 kilometers (two laps). The race is open to professional and recreational athletes as well as teams competing together. There is a free children's run for kids up to 9 years old.
course_highlights: Route passes by orchards
Forest and field paths as well as a closed state road L3063
Return route along the bike path to Laubuseschbach
additional: The 5 km run starts at 10:00 AM, the 10 km run at 10:15 AM. There is a free children's run for kids up to 9 years old at 12:00 PM. Teams consist of at least 8 people with at least 2 runners on each distance. The two fastest runners of each route are counted for the team ranking. Finisher shirts could only be ordered until May 15, 2026. Race takes place in a scenic environment, registration until June 11, 2026, finisher shirt offer until May 15, 2026, team and children's runs.

name: Bayerische Halbmarathon-Meisterschaften
location: Auf dem Westring, near Linde MH Arena, Aschaffenburg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Bavarian Half Marathon Championships will take place on October 4, 2026, in Aschaffenburg on Westring near the Linde MH Arena. The event is organized by TV Haibach and is open to active and masters athletes from Lower Franconia, Bavarian Lower Main, North Bavaria, and all of Bavaria. The championship offers runners the opportunity to compete on an official half marathon course and to win Bavarian championship titles. Online registration is possible until September 22, 2026.
course_highlights: Half marathon course on Westring in Aschaffenburg
Start and finish near the Linde MH Arena
Event as part of the Bavarian State Championships
additional: Registration deadline is September 22, 2026, online registrations are accepted until 11:59 PM. The event is classified as a state championship (category 6.4.3). No information is provided about start times or prize categories on the website. Registration closes on September 22, 2026; location is on Westring near the Linde MH Arena; category: State Championships

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organized by the sports club SV Kirchboitzen. The event will take place in 2026 for the 19th time as an in-person event and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants will receive the most important information directly on-site from the organizing team. Additional practical tips will be provided by SV Kirchboitzen.
course_highlights: Distances: 800 m and 14 km
Typical October weather with about 14 °C and mostly cloudy
Event in the Walsrode region, Lower Saxony
additional: The event is a local club race with walking. The most important info is given on-site by the organizing team, with further details provided by SV Kirchboitzen. It is recommended to check the event details with the organizer before registration. The event takes place in autumn weather with temperatures around 6-14°C, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. It is aimed at runners and walkers who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere.

name: Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, which are flat and easily manageable, making them ideal for hobby runners and beginners. The start and finish are often located at the Eiderstadion, giving the event a family-friendly and straightforward atmosphere. The race attracts children, teenagers, and local club runners and is a regular part of the regional running scene in autumn.
course_highlights: Flat road race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly and local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather with approximately 14°C daytime temperature and mostly cloudy skies. There are various distances from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a Corona break, the procedure was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish at the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat routes; event in autumn; start and finish at the stadium; participation open to all age groups.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: The Cottbus October Run is a traditional race event held at the Cottbus Sports Center in the athletics stadium and mainly in the forest on solid paths and bike paths. The event offers various distances from 400 meters up to the half marathon (21.1 km), with partly paved and unpaved routes. There are special races for children and adolescents with obstacles and varied course sections. Participants receive a commemorative medal and can download certificates online. The event is part of the Sparkassen Run and Walking Cup and offers trophies and material prizes for the best runners in different age groups.
course_highlights: Courses at the Cottbus Sports Center with start and finish in the athletics stadium
Forest passages with solid paths and bike paths, partly unpaved routes
Refreshment points at the Spree Bridge on the longer distances
additional: Timing is done with an ankle transponder, which must be returned after the race (20 EUR fee in case of loss). The bib number must be visibly worn on the chest. Trophies, certificates, and material prizes are awarded for age groups and overall finishes. Changes to the courses for 5 km, 10.5 km, and 21.1 km should be noted. Late registrations are possible online until October 3, 2025, and on-site until one hour before the start. The race starts at 10:50 AM, participation is part of the Sparkassen Run and Walking Cup, online registration is available, with various categories including children and toddler runs.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race taking place on October 4, 2026, in Bad Liebenwerda. The route runs from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda back to Munich and offers a scenic course along the Elster. The race is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, where competitive spirit is secondary. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and at the finish line, participants can enjoy a cozy celebration with drinks and grilled food. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available upon request.
course_highlights: Race route from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda and back
Refreshments approximately every 5 kilometers with drinks and apples
Finish with a Maß beer or other drink and a festival tent with grilled food
additional: Number bibs are issued at the respective starting locations until the start time. Bus transfer from Munich to Bad Liebenwerda is possible upon registration (departure around 9:10 AM). Luggage transfer from the start to the finish is offered. Free entry to the festival tent on race day, grilled food for a small fee. Due to current circumstances, the start from Schweinfurth has been canceled. 14 km run/hike, registration via email, bus transfer from Munich, no official timing.

name: Gaudilauf 27
description: The Munich-BaLi-Munich, formerly known as Gaudilauf, is a 27 km road race in Munich, Germany. The race typically takes place in early October with a start in the morning. The event is organized by LWV 05 Bad Liebenwerda, indicating a club-organized race with a modest number of participants, fewer than 100 runners. The event offers good organization and value for money, although the course is rated as average in scenic quality.
course_highlights: 27 km road race in Munich
Start in the morning in early October
Small field of participants under 100 runners
additional: The race is organized by the club LWV 05 Bad Liebenwerda. The number of participants is small, with only a few finishers recently. The weather in October is typically cool and cloudy, with an average of 14°C during the day and 6°C at night, and about 40 mm of precipitation. 27 km road race, early October, small participant field, registration via website, scenic course with an average rating.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Autumn Run in Ovenhausen is a traditional race event organized annually on the first Sunday in October by TuS Ovenhausen. The event offers various courses for different age and performance groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and mountains as well as shorter runs for young athletes. The race features a diverse route with sections on bike paths, in the Grube Stadium, and in the forest. It is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.
course_highlights: 20.8 km tour through forests and mountains near Ovenhausen
Sections on bike paths and in the Grube Stadium
Forest run with varied terrain
additional: The race traditionally takes place on the first Sunday in October. There are various age groups and distances, including a 1,000m run for children and a 4.5 km run, which is also counted as the district championship in cross-country running. The event is organized by TuS Ovenhausen, which works closely with HLC Höxter. Runs on forest paths, district championships, distances from 1 km to 20.8 km, start and finish locations only visible with RUNME Premium.

name: Herbstlauf Ready4Run Niederwangen
description: The Autumn Run Niederwangen takes place annually on October 4, 2026, and is part of the Voralpen VBAO Cup. The race offers a quarter marathon distance and is known for its attractive cup ranking, with the overall victory ceremony held during the Autumn Run. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and is a regular feature of regional running events.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon distance
Part of the Voralpen VBAO Cup with overall ranking
Attractive race route in Niederwangen
additional: The Autumn Run is part of the VBAO Cup, which does not have minimum participation requirements or discard results. The overall victory ceremony takes place during the Autumn Run in Niederwangen. The event occurs in October in Wangen im Allgäu, with various categories including children and youth runs. Registration is online, and the event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a sporting competitive spirit.

name: IRT - Läufermeeting
location: Industriepark Region Trier, Föhren, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The IRT Running Meeting takes place annually in early October at the premises of the Trier Region Industrial Park (IRT) in Föhren. The event offers super flat, very fast, and officially DLV-measured courses that are ideal for personal best times. Disciplines offered include 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km for children and adolescents. Net time measurement is used for all races except the Bambini race, with a single-use bib with an integrated transponder. Changing and shower facilities are available at the nearby Föhren elementary school.
course_highlights: Super flat, very fast, and officially DLV-measured courses
Event held on the premises of the Trier Region Industrial Park (IRT)
Net time measurement with single-use bib and integrated transponder
additional: Late registrations on the day of the event are possible on-site until at least one hour before the start of each discipline for an additional fee (Bambini and children’s races free of charge). Bib number distribution on the day of the event on-site until 5 minutes before the start. Changing and shower facilities are approximately 3 km away at Föhren elementary school. Toilets are available in the start/finish area. The event takes place annually in early October, with online registration via Chiplauf. It offers an excellent opportunity for runners to achieve personal best times and participate in regional competitions.

name: Kalbsvilla Run
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Kalbsvilla Run takes place in Ortenberg, Hesse, with the historic Kalbsvilla at Am Mühltor serving as the start and finish area. Various distances are offered, including a 5 km run, a 10 km run, a half marathon, and 5 km Nordic walking. Additionally, there are races for toddlers, children, and teenagers, making the event family-friendly. Timing is done electronically via transponder through Race Result, and the event supports a good cause as a charity run.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kalbsvilla at Am Mühltor
Various distances from 5 km to half marathon
Family-friendly races for toddlers, children, and teenagers
additional: Timing via transponder through Race Result; bibs and timing are organized in a tent near the finish line; Charity Run character The event is characterized by an inspiring atmosphere, pacers for the half marathon, and a scenic environment. It is an event suitable for both ambitious runners and families.

name: Luftschifflauf
location: Flughafen Essen/Mülheim, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TURCK Airship Run at Essen/Mülheim Airport offers a unique running experience on the airport's runway. The flat, fast course without tight turns or elevation changes is ideal for personal bests. The highlight is the spectacular finish inside the impressive WDL airship hangar, making the race an unforgettable event. The family-friendly event includes various distances for children, teenagers, and adults and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on the airport's runway
Spectacular finish inside the WDL airship hangar
Loop courses around the airship hangar with wide taxiways
additional: Start times staggered: 11:30 AM for children’s runs, 1:00 PM for youth and community run, 1:30 PM for 4x2.5 km relay and 10 km run. A total of 1500 starting places. Re-registrations are possible up to 15 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in all weather conditions, cancellation only in case of storm warnings. Family-friendly event with on-site catering. Race on airport runway, family-friendly, children’s run, on-site catering, online registration, in all weather, parking outside the premises.

name: Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The Central German Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Germany, connecting the Central German metropolitan region on a fast course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale). The classic marathon route, where the first German marathon was held in 1925, runs from the Bach city of Leipzig to the cultural capital Halle. In addition to the marathon, there are other disciplines such as the Handellauf half marathon, the half marathon relay, 10 km run, 10 km walk, and the Salzwirkerlauf. The event offers a diverse program and is suitable for runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Fast marathon course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale)
Start in the Bach city of Leipzig, finish in the cultural capital Halle
Run through one of Germany's greenest cities
additional: For the marathon, there are pacemakers for target times of 3:30, 3:45, 4:00, and 4:15 hours. The bib number includes a ticket from the Central German Transport Association for a free one-way or return trip on the event day between Halle and Leipzig within the respective fare zones. Split times must be adhered to; otherwise, disqualification will occur. Race documents can be collected at various registration offices. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible. The event includes various race types, starts in Halle and Leipzig, and offers a varied route through the Central German region with villages, forests, and floodplains.

name: Soester Stadtlauf
price_range: abhängig von der Distanz (Infos im Anmeldeportal)
description: Experience the traditional Soester City Run, a sporting highlight for young and old in the historic city center of Soest. Whether casual runners, ambitious athletes, or families - together, the day becomes an unforgettable event with a unique atmosphere along the course. The event offers various race distances, an attractive supporting program, and catering for all participants and guests.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the heart of the historic old town
Atmospheric run through the Soest city center
Moderation, music, and catering along the route

Parking at the outskirts with shuttle service. Beverage and snack stands for participants and guests. Attractive family program and moderation on site. Various race distances, start and finish in the heart of the old town, catering, shuttle service, award ceremony immediately after the races.

name: TrailRUN21
location: Zell am Harmersbach, Ortenaukreis, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The TrailRUN21 in Zell am Harmersbach is a challenging trail running competition in the Black Forest, taking place on October 4, 2026. There are two main distances: the TrailRUN21 with 20.3 km and 710 meters of elevation gain, and the TrailRUN Light with 10.3 km and 390 meters of elevation gain, ideal for beginners. The course is well marked and passes through varied terrain, appealing to both experienced trail runners and newcomers. The race is organized by TV 1898 Unterharmersbach e.V. and emphasizes environmental protection, for example by not providing disposable cups at aid stations.
course_highlights: TrailRUN21: 20.3 km with 710 meters of elevation gain
TrailRUN Light: 10.3 km with 390 meters of elevation gain, ideal for beginners
Courses are well marked with white (TrailRUN21) and blue arrows (TrailRUN Light)
additional: No disposable cups at aid stations; a collapsible cup is recommended (a foldable cup can be ordered for €3 during registration). No late registrations accepted. Age group rankings and separate races for school classes. Organizer: TV 1898 Unterharmersbach e.V. The event takes place on October 4, 2026, with registration already open. It also includes the German Mountain Running Championship 2024 and other championships.

name: UNO URBAN CROSS LAUF
description: The UNO Urban Cross is an urban obstacle race taking place right in the heart of Saarbrücken city center on October 4, 2026. The course spans from 2.5 km to 10 km and features numerous creative obstacles such as scaffolding, tire stacks, cable drums, and hay bales. The race offers a true city adventure for individual and team runners and is supported by Lord Mayor Uwe Conradt. The event promises fun, challenge, and excitement in a unique urban environment.
course_highlights: Course through Saarbrücken city center with new route over Karstadt parking garage, Bahnhofstraße, and Berliner Promenade
Over 200 steps and numerous creative obstacles such as scaffolding, tire stacks, boxing ring, and hay bales
Four distances: 2.5 km sprint cross, 5 km short cross, 7.5 km main cross (3 laps), 10 km main cross (4 laps)

No changing facilities available on site. Clothing bags can be deposited and retrieved. Entry fee will not be refunded in case of cancellation but will be donated to LAZ Saarbrücken. A discount of 4 EUR applies for individual runs. Course length ranges from 2.5 km to 10 km, obstacles located in the city center, registration possible.

name: Biberacher Herbstwaldlauf 2026
location: Biberach an der Riß, Biberach, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

The event is organized by TG Biberach 1847 e.V. and offers runners the choice between 5 km and 10 km. It is a relaxed running event without pre-registration, with registration possible on the day of the race on-site. The course runs through the autumnal Burrenwald area and offers a natural running experience. The entry fee is very affordable at 4 euros and includes refreshments at the finish line as well as a certificate, which can be collected later or sent via email.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Burrenwald area
Start and finish at Burrenwald parking lot
Natural course without stadium sections
additional: No pre-registration required, registration on race day on-site possible. Entry fee 4 euros includes refreshments at the finish and a certificate. Event has been held since at least 2011 with a cancellation in 2020. Local participant field with many repeat runners. Run takes place in Burrenwald, finish line refreshments included, certificate available, autumn weather in October, small and family-friendly event.

The course lengths range from 800 meters to 4.8 kilometers and are designed for fast trail running, not for long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a mountain run and a cross-country race. The Saalfeld Athletics Club has been organizing the event for many years with separate races for children and adults as well as various age groups.
course_highlights: Terrain around Bergfried in Saalfeld
Course lengths from 800 m to 4.8 km
Combination of mountain running and cross-country

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026

Each participation is rewarded with a stamp in the Laufpass, which is available both digitally and in traditional form. The event is aimed at recreational athletes and promotes active movement in the region.

name: BKK Walking am Baldeneysee mit Mini-Marathon

The main marathon runs twice around Lake Baldeney with an additional turnaround loop and is characterized by a flat profile and fast bike paths. The marathon has been held annually since 1963, making it Germany's oldest event of its kind. The event is organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with support from numerous volunteers. The number of participants is limited to 3,000 to avoid bottlenecks on the course.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf

The route is approximately 3 kilometers long with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The run takes place in a group and is free of charge. After the run, a small snack is served, making it a social event.

Elevation gain approximately 100 m
Group run up to Wernigerode Castle
additional: The run is free of charge, conducted in a group, and without timing. A small snack is served afterwards. Group run, no timing, subsequent snack.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Half Marathon Hannover is a new running event in the national calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats, and green route sections. Start and finish are located in the city of Hannover, and the route passes by prominent hotspots through the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a special running experience in a lively city environment. Join the prologue as Hannover writes a new chapter in running history.

Route passes by prominent hotspots of the state capital

In 2026, the route will be run twice over 10 km, later covering the full half marathon distance; registration is open until the day of the event; race features a modern atmosphere and music.

name: München Marathon

description: The Munich Marathon offers a diverse running experience in the Bavarian capital with the disciplines of marathon, half marathon, 10 km run, and marathon relay. The marathon course passes through the Olympic Park, Leopoldstraße, the English Garden, Munich city center, and ends in the Olympic Park. The half marathon starts in the English Garden and also finishes in the Olympic Park. The marathon relay allows teams to complete the 42.195 km together, with handovers at designated kilometer marks. Due to renovation work, the finish line is located at Hans-Jochen-Vogel-Platz next to the Olympic Hall.
course_highlights: Marathon course with sights such as Olympic Park, Siegestor, English Garden, Isartor, Marienplatz, and Odeonsplatz

Marathon relay with four exchange points at km 9.5, 21.3, 27, and a joint finish

The half marathon is designed so that runners with finishing times of up to 3 hours can comfortably complete the distance. Registration is possible until September 27, 2026. The event also includes offerings for children and inclusive running events. The course runs through central Munich districts and provides a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators.

name: Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf
description: The Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bad Hersfeld, attracting runners of all ages and skill levels. With various distances from a toddler run to a 10 km individual race, the Lollslauf offers a sporting challenge in a beautiful setting. In addition to the competition, community spirit and the joy of running are emphasized. The event is a fixture in the race calendar and draws participants from all over Germany.

Run through the historic old town of Bad Hersfeld

Multiple competition classes, registration on site possible, scenic course in Bad Hersfeld.

name: Berglauf

The course leads uphill and offers runners a challenging experience in a scenic environment. The event attracts both ambitious runners and recreational athletes and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere. name: Burscheider Stadtlauf
location: Burscheid, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Burscheid City Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in the city center of Burscheid and offers an ideal environment for runners of all performance levels. There are various distances: the 10-kilometer main race, a 3-kilometer run, and an 800-meter race that serves as a qualification for the sports badge. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and is aimed at both ambitious runners and recreational athletes. All finishers receive the traditional Kretzer City Run bread, and the top places are awarded special trophies.

Free drinks are available along the course and at the finish line. There is an age group classification according to DLO. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross, Burscheid branch. Bib numbers must be worn on the chest. The event also includes children's races, race packets from 10:30 AM, online results, age group classification, as well as medals and trophies. The weather in October is usually mild, making participation comfortable.

The course runs through the city and provides a special running experience in the goldsmith city of Schwabach.

name: Geilenkirchener Volkslauf und 34. Halbmarathon
description: The Geilenkirchen Volkslauf and Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Geilenkirchen-Gillrath, organized by DJK-Gillrath e. V. The event offers a flat half marathon course over 21.1 km as well as various other distances, including 10 km run, 10 km walking and Nordic walking, 4 km run, youth races, and a children's run. All races end at the Gillrath sports field, where race numbers are also issued. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes and is part of a five-year series ranking as well as the RAC ranking.

description: The Hotfoot Run Bad Hönningen is an exciting obstacle race taking place on October 11, 2026, suitable for all performance levels with distances ranging from 7 to 26 kilometers. The course runs through the idyllic spa town of Bad Hönningen on the Rhine, passing vineyards, historic buildings, and offering varied terrain with many elevation changes. Participants can expect spectacular obstacles, mud, water slides, and a unique atmosphere with a spectacular starting show alongside the sporting challenge. The race is ideal for individual runners, teams, and families who want to experience fun and adventure together.

name: Int. Schwarzwald-Marathon
description: The Black Forest Marathon in Bräunlingen is a traditional race that has been held annually since 1968 and is known as the world's oldest nature and women's marathon. The course mainly runs over well-maintained forest paths and offers a varied natural experience with a gentle incline up to kilometer 21 and a slight descent afterward. In addition to the classic marathon, there is also a relay marathon, half marathon, 10 km runs, Nordic walking, and other races for different age groups. The event is ideal for runners who want to combine nature and sporting challenge.

Gentle incline up to approx. km 21, then slight downhill
Kilometer markings throughout the course

Over 1,000 participants take part annually, from children and hobby runners to club runners and fast athletes. The race is a charity event organized by nine volunteers, with proceeds supporting local needy people.

The race is an officially approved competition by the German Athletics Association (DLV) with various age categories and a team classification. The event offers not only the sporting competition but also a friendly atmosphere with catering and return transport for participants.
course_highlights: 8.7 km long course with 510 meters of elevation
Start at 123 m above sea level, finish at the Bismarck Tower at 493 m above sea level
Varied natural course with forest paths, narrow trails, stones, roots, and stairs
additional: The registration fee includes fees for the association and mountain run cup, timing, rental chip (to be returned at the finish), clothing bag and transport, athlete's drink, bananas, rental cup (to be returned at the finish), photo frame, bus transfer, champagne stand on the return route, as well as free certificate printing via my.raceresult.com. Late registrations are possible on-site but not for the Rhineland-Palatinate Championship. Prizes and special awards will be given at the award ceremony; only present participants will receive prizes. Hilly natural course, trails with stones, roots, stairs; online registration; parking fees nearby; bus transfer included.

name: Bottwartal-Marathon Run und Fun Day
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a unique running spectacle set in the picturesque landscape of southern Germany. The course takes you through gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns, and offers an exhilarating atmosphere at the roadside. Whether beginner or ambitious runner, everyone will find their highlight here. In addition to the marathon, there are a variety of running options from 5 km to ultra, suitable for all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Run through historic old towns such as Großbottwar and Steinheim
Course runs along the Bottwar River and through vineyards
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Monthly free training runs with pace groups and guides for preparation. Summer runs during the summer holidays every Tuesday evening. Year-end run with 10 km and afterwards punch and mulled wine. The OPR30 run is limited to 150 participants. All runs have refreshment stations approximately every 5 km. Late registrations are possible until shortly before the event, registration via Datasport. Various distances, including children’s and inclusion runs, registration via Datasport, GPS-based course measurement, medals at the finish line.

name: ENSINGER Laufcup
location: Vaihingen an der Enz, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Ensinger Laufcup on October 17, 2026, offers runners of all ages and performance levels suitable distances in the beautiful region of Vaihingen an der Enz. The event includes various races from children’s runs to challenging trail courses of up to 24 kilometers and up to 700 meters of elevation gain. Participants can enjoy the diverse landscape with asphalt, gravel paths, and trails. Additionally, the Laufcup is part of a regional sponsorship program that supports schools and promotes community engagement.
course_highlights: Varied courses from 550 m to 24 km with up to 700 meters of elevation
Mix of asphalt, gravel forest paths, and trails
Start and finish area in front of the Ensinger Kelter with good public transport connections
additional: Online registration closes on October 8, 2026, at 23:59. Late registrations are possible online from October 9 to 17, 2026, against a late registration fee, but only if starting places are available. All participants receive a medal at the finish. The event is part of the school sponsorship project of the Alison and Peter Klein Foundation, which covers registration fees and donates €5 to the respective school for each finisher. The start and finish area is at the square in front of the Ensinger Kelter in St. Veith-Straße. Parking is only allowed in designated areas; public transport is recommended. Multiple race distances, trail and asphalt routes, detailed course information available.

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig-Marathon will take place on October 17, 2026, in Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers disciplines for marathon, half marathon, walking, Nordic walking, and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course runs through the scenic region of the Rothaar Mountains and is recognized as an approved popular race by the DLV. Over 1,000 active runners participate annually and enjoy the varied trail and forest landscape.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaar Mountains
Approved popular race with DLV recognition
Various disciplines: marathon, half marathon, walking, Nordic walking, 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Registrations are possible from May 1, 2026. Late registrations are accepted until half an hour before the respective start. The start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00 AM, half marathon at 12:00 PM, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15 PM, AOK run at 11:45 AM. The event location is Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in Schmallenberger Sauerland. Registration begins on May 1, 2026. No dog runs are permitted. Detailed course description available. Start times and organizational information can be found on the website.

name: Hachenburger Löwenlauf
description: The Hachenburg Lion Run is a traditional race with a family-friendly character, taking place on October 17, 2026, in Hachenburg. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon, 10.5 km run, 6.3 km fun/run team race, as well as children's races. The courses lead through diverse landscapes of the Westerwald with appealing elevation changes and beautiful views. Since 1989, the proceeds from the race have been donated to social projects, giving the race a special social significance.
course_highlights: Half marathon with the highest point at Gräbersberg (513 m) and varied ascents and descents
10.5 km run mostly on forest paths with the highest point at 439 m above sea level
Start and finish area at the round sports hall in Hachenburg with changing and shower facilities
additional: Electronic timing without chip, certificates for all finishers, prizes for class winners, special prize for the largest team participation in the team race. Late registration possible on October 16 from 17:00 and on the event day from 09:00. Refreshments with electrolytes, water, tea, cola, and fruit available on the course and at the finish. Changing and shower facilities available at the round sports hall. Various race distances (half marathon, 10.5 km, 6.3 km team and fun run, children's races), start and finish area at Lohmühle, Hachenburg, electronic timing (without chip), certificates for all finishers, prizes for class winners, refreshments on the course and at the finish, registration only online.

name: Herbstlauf der DJK Feudenheim

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bei Anmeldung bis zum 11.10.2026 gelten vergünstige Anmeldegebühren.

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The autumn run organized by DJK Feudenheim is a traditional race event in Mannheim-Feudenheim, taking place on October 17, 2026, for the 35th time. The main race covers a 10 km course, to be completed in three laps, with a time limit of 90 minutes. In addition to the main race, there is also a fun run as well as other races for children, toddlers, and inclusion. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, changing and shower facilities, and an award ceremony immediately after the races. Registration opens on June 1, 2026, with discounted fees for entries received by October 11, 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km main race in three laps with a 90-minute time limit
Event takes place in all weather conditions
Start and finish at the sports facility of DJK Feudenheim
additional: Timing is done with a transponder on the back of the start number, which must be visibly worn at the front of the upper body. There are no beverage stations on the course; self-supply is required. Warm tea, changing and shower facilities, as well as medical services, are available at the finish. Wearing headphones is not permitted for safety reasons. The award ceremony takes place after the races in front of the tents. Pre-registration from July 1, 2024. The race takes place in all weather conditions, as part of the Engelhorn Sports Run Cup. On-site registration is possible.

name: Herbstlauf des LSV Porz
organizer: LSV Porz / Kölner Lauf- und Nordic-Walkingteam
description: The autumn run of LSV Porz is the oldest road race in Cologne and takes place in the picturesque leisure area of Leidenhausen. The event offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, which are measured according to the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV) and are eligible for best lists. Both ambitious runners and recreational joggers can enjoy the autumnal idyll while running. The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne and the surrounding area and is often used by top runners to check their form.
course_highlights: Running routes in the leisure area of Leidenhausen in autumnal surroundings
5 km loop as one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
Course measurement according to DLV guidelines, eligible for best lists
additional: Start number must be worn on the chest. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Late registration on the event day is possible for a fee of 2 €, students are exempt from the fee. Liability disclaimer for thefts, accidents, or other damages. Payment via SEPA direct debit a few days before the event. No fee will be charged if the event is canceled. Course measured, registration until 14.10.2025, start times from 11:00 am, parking available nearby, participation in running and Nordic walking events.

name: Krummenseelauf
description: The Krummenseelauf is a traditional road race in Mittenwalde, Brandenburg, organized by WSG 1981 Königs Wusterhausen since 1980. The course runs around Lake Krummensee, which is the central feature of the event. Three distances are offered (3.6 km, 7.2 km, and 15 km) as well as Nordic Walking, all starting in the morning. The event typically takes place in autumn and is part of the Oder-Spree-Cup, making it attractive for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Krummensee
Start at Krummenseer Straße at the sports field in Schenkendorf
Road race with distances of 3.6 km, 7.2 km, and 15 km
additional: All runs and Nordic Walking events start in the morning within a few minutes of each other. The event is part of the Oder-Spree-Cup and typically takes place in autumn with an average temperature of 14 °C. The event occurs in October, with start and finish in Schenkendorf, Mittenwalde. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the beautiful course around Lake Krummensee.

name: Oberwaldlauf
description: The Oberwaldlauf is an annual race held on the third Saturday in October over 5 km and 10 km through the Oberwald in Karlsruhe. The courses are officially measured and approved by the German Athletics Association (Deutscher Leichtathletik-Verband), ensuring the possibility of record listings. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with catering, changing rooms, showers, and a varied program for all participants. Start and finish are located near the clubhouse of TUS Rüppurr, which is also used for bib number distribution and late registrations.
course_highlights: Run through the Karlsruhe Oberwald on well-maintained forest paths and partly paved sections
Officially measured courses over 5 km and 10 km, approved by the DLV
Bib number distribution and late registration in a tent behind the clubhouse
additional: Bib number distribution and late registration from 13:00 to 14:00 in a tent behind the garages near the clubhouse. Free water, tea, and bananas at the finish area for all runners. Toilets, changing rooms, and showers are available in the basement of the clubhouse and in the nearby Eichelgartenhalle. During the event, there will be waffles, coffee, cake, drinks, fries, and sausages. From 13:00, a mobile play area with a bouncy castle and a stand area with catering will be available. The courses include asphalt and forest paths, with family and youth runs, and catering at the finish area.

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: The 24th Niedensteiner Panorama Run will take place on October 17, 2026, in Niedenstein. The event is organized by SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. and the Niedenstein Running Group. The race offers an attractive course around the Hessenturm Stadium and the club house, set in the beautiful landscape of the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized running event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hessenturm Stadium in Niedenstein
Run through the picturesque surroundings of Niedenstein
Event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup
additional: Hilly terrain, family-friendly, children and youth races, finish at Hessenturm Stadium

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitz Moon Race in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional run taking place on October 17, 2026, for the 26th time. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through Wilsnack forests, the spa park, and around the Karthane Hall. The races are suitable for children, teenagers, and adults and are part of the Prignitz Cup as well as the Brandenburg Cup. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, good catering along the route, and professional timing.
course_highlights: 12.4 km and 7.8 km through Wilsnack forests on asphalt and forest paths
3 km course through the spa park
1 km loop course in front of the Karthane Hall
additional: Late registrations are possible on the race day from 08:00 to 09:30, provided the maximum number of participants, 550, has not been reached. The late registration fee is 5 euros in addition to the race fee. Start and finish are at the Karthane Hall in Bad Wilsnack, which also offers showers and toilets. Overall winners receive trophies. Dogs are not allowed during the race. There are refreshment stations on the longer routes. The event offers online registration, catering, showers, and prizes for the top runners. The Moon Race is also known for notable guests such as Dieter Baumann and high participant numbers.

name: Rottachseelauf 2026
description: The Rottachsee Run is a traditional race in Oy-Mittelberg, taking place on October 17, 2026, for the 35th time. Various distances are offered for different age groups, including a main race over 15 kilometers for participants aged 16 and above, as well as children's runs over 2.4 km and 1.2 km. The event is open to runners of all ages and provides a sporting challenge in a beautiful setting. Registration opens in mid-August 2026.
course_highlights: Main race over 15 kilometers
Children's runs over 2.4 km and 1.2 km
Event in the scenic region of Oy-Mittelberg
additional: Registration is via the TSV Petersthal website, with the registration deadline on the day before the race. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Oy-Mittelberg, typically in October conditions with temperatures around 6-14°C and approximately 40 mm of precipitation.

name: Schloss Cross Laupheim
description: The Schloss-Cross Laupheim is a varied cross-country race that takes place on a 1,550-meter loop through the picturesque Schlosspark of Laupheim. Various competitions are offered, including a main race over 9.3 kilometers, a recreational run over 4.65 kilometers, a Nordic walking competition over 6.3 kilometers, and children's races over 1.55 kilometers. The course starts at the archway on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße near the cultural center and runs over gravel, cobblestone, and paved paths with an elevation change of 19 meters. The race offers an attractive program for both ambitious runners and recreational and children's runners.
course_highlights: 1,550-meter loop through the Laupheim Schlosspark
Start at the archway on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße near the cultural center
Course with gravel, cobblestone, and asphalt paths with 19 meters of elevation change
additional: In addition to the main race, there are recreational runs, a Nordic walking competition, and children's races. The course has an elevation difference of 19 meters per lap. The start is at the cultural center on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße. Training plans for preparation are offered. The event is organized by Alpsee Bergwelt and features not only the main race but also children's races, Nordic walking, and a school class cup. Exact start times and further details are available on the official website and Facebook page.

name: Schwindegger VR-Bank 6h-Lauf (Deutsche Meisterschaft der DUV)
description: The Schwindegger VR-Bank 6-hour run is the German Championship of the DUV in the 6-hour run and takes place on October 17, 2026, in Schwindegg. The event is aimed at ultrarunners who want to demonstrate their endurance on a flat, well-marked course. The run offers both individual and relay competitions and is a highlight in the German ultrarunning calendar. The friendly atmosphere and long-standing tradition make the VR-Bank 6-hour run a special experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Flat, well-marked loop course
German Championship in the 6-hour run
Event for individual and relay participants
additional: The run takes place on a flat loop course suitable for individual and relay participants. The event is part of the DUV German Championships in the 6-hour run. It is organized by a friendly running group dedicated to ultrarunning. 6-hour ultramarathon, German championship, paved course, charity event for children's cancer aid BALU.

name: Steigerwald - Fackellauf 2026
location: Burghaslach, Neustadt an der Aisch, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Steigerwald Torch Run has been organized by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach for the 39th time and traditionally takes place on the third Saturday in October. The race offers runners of all performance levels the opportunity to run together through the beautiful landscape of the Steigerwald. The event is a fixed part of the regional sports calendar and promotes community and the fun of running.
course_highlights: Traditional race through the Steigerwald region
Event on the third Saturday in October
Organized by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach
additional: Registration for the Burghaslacher Torch Run 2026 is possible via the official website. The event is organized by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach. There are no explicit details about start times, prize categories, or different distances on the website. The event also includes children's runs, community celebrations in the TSV hall, and a festive running atmosphere with food, drinks, and prizes. The main race is regularly won by local personalities, and the event attracts numerous participants from the region.

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and the surrounding area. Organized by the Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to inspire participants. The event is very popular and the starting spots are quickly filled. The exact course layout is still being finalized but promises a great and unique route. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: Unique course through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
Nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the Teutomarsch 2026 was fully booked within 30 minutes with 500 starting places. There is a waiting list. Participants agree to photo and video recordings and their publication. No refund of entry fees. Minimum age 16 years. Dogs are allowed on a leash. The organizer assumes no liability for personal or property damage as well as loss or theft. Trail running, no timing, refreshment stations along the route, start & finish at the Hohne elementary school, participant limit 500.

name: Vellberger Volkslauf
description: The Vellberg Volkslauf is a local running event in Vellberg, Baden-Württemberg, organized by TSV Vellberg e.V. It is part of the Stadtwerke Läuft bei dir series, which also includes races in Michelfeld, Gaildorf, and Bibersfeld. The event offers a classic 10 km run as well as a 400 m race for different age groups. Registration is exclusively online, with late registration possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Timing is provided by Speed Timing, and certificates can be printed on-site by participants.
course_highlights: Classic 10 km run
Additional 400 m race
Event in the picturesque town of Vellberg
additional: Late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the start. Timing is provided by Speed Timing. Certificates can be printed on-site at a terminal. Distances include 400 m and 10 km; registration online; part of the Stadtwerke Läuft bei dir series.

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
price_range: 15 EUR bis 47 EUR je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in the southeast of Berlin, completely circling the Große Müggelsee. The event offers three course lengths: half marathon, 10 kilometers, and 5 kilometers, each designed as either point-to-point or loop courses. The route passes through the historic Spreetunnel and offers an idyllic setting with views of the largest Berlin lake and the surrounding Müggelberge hills. The race is suitable for all runners aiming for personal bests or simply wanting to enjoy the community and nature. Start and finish are at the Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place on October 18, 2026.
course_highlights: Loop course completely around the Große Müggelsee
Crossing the historic Spreetunnel in Friedrichshagen
Idyllic landscape with views of Müggelberge and Berlin skyline
additional: Race bib pickup on October 17, 2026 from 12:30 to 16:00 and on October 18, 2026 from 07:30 at the Müggelseeperle. Late registrations only on October 17, 2026, with a 3 EUR late registration fee; no late registrations on race day. Free boat shuttle to the start on October 18, 2026, at 8:30 from Friedrichshagen/Spreetunnel. Bag drop available, changing tent on site. Optional T-shirt, preferred race number, and boat accompaniment tickets for relatives can be booked. Terrain includes lake and shoreline paths. Online registration, shuttle service, start/finish in the Müggelsee area, various race distances.

description: The Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon on October 18, 2026 offers runners a diverse selection of distances in the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck. The event includes, in addition to the classic marathon, a duo marathon, half marathon, relay race, and other shorter runs suitable for all age and performance levels. The course runs through the picturesque city and provides a sporting challenge with regional championship scoring. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and emphasizes community and sporting passion.
course_highlights: Marathon with Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring
Change point for duo marathon in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea
Course through the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck
additional: Free medal engraving available upon registration by January 31, 2026, with name, distance, and finish time. Preferred starting number can be chosen free of charge during early registration phases, subject to availability. Relay race with 10 x 4.2 km segments. Handbike half marathon with the same course as the runner half marathon. Change point for duo marathon in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea. Course catering includes honey gels. Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring. Registration deadline is September 30, 2026. Various starting number and medal options.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: The Almetal Marathon 2026 takes place on October 18 and offers runners a scenic route from Büren-Ringelstein to the Ahorn Sports Park in Paderborn. In addition to the classic marathon distance, there are two half-marathon variants as well as a relay race over four segments. The event is characterized by the voluntary commitment of numerous sports clubs and provides a family-friendly atmosphere as well as an impressive natural experience in the Almetal.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the Almetal
Marathon from Büren-Ringelstein to Paderborn
Two half-marathon variants and a relay race with 4 x 10.5 km
additional: The event is organized voluntarily by twelve sports clubs along the route. District administrator Christopher Rüther is the patron. It offers a family-friendly and accessible atmosphere appreciated by participants and spectators. The route runs from Büren-Ringelstein to Paderborn, including half-marathon variants and a relay race; registration via my.raceresult.com
