description: The Biberach Enjoyment Run offers a scenic race event in the heart of Upper Swabia with start and finish on the historic Biberach marketplace. Participants can choose between the BKK VerbundPlus Half Marathon, the 2 x 8 km Biberach District Savings Bank Relay, and the 6 km REWE Engel Genuss Walk. The course runs over paved paths as well as solid forest and field trails and offers magnificent views, including the buses, the Holy Mountain of Upper Swabia, and, in good weather, even the Alps. Excellent catering is provided along the route and at the finish line, where a glass of Prosecco awaits finishers.
course_highlights: Half marathon with a flat start, incline from km 5, and magnificent Allgäu view
2 x 8 km relay with baton change in Biberach city center
6 km Genuss Walk on beautiful paths in Wolfental with or without poles
additional: Race bib distribution on Saturday, October 17 from 5 to 7 pm at the Biberach City Hall. There is ample catering along the route and at the finish, including a glass of Prosecco for finishers. Functional shirts can be purchased online or at the race bib distribution (while supplies last). Late registrations on-site are possible if spots are available. It is possible to transfer the start number free of charge to another person. Age group classification according to DLV guidelines. Certificates and material prizes for age groups and fastest participants/relays. The course includes asphalt and forest paths, catering along the route and at the finish, online and on-site registration, no shirts for corporate registrations, race bib distribution at the City Hall.

name: Ditzinger Keltenlauf
description: The Celtic Run in Ditzingen-Hirschlanden is a versatile race for young and old with distances of 12 km, 6 km, 1.5 km, and 800 m. The course runs through the scenic Strohgäu region and passes significant archaeological monuments such as the Celtic warrior and the Celtic women's grave. The races take place at the Sport and Recreation Center Seehansen and offer suitable competitions for adults, students, and children. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is timed with modern RFID timing.
course_highlights: Course passes the Celtic warrior, an important archaeological monument
Route through the fertile Strohgäu and the village of Schöckingen
Mostly paved course with some inclines, the 12 km run consists of two 6 km laps
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event on-site until shortly before the race, but with a late registration fee. Bambini runs (0.8 km) are free, donations are voluntary. Timing is done with RFID chip on the bib number. Parking is available nearby at Bäckerei Sehne / DM; parking at Seehansen is not possible on the event day. Public transport stop Hirschlanden Kreisverkehr, about 400 meters walk. There is a special classification for firefighters in full gear during the 6 km firefighter run (without breathing apparatus). The course is mostly paved with some inclines, online registration is possible, start and finish are in Hirschlanden.

name: Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Gedächtnis Lauf
description: The Döbraberg Dr. Heinz Laubmann Memorial Run is a traditional group run that starts in Hof and leads participants along the Webersteig to the Döbraberg, the highest point of the Franconian Forest. The event takes place in October and offers various distances of 8.5 km, 14.5 km, and 23 km, as well as 8.5 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The shorter runs for adults are conducted without timing, focusing on reaching the summit together. The course is hilly and challenging, with a structured format where pacemakers set the pace and overtaking is not allowed. The run was established in 1968 in honor of Dr. Heinz Laubmann, the founder of the IfL clubs.
course_highlights: Ascent to Döbraberg, the highest point of the Franconian Forest
Hilly and challenging course profile
Guided group runs with pacemakers and overtaking prohibition
additional: The event emphasizes communal running without competitive timing on the shorter distances. Typical October weather with around 14°C and mostly cloudy skies is expected. The run is a group event without timing for the shorter routes, starting on October 18, 2026, at 10:00 AM. Walking and Nordic walking routes are also offered. October weather in Hof can be variable, adding to the challenge.

name: Filderstadt-Halbmarathon
description: The Filderstadt Half Marathon takes place annually in Filderstadt-Bernhausen and offers an officially measured half marathon course as well as a 10 km run, a school and children’s run, and a team relay race. The event attracts numerous runners and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized infrastructure with refreshment stations and medical support. The course is eligible for best lists and is accompanied by experienced pacers. The race bibs are distributed on the day of the event at the Bürgerzentrum Bernhausen.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon and 10 km courses
Refreshment stations approximately every 4 km with drinks and bananas
Team relay race with five runners, exchange zone at the start/finish area
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start at the Bürgerzentrum Bernhausen, with a late registration fee of €5 for individual and team entries. Timing is done with chips integrated into the race bibs (RaceResult passive system). Award ceremonies take place at the Bürgerzentrum (10 km at 11:20 am, half marathon at 12:30 pm). Medical care is provided by the DRK Filderstadt with emergency doctors. The event takes place in September, with multiple race distances, ideal for hobby runners and families, close to Stuttgart Airport.

name: Gosheimer Lemberglauf
description: The Gosheimer Lemberglauf is a traditional race in Gosheim, Baden-Württemberg, which is part of the Silberdistel-Albcup. The course starts at the Kreissparkasse in the town center and leads to the finish on the Lemberg, with clothing transport available. The race offers various distances, including school and toddler runs as well as other competitions that count towards the overall and club standings of the cup. All participants receive certificates, and the top runners are awarded material prizes. The event is family-friendly and invites runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start at the Kreissparkasse in the town center
Finish on the Lemberg with clothing transport available
Part of the Silberdistel-Albcup with overall and club standings
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start at the Jurahalle Gosheim with a late registration fee. School and toddler runs start around 12:00 PM, with the other races at 12:45 PM. Material prizes for places 1 to 3 as well as certificates for all participants will be awarded. Start at the Kreissparkasse, finish on the Lemberg, online registration until October 11, children’s run around 12:00 PM, main races at 12:45 PM.

name: Hambacher Herbstwaldlauf
description: The Hambacher Autumn Forest Run is a traditional race in Niederzier-Hambach that takes place annually in autumn. Participants enjoy the beautiful atmosphere with the vibrant colors of the forest in autumn weather. Around 200 runners participate across various age groups and distances. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. and offers a family-friendly and sporting atmosphere for recreational and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal forest with colorful foliage
Various routes for children, teenagers, and adults
Traditional event with a family club character
additional: The event attracts approximately 200 runners. Results from the previous year are available online with certificate printing. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. There are no specific details about start times, fee structures, or registration options on the website. Trail through the forest, online registration possible, start and finish at the Sophienhöhe parking lot, event in October 2026.

name: Kauferinger Stauseelauf
description: The Kaufering Reservoir Run is a running event in Kaufering that offers various distances, including a half marathon as well as shorter routes of 0.4 km, 0.8 km, and 8.2 km. The event attracts runners from the region and features a varied course around the reservoir. The atmosphere is family-friendly and suitable for runners of all ages and skill levels. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website, highlighting the tradition and popularity of the race.
course_highlights: Courses around the Kaufering Reservoir
Diverse distances from 0.4 km to half marathon
Family-friendly and varied running route
additional: The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is a popular running event in the Kaufering region.

name: Lauf der 39. Crosslauf-Serie Cochem-Zell 2026 in Bremm
description: The 39th Cross Country Series Cochem-Zell in Bremm is an exciting running event set in the picturesque wine landscape of the Mosel. The cross country courses, ranging from 1 km to 8 km, lead over uneven, natural trails with mud, meadows, and forest sections. These challenging routes require sure-footedness, strength, and coordination, offering runners an authentic cross country experience away from paved roads. The event is ideal for anyone wanting to test their winter fitness and enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Run through the wine landscape of the Mosel
Rough, uneven paths with mud, meadows, and forest
Course lengths from 1 km to 8 km with challenging sections
additional: The cross country series is part of the popular running events in the Cochem-Zell district. The course is a tough test for winter fitness and offers genuine cross country feeling on natural trails. Cross country, 1 km to 8 km, uneven paths, trail running in wine landscape, registration probably required.

name: Müngstener Brückenlauf
description: The Müngstener Bridge Run is a traditional race in Solingen that takes participants through scenic landscapes. The course begins on the narrow Schäfchenweg and features a final ascent before the finish line, passing by meadows and fields. The race is organized by the Solinger Leichtathletik-Club 1951 e.V. and attracts runners from the region.
course_highlights: Start on the narrow, scenic Schäfchenweg
Final ascent before the finish line past meadows and fields
Run through a picturesque environment in Solingen
additional: Results from previous years are available in the archive. Photos of past races can be viewed in the SLC gallery. The course crosses the Müngstener Bridge, including scenic paths and ascents; annual event in October. Certificates can be downloaded online.

name: Naturpark Schönbuchlauf Hildrizhausen
description: The Schönbuch Nature Park Run in Hildrizhausen is a traditional autumn race with a long history, taking place on October 18, 2026, for the 51st time. The event offers various distances from 5 km to 50 km, including the popular 25 km Schönbuch Nature Park Run and the challenging 50 km Schönbuch Ultra. The runs lead through the scenic region of Schönbuch, an ideal running area with well-marked routes. The event is open to runners of all performance levels, from beginners to experienced ultra-runners, and also features children's races. The running group of TSV Hildrizhausen organizes the race with great commitment and looks forward to many participants.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through the Schönbuch Nature Park
Well-marked routes with spray-painted arrows and directional signs at critical points
Various distances from 5 km to 50 km, including ultra-distance
additional: The competition center is located at the Schönbuchhalle, which opens at 08:00 on race day. Award ceremonies also take place there. The routes are continuously marked with spray-painted arrows, and directional signs are used at critical points. There are children's races (approximately 1000 m and 2.5 km) as well as a junior route over 5 km. The event is part of the Schönbuch Cup with rankings for various races. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 25 km, 50 km; online registration available; race on October 18, 2026; parking and public transportation available; changing rooms, showers, and catering in the Schönbuchhalle.

name: Rottweiler Volksbanklauf 2026
description: The 13th Rottweiler Volksbanklauf is a versatile running event in Rottweil, offering both children's and youth races as well as a challenging main race over 10.12 km on a hilly loop course. The course consists of 1.3 km laps with an elevation gain of 108 meters, repeatedly challenging runners with hills. Additionally, there are relay races over 10.1 km for teams of 3 to 8 participants. The event is primarily a local race day with a varied program for all age groups.
course_highlights: Main race over 10.12 km on a hilly loop course
1.3 km long lap with 108 m elevation gain
Relay races for teams of 3 to 8 runners
additional: Children's and youth races over 300 m, 600 m, and 1.3 km are part of the program. Typical weather in October: approx. 14°C daytime high, 6°C low, mostly cloudy with an average of 40 mm precipitation. Races for children and youth, local event, varied course with 108 m elevation gain per lap.

name: Salacher Löwenlauf
description: The Salacher Löwenlauf is a running and Nordic walking event in Salach, Germany, taking place on October 18, 2026. The courses include 500 meters for children, 2 kilometers for youth, 6 kilometers for fitness runners and Nordic walkers, and 10 kilometers for experienced runners. The route is hilly but suitable for beginners and all races end on Baumgartenstraße near the Stauferlandhalle. The event is organized by TSG Salach, which also highlights the connection to the Stauferland region in the Nordic walking race.
course_highlights: Hilly course profile, no flat sprint
Finish line on Baumgartenstraße near Stauferlandhalle
Various distances for children, youth, and adults
additional: Start times are scheduled around midday. There are special races for children (500 m Bambini-Löwenlauf) and youth (2 km Jugend-Löwenlauf). The event also includes 6 km Nordic walking. Weather in October is typically around 14°C with occasional rain and mostly cloudy skies. The event also features Nordic walking and is open to all age groups. It is recommended to check details with the organizer before registration.

name: Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim
description: The Spannrit Volks- und Straßenlauf TSG Kleinostheim is a local road running event in Kleinostheim, Germany, held at the Maingauhalle on Ludwigstraße. The event is organized by TSG Kleinostheim and offers children's and youth runs as well as 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The course for adults is flat and runs as a loop, with all races ending at the Maingauhalle. This is the 15th edition of the event and it is listed in the German athletics calendar, highlighting its significance in organized club running.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalt loop course
Start and finish at the Maingauhalle in Kleinostheim
Children's and youth runs with 750 m distance
additional: The event includes races for various age groups: 750 m for children, 5 km for participants aged 14 to 99, and 10 km for participants from 16 years old. The weather in October is typically cool and cloudy with an average of 14°C and 40 mm of precipitation. The race takes place at the Maingauhalle in Kleinostheim and offers not only the main distances but also children's and youth runs. The weather in October is usually mild, with temperatures around 6-14°C and an average of 40 mm of precipitation.

name: Traditioneller Sparkassen-Herbstwaldlauf
location: Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum, Beckum, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The traditional Sparkassen Autumn Forest Run in Beckum is a popular running event taking place on October 18, 2026, at the Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, including a Bambini run, school run, 5 km fun run, 5 km walk, and the 10 km main race. Participants receive medals, certificates, and trophies, making the race an inspiring experience for both recreational and competitive runners. Late registrations are possible until about 30 minutes before the start, providing flexibility for last-minute entrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum
Competitions for all age groups from Bambini to main race
Trophies for the top finishers and certificates for all participants
additional: Late registrations are accepted on the event day until approximately 30 minutes before the start for a fee of 2€. All participants in the Bambini and school runs receive medals, certificates are awarded for the 5 km fun run and 5 km walk, and trophies are awarded to the top three finishers in the 10 km main race, with certificates for all participants. The race takes place in the forest, with registration and results available on the website.

name: Weißenhorner Altstadtlauf
description: The Weißenhorn Old Town Run is a traditional race held annually in October in the historic old town of Weißenhorn. The event is organized by TSV Weißenhorn and offers runners of all ages the opportunity to participate in a friendly and sporty atmosphere. The race is characterized by its varied course, which runs through the picturesque old town and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes. The enjoyment of running and community are the main focus.
course_highlights: Course through the historic old town of Weißenhorn
Varied terrain with city views
Traditional event in October
additional: The race is organized by TSV Weißenhorn, which also offers other athletics training groups and events. The athletics department meets regularly for training, and the old town run is an annual highlight in October. The event takes place in the TSV hall and the old town. The race occurs annually, with various competitions for all age groups. Registration is usually via Race Result, and the results are publicly accessible. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.

name: Altendorf-Ersdorfer Obstmeilenlauf
description: The Altendorf-Ersdorfer Fruit Mile Run is a traditional community race that has been held annually since 1995 on the last Saturday in October. The event offers races for all age and performance levels, including the Small Fruit Mile (5.3 km), the Large Fruit Mile (9.6 km), and the Mega Mile (16 km). The course runs through the scenic fruit orchards of Altendorf-Ersdorf and is especially popular for the fresh apples at the finish line and the fruit baskets for the winners. There are also special races for children over 400 m and 1000 m. The run is a social event that combines running with nature experience and community spirit.
course_highlights: Course through the fruit orchards of Altendorf-Ersdorf
Three main distances: 5.3 km, 9.6 km, and 16 km
Children's races over 400 m and 1000 m
additional: The event always takes place on the last Saturday in October. Runners regularly meet for training in the Altendorf-Ersdorf forest. Prizes for the winners include fully stocked fruit baskets, and fresh apples are handed out at the finish. The event features distances of 400 m, 1 km, 3.3 miles, 6 miles, and 10 miles. It is a family-friendly event with children's and toddler's races, held annually in October in Meckenheim.

name: Burgkirchner Raiffeisen-Crosslauf
location: Freizeitzentrum Halsbachgraben, Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Burgkirchen Raiffeisen Cross Country is a hilly cross-country race in Burgkirchen an der Alz, Bavaria. Start and finish are located at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Center. The event is part of the Raiffeisen Cross Country series and offers various distances for children, adolescents, and adults, including short distances from 0.65 km to 1.3 km as well as longer runs over 4.5 km and 6.6 km. The course is challenging with hills and not flat, which also requires effort even for short distances. Separate competitions for children and adolescents as well as a special 6.6 km race for men complete the program.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country course, no flat road
Start and finish at the Halsbachgraben Leisure Center
Various distances for children, adolescents, and adults
additional: Results, photos, and further details are available at laufpix.de. Official information is also linked via crosslauf-is.de. Typical weather in October: around 14 °C during the day, 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple course lengths, separate categories for children and adolescents, no flat road race, sporting challenge due to the hilly terrain.

name: Gelenauer Erzgebirgscross
description: The Gelenau Ore Mountains Cross is a traditional running event in the Ore Mountains organized by LV 90 Erzgebirge. The competition takes place in Gelenau and offers runners of various age groups and performance levels the opportunity to compete on a challenging course. The event is known for its scenic and varied cross-country route through the Ore Mountains. It is aimed at children, youth, active athletes, and masters and is a regular part of the regional athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Scenic cross-country course in the Ore Mountains
Various routes for children, youth, active athletes, and masters
Organized by the experienced LV 90 Erzgebirge
additional: Registration deadline is November 2, 2025. Registration is to be sent to Sophia Teicher, Kemtauer Straße 27, 09423 Gelenau/Erzgebirge. The contact email is provided as meldung "ät" lv90.de. The event includes different categories and age groups, with possible official results for leaderboards. The weather in October is typically cool with temperatures around 14°C, and rain is possible.

name: Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf
description: The Helberhäuser HauBerg Run is a traditional race taking place for the 29th time on October 24, 2026. Organized by TSG Helberhausen, the event features a modified course that runs two laps of the well-known route. The race is part of the Rothaar Running Series and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ages in the Hilchenbach region. TSG Helberhausen is a versatile sports club with a wide range of offerings, organizing the race as one of its many popular events.
course_highlights: Two laps of the well-known HauBerg Run route
Part of the Rothaar Running Series
Traditional race in the Hilchenbach region
additional: The course was adjusted for 2025. The event is embedded in the diverse sports offerings of TSG Helberhausen, which has over 20 departments providing a broad spectrum of sports. The 2026 anniversary features a special course layout where all runners will run the course in reverse. The event offers various competitions, including children's runs and Nordic walking, and takes place on a challenging hilly course.

name: Internationaler Halbmarathon, 56. Internationaler Volkslauf
description: The International Half Marathon and the International Community Run in Herzogenrath are established road races organized by DJK Jung Siegfried Herzogenrath. The event includes a 21.1 km long half marathon as well as a 5 km community run designed for all age groups. With the 46th edition of the half marathon and the 56th of the community run, the event has a long-standing tradition and is listed in the running.de race calendar. The organizer is a versatile sports club that offers various sports and fitness activities for the community besides the run.
course_highlights: Road race in Herzogenrath
Officially measured half marathon course (21.1 km)
Community run over 5 km as a group event
additional: Typical weather in October: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy, average rainfall 40 mm. The event is integrated into local club activities and offers not only the running distances but also a community atmosphere that promotes both sporting challenge and social interaction.

name: Lauf um den Mittelpunkt von Sachsen
description: The race around the center of Saxony takes place in Naundorf (Bobritzsch-Hilbersdorf) and is organized by TVL Freiberg e.V. The event is a stadium-independent athletics event that appeals to various age groups from children to masters. The race offers a sporting challenge in the beautiful surroundings of the Tharandt Forest and is an established event in the Saxon athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Race in the Tharandt Forest near Naundorf
Stadium-independent event with a natural course layout
Various age groups from children to masters
additional: The race takes place on October 24, 2026, with different distances for children, adolescents, and adults. The event is part of the regional athletics competitions and offers the opportunity to participate in state championships as well as public race events.

name: Lauf zur Crosslauf Serie im Kreis Bernkastel-Wittlich
description: The cross-country series in the Bernkastel-Wittlich district is a traditional running event consisting of three races in Breit, Wintrich, and Bengel. The series offers courses for various age groups from children to adults, with distances ranging from 200 to 7400 meters. The races take place on diverse cross-country routes that pass through the sports field and surrounding terrain. Participants who take part in all three races receive a gift, and the series winners are honored with certificates, material prizes, and cash prizes for middle and long distances.
course_highlights: Varied course lengths from 200 m to 7400 m for all age groups
Cross-country routes around the sports field in Breit with start and finish at the festival hall
Showers and changing rooms available at the club house near the sports field
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site up to 1 hour before the start with a late registration fee of 2.00 euros. The event takes place at the sports field in Breit. Showers and changing rooms are available at the club house near the sports field. The series winners are awarded certificates and material prizes after all three races, with overall winners of middle and long distances additionally receiving cash prizes. Multiple race distances, including categories for children and adults, with medals, certificates, and prizes. The event is expected to have typical October weather with temperatures around 14°C.

name: Lusatian Race Walking
price_range: 20-40 EUR pro Veranstaltung, kostenlos für Kinder unter 15 Jahren, zusätzlich 10 EUR bei Anmeldung vor Ort

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: U18 und U20 – 20 EUR pro Veranstaltung

description: The Lusatian Race Walking is an internationally recognized race walking event taking place on October 24, 2026, at the Weinauparkstadion in Zittau. The competitions cover various distances from 1 km up to the marathon, conducted on an officially measured and certified 1 km loop on flat asphalt. The event is part of the World Race Walking Tour at Silver Level and offers both elite and public races for different age groups. The organization emphasizes professional timing, medical support, and adherence to international competition rules.
course_highlights: 1 km flat asphalt loop in Weinaupark, Zittau
Officially measured and certified course
Use of penalty zone for longer distances (5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon)
additional: Children up to 15 years start for free. Late registrations are possible until October 21, 2026, with an additional fee of 20 EUR. Accreditation and bib number distribution will take place on October 23 from 16:00 to 18:00 and on October 24 from 8:00 in the start and finish area. The marathon time limit is 4:45 hours. Doping controls will be conducted according to World Athletics and WADA standards. The race takes place on a flat asphalt course in Weinaupark in Zittau, with categories for youth, adults, and masters. Judging seminars and international competition rules are also applied.

name: NELLINGER Kirbe-Lauf
description: The Nellingen Kirbe Run is a traditional community sports event in Ostfildern-Nellingen, held annually in October. The main race covers approximately 7.3 km, with additional student and toddler runs for younger participants. The event is organized by the Turnverein Nellingen 1893 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with sporting challenge. The course runs through the village area and is closed to vehicle traffic from 1:00 PM to ensure a safe race.
course_highlights: Main race approximately 7.3 km (5 laps)
Student race approximately 1.45 km (1 lap)
Toddler race approximately 400 m for children under 8 years old
additional: The race course is closed to vehicle traffic from 1:00 PM. Parking is limited, so public transportation is recommended. Trophies are awarded to overall winners, prizes for the top three in each category, and team trophies for students, the main race, and corporate teams. Award ceremonies take place at 3:10 PM, 4:20 PM, and 4:40 PM. The event also includes local honors, medical support by the DRK Ostfildern, and nearby parking options. Registration is open from August 31 to October 20, 2026. Participation is only possible for those with sufficient physical fitness.

name: Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various race distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon, as well as children's runs. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and good organization. It offers suitable running opportunities for both ambitious runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Race distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children's runs over 1 km and 2 km
Participant records and course records for 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers not only the main races but also children's runs. There is a good mix of sporting challenge and family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. Over 800 participants in the last edition, including record times and culinary offerings, takes place in Nordwalde.

name: Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd
location: Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd, Schwäbisch Gmünd, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Alb Marathon Schwäbisch Gmünd is a traditional ultramarathon that has been held annually since 1991 in the golden October. The course covers 50 kilometers with 1100 meters of elevation gain over the Three Kaiserberge Hohenstaufen, Rechberg, and Stuifen through breathtaking scenery. In addition to the main race, there are other competitions such as the Alb Ultra with approximately 60 km, the Alb Trail with 37 km, a 25 km run, 10 km run & walk, and a children's run. The event offers a sporting spectacle for the whole family and a varied supporting program with lectures, briefings, and a pasta party.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1100 meters of elevation over the Three Kaiserberge Hohenstaufen, Rechberg, and Stuifen
Breathtaking natural and landscape experiences
Various race distances from children's run to 60 km Alb Ultra
additional: Start at all races (except Alb Trail) in Schwerzerallee at the height of the Großsporthalle. Competition center in the Großsporthalle Schwäbisch Gmünd. Electronic timing with transponder in the bib (no Champion Chip). Medal for races over 25 km included; medals for other races can be ordered online for €5. Return transport with local buses and special buses for participants with bib numbers. Supporting program on Friday evening with lectures, briefing, and pasta party (€7 contribution for food). Round course over the Kaiserberge, refreshment stations, relay and team competitions, award ceremonies, bib with RFID transponder.

name: 24. Röntgenlauf
description: The Röntgenlauf in Remscheid is a traditional scenic race with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, and ultramarathon. The half marathon is particularly popular, attracting up to 1500 participants and considered one of the largest scenic races in Germany. The courses lead through diverse natural scenery with forest paths and asphalt sections, with the half marathon covering about one-third of the Röntgenweg. There is a shuttle service from the finish back to the start for the half marathon, and environmental protection is emphasized by recommending reusable drinking containers.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races on a loop course between Hackenberg and Wuppersperre with approximately 95 m and 190 m elevation gain
Half marathon with approximately 405 m ascent and 560 m descent, part of the ultramarathon
Course through forest paths and asphalt, not suitable for spiked shoes
additional: The half marathon has an age restriction from 16 years, and the marathon and ultramarathon from 18 years. Minors require a written consent from guardians. There is clothing transport from start to finish and bus transfer from finish back to start. Participants are asked to use their own reusable drinking containers to protect the environment. Race bib, finisher medal, and refreshments are included. Courses vary from 5 km to ultramarathon (63.3 km), including children's races and scenic runs; registration until October 25, 2026.

name: 26. Dresden-Marathon / DRESDEN-MARATHON
description: The Dresden Marathon has been held regularly since 1999 at the end of October and offers a flat, fast course through the Saxon state capital with its famous sights. The route passes through the historic Old Town with the Brühlsche Terrasse, the Semper Opera, and other Baroque buildings, as well as through the lively Neustadt. Over 300 musicians and numerous bands create a special atmosphere along the course. The second half of the marathon leads through the district of Blasewitz with views of the castles on the Loschwitz Elbe hillside and the villas along Goetheallee, before returning along the Elbe to the Old Town.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Dresden's historic Old Town and Neustadt
Illuminated Waldschlößchen Tunnel and bridge, Großer Garten
Atmosphere created by over 300 musicians and bands along the route
additional: Over 300 musicians and numerous bands create a lively atmosphere along the course. There is a marathon expo, race bib distribution, and a SPARKASSEN pacemaker service. After the race, medals can be engraved, and services such as photo service, showers, changing rooms, toilets, and award ceremonies are available. The evening before, a jubilee party takes place in a festival tent behind the Heinz-Steyer Stadium (entry €25, limited participants). Multiple race disciplines, online registration, health questionnaire, event scheduled for October 24 and 25, 2026.

name: 35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklinger Volkslauf is a local race event day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat runs for adults of about 5.5 to 5.7 km as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main race is a 10 km run, the Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. Additionally, there is a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest children and a 1 km school run, allowing families and club runners to start together but separated by age groups.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Runs for adults, children, and walking/Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking options are sorted by distance and age group. There is a 400 m Bambini run and a 1 km school run. All races end at the same finish location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various running options, including walking and children's races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbster Rolandlauf is a traditional community run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, with start and finish at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children's runs to 10 kilometers for adults. The course consists of a flat 5-kilometer loop on road and mixed terrain, which also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals and certificates for the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on road and mixed terrain
Course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
10 km run consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, adolescents, adults, and seniors. Winners receive special 3D medals and certificates for the top three in each category. Typical weather in October: around 14°C, mostly cloudy with about 40 mm of precipitation. The run also supports the Anhalt Hospice Zerbst, with the event designed as a community and public race featuring medals and certificates.

name: Mainova Frankfurt Marathon
description: The Mainova Frankfurt Marathon is a special running experience with a fast course, fantastic atmosphere along the route, and an overwhelming finish in the event hall. The event offers a colorful program for the entire running family, including the classic marathon, relay marathon, mini-marathon, and Struwwelpeter run for children. The marathon covers the full distance of 42.195 kilometers through Frankfurt and is known for its great atmosphere and street festival around the event.
course_highlights: Fast course through Frankfurt
Fantastic atmosphere along the route
Finish in the beautifully illuminated festival hall
additional: The marathon starts from 10 a.m. in four waves at Friedrich-Ebert-Anlage. The finish is in the festival hall. There is an extensive supporting program with a marathon mall, pasta party, pretzel run, and street festivals. The pretzel run takes place the day before. Children's races (mini-marathon and Struwwelpeter run) also lead into the festival hall. The event is part of a large street festival in Frankfurt. Street races, registration, program for the running family, Green Marathon, pasta party, street festivals.

name: Oldenburg Marathon / Oldenburg Marathon 2026
price_range: 35 Euro für das Sportshirt (zusätzliche Startgebühren nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on October 25, 2026, offers a diverse range of running events including the EWE Marathon, public half marathon, AZO relay half marathon, 10 km Volksbank City Run, 5 km Müller & Egerer Run, and the Decathlon Kids' Miles Run. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to participate in various disciplines. The course runs through the city of Oldenburg and provides a great running experience for participants of all performance levels. Additionally, there is a high-quality, sustainable long-sleeve shirt as a special offer for registered participants.
course_highlights: Diverse courses from marathon to kids' run
Course through the city of Oldenburg
Start time at 10:00 AM for short-distance runs
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on October 11 from 11 AM at the Schlosshöfe. Pre-event check-in on Saturday from 11 AM to 6 PM is recommended. There is a group registration option. A high-quality, sustainable long-sleeve shirt by Wijld for 35 EUR is available only with registration. Race bibs can also be collected by relatives. Multiple race distances, starting points in Oldenburg, special medals, event merchandise, and information on race bibs and registration.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: The Gütersloh DJK Half Marathon is an established running event in Gütersloh, taking place on October 25, 2026. Participants can choose from a half marathon as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The courses are officially measured according to DLV standards and are suitable for record listings. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for the fastest runners in various age groups and overall classifications.
course_highlights: DLV measured half marathon course according to IAAF/AIMS standards
5 km and 10 km road races as additional competitions
Impressive awards for positions 1-6 in the overall field
additional: Certificates can be downloaded from the timing company's website www.timeteam-jung.de. Award ceremonies will take place as soon as possible after the races in a tent. Parking is available at the Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee. The DJK Gütersloh assumes no liability for accidents, thefts, or other damages. Course measurement according to DLV/IAAF/AIMS, online registration, parking at Hauptschule Nord, liability disclaimer, certificates via www.timeteam-jung.de

name: Oeventroper Volks- und Straßenlauf
location: Sportplatz 'In den Oeren', Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Arnsberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Oeventrop People's and Street Run is a local road race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop held at the sports field 'In den Oeren'. The focus is on the flat 10 km race for adults, which starts in the morning. Additionally, there is a 5 km youth run and several 1.1 km children's races, separated by age and gender. Start and finish are centrally located at the sports field, making the race family-friendly and easy to follow. The event is organized by TuS 1896 Oeventrop e.V. and is part of the Lauf Cup standings.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km loop course
5 km youth run on a flat loop
Children's races over 1.1 km separated by age and gender
additional: Start and finish are at the sports field 'In den Oeren', bringing everything together for runners and families in one place. There is a three-person team competition for the 5 km run. The children's races have separate starts for different age and gender groups. Race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Lauf Cup standings, parking at REWE and ALDI Widayweg

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on October 25, 2026, offers runners a diverse program with a marathon, half marathon, relay half marathon, 10 km city run, 5 km run, and children's miles run. The course takes participants through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its good catering and friendly atmosphere. The event is open to all performance levels and also features a public running series with additional competitions throughout the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeve shirts and extensive on-site services.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km from 10 km mark with water, sports drinks, and fruit
Showers in the sports hall of Graf Anton Günther School approximately 300 meters from the start-finish area
Changing rooms and baggage drop-off at parking deck 1 in the Schlosshöfe
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on October 11 from 11 a.m. in the Schlosshöfe. On the day of the event, distribution begins at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for all others. There is group registration available. After the race, extensive catering with drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries, and non-alcoholic wheat beer is provided. Free massages are offered by physiotherapy students. Mobile toilets and changing facilities are available. Multiple race distances, start in Wardenburg, street closures in the city center, medals for finishers, online registration possible.

name: Birkhahnlauf
location: Schneeren, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Birkhahnlauf in Schneeren is a traditional race that has been held annually for over 50 years on the last Sunday of October. The event offers courses for all age groups, from short children's runs of 500 meters to challenging 5 km and 10 km runs for adults. The race routes lead through the pine forest on paved forest paths with slightly sandy ground and no significant elevation profile, making the race a special experience in nature. A new addition is a 2.3 km course starting from the U12 age group. The family-friendly atmosphere and prompt award ceremonies with certificates and medals complete the event.
course_highlights: Race routes through pine forest on paved forest paths
Course lengths from 500 m to 10.2 km for all age groups
Kilometer markers on the 5.1 km and 10.2 km routes without significant elevation profile
additional: Start times: children 500m at 10:30 AM, 1000m at 10:45 AM, 2.3 km at 11:10 AM, 5.1 km and 10.2 km at 11:40 AM. Award ceremonies take place shortly after each race. Parking is available nearby and signposted. Registration is preferred online from August 1, 2026, with the start fee payable on site up to 20 minutes before the race begins. Race takes place in the forest, with courses from 0.5 km to 10 km, children's runs, online registration from August 1, 2026, race date October 25, 2026.

name: Drachenlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Drachenlauf: 28 Euro Davon 1 Euro als Spende für den Verein "Bunter Kreis Rheinland".

description: The Dragon Run is a challenging trail run in the Siebengebirge near Königswinter, taking place on October 25, 2026. The course leads through one of Germany's oldest nature parks and offers technically demanding trails with over a thousand meters of elevation gain, steep ascents, and long downhill sections. The race is aimed at experienced runners who want to experience nature and their limits. The event is characterized by a special atmosphere in the autumnal forest of the Rhenish Alps and promotes a sense of community among participants.
course_highlights: Technically demanding trails in the Siebengebirge Nature Park
Over a thousand meters of elevation gain with steep ascents and long downhill sections
Autumnal scenery of the Rhenish Alps
additional: Registration is exclusively possible online via raceresult.com. There is a participant limit of 555 runners. Late registrations on-site are possible if spots are still available, with a fee of 4 euros. Participants who take part for the 10th, 15th, or 20th time receive special All-Timer shirts and bibs. Shuttle buses run from the largest parking lot (REWE parking lot) to the start. The award ceremony takes place around 2 p.m. at the Heinrich-Imbusch-Haus. Registration opens on June 14, 2026, at 8 p.m.; the event takes place in autumn in the Siebengebirge; trail with technical challenges and significant elevation gain.

name: Friedrichstaler Waldlauf
description: The Friedrichstaler Forest Run is part of the Stutensee Cup and will take place for the 11th time in 2026. The event includes four scoring runs over 10 km, in which runners are automatically scored if they participate in at least three runs. The course offers an attractive running opportunity in the autumnal Friedrichstal and is suitable for runners of all performance levels. After the final run on October 25, 2026, the five fastest runners will be honored. The event is organized by TV Friedrichstal 1899 e.V., the largest club in Stutensee.
course_highlights: Four scoring runs over 10 km
Run through the autumnal Friedrichstaler Forest
Participation in at least three runs for scoring in the Stutensee Cup
additional: The award ceremony for the five fastest runners will take place after the Friedrichstaler Forest Run on October 25, 2026. Registration for the run opens in September. The scoring in the Stutensee Cup is automatic upon participation in at least three of the four 10 km runs, with the best three times counted if all four are completed. Registration opens in September, natural experience, community event.
