The event is organized by the Sportgemeinschaft Duisburg-Süd 98/20 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Loop course through Biegerpark with asphalt surface
10 km runners complete 3 laps, 5 km runners 2 laps
Last 300 meters on the stadium's cinder track
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start in limited numbers. Certificates are issued online and on-site with a waiting period. Weckmänner are provided at the finish for students and children. The event offers a sports liability insurance as part of the Sporthilfe insurance contract NRW. The last 300 meters are run on the stadium's cinder track. The course is a loop through Biegerpark with asphalt paths, with the final 300 meters on a cinder track; dates and registration via email; start times for different age groups; medals and Weckmänner for children.

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, taking place in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run on a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometers long, aiming to complete as many laps as possible within six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in a scenic environment.
course_highlights: Loop course with a length of 3.67 km
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour endurance run with individual distance
additional: The course is a loop course that is run multiple times. The event is traditional and held annually. Results from previous years can be viewed on the website. The race takes place on a 2040 m loop course, with increasing participant numbers and a legendary refreshment buffet. In 2023, a participant record was set, and the event is already fully booked for 2024. The weather in November is usually cool and rainy, which adds to the challenge.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Championships Cross Country are the official championship of the police in cross country running and focus on competition within the police force. The event takes place in the Ravensberger Forest in Potsdam and includes distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a larger German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross country experience under typical November weather conditions with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross country running in Ravensberger Forest
Officially measured courses over 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated police championships
additional: Typical weather in November: approx. 7 °C, low of 2 °C, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation and rainy days. Registration is usually through the regional athletics associations. The event is not an open street race but exclusively for police runners. No open public participation, organized within the police, with a demanding course featuring uphill and downhill sections, sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Snail Run is a traditional running event held annually at the Waldstadion Graal-Müritz. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from various distances, including a toddler course, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, good organization, and the honoring of the strongest classes and best teams. Especially popular are the cinnamon rolls, which are served after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: Red route: 2 km run
Blue route: 5 km and 10 km (two 5 km laps)
Start and finish at Waldstadion Graal-Müritz
additional: Start times: 10:00 AM for the toddler course, 10:30 AM for the 2 km run, 11:00 AM for the 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30 PM to 6:00 PM in the sports hall of the Ostseegrundschule. Traditional honors are awarded for the strongest class and best team. Cinnamon rolls are a popular refreshment after the run. The race takes place at the Waldstadion, registration is possible in advance, and there are categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

name: Gudensberger Crosslauf 2026 Hermann Kilian Gedächtnislauf
description: The Gudensberg Cross Country Hermann Kilian Memorial Run is a traditional cross country race in Gudensberg, offering short distances in the terrain. The start and finish are located on a field path and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool on Schwimmbadweg. The course mainly runs over unpaved paths, which is emphasized by the permission to wear spikes, maintaining the classic cross country character. The event commemorates Hermann Kilian, a dedicated runner and coach of TSV Obervorschütz.
course_highlights: Start and finish on a field path and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool
Course mainly over unpaved paths, spikes allowed
Three distances: 1000m (two small laps), 2000m (two large laps), 4000m (longer lap)
additional: Depending on the announcement, district championships may be integrated. Typical November weather with approximately 7°C and rainy days is expected. Weather in November is mostly rainy, terrain in cross country style, honoring Hermann Kilian, who distinguished himself through his commitment to the sport.

name: Herzowerke-Trail 2026
location: TSH sports grounds, Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 3rd Herzowerke Trail will take place on November 14, 2026, in Herzogenaurach. The trail starts and ends at the TSH sports grounds and runs through the Dohnwald around the town. There are several distances from 0.5 km to 16 km, with the longest route can be run as one or two laps. The trail is a true forest trail with the permitted use of poles, with no refreshment stations along the way, only at the start and finish areas. The event is organized by the running department of Turnerschaft Herzogenaurach.
course_highlights: Trail through the Dohnwald around Herzogenaurach
Authentic trail with permitted use of poles
Refreshments only at the start and finish areas, no supply stations along the route
additional: There are multiple distances: 0.5 km Bambini Trail, 2 km Kids Trail, 4 km Youth Trail, 8 km Speed Trail, and 16 km (one or two laps). The route is self-sufficient, with no drink or supply stations in the forest. Times, result lists, and rankings are published online. The top three will be honored. Trail with various distances, self-supply in forest sections, start and finish at the TSH sports grounds, online results and rankings, potentially cool and wet November weather.

name: Int. DEULUX-Lauf
description: The International DEULUX Race takes place annually on the second Saturday in November in Langsur and offers four different races for all age groups. From a 360-meter race for the youngest to the 10-kilometer road race, the most popular race in Rhineland-Palatinate, there is something for everyone. The event is part of the 4-Regio Cup and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can look forward to varied courses and special awards.
course_highlights: Four different races from 360 m to 10 km
Most popular 10 km road race in Rhineland-Palatinate
Family-friendly event with special awards for every participant
additional: Start times: Race for the youngest at 1:30 PM, children's race at 2:00 PM, youth race at 2:30 PM, main race at 3:00 PM. All children's races are free of charge. RFID chip timing for children's and youth races. Late registrations are not possible, not even on the day of the event. Multiple race distances, including children's and youth races, registration will open in a few weeks. The event takes place in Langsur.

name: Kerner Nachtlauf
description: The Kerner Night Run is a atmospheric autumn run taking place on Saturday evening, November 14, 2026, in Kernen. Runners start at dusk on a course approximately 4.5 km long, which runs on illuminated paths through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets around Kernen. An additional 10 km distance is also offered. The event stands for running passion and communal sports experience in a special atmosphere.
course_highlights: A round of about 4.5 km through illuminated paths
Course passes through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets
Start at dusk on Saturday evening
additional: Run through illuminated paths, options of 4.5 km and 10 km, atmosphere with lights and torches, finish at the stadium with snacks and drinks

name: Landesoffener Crosslauf des KLV Segeberg
description: The State Open Cross Country Race of the KLV Segeberg takes place annually in November at the Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park. It offers races for children, youth, adults, and masters with distances ranging from approximately 625 meters to 7.9 km. The event is open to participants from all over Schleswig-Holstein. The course runs through meadows, parks, and wooded areas, providing a varied alternative to traditional road or track races. The event is organized by KLV Segeberg and Kaltenkirchener TS, who also host on-site.
course_highlights: Course lengths from approx. 625 m to 7.9 km
Run in Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park over meadows, parks, and wooded areas
Open to all of Schleswig-Holstein with categories for children, youth, adults, and masters
additional: Typical November weather with around 7°C and rainy days. The event is part of the KLV Segeberg Cross Country Championship series, which also includes other local club locations in the Segeberg district. Cross country in November with typical weather featuring rain and temperatures around 2-7°C, outdoor terrain, suitable for trail running and cross-country enthusiasts.

name: Neusser Erftlauf
description: The Neuss Erftlauf is a traditional running event organized annually by DJK Novesia 1919 Neuss e.V. The 53rd edition will take place on November 14, 2026, and offers runners of various performance levels an attractive course along the Erft. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, good organization, and support from numerous sponsors. The 15 km main race is particularly popular and has gained many participants in recent years.
course_highlights: 15 km main race with construction site detour, 5 km loop capable of ranking lists
Course along the Erft with varied terrain
Refreshment stations and cool drinking water at the thirst quencher
additional: The Erftlauf is supported by numerous volunteers who ensure smooth operations at the course, start and finish areas, and refreshment stations. The event is sponsored by organizations such as RheinLand Versicherungsgruppe, Stadtwerke Neuss, and other partners. There is a construction site detour on the 15 km route, but the 5 km loop remains capable of ranking lists. An extensive photo album is available online. The course runs on paved paths and roads; spikes are not allowed. Registration opens online from September 1, 2025. Start times begin at 11:30 AM. Medals are awarded to children, and material prizes to winners. Limited parking is available. Showers are provided.

name: Potsdamer Cross im Rahmen der 22. DPM
description: The 2nd Potsdam Cross, part of the 22nd German Police Championships (DPM), will take place on November 14, 2026, in Potsdam. The event is organized and hosted by OSC Potsdam Luftschiffhafen e.V., Athletics Department. The event offers runners the opportunity to compete in a challenging cross-country race and to be part of a long-standing competition series. Registration is open until November 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Participation in the German Cross Championships (DPM)
Terrain outside the stadium in Potsdam
Event as part of a national championship
additional: Registration deadline is November 9, 2026; the terrain is scenic and offers a varied cross-country course

name: Potzberg-Berglauf
description: The Potzberg Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race organized by TuS Glan-Münchweiler. The course covers 8.2 kilometers with 350 meters of elevation gain and offers runners a challenging experience in the beautiful landscape around Potzberg. The race takes place annually and attracts both ambitious runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The organizer thanks the sponsors and is happy to answer any further questions.
course_highlights: Course length: 8.2 kilometers
Elevation gain: 350 meters
Landscape around Potzberg
additional: The Potzberg Mountain Run is the 4th race in the year 2026. Results from previous races are available on the website. There are no listed events or registration dates on the website. For more information, TuS Glan-Münchweiler can be reached by phone. The race is part of the Palatinate Mountain Running Cup, with categories for adults and youth, as well as convenient luggage and clothing transport to the finish line. The event takes place in November.

name: Steverlauf
location: Sportpark Senden, Senden, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Steverlauf is an established running event at Sportpark Senden, taking place annually and welcoming runners of all ages. The officially measured courses by the DLV over 5 km and 10 km lead along park and canal side paths and offer an attractive running environment. There is a separate participation option for children and adolescents at a reduced entry fee. The event takes place in all weather conditions and provides changing and shower facilities as well as catering with coffee, cake, soup, and sausages. The organizing team looks forward to numerous participants and a successful event.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses by the DLV over 5 km and 10 km
Running routes lead along park and canal side paths
Changing and shower facilities at Sportpark Senden
additional: Catering with coffee, tea, cake, cookies, as well as soup and sausages by roterkeil Senden e.V. The event takes place in all weather conditions. No liability for damages. Changing and shower facilities are available. Routes pass through Senden Castle, the canal, and Königspark; good supply of cake, drinks, and warm food; possible in any weather.

name: Waldlauf
location: Remsecker Waldlauf, Hochdorfer Wald, Büchenbach, Bayern, Germany
description: The Remsecker Waldlauf is a family-friendly run through the picturesque Hochdorfer Forest, appealing to runners of all ages and skill levels. The event offers various distances, from a toddler run to school and youth races, as well as short, medium, and long-distance runs. The diverse forest trails with muddy, uneven surfaces and small obstacles make the run an impressive and adventurous experience. The race is organized by the Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and emphasizes community and nature experience.
course_highlights: All courses lead through the beautiful Hochdorfer Forest
Muddy, uneven surfaces and narrow paths with small obstacles
Various distances for children, youth, and adults
additional: Number bib distribution on Friday from 16:30 to 18:00 and Saturday from 9:30 onwards. Each participant receives a number bib with an integrated chip. Optional recycled functional shirts can be ordered online until 05.09.2026 (Children 15 €, Adults 20 €). Late registration on the event day is possible up to 60 minutes before the start, with a late registration fee of 3 €.

name: Zeiler Waldmarathon
location: Zeil am Main, Haßberge, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Zeiler Waldmarathon takes place on November 14, 2026, in Zeil am Main and offers challenging running routes through the Haßberge Nature Park. The course mainly runs on paved forest paths with a varied route over the Schlossberg, Bischofsheimer Höhe, and past several lakes. There are competitions for marathon, half marathon, as well as walking/nordic walking over 21.1 km and 7.5 km. The event is organized by TV 1884 Zeil and features professional timing with an integrated chip.
course_highlights: Challenging course through the Haßberge Nature Park on almost continuously paved forest paths
Route over Schlossberg, Bischofsheimer Höhe, and past the Seven Lakes
Refreshment stations every 5 km with mineral water, tea, isotonic drinks, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the Setzbachbrunnen in the Zeil am Main running park. Timing with integrated chip. Marathon runners can switch to the half marathon after one lap. Parking is available at the indoor pool and school parking lot as well as Tuchanger parking lot with city bus transfer. Bib number pickup at the school on Friday evening and Saturday morning. Showers and changing rooms are available in the school gymnasium. No clothing storage at the start/finish area. Free bus transfer every 5 minutes from the school building to the start line. The course runs almost exclusively on paved forest paths in the Haßberge Nature Park. There are refreshment stations every 5 km, bib numbers with chips, parking at the indoor pool and school parking lot, as well as showers and changing rooms in the school gymnasium. Medals are awarded to all participants after the race, and there is an option for a free bus transfer.

name: 1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a diverse running experience with distances ranging from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, relay marathon, 10 km run, and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany with only 19 meters of elevation change, which favors personal best times. The event is characterized by urban flair, modern music, and green sections of the course that pass through the city center and notable hotspots of Hannover. In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a comprehensive supporting program with an expo, power party, and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with only 19 m elevation change
Course passes through the city center and notable hotspots of Hannover
Various distances from 4 to 42 km including relay and handbike
additional: Race bibs are issued at the marathon expo during the marathon weekend. The course is very flat and thus ideal for personal best times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. There is a massage area and showers. The supporting program includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, expo, and finisher party at the brewery. Free public transportation on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results, and photos can be found on the event website. The race is part of a broad running pass program with various events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organized by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It offers runners the opportunity to compete on a demanding course and experience ultimate cross-country fun. The event traditionally takes place in November in Bremen and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
Event in Bremen with a traditional character
Organized by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, teenagers, and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Geislinger Volkslauf
description: The Geislingen Volkslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Geislingen. The race offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages, including school runs and an inclusion run. The course starts at the Schlossparkhalle and is known for its varied and well-organized route. The event is a popular sports occasion in the region and is organized by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V.
course_highlights: Start at Schlossparkhalle Geislingen
School run for all school classes
Inclusion run for inclusive participation
additional: The Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, November 15, 2026. There are school runs and an inclusion run. The event is organized by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V. The start is at 10:30 AM at the Schlossparkhalle. Runners can register online until November 12, 2025; the event includes children, youth, active, and masters competitions.

name: itdesign-Nikolauslauf Probelauf
description: The itdesign Nikolauslauf in Tübingen is a traditional half marathon that has been organized by Post-SV Tübingen since 1976. The course is officially measured and recognized as a road race, making it eligible for best lists. The running route leads over finely gravelled forest paths and paved sections with moderate inclines, and several refreshment stations offer water, tea, and special sports drinks. All participants receive a high-quality functional shirt included in the entry fee, which can be picked up at the runner's expo. In addition to the main race, there is a 10 km school competition and a virtual 10 km run.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon (21.1 km), eligible for best lists
Finely gravelled forest paths and approximately 8.5 km of paved paths
Maximum elevation difference approx. 82 meters, total elevation gain approx. 300 meters
additional: Refreshments at kilometers 5, 11, and 17 with water, tea, and UltraSports products; finish line refreshments with raisin rolls, water, UltraRefresher, and warm tea; start and finish at Waldhäuser Straße 120, 72076 Tübingen, near the runner's expo; runner's expo and race office in the sports hall of the Geschwister-Scholl-Schule; free Nikolauslauf app for current information and bib management; high-quality functional shirt included in the entry fee with exchange option at the runner's expo; shirt shipping for virtual 10 km participants only within Germany. The test run takes place on November 16, 2025, is free, no registration required, run in groups with pacers, parking available at the Geschwister-Scholl-Schule, finish line refreshments with pretzels and vegetable broth, no shower facilities on site.

name: Jetzendorfer Hobby Crosslauf
description: The Jetzendorf Hobby Cross Run is a local cross-country event held at the LOWA Stadium in Jetzendorf, Bavaria. Organized by TSV Jetzendorf, the event takes place in November and offers various distances for different age groups. The event is aimed at hobby runners, families, and club athletes and is now in its 17th edition. In addition to the running competitions, there is also a Nordic walking course suitable for beginners and recreational walkers.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at LOWA Stadium Jetzendorf
Course lengths from 650 m to 5.8 km
Nordic walking course approx. 2.9 km

name: Kreis Herbst Waldlauf Meisterschaften
description: The Kreis Autumn Forest Run Championships will take place on November 15, 2026, in Usingen/Merzhausen. This event is part of the traditional competitions of the HLV-Kreis Hochtaunus and offers runners of various age groups the opportunity to compete in cross country running. The course leads through autumnal forest areas and promises a varied and natural running environment. The championships are an important date in the regional athletics calendar and promote young athletic talent.
course_highlights: Run through autumnal forest areas
Natural cross country course
Event in Usingen/Merzhausen
additional: Weather-dependent event in November, no fixed distances for all categories, regional character with multiple participating clubs

name: Lila-Eule-Cross
description: The 37th Lila-Eule-Cross in Kappeln is a traditional cross-country race along the Schlei, very popular among runners. In the last event, 308 runners reached the finish line, setting a record participation. The course features an autumnal atmosphere and is less muddy than in previous years, making the race particularly attractive. The race is organized by the Schleswig-Holstein Athletics Association e.V. and offers a sporting challenge in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race along the Schlei
Autumnal atmosphere with strong performances
Less muddy course than in previous years
additional: Cross-country race on a varied course along the Schlei, including children’s and youth races, with a focus on autumn weather and state championships.

name: Offenbacher Behörden- und Volkswaldlauf
price_range: Erwachsene 6,00 EUR, Jugendliche U18/U20 3,00 EUR, U10-U16 1,00 EUR, Nachmeldung 2,00 EUR
description: The Offenbach Authorities and People's Forest Run is a traditional race event that has been held annually since 1972. The race is aimed at municipal employees, corporate athletes, and guest runners competing on forest paths in Offenbach am Main. The course is 100% on forest trails with start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. In addition to individual competitions, there are team rankings with trophies for the winners. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers shower and changing facilities as well as free refreshments after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: Course entirely on forest paths
Start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings
Various distances for youth, adults, and walking
additional: The forest run takes place in all weather conditions. Shower and changing facilities are available on the forest recreation grounds of the Workers' Welfare Association. Free tea is offered after crossing the finish line. Award ceremonies include trophies for team winners and individual competitions. The recommended parking lot is at Nassen Dreieck opposite the city hall. The course is 100% on forest paths, with start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. Registration is open until November 6, 2025, with late registrations accepted until 9:30 a.m. on race day. Refreshments include free tea, and changing and shower facilities are available.

name: Riegeler Crosslauf - Rund um den Michaelsberg
location: Riegel am Kaiserstuhl, Freiburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 50th Riegeler Cross Run - Around the Michaelsberg is a traditional cross-country race in Riegel am Kaiserstuhl organized by TV Riegel. The event offers various distances for children, youth, open runners, and masters, including short cross-country and road races. The courses run around the Michaelsberg and provide an excellent opportunity for local runners and young athletes to gain race experience. The longest distance is 8.1 km and is open to men, women, and masters.
course_highlights: Cross-country race around the Michaelsberg
Course lengths from 0.5 km to 8.1 km
Separate starts for children, youth, open runners, and masters
additional: The program includes children's runs (520 m), youth runs (840 m, 1,400 m), a 2,900 m race for older youth and adults, and the main race over 8,100 m. Typical November weather with around 7°C and frequent rain is expected. Terrain race event, scheduled in November, with typical weather conditions around 7°C, often rainy, featuring various distances for all age groups.

name: Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition
description: The Volksbank run Cross Country Beach Edition takes place in Xanten and features the 5 km race as the main distance. The race occurs on an afternoon in November and promises a cross-country feeling on the beach, which sets it apart from a normal road race. In addition to the main distance, there are shorter runs over 400 meters and longer ones over 7.5 km, so both young athletes and experienced runners can find suitable distances. Children's and youth races are also part of the program. The finish line for all races is located at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten.
course_highlights: Cross-country feeling on the beach
Distances from 400 m to 7.5 km
Finish line at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten
additional: Typical November weather with approximately 7 °C, lows around 2 °C, and rainy weather on most days. Results are linked via RUNME.de. Children's and youth races, weather-dependent November event, outdoor atmosphere at Naturbad Xantener Südsee.

name: Finnensturm
location: Sport- und Solepark Große Wiese, Arnsberg-Hüsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Finnish Storm is an evening run in November on a joint-friendly Finnish track at the Sport and Salt Park Große Wiese in Arnsberg-Hüsten. The 1,000-meter-long and 2.50-meter-wide Finnish track offers a comfortable running surface with its soft, springy surface, which differs from asphalt or synthetic tracks. The course is illuminated in the evening, creating a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event attracts several hundred participants annually and is ideal for a November race in great spirits.
course_highlights: Running on a 1,000 m long, joint-friendly Finnish track
Soft, springy surface instead of asphalt or synthetic material
Illuminated course in the evening for a special atmosphere
additional: The Finnish track is 2.50 m wide and runs independently of the rest of the pathway system. It is illuminated from 5:00 a.m. and until 11:00 p.m. in the evening. The Sport and Salt Park Große Wiese is signposted from the Hüsten junction of the A46. The event takes place on a wood chip track in the Sport and Salt Park Hüsten, which may be wet and slippery in November due to weather conditions, with catering and showers available on site.

name: 13. Schloss Marienburg Marathon
description: The 13th Schloss Marienburg Marathon will take place on November 21, 2026, in Nordstemmen-Adensen. The scenic marathon is varied and suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The course runs through village streets, paved and unpaved field paths, forest trails, and trails with approximately 560 meters of elevation. A special highlight is the refreshment station located in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg, inviting runners to rest. The 21.1 km race course is shaped like an eight, with three refreshment stations in Adensen, offering beautiful views of the Calenberger Land and the Leinebergland in good weather.
course_highlights: Varied course with village streets, field paths, forest trails, and trails
Refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg
Loop course in the shape of an eight with approx. 560 meters of elevation and views of Calenberger Land and Leinebergland
additional: Early start marathon at 9:00 AM for runners who need more than 6 hours. Official timing with electronic measurement. Refreshments approximately every 5 km with water, tea, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and gingerbread. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and luggage storage available at the start and finish area. DRK medical service at the start/finish area and along the route. Participant limit: 550 runners, of which a maximum of 300 are half marathoners. Hilly course with trails, 560 meters of elevation, scenic views, aid stations every 5 km.

name: 4. Heartbeat Ultra
description: Heartbeat Ultra is a participatory ultra charity run in Fulda taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants run on a roughly 6 km loop up to 112 km and decide themselves when to start, pause, and finish their run. With each completed lap, donations are collected for children with half a heart to support research and joy of life. The run is open to everyone, from beginners to ultramarathon runners, and wheelchair users are also warmly welcome.
course_highlights: Loop course of approximately 6 km in Sportpark Johannisau, Fulda
Up to 112 km of donation laps
Flexible start and running time between 06:00 and 21:00
additional: The run is a charity event where every lap counts and the registration fee is fully donated. Participants receive a personal donation page where supporters can donate per lap run. There is a 400-meter children's run in the stadium, which is counted per lap. The run is also possible virtually, allowing worldwide participation. Flexible running time, virtual participation, donations for children with heart defects, registration with personal donation page, medal for the first 1500 participants.

name: 50. See-Park-Lauf
description: The 50th Bad Gandersheimer See-Park-Lauf is a traditional road race held at the Seepark in Bad Gandersheim at the end of November. Organized by SVG GW Bad Gandersheim, the race offers classifications for various age and performance groups, including boys, girls, men, women, juniors, open runners, as well as masters up to 95+. The event is closely linked to the Bad Gandersheim Secondary School, whose students and teachers actively participate and support the organizing team. After the race, results, personal certificates, and a photo gallery are made available online.
course_highlights: Road race on the grounds of the Seepark Bad Gandersheim
Separate classifications for various age and performance groups
Close connection to Bad Gandersheim Secondary School with active participation
additional: There are two distances: 400 m and 10 km. Typical November weather with a maximum of about 7 °C and rainy days is expected. The organizing team comprises about 50 people, supported by around 80 students and teachers. After the race, results, certificates, and a photo gallery are posted online. Road race in the Seepark, distances 400 m and 10 km, organized by the school, rainy weather expected in November.

name: Ainringer Crosslauf
description: The Ainringer Crosslauf is a traditional running event organized by the Ski-Club Ainring e.V., taking place in the municipality of Ainring. The start and finish are located on Schwimmbadstraße. The event offers runners the opportunity to test their endurance and running technique on varied cross-country courses. The race is part of the club's diverse sports program and is open to runners of all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Schwimmbadstraße in Ainring
Varied cross-country courses in the municipality
Traditional race event of the Ski-Club Ainring
additional: Runs take place in Ainringer Moos and around the Eschlberg area; start and finish are on Schwimmbadstraße; including children's and school races.

name: Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser
description: The Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser is a traditional race at the end of the running season, passing through the Braunsteich landscape conservation area. Notably, it features crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, offering a picturesque view over the water. The event is open to all age groups from children to seniors who enjoy running and walking. The race is part of the Dresden District Ranking and the Niederlausitz Cup and is officially recognized by the German Athletics Association in the walking category.
course_highlights: Crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge with a view over the water
Course mainly runs on public forest paths with three short sections on quiet residential dead-end streets
Autumnal November atmosphere in the Braunsteich landscape conservation area
additional: The 5 km and 10 km routes include three short sections on public roads with low traffic as they are residential dead-end streets. The rest of the course runs over moderate, partly cross-country forest paths. The race is open to all age groups and walking is officially recognized. Participant limit of 300-500, medals for finishers, registration on-site or online, free showers and changing rooms available, integrated into regional athletics.

name: Bönnigheimer Stromberglauf
description: The Bönnigheimer Stromberglauf is a traditional autumn race at the foot of the Stromberg, inspiring both top runners and hobby athletes. The event offers attractive courses through vineyards, fields, and meadows with varied elevation gains and stunning panoramic views. The 5-kilometer loop is fast and flat, while the 10-kilometer distance features challenging climbs and a motivating atmosphere. The race takes place around the Strombergkeller and is known for its lively atmosphere and support from the local community.
course_highlights: 5 km flat loop with only 20 meters of elevation through fields and residential areas
10 km challenging course with 60 meters of elevation and panoramic views over vineyards
2 km student race around the Strombergkeller on predominantly paved paths
additional: Registration is handled via the service provider raceresult. There are special categories for schools, companies, and cultural clubs with attractive prizes such as a box of Strombergkeller wine. The course is mostly paved and offers a varied challenge with around 70 meters of elevation per lap. Participants without a time goal are placed in the last start block. The event is organized by LG Neckar-Enz with support from the city of Bönnigheim. Routes over 5 km, 10 km, and 2 km; cultural activities; children and youth races; online registration.

name: Crossmeisterschaft SC Magdeburg
description: The Cross Championship SC Magdeburg is a traditional cross-country race organized by SC Magdeburg and the city of Magdeburg in Saxony-Anhalt. As a championship cross in the German athletics calendar, the race features a challenging off-road course that differs from classic track races. The event is integrated into the DLV system with official registrations, rules, and timing, and is supported by voluntary club and association culture. The races take place in November under typical cool and rainy weather conditions, offering an authentic cross-country experience for club and association runners.
course_highlights: Off-road cross-country style run, not on the track
Distances: 700 m and 1.4 km
Event within the German athletics calendar
additional: The event is officially listed in the DLV system with registrations, rules, and timing. Typical weather in November is cool (7 °C, lowest 2 °C) and rainy with an average of 45 mm precipitation. The start location is in Magdeburg, with detailed directions available. Cross-country run, distances 700 m and 1.4 km, in November with rainy weather.

name: Int. Brubbellauf
description: The International Brubbellauf in Wallenborn is a traditional race organized annually by SV Wallenborn. It takes place in November and is open to runners of all performance levels, including beginners. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and allows late registrations up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Results and certificates are available in the "Information" section on the website.
course_highlights: Course through the town center of Wallenborn
Varied program for all ages and performance levels
Late registrations possible on-site
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site up to 30 minutes before the respective start. The race distances range from 200 m to 10.2 km, including children's runs, open race, corporate run, and walking. The event takes place in mild November weather with an average temperature of 2-7°C, suitable for families, beginners, and ambitious runners.

name: Kunstweglauf Rednitzhembach
description: The Kunstweglauf in Rednitzhembach is organized by the endurance sports club PowerBärs Rednitzhembach e.V. and will take place in 2026 for the 18th time. The event combines art and sport in a unique symbiosis and is centered around the school building in Rednitzhembach, which offers optimal infrastructure with changing rooms, showers, and catering. The start and finish are located directly in front of the school, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is an established event in the region south of Nuremberg and offers a family-friendly and athletic experience in November.
course_highlights: Start and finish directly in front of the school building in Rednitzhembach
Perfect infrastructure with changing rooms, showers, and school café
Combination of art and sport in the running event
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 60 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in and around the school building, which serves as the center with an auditorium for award ceremonies and catering. The event also includes results, announcements, and photos, and is a creative connection of art and running fun in Rednitzhembach.

name: Lindenseelaufserie
location: Rüsselsheim am Lindensee, Groß-Gerau, Hesse, Germany
description: The Lindenseelauf series in Rüsselsheim at Lindensee is a traditional running event held annually. It offers runners of various age and performance levels the opportunity to run on attractive courses around Lindensee. The series is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a varied course layout. The event is organized by LG Rüsselsheim and is a regular part of the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Running routes around the picturesque Lindensee
Varied course layout for different age groups
Family-friendly and sporting atmosphere
additional: Runs in November and January, no series ranking in November and January, certificates for the top 3 in each age group and teams, award ceremony after the race

name: Lipperland Marathon
description: The Lipperland Marathon in Dörentrup offers a family-friendly and welcoming atmosphere without crowds along the streets. The event is characterized by straightforward organization and takes place in the beautiful Lipperland in autumn. Runners can look forward to great views and a pleasant atmosphere in Humfeld. The event is organized by TuS Humfeld 1911 e.V. and is open to all participants seeking a personal running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon in a family-friendly environment
Beautiful Lipperland in autumn with great views
No crowds along the streets
additional: The course runs through hilly terrain, start at the Humfeld sports hall, family-friendly, includes half marathon and round course options, registration via bank transfer

name: Nussdorflauf
description: The Nussdorflauf is a traditional running event in Nussdorf near Eberdingen, held annually in November. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, from children and school runs to beginner and panoramic runs as well as Nordic walking. All participants receive a medal, certificates, and sometimes trophies or cash prizes after crossing the finish line. The race is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and broad support from sponsors and volunteers.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
Panoramic run over 10 km with rating classes for all age groups
Courses for children, students, youth, and adults
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day from 10:30 AM in the Nussdorf community hall until 30 minutes before the respective start. All participants receive a medal and certificate. Trophies and cash prizes are awarded for the top 3 in various rating classes. Registration for children and school runs is through the schools. Various race distances, registration from 01.09.2025, participation conditions, results, and photos available online.

name: Rhädenlauf
description: The Rhädenlauf takes place on November 21, 2026, in the Rhäden Nature Reserve in Wildeck-Obersuhl. The race is organized by TV 1888 Obersuhl and is part of the 2026 competition year. The event is aimed at runners who wish to experience a natural course in a protected landscape. Since 2022, timing has been carried out with a modern ALGE system, ensuring precise results.
course_highlights: Run through the Rhäden Nature Reserve
Natural and scenic course
Modern timing system from ALGE since 2022 in use
additional: Timing is done with an ALGE timing system including a start trigger with integrated flash (E-Start). The department head is Luisa Wunn, reachable at 0177 4691132. Training times for the club are Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 5:30 PM to 7:00 PM at the stadium or the Großsporthalle Obersuhl. Course layout in the nature reserve, training plans for participants.

name: Ring Running Series 2026
description: The Ring Running Series at Hockenheimring offers a unique running experience on November 21, 2026, on an officially measured and record-eligible Formula 1 race track. The flat, continuously asphalted course runs over the legendary Grand Prix circuit with highlights such as the Motodrom, the Bernie Ecclestone Curve, and the South Curve. Participants can choose between a half marathon and a marathon and benefit from a secured course, high-quality catering, and professional timing. The event combines motorsport atmosphere with sporting challenge and is ideal for runners seeking a special route and fast times.
course_highlights: Officially measured and record-eligible course with AIMS certification
Flat, continuously asphalted race track with long straights
Passage of all highlights of Hockenheimring such as Motodrom and Bernie Ecclestone Curve
additional: Number bib distribution on November 20 and 21 on-site with personal bib and integrated timing chip. Changing facilities in the pit lane, medical assistance along the course, high-quality catering on the course and at the finish, luggage storage near the finish, jacket drop-off in the start area with return near the finish, free parking, shower facilities. The finish line is located on the original Formula 1 finish line. Schedule: Marathon start at 10:00, half marathon start at 11:00, cut-off time at 16:00, awards ceremony at 13:30. The event offers live tracking, bib distribution, overnight stays at Seehotel Ketsch, and a unique atmosphere that motivates runners to achieve personal best times.

name: Rurbrückenlauf
location: SIG Combibloc Systems, Linnich, Düren, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 12.5 km, 11.5 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Rurbrückenlauf is a running series in Linnich with start and finish at SIG Combibloc Systems. Various distances are offered for children, adolescents, and adults. For adults, there is a flat 5.2 km run as well as an 11.5 km run with a hilly profile, providing a bit more variety. The event takes place in November and is open to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at SIG Combibloc Systems in Linnich
Flat 5.2 km run for clear, flat routes
11.5 km run with a hilly profile for more variety
additional: The event includes distances from 0.5 km to 12.5 km, including children and youth runs. Typical November weather in Linnich is around 7°C with rainy days and an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Distances: 0.5 km, 1 km, 1.5 km, 4.9 km, 11.5 km, 12.5 km; start and finish at SIG Combibloc Systems; weather in November approximately 7°C, rainy; event for all age groups.

name: Schwollener Crosslauf - 2. Lauf der 17. OIE Nahecrosslaufserie
location: Schwollen, Landkreis Bad Kreuznach, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Schwollener Cross Run is the second race of the 17th OIE Nahe Cross Run Series and offers runners a varied cross-country course in the Schwollen region. The series is characterized by its family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to participate in multiple races to receive a series gift. The event is supported by dedicated volunteers and is open to runners of all ages and performance levels. The races take place on various sports fields and in natural surroundings, which makes the series particularly attractive.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in natural surroundings near Schwollen
Various distances for children, middle, and long-distance races
Part of the traditional Nahe Cross Run Series with multiple stages
additional: Each participant who takes part in at least 4 races of the series receives a series gift (sports socks for middle and long-distance races). The sock size is requested during registration. Registration is done online via the website. Due to weather-related cancellation, an alternative date has been set for another race in the series. The series includes several dates at different locations in the region. Dates at various locations, registration with sock size, series ranking, weather-dependent date changes, series gift for participants

name: Stadtwerke Night Run
description: The Stadtwerke Night Run in Sindelfingen is the perfect event to end the 2026 running season and to get participants in the Christmas spirit. Runners wear headlamps on an illuminated course, offering a special running experience in the dark. Various competitions for all age groups, from the Glow Worm Run for the youngest, school runs, to 5 km and 10 km races, ensure a diverse program. The event concludes in the Winterdörfle with Swedish fires, creating a festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Running with headlamps on illuminated courses
Various competitions for children, students, and adults
Finish in the Winterdörfle with Swedish fires

name: Werler Straßenlauf
description: The Werler Road Race is a traditional running event taking place on November 21, 2026, for the 36th time. It offers a wide range of running options with distances for children, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes. The event marks the year-end finale of the DJK competition year and invites runners of all performance levels to run with heart. The event is held in the autumnal atmosphere of Werl and combines sporting ambition with a sense of community.
course_highlights: Distances from short races up to 10 kilometers
Suitable for children, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes
Traditional event with a 36-year history
additional: Distances for children, recreational runners, and athletes; takes place on November 21, 2026; ideal for fast times and personal bests

name: Hamelner Winterlaufserie
description: The 36th ESV Cross Winter Run Series in Hameln is a traditional running event held during the cold season. The series includes various distances, such as 3 km, 5 km, and 10 km runs, which take place on challenging, partly icy cross-country courses. The races offer exciting duels and a great atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event is organized by ESV Eintracht Hameln and regularly attracts many participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses with icy ground
Distances: 3 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Exciting duels and categories for pupils and adults
additional: There are separate categories for pupils and adults. The series takes place in winter on cross-country courses that can be partly icy. The event is organized by ESV Eintracht Hameln. The series also includes categories for pupils and offers a winter running atmosphere on cross-country and road courses.

name: Wilscher Geburtstags-Etappen-Marathon
description: The VfR Wilsche-Neubokel birthday stage marathon is a special group run that annually honors all runners celebrating a milestone birthday this year. Participants run together at a moderate pace of 6:00 to 6:15 minutes per kilometer and can join at various refreshment points. At these stations, the runners are treated to culinary delights by the birthday celebrants, making the run a unique and enjoyable experience. The event combines athletic camaraderie with a festive atmosphere and is a cherished tradition of the club.
course_highlights: Group run with pace 6:00 - 6:15 min/km
Refreshment points approximately every 5-10 km with 10-minute breaks
Joining possible at each refreshment point
additional: The run honors all participants with a milestone birthday in the year. The refreshments at the stage points are lovingly prepared by the birthday celebrants. Current pictures of the run are available via an external Flickr link. Group run, approx. 6:00-6:15 min/km, registration via external link.

name: WMF BKK AST Süßen Herbstlauf
description: The WMF BKK AST Süßen Autumn Run is a traditional running event held annually in Süßen. Main races include 5 km and 11 km runs, a youth run over 1.8 km, and a walking round over 5 km. The event takes place at the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, which is open from 11:00 AM until the evening. The Autumn Run is suitable for runners of all performance levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 11 km
Youth run over 1.8 km
Walking round over 5 km
additional: The venue is the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, open from 11:00 AM until evening. There are races for various age and performance groups as well as a walking round. The event is embedded in the club life of AST Süßen. Routes are not officially measured; registration possible on-site; bibs with transponder timing; various running and walking options for all age groups.

name: Freiberger Adventslauf
description: The Freiberg Advent Run takes place on November 28, 2026, in the festively decorated city center of Freiberg and combines athletic activity with the special atmosphere of the pre-Christmas season. The race is a regional highlight with several competitions for different age groups and distances. The event attracts many runners each year and offers a festive setting with musical accompaniment, such as the Fasstrommler band "Blechlawine" on the castle square. Registration opens in June 2026 and is highly sought after due to the participant limit of 1,000 pre-registrations.
course_highlights: Festively decorated city center of Freiberg
Musical support from Fasstrommler "Blechlawine" on the castle square
Various race distances from 1 km to 12 km including relay
additional: Number bib distribution from 12:00 PM at the Rüleinsporthalle, late registrations and changes possible up to 1 hour before the start. All starts are at Café Hartmann. Start times: Bambini run at 3:00 PM, children’s 1 km run at 3:15 PM, teen run 3 km at 3:30 PM, community run 6 km at 3:45 PM, main run 12 km and relay at 4:30 PM. Participant limit of 1,000 pre-registrations. Registration opens in June 2026, late registrations on race day possible, start times: Bambini run at 3:00 PM, children’s run at 3:15 PM, teen run at 3:30 PM, community run at 3:45 PM, main run at 4:30 PM.

name: Hainberglauf
description: The Hainberglauf is a challenging trail run approximately 4.8 km long with 250 meters of elevation gain, held annually on the last Saturday in November in Stadtsteinach. The course runs through the terrain around Hainberg and requires appropriate footwear. The event is a charity run, with no registration fee, but voluntary donations are collected for social projects. The award ceremony for the Upper Franconian Mountain Running Championships takes place afterwards at the Steinachtalhalle.
course_highlights: Trail run approximately 4.8 km with 250 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Steinachtalhalle in Stadtsteinach
Challenging course run in all weather conditions
additional: Race number distribution from approximately 11:30 AM at the Steinachtalhalle. No registration fee is charged; donations are welcome. Refreshments with drinks available at the finish area. Changing clothes can be transported to the finish depending on capacity. The return journey is at participants' own responsibility, usually in groups. Traffic regulations apply. Trail run, 4.8 km, 250 meters of elevation, in all weather, online registration until 29.11.2025, start at Steinachtalhalle, refreshments at the finish, no age group awards at the ceremony.

name: Lauf gegen Gewalt
organizer: verschiedene lokale Organisationen, Stadt Weißenfels, Landkreis München, Hamburger Frauenhäuser, Tuğçe Albayrak e.V. und Stadt Bad Soden-Salmünster
price_range: 10 Euro Startgeld ab 18 Jahren (Weißenfels), sonst variabel oder null

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Für Starter ab 18 Jahren wird ein Startgeld von 10 Euro erhoben.

description: The 5th Weißenfels Run Against Violence will take place on September 2, 2026, in Klemmbergpark. With this run, we aim to send a visible message for respect, protection, and recognition of all rescue and emergency services personnel who work daily under extreme conditions for our safety. The event is open to everyone who wants to make a stand against violence, especially against assaults on fire brigade, police, emergency services, and disaster protection. Registration opens on June 1, 2026, with an entry fee of 10 euros for participants aged 18 and over.
course_highlights: Event location: Klemmbergpark in Weißenfels
Message against violence and for respect towards emergency personnel
Open participation for adults aged 18 and over
additional: Registration is possible from June 1, 2026. Support through donations to the specified account of the city of Weißenfels is encouraged. Contact options are available via the equality officer of the city of Weißenfels. Events will take place in September, November, July, and other dates in 2026, with registration starting in June or July. Donation options are available, including running, walking, and cycling.

name: Mesumer Adventslauf
description: The Mesumer Advent Run is a traditional running event in Rheine that offers various distances from 1 to 10 kilometers. In the 37th edition, over 660 runners started in pleasant temperatures and sunshine. The event is characterized by a broad participant field, including many athletes from the Emsdetten Running Community, who achieved excellent results in various age categories. The run provides an attractive competition opportunity for both ambitious and recreational runners during the Advent season.
course_highlights: Competitions over 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Participation of over 660 finishers
Top placements in various age groups

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolauslauf in Reichenbach near Lahr/Black Forest is an approved and record-eligible race by the DLV with distances of 5 km and 10 km. The course runs on a 2 x 5 km loop over asphalt and forest paths, mostly flat with slight inclines. The start and finish are located next to the Schutter river near the Geroldseckerhalle. Additionally, there is a 5.5 km walking route with a scenic course through forests and villages, offering beautiful views of Hohengeroldseck Castle.
course_highlights: 2 x 5 km loop on asphalt and forest paths
Flat course profile with slight and short inclines
Walking route with views of Hohengeroldseck Castle
additional: The start for the 5.5 km walking event is at 14:10 near the finish area. Experience shows that the start area for the 5 km and 10 km runs is very crowded, so early arrival is recommended. The walking route passes by historic and scenic points. The course includes asphalt and forest paths, with the start and finish area next to the Geroldseckerhalle. Limited parking is available; early arrival is advised.

name: Villmarer Dorflauf
description: The Villmarer Village Run is a traditional race held in Villmar at the end of November. Offered are runs over 5 km and 10 km, with youth able to participate in the adult races. The course is flat and all competitions end in the same finish area. Additionally, there are children’s and youth races, which are described in more detail in the official announcement. With its 33rd edition, the race has become a fixed part of the local running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat course
Shared finish line for all adult races
Children’s and youth races in addition to the main program
additional: The 5 km run and 5 km walk start first, followed by the 10 km run. Typical November weather in Villmar is around 7 °C with frequent rain. The race takes place in November; detailed information about registration and participation is available in the official announcement.

name: Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is a festive forest run in the Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines athletic activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through the picturesque Klövensteen Forest
Choice between 6 km and 12 km distances
Start number in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race bib distribution on the event day from 09:00 to 11:15. Start numbers in the shape of a Christmas tree, to be worn visibly on the chest. Clothing bag drop-off with coupon available at the start. No late registrations are possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Award ceremony for 6 km at 11:15, for 12 km at 13:00. The event includes bib number distribution, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Schiffenberger Wald, Gießen, is a flat race held annually in November. It offers courses over 5 km and 10 km for adults as well as competitions for children and teenagers. The event is ideal for runners seeking a fast, flat course in a natural setting. Start and finish are at the same location, with exact details available via RUNME Premium. The race takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, starting at 10:15 AM.
course_highlights: Flat course in Schiffenberger Wald
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Competitions for children and teenagers
additional: Start and finish are the same for all competitions. Exact start and finish locations are only visible with RUNME Premium. There are also walking and Nordic walking competitions over 5 km. Results are usually published shortly after the finish on the RUNME results page. The race is open to adults, children, and teenagers, with start times in the morning. Exact start and finish locations are only visible with RUNME Premium.

name: Adventslauf SV Weiden e.V.
description: The Advent Run of SV Weiden e.V. is a traditional community race that has been held for over three decades on the first Sunday of Advent in the Rottweil region, near Fuchswald on the sports grounds. The varied course mostly runs on forest and farm roads and offers a beautiful running experience for participants of all performance levels. In addition to the main race and the middle-distance race, there are also children's races and a toddler's race, making the event suitable for the whole family.
course_highlights: Course mostly on forest and farm roads
Main race 10.7 km and middle-distance race 5.9 km
Children's races and toddler's race on sports field and field paths
additional: The Advent Run is aimed at Nordic walkers, hobby, and ambitious runners. There are numerous training plans for preparation. Participant numbers exceed 200 runners, with 28 children and adolescents in the children's races. The toddler's race (350 m) takes place on the sports field. The routes are natural and family-friendly, including Nordic walking options.

name: FORD Advent-Lauf
location: Leinpfad, Daarler Brücke, Saarbrücken, Saarland, Germany
description: The FORD Advent Run is a traditional road race held at the end of November in Saarbrücken at the Daarler Bridge on the Leinpfad. It is part of the Sparkassen City Run series and offers a variety of distances including 10 km, 5 km, and 2 km for experienced runners, beginners, and children. The event is organized by SV GO! Saar 05 Leichtathletik e.V. with support from SparkasseSB, Ford, and LottoSaartoto. Registration is available via meisterchip.de, and the courses are officially measured, allowing participation in record lists.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Leinpfad Daarler Bridge in Saarbrücken
Part of the Sparkassen City Run series
Offers 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances for different runner groups
additional: Typical November weather with an average of 7 °C, lows around 2 °C, and rainy days. The race is listed in the German race calendar system, and the courses are officially measured. The event takes place in Saarbrücken, with start and finish at the Leinpfad Daarler Bridge. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and is a great opportunity to start the Advent season with a sporting event.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, which is part of the Syke-Weyher Cross-Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km school run to the 10.3 km main race, suitable for children, teenagers, and adults. The course mostly runs on forest paths with a short asphalt section before the finish line in the Syke Forest Stadium. The event offers a varied cross-country experience in an autumnal atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest paths with only about 100 m asphalt
Start and finish in the Syke Forest Stadium
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross-Series with multiple distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km school run, 3.6 km middle distance from U16, 10.3 km main race from U20. The event is part of a series of three races with series scoring when registering before the first race. Switching between middle and long distance is possible but does not count as a series switch. Forest paths, cross-country, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities in the Syke Forest Stadium.

name: Lorsbacher Winterlauf- und Walkingserie
location: Langenhainer Wald, Hofheim-Lorsbach, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Lorsbacher Winter Running and Walking Series is a traditional race series in the Langenhainer Forest near Hofheim-Lorsbach, taking place on five Sundays during the winter half-year. Participants can choose between 10 km and 20 km routes, which are permanently signposted and can also be used as walking or hiking routes. The start is free, there is no timing, and the event is based on communal running without competitive character. On race Sundays, runners are supplied with tea at a refreshment station, and after the run, there is coffee and cookies in the sports hall. On the last date, soup, wheat beer, coffee, and cake are also served.
course_highlights: Permanently signposted 10 km route in the Langenhainer Forest
Additional loop for the 20 km round, signposted from late November to mid-February
Provision of warm tea at the refreshment station near the Waldparkplatz Bahai’i (approx. km 6.4)
additional: Start is individual without timing, no registration required, participation is free with voluntary donations. Changing rooms are available in the sports hall at Schinderwald on Sundays from 8:00 to 13:00. After the run, coffee and cookies; on the last date, soup and wheat beer. Bring your own foldable cup for tea. Route profiles are available on Komoot. Routes: 10 km and 20 km, challenging and varied routes, no timing, individual starts, GPS track via Komoot, refreshment station with tea, coffee, cookies, soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake, changing rooms in the sports hall, parking at the sports field and Park&Ride, no registration required.

name: Pfungstädter Advents-Crosslauf
description: The Pfungstädter Advent Cross Run is a traditional cross-country event that will celebrate its 57th edition in 2026. The races take place on a proven course with cross-country conditions and offer attractive competitions for all age groups from children to seniors. The event is integrated into the long-distance cup and the district cross ranking of the HLV Darmstadt-Dieburg district. Start times are staggered, allowing exciting races over various distances and age groups.
course_highlights: Cross course approximately 3700 m for middle distance
Long distance approximately 7300 m over 6 cross rounds
Sprint course approximately 850 m for children and youth
additional: Race documents for schools will be issued on the hard court, all other participants will receive their documents in the youth room. No late registrations or changes on site are possible. The start times are approximate and may be slightly changed. Registration only online until 28.11.2025; no late registrations on site; catering available; toilets at Ludwig-Crössmann-Heim; no changing or shower facilities.

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. The main course covers 26 kilometers, mostly on hiking trails with scenic sections and historical references. Additionally, there is a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children's race, making it accessible for beginners. The event combines athletic challenge with nature experience and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg with approximately 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
Five refreshment points along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20, and 22.5
7.5 km scenic course around Küchensee, as well as a 1.5 km children's race with audience support
additional: New since 2022 is the intermediate timing at the 26 km course, allowing spectators and athletes to track split times. The races start simultaneously, with a sorting at the start on the right side at Königsdamm. The children's race is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de. Courses around Lake Ratzeburg and Küchensee, online registration from September 1, 2026, maximum participant numbers for each distance, timing with Race Result.

name: Schlößlelauf - 4. Lauf der Jedermannlaufserie
description: The Schlößlelauf in Donauwörth is the 4th race in the amateur running series and offers an attractive competition opportunity for runners of all ages and performance levels. The event is organized by LG Donau-Ries and traditionally takes place in late autumn. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Donauwörth and is part of a popular running series in the region. The event promotes recreational sports and is aimed at children, teenagers, and active runners.
course_highlights: Part of the amateur running series
Various categories for all age groups
Run in the historic city of Donauwörth
additional: Registration is via email, the event includes running and cycling activities as well as terrain and sport type filters.

name: Schmachtendorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Schmachtendorf Nikolaus Run is a traditional running event held at the end of November in Oberhausen-Schmachtendorf, organized by Spvgg. Sterkrade-Nord 1920/25 e.V. The event offers races for all age groups, from a 300-meter children's run to a 10 km race for adults. The course mainly runs on forest paths in Dunkelschlag and around the Buchenweg sports field. Each participant receives a Stutenkerl, and the award ceremony takes place promptly after each race with prizes for the best runners in each category.
course_highlights: 300-meter loop around the artificial turf field at Buchenweg (children's run)
10 km race mostly on forest paths in Dunkelschlag
Start and finish at Buchenweg sports field, no traditional city center course
additional: Electronic timing with chip in the start number by TAF-TIMING. Certificates are issued on the day of the event or later online. Parking is available at Heinrich-Böll-Gesamtschule and the Schmachtendorf marketplace, indicated by signs. Distances: 300 m for children, 10 km for adults; course on forest paths and sports field; categories for children and adults; weather conditions may be rainy in November.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race that takes place for the 54th time. The races lead through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather conditions. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used as preparation for cross-country championships. Various course lengths allow youths and adults to achieve personal bests or improve endurance. The Förderverein of the Remels Elementary School provides food and drinks, including coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on weather conditions
Various course lengths for different age groups
additional: Youth U14 can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m, U16 can start on the 4450 m middle distance. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m starting zone. The race uses a junction system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve, course lengths vary, registration and results online, coffee and cake from the Förderverein of the Remels Elementary School.

name: Volksbank WeinstadtCross mit DM Cross und Deutschem Cross Cup
description: The Volksbank WeinstadtCross is a traditional cross-country race taking place on November 29, 2026, in Weinstadt. The event includes school championships, children’s and youth races, and the open cross on Saturday, while the German Cross Championships are held on Sunday. The challenging course runs cross-country over uneven terrain, through mud and steep inclines, offering runners of all ages and performance levels a true running experience. The WeinstadtCross is part of the German Cross Cup and attracts participants from all over Germany.
course_highlights: Cross-country over uneven terrain
Course with mud and steep inclines
Race on a course worthy of a German Championship
additional: On Saturday (28.11.26), school championships, children’s and youth races, as well as the open cross, will take place. On Sunday (29.11.26), the German Cross Championships will be held. The event is open to all age and performance groups. It includes school, youth, and open races, takes place in typical November weather with rain and temperatures around 2-7°C, and features a challenging cross-country course with national significance.

name: Weihnachtsmarktlauf
description: The Christmas Market Run in Landstuhl is a traditional race held annually on November 30th. It offers a sporting challenge for various age groups with a main race over 7.6 km and a student race over 1.3 km. The event is organized by LLG Landstuhl e.V. and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere and a ranking for clubs and groups. Registration is open from October 15th to November 28th, with late registrations allowed on-site.
course_highlights: Main race over 7.6 km
Student race over 1.3 km
Ranking by age groups and group classification
additional: Registration is open from October 15th to November 28th. Late registrations are possible on-site. There is a performance and group ranking with prize money for the best participants and groups. The race takes place on November 30th, with online registration available, prizes for individual and group rankings, and the course runs through the festively decorated city.

name: Überruhrer Adventscrosslauf
description: The Überruhrer Advent Cross Run takes place on November 29, 2026, in Essen-Überruhr and offers a cross-country course that, fittingly for Advent, guides runners through the wintery nature. The event is open to all age groups from children to seniors and is conducted according to the German Athletics Association (DLO) regulations. The award ceremony and certificate presentation are held directly next to the race course, creating a family-friendly and sporting atmosphere. A catering stand at the finish area provides warm and cold drinks as well as snacks.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the nature of Essen-Überruhr
Classification for all age groups from U8 to seniors M/W 80
Award ceremony and certificate presentation directly next to the race course
additional: Parking is available in the adjacent residential area, with a recommended parking spot at Marktplatz Überruhr (about 500m walk). Public transport connections include bus lines SB15, 144, 166, 177. At the finish area, there is catering with cold and hot drinks, cake, and sausages. The race office is located in the park. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. The run takes place on the first Sunday of Advent, typically with November weather, temperatures around 2-7°C, often rainy. The event is open to everyone who enjoys cross-country running and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with onsite award ceremonies.

name: Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf
description: The Wiedenbrück Christkindllauf is a popular race around the Christkindlmarkt in the festively illuminated old town of Wiedenbrück. The course is a loop over five laps with a length of approximately 10.2 km and is not officially measured. The race traditionally takes place in December and offers a festive atmosphere in the city center. The event is organized by LG Burg Wiedenbrück and attracts numerous runners from the region.
course_highlights: Loop course over five laps around the Christkindlmarkt
Festively illuminated old town of Wiedenbrück
Course length approx. 10.2 km, running direction clockwise
additional: Start and finish on Lange Straße in Wiedenbrück. Distribution of race bibs on December 5, 2025 from 15:00 at the Luise-Hensel-Saal in the Stadthaus. Registration only online from October 8, 2025, 21:00. No late registrations on the event day. Time limit 75 minutes. Wearing headphones or earphones is prohibited and will lead to disqualification. Participants are asked to run as far to the right as possible and not form groups due to overtaking. Participant limit 1100, registration only online, medals can be reordered, race starts on December 4, 2026.

name: /10k Rainbow Run 2026
location: Frankfurt am Main, Frankfurt City Forest, Hesse, Germany
description: The 5/10k Rainbow Run is a forest run in the Frankfurt Stadtwald Goldstein, taking place on December 5, 2026. Participants can choose between a 5 km loop or two loops for 10 km. The course mainly runs on solid forest paths with some asphalt sections, making it suitable for both beginners and runners seeking a faster pace. The race is part of the FVV XMAS Tournament weekend and advocates against homophobia in sports by promoting an open and tolerant society. The event targets a diverse running community, including queer athletes, allies, and people of all ages and backgrounds.
course_highlights: Forest course in Frankfurt Stadtwald Goldstein
Solid forest paths with some asphalt sections
Part of the traditional FVV XMAS Tournament with over 30 years of LGBTIQ* sports history
additional: The FVV XMAS Tournament includes, besides the run, a Saturday evening party, a Sunday brunch, and a city tour. Typical December weather is around 3 °C with frequent snowfall and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Part of the FVV XMAS Tournament weekend with social events such as party, brunch, and city tour, including support for LGBTQ+ causes.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The Berlin Nikolaus Run 2026 is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke in Berlin's Grunewald. The course runs along a measured lakeside path of 5.3 kilometers, appreciated by both leisure seekers and competitive athletes. The race offers various distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. The event takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organized by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: Loop course around Schlachtensee with 5.3 km per lap
Nature-oriented route in Berlin's Grunewald with forested setting
Popular training route for top athletes and leisure runners
additional: Race bib distribution on race day from 8:00 AM at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turnaround circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Late registrations are possible online on race day, but with an additional fee. The event offers a variety of distances for runners and Nordic walkers as well as relay races. Courses range from 330 m to 26.8 km, registration online or in writing, late registrations on race day only online for a fee, race bib pickup in Berlin.

name: Forchheimer Nikolauslauf
description: The Forchheimer Nikolauslauf is a traditional running event organized by LG Forchheim on the Sports Island in Forchheim. The 46th edition will take place on December 5, 2026, and offers races for children and youth as well as a fun run over 5.3 km and a 10 km main race.
